blocks.html_en: • enhancement: forward-referenced type tests can now be open-coded by using block compilation. The result is that mutually referential defstructs are now efficiently compiled in block compilation mode, superseding a lighter mechanism that worked in fewer contexts. However, that lighter mechanism has been removed, so for now, users who want to efficiently compile mutually referential defstructs must explicitly opt-in using block compilation.

sentences.en: enhancement: forward-referenced type tests can now be open-coded by using block compilation.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：前向引用类型测试现在可以通过使用块编译进行开放编码。

sentences.en: The result is that mutually referential defstructs are now efficiently compiled in block compilation mode, superseding a lighter mechanism that worked in fewer contexts.
sentences.zh: 结果是，相互引用的 defstruct 现在可以在块编译模式下高效编译，取代了在更少上下文中工作的更轻量的机制。

sentences.en: However, that lighter mechanism has been removed, so for now, users who want to efficiently compile mutually referential defstructs must explicitly opt-in using block compilation.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种较轻的机制已被删除，因此目前，想要有效编译相互引用的 defstruct 的用户必须显式选择使用块编译。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: defstructs with empty initforms in the sbcl source are now explicitly intiialized with NIL, as that is undefined behavior under ANSI. This helps cross compilation hosts which do not implicitly initialize empty initform slots to NIL. (Thanks to Karsten Poeck)

sentences.en: bug fix: defstructs with empty initforms in the sbcl source are now explicitly intiialized with NIL, as that is undefined behavior under ANSI.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：sbcl 源中具有空 initforms 的 defstruct 现在使用 NIL 显式初始化，因为这是 ANSI 下未定义的行为。

sentences.en: This helps cross compilation hosts which do not implicitly initialize empty initform slots to NIL.
sentences.zh: 这有助于交叉编译主机不会将空的 initform 槽隐式初始化为 NIL。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Karsten Poeck)
sentences.zh: （感谢卡斯滕·波克）

• optimizations:
    • the instruction sequence for multiple-value calls is more efficient on x86-64.
    • the direction flag is now unused on x86 and x86-64 when handling an unknown number of return values. (Thanks to Fanael Linithien)
    • the x86-64 backend is better able to use memory operands for arithmetic operations.
    • compilation of TYPECASE to a jump table is enabled when all the types being tested are frozen.
    • compilation of CASE and ECASE into a jump table has been implemented on 32- and 64-bit powerpc platforms.
    • the implementation of Unicode normalization has been sped up.
    • pretty-printing dispatch on conses is faster, particularly with the standard pretty-print dispatch table. Deeply-nested forms should also pretty-print faster.

blocks.html_en:
• optimizations:
    • CASE and ECASE with symbols as keys may be optimized into a vector lookup if all result forms are quoted or self-evaluating objects.
    • CASE and ECASE can be optimized into a jump table on the x86[-64] backends with arbitrary result forms provided that the clause keys are either all fixnums, all characters, or all symbols.
    • a number of forms are converted to use CASE in circumstances where that makes sense, including calls to POSITION, MEMQ and MEMBER, and TYPECASE where the types are MEMBER/EQL types.
    • POSITION of a variable symbol in a constant sequence of symbols is converted to CASE and thence to a jump table.
    • TYPECASE of a variable where the clauses are member types is converted to CASE and thence to a jump table.
    • a number of slow instructions are no longer used on x86 and x86-64 machines. (Thanks to Fanael Linithien)
    • the compiler is better at tracking the implications of branches after EQ and EQL tests.
    • parsing &KEY lists is slightly less register-intensive.
    • a pattern-based peephole optimizer pass has been added, running some simple transformations on the x86-64 backend.

sentences.zh: 优化：如果所有结果形式都被引用或自评估对象，则以符号为键的 CASE 和 ECASE 可以优化为向量查找。

sentences.zh: 符号常量序列中变量符号的 POSITION 被转换为 CASE，然后转换为跳转表。

blocks.html_en:
• platform support:
    • many bug fixes to the experimental 64-bit PowerPC/Linux port, to the extent that the little-endian variant passes all applicable tests in the regression test suite; the big-endian variant currently has some failures
    • experimental support for sb-threads on 64-bit PowerPC/Linux
    • support threads on x86-64 Sun OS (#1841280)
    • handle PAX restrictions on mprotect() on NetBSD
    • experimental support for HaikuOS
    • the runtime is built as a position-independent executable by default on x86-64 Linux and x86-64 Darwin

sentences.en: platform support: many bug fixes to the experimental 64-bit PowerPC/Linux port, to the extent that the little-endian variant passes all applicable tests in the regression test suite; the big-endian variant currently has some failures experimental support for sb-threads on 64-bit PowerPC/Linux support threads on x86-64 Sun OS (#1841280) handle PAX restrictions on mprotect() on NetBSD experimental support for HaikuOS the runtime is built as a position-independent executable by default on x86-64 Linux and x86-64 Darwin
sentences.zh: 平台支持：对实验性 64 位 PowerPC/Linux 端口进行了许多错误修复，使得小端变体通过了回归测试套件中的所有适用测试； big-endian 变体目前存在一些故障 在 64 位 PowerPC/Linux 上对 sb 线程的实验性支持 在 x86-64 Sun OS 上支持线程 (#1841280) 在 NetBSD 上处理 mprotect() 上的 PAX 限制 对 HaikuOS 的实验性支持 默认情况下，在 x86-64 Linux 和 x86-64 Darwin 上将运行时构建为与位置无关的可执行文件

• bug fixes for issues caught by the random tester:
    • never derive the type of TRUNCATE on arbitrary numbers as the empty type. (#1838267)
    • provide out-of-line definitions for internal machinery related to FLOAT-SIGN. (#1838337)
    • include COMPLEX in the derived type of SIGNUM when appropriate. (#1838333)
    • more correct internal type testing for function types. (#1838808, #1838888, #1838986)

    • recognize that PHASE on non-positive numbers can return 0 as well as PI. (#1838892)

sentences.en: (#1838827) recognize that PHASE on non-positive numbers can return 0 as well as PI.

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the CLOBBER-IT restart for defstruct redefintion has been removed after a 15 year deprecation cycle. Use the new name, RECKLESSLY-CONTINUE. Note also that this restart is hidden if deemed unsafe due to altered placement of untagged slots in the structure.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the CLOBBER-IT restart for defstruct redefintion has been removed after a 15 year deprecation cycle.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：在 15 年弃用周期后，重新启动 defstruct 的 CLOBBER-IT 已被删除。

sentences.zh: 使用新名称“RECKLESSLY-CONTINUE”。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the reader will when feasible create new symbols using a BASE-STRING for the print name. Additionally, string literals can favor the base-string type if desired, though the default is to always return UTF-32 strings for compatibility. A preference for base-string does not disable reading Unicode. The choice is controlled via (SETF READTABLE-BASE-CHAR-PREFERENCE). If Unicode was disabled at build time, this setting does nothing.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the reader will when feasible create new symbols using a BASE-STRING for the print name.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：读者将在可行时使用 BASE-STRING 作为打印名称创建新符号。

sentences.en: Additionally, string literals can favor the base-string type if desired, though the default is to always return UTF-32 strings for compatibility.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果需要，字符串文字可以支持基本字符串类型，但默认情况下始终返回 UTF-32 字符串以实现兼容性。

sentences.en: A preference for base-string does not disable reading Unicode.
sentences.zh: 对基本字符串的首选项不会禁用读取 Unicode。

sentences.en: The choice is controlled via (SETF READTABLE-BASE-CHAR-PREFERENCE).
sentences.zh: 该选择是通过 (SETF READTABLE-BASE-CHAR-PREFERENCE) 控制的。

sentences.en: If Unicode was disabled at build time, this setting does nothing.
sentences.zh: 如果在构建时禁用 Unicode，则此设置不会执行任何操作。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SBCL generates more debug information by default.

sentences.en: enhancement: SBCL generates more debug information by default.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SBCL 默认生成更多调试信息。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: type errors provide context information, such as which variable is being bound, which slot of which structure is being set.

sentences.en: enhancement: type errors provide context information, such as which variable is being bound, which slot of which structure is being set.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：类型错误提供上下文信息，例如正在绑定哪个变量、正在设置哪个结构的哪个槽。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: if #+immobile-symbols is in build-time *FEATURES* (not enabled by default), then symbols will never be moved in memory except by SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE. Immobility has helpful implications for code generation as well as interaction with foreign routines. This feature can only be enabled if #+immobile-space is enabled.

sentences.en: enhancement: if #+immobile-symbols is in build-time *FEATURES* (not enabled by default), then symbols will never be moved in memory except by SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：如果 #+immobile-symbols 处于构建时*FEATURES*（默认情况下未启用），则符号将永远不会在内存中移动，除非通过 SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE。

sentences.en: Immobility has helpful implications for code generation as well as interaction with foreign routines.
sentences.zh: 固定性对于代码生成以及与外部例程的交互具有有益的影响。

sentences.en: This feature can only be enabled if #+immobile-space is enabled.
sentences.zh: 仅当启用 #+immobile-space 时才能启用此功能。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: undefined function errors can be restarted on x86-64, to either retry calling the function again or call a user supplied function.

sentences.en: enhancement: undefined function errors can be restarted on x86-64, to either retry calling the function again or call a user supplied function.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：未定义的函数错误可以在 x86-64 上重新启动，以再次重试调用该函数或调用用户提供的函数。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: sb-ext:restrict-compiler-policy accepts an upper bound in addition to a lower bound.

sentences.en: enhancement: sb-ext:restrict-compiler-policy accepts an upper bound in addition to a lower bound.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：sb-ext:restrict-compiler-policy 除了下限之外还接受上限。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: #+immobile-code improves the speed of function calling. Some delay may be noticed when redefining an existing function from a saved core file however.

sentences.en: enhancement: #+immobile-code improves the speed of function calling.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：#+immobile-code 提高函数调用速度。

sentences.en: Some delay may be noticed when redefining an existing function from a saved core file however.
sentences.zh: 然而，当从保存的核心文件重新定义现有函数时，可能会注意到一些延迟。

blocks.html_en: • defaults change: sb-ext:*disassemble-annotate* default to NIL, due to its poor reliability.

sentences.en: defaults change: sb-ext:*disassemble-annotate* default to NIL, due to its poor reliability.
sentences.zh: 默认更改： sb-ext:*disassemble-annotate* 默认为 NIL，因为其可靠性较差。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-LINKABLE-RUNTIME, allowing linking with extra object files to help with delivery of executables. (Thanks to François-René Rideau)

sentences.en: new feature: SB-LINKABLE-RUNTIME, allowing linking with extra object files to help with delivery of executables.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-LINKABLE-RUNTIME，允许链接额外的目标文件以帮助交付可执行文件。

sentences.en: (Thanks to François-René Rideau)
sentences.zh: （感谢弗朗索瓦·勒内·里多）

sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：SB-PCL walker 不再识别扩展为 DECLARE 表达式的宏。

sentences.en: enhancement: for several macros such as MULTIPLE-VALUE-{BIND,SETQ}, COND, DO{,*,LIST}, {RESTART,HANDLER}-{BIND,CASE}, *CASE, conditions signaled during macroexpansion point to the form that caused the problem more accurately.

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: on x86-64, compiled functions loaded from fasl files can not be moved, but can be freed, by GC. Additionally, COMPILE will produce immobile code if SB-C::*COMPILE-TO-MEMORY-SPACE* is set to :IMMOBILE. (Caution: the flag is experimental and subject to change.) The benefits are better physical separation of code from data, and potentially easier examination of live images by external tools.

sentences.en: enhancement: on x86-64, compiled functions loaded from fasl files can not be moved, but can be freed, by GC.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：在 x86-64 上，从 fasl 文件加载的编译函数无法移动，但可以通过 GC 释放。

sentences.en: Additionally, COMPILE will produce immobile code if SB-C::*COMPILE-TO-MEMORY-SPACE* is set to :IMMOBILE.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果 SB-C::*COMPILE-TO-MEMORY-SPACE* 设置为 :IMMOBILE，COMPILE 将生成不可移动代码。

sentences.en: (Caution: the flag is experimental and subject to change.)
sentences.zh: （注意：该标志是实验性的，可能会发生变化。）

sentences.en: The benefits are better physical separation of code from data, and potentially easier examination of live images by external tools.
sentences.zh: 好处是代码与数据更好的物理分离，并且可能更容易通过外部工具检查实时图像。

sentences.zh: 增强功能：SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE 的文档字符串已修改为：ROOT-STRUCTURES 参数在 gencgc 上并非毫无意义，具体取决于平台。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SET-PPRINT-DISPATCH will warn when given an expression in which any part is unrecognizable as a legal type-specifier. The dispatch table will be altered, but the new entry is disabled. Subsequent type-defining forms will cause pprint-dispatch tables to re-examine whether any disabled entries should be enabled. (#1429520)

sentences.en: enhancement: SET-PPRINT-DISPATCH will warn when given an expression in which any part is unrecognizable as a legal type-specifier.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：当给定的表达式中的任何部分都无法识别为合法类型说明符时，SET-PPRINT-DISPATCH 将发出警告。

sentences.en: The dispatch table will be altered, but the new entry is disabled.
sentences.zh: 调度表将被更改，但新条目被禁用。

sentences.en: Subsequent type-defining forms will cause pprint-dispatch tables to re-examine whether any disabled entries should be enabled.
sentences.zh: 后续的类型定义表单将导致 pprint-dispatch 表重新检查是否应启用任何禁用的条目。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: Loading code containing calls to a deprecated function will, under most circumstances, signal warnings similar to compiling such code. The usual caveat holds about not detecting calls through a computed name, as in (funcall (intern "DEPRECATED-FUN" "SB-EXT")).

sentences.en: enhancement: Loading code containing calls to a deprecated function will, under most circumstances, signal warnings similar to compiling such code.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：在大多数情况下，加载包含对已弃用函数的调用的代码将发出类似于编译此类代码的警告信号。

sentences.en: The usual caveat holds about not detecting calls through a computed name, as in (funcall (intern "DEPRECATED-FUN" "SB-EXT")).
sentences.zh: 通常的警告是不检测通过计算名称的调用，如 (funcall (intern "DEPRECATED-FUN" "SB-EXT"))。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: (SB-EXT:COMPILE-FILE-LINE) is a new macro that expands to a constant (VALUES integer integer) indicating the source line/column from which it was read, intended for logging Lisp runtime errors in a style similar to that afforded by the C preprocessor __LINE__ macro. Similarly (SB-EXT:COMPILE-FILE-POSITION) returns a position in characters.

sentences.en: enhancement: (SB-EXT:COMPILE-FILE-LINE) is a new macro that expands to a constant (VALUES integer integer) indicating the source line/column from which it was read, intended for logging Lisp runtime errors in a style similar to that afforded by the C preprocessor __LINE__ macro.
sentences.zh: 增强功能： (SB-EXT:COMPILE-FILE-LINE) 是一个新的宏，它扩展为一个常量（VALUES 整型整数），指示从中读取它的源行/列，旨在以类似于 C 预处理器 __LINE__ 宏提供的风格记录 Lisp 运行时错误。

sentences.en: Similarly (SB-EXT:COMPILE-FILE-POSITION) returns a position in characters.
sentences.zh: 类似地 (SB-EXT:COMPILE-FILE-POSITION) 返回字符位置。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change and bug fix: unboxed numeric constants on x86oids are arranged in memory differently, and the disassembler does not show them separately in DISASSEMBLE, but does if DISASSEMBLE-CODE-COMPONENT is used. (#1421987)

blocks.html_en: • optimization: The compiler's treatment of type specifiers makes it slightly faster and more memory-efficient. Portable code should be indifferent to this change, however, users of SB-INTROSPECT:FUNCTION-TYPE might notice that (MEMBER T NIL) and (MEMBER NIL T) are both internally collapsed to the former, so that the latter can never be obtained as part of an FTYPE.

sentences.en: optimization: The compiler's treatment of type specifiers makes it slightly faster and more memory-efficient.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器对类型说明符的处理使其速度稍快且内存效率更高。

sentences.en: Portable code should be indifferent to this change, however, users of SB-INTROSPECT:FUNCTION-TYPE might notice that (MEMBER T NIL) and (MEMBER NIL T) are both internally collapsed to the former, so that the latter can never be obtained as part of an FTYPE.
sentences.zh: 可移植代码应该对此变化漠不关心，但是，SB-INTROSPECT:FUNCTION-TYPE 的用户可能会注意到 (MEMBER T NIL) 和 (MEMBER NIL T) 都在内部折叠为前者，因此后者永远无法作为 FTYPE 的一部分获得。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: a TYPEP call in which the second argument is not a QUOTE form but nevertheless recognized as a compile-time constant might open-code the test. One scenario for this involves backquote, such as (TYPEP x `(my-type ,some-arg)). Code which relied upon deferring until runtime should declare (NOTINLINE TYPEP). [Due to the sematic constraints of DEFTYPE etc in in CLHS 3.2.2.3, code requiring delayed evaluation could be unportable though.]

sentences.en: optimization: a TYPEP call in which the second argument is not a QUOTE form but nevertheless recognized as a compile-time constant might open-code the test.
sentences.zh: 优化：第二个参数不是 QUOTE 形式但仍然被识别为编译时常量的 TYPEP 调用可能会打开测试代码。

sentences.en: One scenario for this involves backquote, such as (TYPEP x `(my-type ,some-arg)).
sentences.zh: 一种情况涉及反引号，例如 (TYPEP x `(my-type ,some-arg))。

sentences.en: Code which relied upon deferring until runtime should declare (NOTINLINE TYPEP). [Due to the sematic constraints of DEFTYPE etc in in CLHS 3.2.2.3, code requiring delayed evaluation could be unportable though.]
sentences.zh: 依赖于延迟到运行时的代码应该声明（NOTINLINE TYPEP）。 [由于 CLHS 3.2.2.3 中 DEFTYPE 等的语义限制，需要延迟评估的代码可能无法移植。]

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: the #\` ("backquote") reader macro was reimplemented to support robust pretty-printing. Reading a form involving #\` produces an invocation of the QUASIQUOTE ordinary macro which may contain subforms that are not lists. Code that unportably attempts operations on un-evaluated forms resulting therefrom, e.g. (SUBST a b (read-from-string "`(x (,y))")) might generate incorrect results and/or errors.

sentences.en: incompatible change: the #\` ("backquote") reader macro was reimplemented to support robust pretty-printing.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：#\`（“反引号”）读取器宏被重新实现以支持健壮的漂亮打印。

sentences.en: Reading a form involving #\` produces an invocation of the QUASIQUOTE ordinary macro which may contain subforms that are not lists.
sentences.zh: 读取涉及 #\` 的表单会生成对 QUASIQOTE 普通宏的调用，该宏可能包含非列表的子表单。

sentences.en: Code that unportably attempts operations on un-evaluated forms resulting therefrom, e.g. (SUBST a b (read-from-string "`(x (,y))")) might generate incorrect results and/or errors.
sentences.zh: 不可移植地尝试对由此产生的未评估表单进行操作的代码，例如(SUBST a b（从字符串“`(x (,y))”读取））可能会生成不正确的结果和/或错误。

• bug fixes to the x86-64 XCHG instruction:
    • it was misencoded when used with RAX, R8-R15 registers. (reported by Eric Marsden)

    • the disassembler wrongly printed XCHG RAX, R8 and the corresponding 32- and 16-bit variations as NOP.

sentences.zh: 反汇编程序错误地将 XCHG RAX、R8 以及相应的 32 位和 16 位变体打印为 NOP。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: the iterative spilling/coloring register allocator developed by Alexandra Barchunova during Google Summer of Code 2013 is now merged in. By default, it only activates for functions that optimize with (speed 3) and (> speed compilation-speed), but setting sb-regalloc:*register-allocation-method* to :iterative forces its execution. The previous behaviour can be obtained by instead setting that variable to :greedy. Thanks again to Google for their support, and, more crucially, to Alexandra Barchunova for her hard work.

sentences.en: new feature: the iterative spilling/coloring register allocator developed by Alexandra Barchunova during Google Summer of Code 2013 is now merged in.
sentences.zh: 新功能：由 Alexandra Barchunova 在 Google Summer of Code 2013 期间开发的迭代溢出/着色寄存器分配器现已合并。

sentences.en: By default, it only activates for functions that optimize with (speed 3) and (> speed compilation-speed), but setting sb-regalloc:*register-allocation-method* to :iterative forces its execution.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下，它仅针对使用 (speed 3) 和 (> speed编译速度) 优化的函数激活，但将 sb-regalloc:*register-allocation-method* 设置为 :iterative 会强制其执行。

sentences.en: The previous behaviour can be obtained by instead setting that variable to :greedy.
sentences.zh: 可以通过将该变量设置为 :greedy 来获得先前的行为。

sentences.en: Thanks again to Google for their support, and, more crucially, to Alexandra Barchunova for her hard work.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢 Google 的支持，更重要的是感谢 Alexandra Barchunova 的辛勤工作。

sentences.en: bug fix: problems with NCONC type derivation (reported by Jerry James).

sentences.en: bug fix: EXPT type derivation no longer constructs bogus floating-point types.

sentences.en: (reported by Vsevolod Dyomkin)

sentences.en: (#1187041, patch by Jerry James)
sentences.zh: （#1187041，Jerry James 的补丁）

sentences.en: bug fix: uninitialized type-error conditions can now be printed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：现在可以打印未初始化的类型错误条件。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: tests for sb-bsd-sockets no longer use a predefined port for listening, allowing several tests to run in parallel.

sentences.en: bug fix: tests for sb-bsd-sockets no longer use a predefined port for listening, allowing several tests to run in parallel.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：sb-bsd-sockets 的测试不再使用预定义端口进行监听，允许多个测试并行运行。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: during disassembly to *COMPILER-TRACE-OUTPUT* instruction prefixes as used on x86 and x86-64 no longer sometimes print incorrectly. (#1085729)

sentences.en: bug fix: during disassembly to *COMPILER-TRACE-OUTPUT* instruction prefixes as used on x86 and x86-64 no longer sometimes print incorrectly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 x86 和 x86-64 上使用的 *COMPILER-TRACE-OUTPUT* 指令前缀反汇编期间，不再有时打印错误。

sentences.en: bug fix: Specialised SIMD-PACK types can be negated.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：可以否定专用 SIMD-PACK 类型。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Modular arithmetic is more robust. (incidentally fixes another bug reported by Eric Marsden)

sentences.en: bug fix: Modular arithmetic is more robust.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：模运算更加稳健。

sentences.en: (incidentally fixes another bug reported by Eric Marsden)
sentences.zh: （顺便修复了 Eric Marsden 报告的另一个错误）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FP return values from foreign calls are always rounded to single or double float precision on x87.

sentences.en: bug fix: FP return values from foreign calls are always rounded to single or double float precision on x87.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 x87 上，外部调用的 FP 返回值始终四舍五入为单精度或双精度浮点精度。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Known-safe vector access on x86oids should not fail spuriously when the index is of the form (+ x constant-positive-integer).

sentences.en: bug fix: Known-safe vector access on x86oids should not fail spuriously when the index is of the form (+ x constant-positive-integer).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当索引的形式为 (+ x 常量正整数) 时，x86oid 上的已知安全向量访问不应意外失败。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Remove GPL-licensed files from source distribution. (#1185668)

sentences.en: bug fix: Remove GPL-licensed files from source distribution.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：从源代码分发中删除 GPL 许可的文件。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: backtrace printer no longer tries to create very large lists when the arg-count register is clobberred by other code. (#1192929)

sentences.en: bug fix: backtrace printer no longer tries to create very large lists when the arg-count register is clobberred by other code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当 arg-count 寄存器被其他代码破坏时，回溯打印机不再尝试创建非常大的列表。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: x86 should never signal an FP exception while boxing an FP value, a situation that lands us into ldb.

sentences.en: bug fix: x86 should never signal an FP exception while boxing an FP value, a situation that lands us into ldb.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：x86 在装箱 FP 值时永远不应该发出 FP 异常信号，这种情况会使我们陷入 ldb。

blocks.html_en: • notice: The implementation of MAP-ALLOCATED-OBJECTS (the heart of ROOM, plus a few SB-INTROSPECT functions) has been completely rewritten; it may now exhibit different bugs than before.

sentences.en: notice: The implementation of MAP-ALLOCATED-OBJECTS (the heart of ROOM, plus a few SB-INTROSPECT functions) has been completely rewritten; it may now exhibit different bugs than before.
sentences.zh: 注意：MAP-ALLOCATED-OBJECTS（ROOM 的核心，加上一些 SB-INTROSPECT 函数）的实现已完全重写；它现在可能会表现出与以前不同的错误。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: minimal runtime/compiler intrastructure support for SSE SIMD values, as SB-EXT:SIMD-PACK. Enabled on x86-64 via the build-time feature :sb-simd-pack. This should enable intrinsics extensions as libraries, without patching SBCL itself. Thanks to Alexander Gavrilov for maintaining a branch for so long.

sentences.en: new feature: minimal runtime/compiler intrastructure support for SSE SIMD values, as SB-EXT:SIMD-PACK.
sentences.zh: 新功能：对 SSE SIMD 值的最小运行时/编译器内部结构支持，如 SB-EXT:SIMD-PACK。

sentences.en: Enabled on x86-64 via the build-time feature :sb-simd-pack.
sentences.zh: 通过构建时功能 :sb-simd-pack 在 x86-64 上启用。

sentences.en: This should enable intrinsics extensions as libraries, without patching SBCL itself.
sentences.zh: 这应该可以将内部函数扩展作为库启用，而无需修补 SBCL 本身。

sentences.en: Thanks to Alexander Gavrilov for maintaining a branch for so long.
sentences.zh: 感谢 Alexander Gavrilov 维持了这么长时间的分支。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: RUN-PROGRAM supports a :DIRECTORY argument to set the working directory of the spawned process. (#791800) (patch by Matthias Benkard)

sentences.en: enhancement: RUN-PROGRAM supports a :DIRECTORY argument to set the working directory of the spawned process.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：RUN-PROGRAM 支持 :DIRECTORY 参数来设置生成进程的工作目录。

sentences.en: (#791800) (patch by Matthias Benkard)
sentences.zh: (#791800)（Matthias Benkard 的补丁）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: boxed vectors (vectors of T or of FIXNUM) can now be stack-allocated on PPC.

sentences.en: enhancement: boxed vectors (vectors of T or of FIXNUM) can now be stack-allocated on PPC.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：盒装向量（T 或 FIXNUM 的向量）现在可以在 PPC 上进行堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: "fixed objects" can now be stack-allocated on PPC.

sentences.en: enhancement: "fixed objects" can now be stack-allocated on PPC.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：“固定对象”现在可以在 PPC 上进行堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: WITH-PINNED-OBJECTS no longer conses on PPC/GENCGC.

sentences.en: enhancement: WITH-PINNED-OBJECTS no longer conses on PPC/GENCGC.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：WITH-PINNED-OBJECTS 不再对 PPC/GENCGC 不利。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: (sb-introspect:find-definition-sources-by-name x :vop) now also returns VOPs which do not translate any functions, and finds defoptimizer types ir2convert and stack-allocate-result.

sentences.en: enhancement: (sb-introspect:find-definition-sources-by-name x :vop) now also returns VOPs which do not translate any functions, and finds defoptimizer types ir2convert and stack-allocate-result.
sentences.zh: 增强功能： (sb-introspect:find-definition-sources-by-name x :vop) 现在还返回不转换任何函数的 VOP，并查找 defoptimizer 类型 ir2convert 和 stack-allocate-result。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: better type derivation for APPEND, NCONC, LIST. (#538957)

sentences.en: enhancement: better type derivation for APPEND, NCONC, LIST.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：更好地导出 APPEND、NCONC、LIST 的类型。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: MAP-ALLOCATED-OBJECTS (the heart of ROOM) now walks the heap in a manner similar to the GC rather than its previous ad-hoc scheme, and is therefore no less and possibly more accurate.

sentences.en: enhancement: MAP-ALLOCATED-OBJECTS (the heart of ROOM) now walks the heap in a manner similar to the GC rather than its previous ad-hoc scheme, and is therefore no less and possibly more accurate.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：MAP-ALLOCATED-OBJECTS（ROOM 的核心）现在以类似于 GC 的方式遍历堆，而不是以前的临时方案，因此同样准确，而且可能更准确。

blocks.html_en:
• fixes and enhancements related to Unicode:
    • the character database information has been updated to Unicode 6.2;
    • support for canonical and compatibility decomposition of characters has been added, along with support for primary composition;
    • support for Unicode normalization forms of strings (NFC, NFKC, NFD and NFKD) has been included;
    • querying the character database for code points not defined by Unicode gives less wrong answers (#1178038, reported by Ken Harris)

sentences.en: fixes and enhancements related to Unicode: the character database information has been updated to Unicode 6.2; support for canonical and compatibility decomposition of characters has been added, along with support for primary composition; support for Unicode normalization forms of strings (NFC, NFKC, NFD and NFKD) has been included; querying the character database for code points not defined by Unicode gives less wrong answers (#1178038, reported by Ken Harris)
sentences.zh: 与 Unicode 相关的修复和增强：字符数据库信息已更新至 Unicode 6.2；添加了对字符的规范和兼容性分解的支持，以及对主要组合的支持；已包含对字符串 Unicode 规范化形式（NFC、NFKC、NFD 和 NFKD）的支持；查询字符数据库中未由 Unicode 定义的代码点可以减少错误答案（#1178038，由 Ken Harris 报告）

blocks.html_en: • the character database information has been updated to Unicode 6.2;

sentences.en: the character database information has been updated to Unicode 6.2;
sentences.zh: 字符数据库信息已更新至Unicode 6.2；

blocks.html_en: • support for canonical and compatibility decomposition of characters has been added, along with support for primary composition;

sentences.en: support for canonical and compatibility decomposition of characters has been added, along with support for primary composition;
sentences.zh: 添加了对字符的规范和兼容性分解的支持，以及对主要组合的支持；

blocks.html_en: • support for Unicode normalization forms of strings (NFC, NFKC, NFD and NFKD) has been included;

sentences.en: support for Unicode normalization forms of strings (NFC, NFKC, NFD and NFKD) has been included;
sentences.zh: 已包含对字符串 Unicode 规范化形式（NFC、NFKC、NFD 和 NFKD）的支持；

blocks.html_en: • querying the character database for code points not defined by Unicode gives less wrong answers (#1178038, reported by Ken Harris)

sentences.en: querying the character database for code points not defined by Unicode gives less wrong answers (#1178038, reported by Ken Harris)
sentences.zh: 查询字符数据库中未由 Unicode 定义的代码点可以减少错误答案（#1178038，由 Ken Harris 报告）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: print intermediate evaluation results for some ASSERTed expressions. (#789497) (patch by Alexandra Barchunova)

sentences.en: enhancement: print intermediate evaluation results for some ASSERTed expressions.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：打印某些 ASSERTed 表达式的中间评估结果。

sentences.en: (#789497) (patch by Alexandra Barchunova)
sentences.zh: (#789497)（由 Alexandra Barchunova 提供的补丁）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: x86-64 disassemblies are annotated with unboxed constant values when there are references to (RIP-relative) unboxed constants.

sentences.en: enhancement: x86-64 disassemblies are annotated with unboxed constant values when there are references to (RIP-relative) unboxed constants.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：当引用（RIP 相关）未装箱常量时，x86-64 反汇编会使用未装箱常量值进行注释。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: type derivation for LOG{AND,IOR,XOR} scales linearly instead of quadratically with the size of the input in the worst case. (#1096444)

sentences.en: bug fix: type derivation for LOG{AND,IOR,XOR} scales linearly instead of quadratically with the size of the input in the worst case.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：LOG{AND,IOR,XOR} 的类型推导在最坏的情况下与输入的大小呈线性而不是二次缩放。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: handle errors when initializing *default-pathname-defaults*, sb-ext:*runtime-pathname*, sb-ext:*posix-argv* on startup, like character decoding errors, or directories being deleted.

sentences.en: bug fix: handle errors when initializing *default-pathname-defaults*, sb-ext:*runtime-pathname*, sb-ext:*posix-argv* on startup, like character decoding errors, or directories being deleted.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：处理启动时初始化 *default-pathname-defaults*、sb-ext:*runtime-pathname*、sb-ext:*posix-argv* 时的错误，例如字符解码错误或目录被删除。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Loading a core with a discontiguous dynamic space now correctly computes the amount of dynamic space used.

sentences.en: bug fix: Loading a core with a discontiguous dynamic space now correctly computes the amount of dynamic space used.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：加载具有不连续动态空间的核心现在可以正确计算所使用的动态空间量。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: disassembler missing ",8" on SHLD

sentences.en: bug fix: disassembler missing ",8" on SHLD
sentences.zh: 错误修复：反汇编程序在 SHLD 上缺少“,8”

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: backtracing through INTERNAL-ERROR signal handlers on systems that provide an "invalid" stack frame link for the signal handler itself now use the saved-fp-and-pc mechanism to pick up from the stack frame in the interrupt (signal) context. This is known to affect threaded FreeBSD/x86-64.

sentences.en: bug fix: backtracing through INTERNAL-ERROR signal handlers on systems that provide an "invalid" stack frame link for the signal handler itself now use the saved-fp-and-pc mechanism to pick up from the stack frame in the interrupt (signal) context.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在为信号处理程序本身提供“无效”堆栈帧链接的系统上通过内部错误信号处理程序进行回溯现在使用保存的 fp-and-pc 机制从中断（信号）上下文中的堆栈帧中获取。

sentences.en: This is known to affect threaded FreeBSD/x86-64.
sentences.zh: 已知这会影响线程 FreeBSD/x86-64。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: some LOOP statements couldn't be compiled. (#1178989)

sentences.en: bug fix: some LOOP statements couldn't be compiled.
sentences.zh: bug修复：一些LOOP语句无法编译。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: sb-sequence:dosequence works on literal vectors.

sentences.en: bug fix: sb-sequence:dosequence works on literal vectors.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：sb-sequence:dosequence 适用于文字向量。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: errors in generic arithmetic show the assembly routine's caller on x86 and x86-64. (#800343)

sentences.en: bug fix: errors in generic arithmetic show the assembly routine's caller on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：通用算术中的错误显示 x86 和 x86-64 上的汇编例程的调用者。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Compile-time type errors should never result in COMPILE-FILE failure. (#943953)

sentences.en: bug fix: Compile-time type errors should never result in COMPILE-FILE failure.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译时类型错误永远不会导致编译文件失败。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Known bad local calls do not cause strange failures when emitting or dumping code. (#504121)

sentences.en: bug fix: Known bad local calls do not cause strange failures when emitting or dumping code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：发出或转储代码时，已知的错误本地调用不会导致奇怪的失败。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Multiply-inlined structure constructor don't cause IR2-time codegen errors: type checks are inserted as necessary. (#1177703)

sentences.en: bug fix: Multiply-inlined structure constructor don't cause IR2-time codegen errors: type checks are inserted as necessary.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：多重内联结构构造函数不会导致 IR2 时间代码生成错误：根据需要插入类型检查。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Unsigned modular arithmetic is correctly converted into signed modular arithemtic (mostly to exploit fixnum-width VOPs). (#1026634)

sentences.en: bug fix: Unsigned modular arithmetic is correctly converted into signed modular arithemtic (mostly to exploit fixnum-width VOPs).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：无符号模算术被正确转换为有符号模算术（主要是为了利用固定宽度的 VOP）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a combination of inlined local function with &optional and recursion no longer causes undescriptive compiler errors. (#1180992)

sentences.en: bug fix: a combination of inlined local function with &optional and recursion no longer causes undescriptive compiler errors.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：内联本地函数与&可选和递归的组合不再导致无法描述的编译器错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: sub-word BOOLEAN alien types now disregard higher order bits when testing for non-zero-ness.

sentences.en: bug fix: sub-word BOOLEAN alien types now disregard higher order bits when testing for non-zero-ness.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：子字 BOOLEAN 外来类型现在在测试非零性时忽略高阶位。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: (CONCATENATE 'null ...) no longer fails for generic sequences. (#1162301)

sentences.en: bug fix: (CONCATENATE 'null ...)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：（连接'null ...）

sentences.en: no longer fails for generic sequences.
sentences.zh: 通用序列不再失败。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Type mismatch for the value of conditional expressions are correctly reported when detected at compile-time, instead of complaining about a constant NIL (similar for non-EQ-comparable catch tags).

sentences.en: bug fix: Type mismatch for the value of conditional expressions are correctly reported when detected at compile-time, instead of complaining about a constant NIL (similar for non-EQ-comparable catch tags).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在编译时检测到条件表达式值的类型不匹配时，会正确报告，而不是抱怨常量 NIL（与非 EQ 可比较的 catch 标记类似）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Referring to INLINE global functions as values should not result in a compilation failure. (#1035721)

sentences.en: bug fix: Referring to INLINE global functions as values should not result in a compilation failure.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：将内联全局函数引用为值不应导致编译失败。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: faster ISQRT on fixnums and small bignums

sentences.en: optimization: faster ISQRT on fixnums and small bignums
sentences.zh: 优化：在fixnums和小bignums上更快的ISQRT

blocks.html_en: • optimization: faster and smaller INTEGER-LENGTH on fixnums on x86-64.

sentences.en: optimization: faster and smaller INTEGER-LENGTH on fixnums on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：x86-64 上的 fixnums 上的 INTEGER-LENGTH 更快、更小。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: On x86-64, the number of multi-byte NOP instructions used for code alignment is now always minimal.

sentences.en: optimization: On x86-64, the number of multi-byte NOP instructions used for code alignment is now always minimal.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86-64 上，用于代码对齐的多字节 NOP 指令的数量现在始终是最少的。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: On 64-bit targets, the compiler generates much faster code for type checks for types known at compile time that are smaller than (SIGNED-BYTE 64) or (UNSIGNED-BYTE 64) and larger than FIXNUM, and their COMPLEX variants.

sentences.en: optimization: On 64-bit targets, the compiler generates much faster code for type checks for types known at compile time that are smaller than (SIGNED-BYTE 64) or (UNSIGNED-BYTE 64) and larger than FIXNUM, and their COMPLEX variants.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 64 位目标上，编译器会生成更快的代码，对编译时已知的小于 (SIGNED-BYTE 64) 或 (UNSIGNED-BYTE 64) 且大于 FIXNUM 的类型及其 COMPLEX 变体进行类型检查。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: On x86 targets, more uses of ALIEN-FUNCALL during cross compilation now inline the INVOKE-WITH-SAVED-FP-AND-PC dance.

sentences.en: optimization: On x86 targets, more uses of ALIEN-FUNCALL during cross compilation now inline the INVOKE-WITH-SAVED-FP-AND-PC dance.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86 目标上，交叉编译期间更多使用 ALIEN-FUNCALL 现在内联 INVOKE-WITH-SAVED-FP-AND-PC dance。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: ROOM no longer conses so egregiously on non-x86oid systems.

sentences.en: optimization: ROOM no longer conses so egregiously on non-x86oid systems.
sentences.zh: 优化：ROOM 在非 x86oid 系统上不再如此严重。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: associative bitwise operations reassociate patterns like (f (f x k1) k2) to expose (f x (f k1 k2)). Same for + and * of rational values.

sentences.en: optimization: associative bitwise operations reassociate patterns like (f (f x k1) k2) to expose (f x (f k1 k2)).
sentences.zh: 优化：关联按位运算重新关联 (f (f x k1) k2) 等模式以公开 (f x (f k1 k2))。

sentences.en: Same for + and * of rational values.
sentences.zh: 有理值的 + 和 * 相同。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: quasiquote expressions now perform more constant folding, instead of consing equal lists at runtime. (#1026439)

sentences.en: optimization: quasiquote expressions now perform more constant folding, instead of consing equal lists at runtime.
sentences.zh: 优化：准引用表达式现在执行更多常量折叠，而不是在运行时使用相等列表。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: local call analysis of inlined higher-order function should converge more quickly, resulting in better code for complex functions.

sentences.en: optimization: local call analysis of inlined higher-order function should converge more quickly, resulting in better code for complex functions.
sentences.zh: 优化：内联高阶函数的本地调用分析应该更快地收敛，从而为复杂函数生成更好的代码。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: On x86-64, medium (word-sized but wider than 32 bits) integer constants are handled more cleverly, especially when they can be represented as sign-extended (signed-byte 32). (Based on a patch by Douglas Katzman)

sentences.en: optimization: On x86-64, medium (word-sized but wider than 32 bits) integer constants are handled more cleverly, especially when they can be represented as sign-extended (signed-byte 32).
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86-64 上，中等（字大小但比 32 位宽）整数常量的处理更加巧妙，特别是当它们可以表示为符号扩展（有符号字节 32）时。

sentences.en: (Based on a patch by Douglas Katzman)
sentences.zh: （基于 Douglas Katzman 的补丁）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: IF/IF conversion should reliably result in sane code when (some of) the results of the inner IF are always false or always true.

sentences.en: optimization: IF/IF conversion should reliably result in sane code when (some of) the results of the inner IF are always false or always true.
sentences.zh: 优化：当（某些）内部 IF 的结果始终为 false 或始终为 true 时，IF/IF 转换应该可靠地生成正常的代码。

sentences.zh: 增强功能：对 Windows 的 MSI 安装程序支持现在使用 Windows Installer XML 至少版本 3.5，并包括各种可用性改进。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Dmitry Kalyanov and Anton Kovalenko.)
sentences.zh: （感谢德米特里·卡利亚诺夫和安东·科瓦连科。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: The sb-bsd-sockets contrib now supports non-blocking-mode on Windows. (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)

sentences.en: enhancement: The sb-bsd-sockets contrib now supports non-blocking-mode on Windows.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：sb-bsd-sockets contrib 现在支持 Windows 上的非阻塞模式。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)
sentences.zh: （感谢安东·科瓦连科。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: The Windows backend now supports the x86-64 platform. (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)

sentences.en: enhancement: The Windows backend now supports the x86-64 platform.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：Windows 后端现在支持 x86-64 平台。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)
sentences.zh: （感谢安东·科瓦连科。）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: fasls are now once again directly executable (on platforms supporting shebang lines, with a suitably-installed sbcl).

sentences.en: bug fix: fasls are now once again directly executable (on platforms supporting shebang lines, with a suitably-installed sbcl).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：fasls 现在再次可以直接执行（在支持 shebang 行的平台上，并适当安装了 sbcl）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: make.sh --help no longer runs clean.sh. (#937001)

sentences.en: bug fix: make.sh --help no longer runs clean.sh.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：make.sh --help 不再运行 clean.sh。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Fix CAS access to slots of direct instances of structure classes in the presence of subclasses sharing the same conc-name.

sentences.en: bug fix: Fix CAS access to slots of direct instances of structure classes in the presence of subclasses sharing the same conc-name.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在存在共享相同 conc-name 的子类的情况下，修复 CAS 对结构类直接实例槽的访问。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Logical pathname namestrings on Windows have been changed to be lower-case, to minimize differences between POSIX and Windows.

sentences.en: bug fix: Logical pathname namestrings on Windows have been changed to be lower-case, to minimize differences between POSIX and Windows.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：Windows 上的逻辑路径名名称字符串已更改为小写，以尽量减少 POSIX 和 Windows 之间的差异。

sentences.en: New in version 1.1.2, 2012-12-01

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • notice: System requirements for SBCL on Microsoft Windows: Windows NT 5.1 or newer (Windows XP, Server 2003) is required. Support for Windows 2000 (NT 5.0) is no longer being maintained.

sentences.en: notice: System requirements for SBCL on Microsoft Windows: Windows NT 5.1 or newer (Windows XP, Server 2003) is required.
sentences.zh: 注意：Microsoft Windows 上 SBCL 的系统要求：需要 Windows NT 5.1 或更高版本（Windows XP、Server 2003）。

sentences.en: Support for Windows 2000 (NT 5.0) is no longer being maintained.
sentences.zh: 不再维护对 Windows 2000 (NT 5.0) 的支持。

blocks.html_en: • notice: Starting with this version, SBCL on Windows no longer supports building with disabled thread support.

sentences.en: notice: Starting with this version, SBCL on Windows no longer supports building with disabled thread support.
sentences.zh: 注意：从此版本开始，Windows 上的 SBCL 不再支持使用禁用的线程支持进行构建。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: frlocks have been added to SB-CONCURRENCY contrib module.

sentences.en: enhancement: frlocks have been added to SB-CONCURRENCY contrib module.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：frlocks 已添加到 SB-CONCURRENCY contrib 模块中。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: New feature sb-dynamic-core allows the runtime to be rebuilt or relocated without requiring changes to the core file on all linkage table platforms. Required on Windows. (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)

sentences.en: enhancement: New feature sb-dynamic-core allows the runtime to be rebuilt or relocated without requiring changes to the core file on all linkage table platforms.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：新功能 sb-dynamic-core 允许重新构建或重新定位运行时，而无需更改所有链接表平台上的核心文件。

sentences.en: Required on Windows.
sentences.zh: Windows 上需要。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)
sentences.zh: （感谢安东·科瓦连科。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: Console I/O streams use UCS-2. (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)

sentences.en: enhancement: Console I/O streams use UCS-2.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：控制台 I/O 流使用 UCS-2。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)
sentences.zh: （感谢安东·科瓦连科。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: I/O on Windows unnamed pipes is interruptible asynchronously using interrupt-thread, timers when running on Windows NT version 6.1 or newer (Windows 7, Server 2008 R2). (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)

sentences.en: enhancement: I/O on Windows unnamed pipes is interruptible asynchronously using interrupt-thread, timers when running on Windows NT version 6.1 or newer (Windows 7, Server 2008 R2).
sentences.zh: 增强功能：在 Windows NT 版本 6.1 或更高版本（Windows 7、Server 2008 R2）上运行时，Windows 无名管道上的 I/O 可使用中断线程、计时器异步中断。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.)
sentences.zh: （感谢安东·科瓦连科。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: Support for the experimental safepoint-based stop-the-world protocol on the PowerPC platform.

sentences.en: enhancement: Support for the experimental safepoint-based stop-the-world protocol on the PowerPC platform.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：支持 PowerPC 平台上实验性的基于安全点的 stop-the-world 协议。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Non-blocking reads from the Windows console were not necessarily non-blocking. Thanks to Anton Kovalenko. (#308923)

sentences.en: bug fix: Non-blocking reads from the Windows console were not necessarily non-blocking.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：来自 Windows 控制台的非阻塞读取不一定是非阻塞的。

sentences.en: Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.
sentences.zh: 感谢安东·科瓦连科。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: stability of threads on Windows has been improved upon through an updated stop-the-world protocol (thanks to Anton Kovalenko).

sentences.en: bug fix: stability of threads on Windows has been improved upon through an updated stop-the-world protocol (thanks to Anton Kovalenko).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：通过更新的 stop-the-world 协议改进了 Windows 上线程的稳定性（感谢 Anton Kovalenko）。

sentences.en: New in version 1.1.1, 2012-11-02

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: WITH-COMPILATION-UNIT no longer grabs the world-lock. (COMPILE and COMPILE-FILE still do.)

sentences.en: enhancement: WITH-COMPILATION-UNIT no longer grabs the world-lock.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：WITH-COMPILATION-UNIT 不再获取世界锁。

sentences.en: (COMPILE and COMPILE-FILE still do.)
sentences.zh: （COMPILE 和 COMPILE-FILE 仍然有效。）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the SPARC backend now supports the precise generational (GENCGC) garbage collection. Enabled by default on Solaris/SPARC and Linux/SPARC. Thanks to Raymond Toy (via CMUCL).

sentences.en: optimization: the SPARC backend now supports the precise generational (GENCGC) garbage collection.
sentences.zh: 优化：SPARC 后端现在支持精确分代 (GENCGC) 垃圾收集。

sentences.en: Enabled by default on Solaris/SPARC and Linux/SPARC.
sentences.zh: 在 Solaris/SPARC 和 Linux/SPARC 上默认启用。

sentences.en: Thanks to Raymond Toy (via CMUCL).
sentences.zh: 感谢 Raymond Toy（来自 CMUCL）。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: add experimental support for the SB-THREAD feature and the timer facility on Windows. Thanks to Dmitry Kalyanov and Anton Kovalenko. Threads are enabled by default, and this version of SBCL is considered to be the last and final release to officially support building with threads disabled.

sentences.en: enhancement: add experimental support for the SB-THREAD feature and the timer facility on Windows.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：添加对 Windows 上的 SB-THREAD 功能和计时器设施的实验性支持。

sentences.en: Thanks to Dmitry Kalyanov and Anton Kovalenko.
sentences.zh: 感谢德米特里·卡利亚诺夫和安东·科瓦连科。

sentences.en: Threads are enabled by default, and this version of SBCL is considered to be the last and final release to officially support building with threads disabled.
sentences.zh: 默认情况下启用线程，此版本的 SBCL 被认为是正式支持禁用线程构建的最后一个版本。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: The compiler no longer rotates loops in some cases where this transformation actually lead to worse code being generated.

sentences.en: optimization: The compiler no longer rotates loops in some cases where this transformation actually lead to worse code being generated.
sentences.zh: 优化：在某些情况下，编译器不再旋转循环，这种转换实际上会导致生成更糟糕的代码。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-CLTL2:MACROEXPAND-ALL correctly handles shadowing of symbol-macros by lexical bindings.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-CLTL2:MACROEXPAND-ALL correctly handles shadowing of symbol-macros by lexical bindings.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-CLTL2:MACROEXPAND-ALL 通过词法绑定正确处理符号宏的遮蔽。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: stack allocation was prevented by high DEBUG declaration in several cases.

sentences.en: bug fix: stack allocation was prevented by high DEBUG declaration in several cases.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在某些情况下，高 DEBUG 声明会阻止堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-EXT:GC-LOGFILE signaled an error when no logfile was set. (thanks to SANO Masatoshi)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-EXT:GC-LOGFILE signaled an error when no logfile was set.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：未设置日志文件时，SB-EXT:GC-LOGFILE 发出错误信号。

sentences.en: (thanks to SANO Masatoshi)
sentences.zh: （感谢佐野正敏）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING performed non-native parsing when :JUNK-ALLOWED was true.

sentences.en: bug fix: PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING performed non-native parsing when :JUNK-ALLOWED was true.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当 :JUNK-ALLOWED 为 true 时，PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING 执行非本机解析。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: type derivation inferred overly conservative types for unions of array types. (#1050768)

sentences.en: bug fix: type derivation inferred overly conservative types for unions of array types.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：类型派生为数组类型的联合推断出过于保守的类型。

sentences.en: New in version 1.1.0, 2012-10-01

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: New variable, sb-ext:*disassemble-annotate* for controlling source annotation of DISASSEMBLE output. Defaults to T.

sentences.en: enhancement: New variable, sb-ext:*disassemble-annotate* for controlling source annotation of DISASSEMBLE output.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：新变量 sb-ext:*disassemble-annotate* 用于控制 DISASSSEMBLE 输出的源注释。

sentences.en: Defaults to T.
sentences.zh: 默认为 T。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: TIMEOUT arguments added to WITH-MUTEX and WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK, and WAIT-P argument added to WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK.

sentences.en: enhancement: TIMEOUT arguments added to WITH-MUTEX and WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK, and WAIT-P argument added to WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：向WITH-MUTEX 和WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK 添加了TIMEOUT 参数，向WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK 添加了WAIT-P 参数。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-EXT:ATOMIC-PUSH and SB-EXT:ATOMIC-POP allow atomic operations on list heads.

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-EXT:ATOMIC-PUSH and SB-EXT:ATOMIC-POP allow atomic operations on list heads.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-EXT:ATOMIC-PUSH 和 SB-EXT:ATOMIC-POP 允许对列表头进行原子操作。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: Optional features (not enabled by default) allow the use of signals for inter-thread synchronization to be reduced on certain supported platforms (currently Linux, Solaris, and FreeBSD on x86 and x86-64). Set (and :sb-thread :sb-safepoint :sb-thruption :sb-wtimer) to test these experimental features. Known remaining bugs include minor thread safety issues, less timely freeing of memory by GC, and certain (not yet optimally low) runtime overhead. Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.

sentences.en: enhancement: Optional features (not enabled by default) allow the use of signals for inter-thread synchronization to be reduced on certain supported platforms (currently Linux, Solaris, and FreeBSD on x86 and x86-64).
sentences.zh: 增强功能：可选功能（默认情况下未启用）允许在某些受支持的平台（当前 x86 和 x86-64 上的 Linux、Solaris 和 FreeBSD）上减少线程间同步信号的使用。

sentences.en: Set (and :sb-thread :sb-safepoint :sb-thruption :sb-wtimer) to test these experimental features.
sentences.zh: 设置（和 :sb-thread :sb-safepoint :sb-thruption :sb-wtimer）来测试这些实验性功能。

sentences.en: Known remaining bugs include minor thread safety issues, less timely freeing of memory by GC, and certain (not yet optimally low) runtime overhead.
sentences.zh: 已知的剩余错误包括较小的线程安全问题、GC 不太及时释放内存以及某些（尚未达到最佳低）运行时开销。

sentences.en: Thanks to Anton Kovalenko.
sentences.zh: 感谢安东·科瓦连科。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: CL:SORT and CL:STABLE-SORT of lists are faster and use fewer comparisons, particularly on almost-sorted inputs.

sentences.en: optimization: CL:SORT and CL:STABLE-SORT of lists are faster and use fewer comparisons, particularly on almost-sorted inputs.
sentences.zh: 优化：列表的 CL:SORT 和 CL:STABLE-SORT 速度更快，并且使用的比较次数更少，特别是在几乎排序的输入上。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Reading floats with large exponents no longer takes too much time before reporting that the exponent is too large.

sentences.en: bug fix: Reading floats with large exponents no longer takes too much time before reporting that the exponent is too large.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在报告指数太大之前，读取具有大指数的浮点数不再需要太多时间。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:SOCKET-RECEIVE with a UDP socket now works correctly when the received datagram is larger than the provided buffer. (#1023438, thanks to Robert Uhl)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:SOCKET-RECEIVE with a UDP socket now works correctly when the received datagram is larger than the provided buffer.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当接收到的数据报大于提供的缓冲区时，SB-BSD-SOCKETS：带有 UDP 套接字的 SOCKET-RECEIVE 现在可以正常工作。

sentences.en: (#1023438, thanks to Robert Uhl)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-EXT:GET-CAS-EXPANSION returned a bogus read-form when given a SYMBOL-VALUE form with a constant symbol argument.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-EXT:GET-CAS-EXPANSION returned a bogus read-form when given a SYMBOL-VALUE form with a constant symbol argument.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当给定带有常量符号参数的 SYMBOL-VALUE 形式时，SB-EXT:GET-CAS-EXPANSION 返回虚假的读取形式。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-EXT:GET-CAS-EXPANSION signaled an error when a macro expanding into a DEFCAS defined place was used as the place.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-EXT:GET-CAS-EXPANSION signaled an error when a macro expanding into a DEFCAS defined place was used as the place.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当宏扩展到 DEFCAS 定义的位置用作该位置时，SB-EXT:GET-CAS-EXPANSION 发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FIND and POSITION signaled a type-error when non-bits where looked for from bit-vectors.

sentences.en: bug fix: FIND and POSITION signaled a type-error when non-bits where looked for from bit-vectors.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当从位向量中查找非位时，FIND 和 POSITION 发出类型错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a race condition around thread creation could (in SBCL 1.0.57) lead to internal errors or crashes (#1058799).

sentences.en: bug fix: a race condition around thread creation could (in SBCL 1.0.57) lead to internal errors or crashes (#1058799).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：围绕线程创建的竞争条件可能（在 SBCL 1.0.57 中）导致内部错误或崩溃 (#1058799)。

blocks.html_en: • documentation: a section on random number generation has been added to the manual. (#656839)

sentences.en: documentation: a section on random number generation has been added to the manual.
sentences.zh: 文档：手册中添加了有关随机数生成的部分。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.58, 2012-08-06

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: implicit generic function warnings now specify the package in which the new generic function is being created.

sentences.en: enhancement: implicit generic function warnings now specify the package in which the new generic function is being created.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：隐式通用函数警告现在指定在其中创建新通用函数的包。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-EXT:ATOMIC-UPDATE makes it easy to perform non-destructive updates of CAS-able places (similar to Clojure's swap!).

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-EXT:ATOMIC-UPDATE makes it easy to perform non-destructive updates of CAS-able places (similar to Clojure's swap!).
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-EXT:ATOMIC-UPDATE 可以轻松地对支持 CAS 的位置执行非破坏性更新（类似于 Clojure 的交换！）。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: run-program no longer decodes and re-encodes environment when :environment argument is not provided. (#985904)

sentences.en: enhancement: run-program no longer decodes and re-encodes environment when :environment argument is not provided.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：当未提供 :environment 参数时，运行程序不再解码和重新编码环境。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: errors during compiler-macro expansion no longer cause runtime errors, only a compile-time warning, otherwise behaving as if the compiler macro had declined to expand.

sentences.en: enhancement: errors during compiler-macro expansion no longer cause runtime errors, only a compile-time warning, otherwise behaving as if the compiler macro had declined to expand.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：编译器宏扩展期间的错误不再导致运行时错误，只会导致编译时警告，否则表现为编译器宏拒绝扩展。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: On x86-64, code alignment of block headers is done with multi-byte NOPs now instead of repetitions of the single-byte NOP.

sentences.en: optimization: On x86-64, code alignment of block headers is done with multi-byte NOPs now instead of repetitions of the single-byte NOP.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86-64 上，块头的代码对齐现在使用多字节 NOP 完成，而不是重复单字节 NOP。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: MAP-INTO is substantially faster when the target sequence is of unknown type; mapping into lists is no longer O(N^2). (#1001043, thanks to James M. Lawrence)

sentences.en: optimization: MAP-INTO is substantially faster when the target sequence is of unknown type; mapping into lists is no longer O(N^2).
sentences.zh: 优化：当目标序列类型未知时，MAP-INTO 明显更快；映射到列表不再是 O(N^2)。

sentences.en: (#1001043, thanks to James M.
sentences.zh: （#1001043，感谢 James M.

sentences.en: Lawrence)
sentences.zh: 劳伦斯）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the compiler no longer heap-conses to check exits in cases where the exit function is dynamic extent, or when it can prove the exit function cannot escape. (#1002534)

sentences.en: optimization: the compiler no longer heap-conses to check exits in cases where the exit function is dynamic extent, or when it can prove the exit function cannot escape.
sentences.zh: 优化：在退出函数是动态范围的情况下，或者当它可以证明退出函数无法逃逸时，编译器不再使用堆控制台来检查退出。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: SB-SEQUENCE:DOSEQUENCE is faster on vectors of unknown element type, and vectors that aren't SIMPLE-ARRAYs.

sentences.en: optimization: SB-SEQUENCE:DOSEQUENCE is faster on vectors of unknown element type, and vectors that aren't SIMPLE-ARRAYs.
sentences.zh: 优化：SB-SEQUENCE:DOSEQUENCE 在未知元素类型的向量以及非 SIMPLE-ARRAY 的向量上速度更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: CL:SORT and CL:STABLE-SORT are more efficient in execution speed (around 1/3 the time in some cases), and a little better in terms of comparison calls. (Thanks to Takeru Ohta)

sentences.en: optimization: CL:SORT and CL:STABLE-SORT are more efficient in execution speed (around 1/3 the time in some cases), and a little better in terms of comparison calls.
sentences.zh: 优化：CL:SORT 和 CL:STABLE-SORT 在执行速度上更高效（在某些情况下大约是时间的 1/3），并且在比较调用方面更好一些。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Takeru Ohta)
sentences.zh: （感谢太田健）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: On SPARC, a limitation on the number of code constants emittable by the compiler has been lifted, allowing certain long functions to compiled and assembled which had previously been unsupported; fixes cl-bench on this ISA (#1008996).

sentences.en: bug fix: On SPARC, a limitation on the number of code constants emittable by the compiler has been lifted, allowing certain long functions to compiled and assembled which had previously been unsupported; fixes cl-bench on this ISA (#1008996).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 SPARC 上，取消了对编译器可发出的代码常量数量的限制，允许编译和汇编某些以前不支持的长函数；修复了此 ISA 上的 cl-bench (#1008996)。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: potential for infinite recursion during compilation of CLOS slot typechecks when dependency graph had loops. (#1001799)

sentences.en: bug fix: potential for infinite recursion during compilation of CLOS slot typechecks when dependency graph had loops.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当依赖图有循环时，CLOS 插槽类型检查编译期间可能会出现无限递归。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: error forms reported with some program-errors were not escaped properly.

sentences.en: bug fix: error forms reported with some program-errors were not escaped properly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：某些程序错误报告的错误表单未正确转义。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: functions from EVAL are now on more equal footing with functions from COMPILE. (#1000783, #851170, #922408)

sentences.en: bug fix: functions from EVAL are now on more equal footing with functions from COMPILE.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：EVAL 中的函数现在与 COMPILE 中的函数处于更加平等的地位。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ENSURE-GENERIC-METHOD-COMBINATION accepts method combination objects as its :METHOD-COMBINATION argument, not just lists designating method combinations. (#936513)

sentences.en: bug fix: ENSURE-GENERIC-METHOD-COMBINATION accepts method combination objects as its :METHOD-COMBINATION argument, not just lists designating method combinations.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ENSURE-GENERIC-METHOD-COMBINATION 接受方法组合对象作为其 :METHOD-COMBINATION 参数，而不仅仅是列出指定方法组合。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: run-program no longer unconditionally uses /tmp/ for temporary files. (#968837).

sentences.en: bug fix: run-program no longer unconditionally uses /tmp/ for temporary files.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：运行程序不再无条件使用 /tmp/ 作为临时文件。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: restore build on solaris/sparc. (#1008506)

blocks.html_en:
• RANDOM enhancements and bug fixes:
    • bug fix: the range and distribution of random integers could be catastrophically wrong when the compiler derived the type of its argument as a disjoint set of small integers.
    • bug fix: the distribution of random integers is now completely uniform even when the specified limit is not a power of two. (Previously some values could be about 0.1 % more probable than others in the worst case.) (#309467)
    • RANDOM on large integer arguments is generally faster and conses less than before; this is visible for fixnums above a length of about 24 bits, but extremely so for bignums: the old implementation used time and space quadratical in the size of the argument there, the new one is linear.

sentences.en: RANDOM enhancements and bug fixes: bug fix: the range and distribution of random integers could be catastrophically wrong when the compiler derived the type of its argument as a disjoint set of small integers.
sentences.zh: 随机增强功能和错误修复：错误修复：当编译器将其参数类型派生为不相交的小整数集时，随机整数的范围和分布可能会出现灾难性错误。

sentences.en: bug fix: the distribution of random integers is now completely uniform even when the specified limit is not a power of two.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：即使指定的限制不是 2 的幂，随机整数的分布现在也是完全均匀的。

sentences.en: (Previously some values could be about 0.1 % more probable than others in the worst case.)
sentences.zh: （以前，在最坏的情况下，某些值的概率可能比其他值高 0.1% 左右。）

sentences.en: (#309467) RANDOM on large integer arguments is generally faster and conses less than before; this is visible for fixnums above a length of about 24 bits, but extremely so for bignums: the old implementation used time and space quadratical in the size of the argument there, the new one is linear.
sentences.zh: (#309467) 大整数参数上的 RANDOM 通常比以前更快、更简洁；这对于长度超过 24 位的 Fixnum 来说是可见的，但对于 Bignum 来说尤其如此：旧的实现使用的时间和空间与参数的大小呈二次方，而新的实现是线性的。

blocks.html_en:
• enhancements to building SBCL using make.sh:
    • --fancy can be specified to enable all supported feature enhancements.
    • --with-<feature> and --without-<feature> can be used to specify which features to build with.
    • --arch option can be used to specify the architecture to build for. (Mainly useful for building 32-bit SBCL's on x86-64 hosts, not full-blows cross-compilation.)

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: BACKTRACE and DESCRIBE now bind *PRINT-CIRCLE* to T, and generally behave better when errors occur during printing.

sentences.en: enhancement: BACKTRACE and DESCRIBE now bind *PRINT-CIRCLE* to T, and generally behave better when errors occur during printing.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：BACKTRACE 和 DESCRIBE 现在将 *PRINT-CIRCLE* 绑定到 T，并且在打印期间发生错误时通常表现得更好。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: the test runner now takes a --report-skipped-tests argument to report the individual tests skipped as well as the number of skipped tests.

sentences.en: enhancement: the test runner now takes a --report-skipped-tests argument to report the individual tests skipped as well as the number of skipped tests.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：测试运行程序现在采用 --report-skipped-tests 参数来报告跳过的各个测试以及跳过的测试数量。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: undefined functions now appear in backtraces as ("undefined function") instead of ("bogus stack frame") on x86oids.

sentences.en: enhancement: undefined functions now appear in backtraces as ("undefined function") instead of ("bogus stack frame") on x86oids.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：在 x86oid 上，未定义的函数现在在回溯中显示为（“未定义函数”）而不是（“虚假堆栈帧”）。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: detected deadlocks no longer cause stderr to be spammed, and deadlock errors are reported in an easier-to-decipher manner.

sentences.en: enhancement: detected deadlocks no longer cause stderr to be spammed, and deadlock errors are reported in an easier-to-decipher manner.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：检测到的死锁不再导致 stderr 被垃圾邮件发送，并且死锁错误以更容易破译的方式报告。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: DESCRIBE on type designators reports the expansion in more cases.

sentences.en: enhancement: DESCRIBE on type designators reports the expansion in more cases.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：类型指示符上的 DESCRIBE 报告更多情况下的扩展。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SBCL now provides either an explicit :BIG-ENDIAN or :LITTLE-ENDIAN in *FEATURES*, instead of :BIG-ENDIAN being implied by lack of the :LITTLE-ENDIAN feature. (Thanks to Luís Oliveira, #901661)

sentences.en: enhancement: SBCL now provides either an explicit :BIG-ENDIAN or :LITTLE-ENDIAN in *FEATURES*, instead of :BIG-ENDIAN being implied by lack of the :LITTLE-ENDIAN feature.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SBCL 现在在 *FEATURES* 中提供显式 :BIG-ENDIAN 或 :LITTLE-ENDIAN，而不是因缺乏 :LITTLE-ENDIAN 功能而隐含 :BIG-ENDIAN。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Luís Oliveira, #901661)
sentences.zh: （感谢路易斯·奥利维拉，#901661）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: better disassembly of segment-prefixes on x86 and other instruction prefixes (e.g. LOCK) on x86 and x86-64.

sentences.en: enhancement: better disassembly of segment-prefixes on x86 and other instruction prefixes (e.g. LOCK) on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：更好地反汇编 x86 上的段前缀以及 x86 和 x86-64 上的其他指令前缀（例如 LOCK）。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: FIND and POSITION on bit-vectors are orders of magnitude faster (assuming KEY and TEST are not used, or are sufficiently trivial.)

sentences.en: optimization: FIND and POSITION on bit-vectors are orders of magnitude faster (assuming KEY and TEST are not used, or are sufficiently trivial.)
sentences.zh: 优化：位向量上的 FIND 和 POSITION 速度快了几个数量级（假设未使用 KEY 和 TEST，或者它们足够简单。）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: SUBSEQ on vectors of unknown element type is substantially faster. (#902537)

sentences.en: optimization: SUBSEQ on vectors of unknown element type is substantially faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：未知元素类型向量上的 SUBSEQ 速度要快得多。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: specialized arrays with non-zero :INITIAL-ELEMENT can be stack-allocated. (#902351)

sentences.en: optimization: specialized arrays with non-zero :INITIAL-ELEMENT can be stack-allocated.
sentences.zh: 优化：具有非零 :INITIAL-ELEMENT 的专用数组可以进行堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the compiler is smarter about representation selection for floating point constants used in full calls.

sentences.en: optimization: the compiler is smarter about representation selection for floating point constants used in full calls.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器对于完整调用中使用的浮点常量的表示选择更加智能。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the compiler no longer refuses to coerce large fixnums to single floats inline, except on x86 where this limitation is still necessary.

sentences.en: optimization: the compiler no longer refuses to coerce large fixnums to single floats inline, except on x86 where this limitation is still necessary.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器不再拒绝将大的 fixnum 强制为内联的单个浮点数，但在 x86 上，此限制仍然是必要的。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: truncation operations on integers with constant divisor arguments 1 and -1 are optimized away.

sentences.en: optimization: truncation operations on integers with constant divisor arguments 1 and -1 are optimized away.
sentences.zh: 优化：对具有常数除数参数 1 和 -1 的整数的截断操作被优化掉。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: deadlock detection could report the same deadlock twice, for two different threads. Now a single deadlock is reported exactly once.

sentences.en: bug fix: deadlock detection could report the same deadlock twice, for two different threads.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：死锁检测可能会针对两个不同的线程报告相同的死锁两次。

sentences.en: Now a single deadlock is reported exactly once.
sentences.zh: 现在，单个死锁只报告一次。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: interval-arithmetic division during type derivation did not account for signed zeros.

sentences.en: bug fix: interval-arithmetic division during type derivation did not account for signed zeros.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：类型推导期间的区间算术除法未考虑有符号零。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: compiler error when typechecking a call to a function with non-constant keyword arguments.

sentences.en: bug fix: compiler error when typechecking a call to a function with non-constant keyword arguments.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对具有非常量关键字参数的函数调用进行类型检查时出现编译器错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: misoptimization of TRUNCATE causing erratic behaviour.

sentences.en: bug fix: misoptimization of TRUNCATE causing erratic behaviour.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：TRUNCATE 的错误优化导致不稳定的行为。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: condition slot accessors no longer cause undefined function style-warnings when used in the :REPORT clause of the DEFINE-CONDITION form that defines them. (#896379)

sentences.en: bug fix: condition slot accessors no longer cause undefined function style-warnings when used in the :REPORT clause of the DEFINE-CONDITION form that defines them.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：条件槽访问器在定义它们的 DEFINE-CONDITION 形式的 :REPORT 子句中使用时不再导致未定义的函数样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DEFGENERIC warns about unsupported declarations, as specified by ANSI. (#894202)

sentences.en: bug fix: DEFGENERIC warns about unsupported declarations, as specified by ANSI.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DEFGENERIC 警告有关 ANSI 指定的不支持的声明。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SUBTYPEP tests involving forward-referenced classes no longer bogusly report NIL, T.

sentences.en: bug fix: SUBTYPEP tests involving forward-referenced classes no longer bogusly report NIL, T.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：涉及前向引用类的 SUBTYPEP 测试不再错误地报告 NIL、T。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: bogus style-warnings for DEFMETHOD forms that both declared some required arguments ignored and performed assignments to others. (#898331)

sentences.en: bug fix: bogus style-warnings for DEFMETHOD forms that both declared some required arguments ignored and performed assignments to others.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DEFMETHOD 表单的虚假样式警告，该表单既声明了一些必需的参数被忽略，又对其他参数执行了赋值。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: *EVALUATOR-MODE* :COMPILE treated (LET () ...) identically to (LOCALLY ...) leading to internally inconsistent toplevel-formness.

sentences.en: bug fix: *EVALUATOR-MODE* :COMPILE treated (LET () ...)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：*EVALUATOR-MODE*：COMPILE 处理 (LET () ...)

sentences.en: identically to (LOCALLY ...)
sentences.zh: 与（本地...）相同

sentences.en: leading to internally inconsistent toplevel-formness.
sentences.zh: 导致内部不一致的顶层形式。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: non-toplevel DEFSTRUCT signaled a style warning for unknown type.

sentences.en: bug fix: non-toplevel DEFSTRUCT signaled a style warning for unknown type.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：非顶级 DEFSTRUCT 发出未知类型的样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: redefining a function whose previous definition contained an unknown type no longer causes a style-warning. (#806243)

sentences.en: bug fix: redefining a function whose previous definition contained an unknown type no longer causes a style-warning.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：重新定义先前定义包含未知类型的函数不再导致样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: undefined functions now appear in backtraces as ("undefined function") instead of ("bogus stack frame") on non-x86oids.

sentences.en: bug fix: undefined functions now appear in backtraces as ("undefined function") instead of ("bogus stack frame") on non-x86oids.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在非 x86oid 上，未定义的函数现在在回溯中显示为（“未定义函数”）而不是（“虚假堆栈帧”）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: backtraces are no longer cut off at ("undefined function") when called under certain circumstances (involving a caller-allocated stack frame) on PPC.

sentences.en: bug fix: backtraces are no longer cut off at ("undefined function") when called under certain circumstances (involving a caller-allocated stack frame) on PPC.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 PPC 上的某些情况下（涉及调用者分配的堆栈帧）调用时，回溯不再在（“未定义函数”）处被切断。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: RUN-PROGRAM leaked a file-descriptor per call on non-Windows systems. (regression since 1.0.53)

sentences.en: bug fix: RUN-PROGRAM leaked a file-descriptor per call on non-Windows systems.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：RUN-PROGRAM 在非 Windows 系统上每次调用都会泄漏文件描述符。

sentences.en: (regression since 1.0.53)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: GC deadlocks from dladdr() on certain platforms.

sentences.en: bug fix: GC deadlocks from dladdr() on certain platforms.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：某些平台上 dladdr() 的 GC 死锁。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: broken standard streams no longer automatically cause recursive errors on debugger entry.

sentences.en: bug fix: broken standard streams no longer automatically cause recursive errors on debugger entry.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：损坏的标准流不再自动导致调试器条目出现递归错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: build ignored --dynamic-space-size=<size> argument to make.sh (regression since 1.0.53)

sentences.en: bug fix: build ignored --dynamic-space-size=<size> argument to make.sh (regression since 1.0.53)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：构建忽略了 make.sh 的 --dynamic-space-size=<size> 参数（自 1.0.53 以来的回归）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: attempts to stack allocate a required argument to a function with an external entry point caused compiler-errors.

sentences.en: bug fix: attempts to stack allocate a required argument to a function with an external entry point caused compiler-errors.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：尝试将所需参数堆栈分配给具有外部入口点的函数会导致编译器错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: compiler notes for failed stack allocation for a function argument no longer claim to be unable to stack allocate the function.

sentences.en: bug fix: compiler notes for failed stack allocation for a function argument no longer claim to be unable to stack allocate the function.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译器对函数参数的堆栈分配失败的注释不再声明无法堆栈分配该函数。

blocks.html_en:
• thread-related enhancements: (This work has been funded by the SBCL Threading 2011 IndieGoGo campaign. Many thanks to generous donors!)
    • Threading is now more reliable on non-Linux platforms. We still don't consider threads on non-Linux platforms good enough to enable them by default, but they're in a clearly better shape now.
    • Deadlines supported now on all platforms.
    • All blocking functions in the threading API now have a :TIMEOUT argument.
    • Semaphore notification objects have been added to SB-THREAD.
    • SB-CONCURRENCY contrib now includes Allegro-style GATE objects.
    • SB-EXT:COMPARE-AND-SWAP has been extended to support SLOT-VALUE, STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS, and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS.
    • Users can now defined new places usable with SB-EXT:COMPARE-AND-SWAP using an API anologous to defining new SETFable places.

blocks.html_en:
• GC-related enhancements and bug fixes:
    • --dynamic-space-size and --control-stack-size now understand Kb, Mb, and Gb suffixes. Default is megabytes as before.
    • on GENCGC targets, the default dynamic space size is now 512Mb for 32-bit systems, and 1Gb for 64-bit systems. (OpenBSD/x86-64 is the only exception, defaulting to mere 444Mb to fit under default ulimits.) The new defaults are in place to prevent hitting swap on low-end systems. Use build-time option --dynamic-space-size to build an SBCL with another default, or the runtime option to adjust the size at startup: a good size is at most equal to the amount of physical memory the system has.
    • on GENCGC targets, nursery and generation sizes now default to 5% of dynamic-space size.
    • on GENCGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ no longer categorically refuses to create SIMPLE-FUN objects.
    • on 64-bit GENCGC targets, setting the nursery size above 4Gb now works. (#870868)
    • on CHENEYGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ now does the same validation of pointer objects as GENCGC does, instead of a comparatively weak bounds-check against the heap spaces.

sentences.zh: GC 相关的增强功能和错误修复：--dynamic-space-size 和 --control-stack-size 现在可以理解 Kb、Mb 和 Gb 后缀。

sentences.zh: 和以前一样默认为兆字节。
