sentences.zh: 在 64 位 GENCGC 目标上，现在可以将 Nursery 大小设置为 4Gb 以上。

sentences.en: (#870868) on CHENEYGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ now does the same validation of pointer objects as GENCGC does, instead of a comparatively weak bounds-check against the heap spaces.
sentences.zh: (#870868) 在 CHENEYGC 目标上，SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ 现在对指针对象进行与 GENCGC 相同的验证，而不是针对堆空间进行相对较弱的边界检查。

blocks.html_en: • --dynamic-space-size and --control-stack-size now understand Kb, Mb, and Gb suffixes. Default is megabytes as before.

sentences.en: --dynamic-space-size and --control-stack-size now understand Kb, Mb, and Gb suffixes.
sentences.zh: --dynamic-space-size 和 --control-stack-size 现在可以理解 Kb、Mb 和 Gb 后缀。

sentences.en: Default is megabytes as before.
sentences.zh: 和以前一样默认为兆字节。

blocks.html_en: • on GENCGC targets, the default dynamic space size is now 512Mb for 32-bit systems, and 1Gb for 64-bit systems. (OpenBSD/x86-64 is the only exception, defaulting to mere 444Mb to fit under default ulimits.) The new defaults are in place to prevent hitting swap on low-end systems. Use build-time option --dynamic-space-size to build an SBCL with another default, or the runtime option to adjust the size at startup: a good size is at most equal to the amount of physical memory the system has.

sentences.en: on GENCGC targets, the default dynamic space size is now 512Mb for 32-bit systems, and 1Gb for 64-bit systems.
sentences.zh: 在 GENCGC 目标上，32 位系统的默认动态空间大小现在为 512Mb，64 位系统的默认动态空间大小为 1Gb。

sentences.en: (OpenBSD/x86-64 is the only exception, defaulting to mere 444Mb to fit under default ulimits.)
sentences.zh: （OpenBSD/x86-64 是唯一的例外，默认仅为 444Mb 以适应默认 ulimits。）

sentences.en: The new defaults are in place to prevent hitting swap on low-end systems.
sentences.zh: 新的默认设置是为了防止在低端系统上发生交换。

sentences.en: Use build-time option --dynamic-space-size to build an SBCL with another default, or the runtime option to adjust the size at startup: a good size is at most equal to the amount of physical memory the system has.
sentences.zh: 使用构建时选项 --dynamic-space-size 构建具有另一个默认值的 SBCL，或使用运行时选项在启动时调整大小：好的大小最多等于系统拥有的物理内存量。

blocks.html_en: • on GENCGC targets, nursery and generation sizes now default to 5% of dynamic-space size.

sentences.en: on GENCGC targets, nursery and generation sizes now default to 5% of dynamic-space size.
sentences.zh: 在 GENCGC 目标上，托儿所和生成大小现在默认为动态空间大小的 5%。

blocks.html_en: • on GENCGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ no longer categorically refuses to create SIMPLE-FUN objects.

sentences.en: on GENCGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ no longer categorically refuses to create SIMPLE-FUN objects.
sentences.zh: 在 GENCGC 目标上，SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ 不再断然拒绝创建 SIMPLE-FUN 对象。

blocks.html_en: • on 64-bit GENCGC targets, setting the nursery size above 4Gb now works. (#870868)

sentences.en: on 64-bit GENCGC targets, setting the nursery size above 4Gb now works.
sentences.zh: 在 64 位 GENCGC 目标上，现在可以将 Nursery 大小设置为 4Gb 以上。

blocks.html_en: • on CHENEYGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ now does the same validation of pointer objects as GENCGC does, instead of a comparatively weak bounds-check against the heap spaces.

sentences.en: on CHENEYGC targets, SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ now does the same validation of pointer objects as GENCGC does, instead of a comparatively weak bounds-check against the heap spaces.
sentences.zh: 在 CHENEYGC 目标上，SB-KERNEL:MAKE-LISP-OBJ 现在对指针对象进行与 GENCGC 相同的验证，而不是针对堆空间进行相对较弱的边界检查。

blocks.html_en:
• SB-BSD-SOCKETS bug fixes:
    • GET-PROTOCOL-BY-NAME had a significant memory leak.
    • GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS small amounts of memory on systems with getaddrinfo().
    • GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS weren't thread or interrupt safe outside systems with getaddrinfo().

sentences.en: SB-BSD-SOCKETS bug fixes: GET-PROTOCOL-BY-NAME had a significant memory leak.
sentences.zh: SB-BSD-SOCKETS 错误修复：GET-PROTOCOL-BY-NAME 存在严重内存泄漏。

sentences.en: GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS small amounts of memory on systems with getaddrinfo().
sentences.zh: 使用 getaddrinfo() 的系统上的 GET-HOST-BY-NAME 和 GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS 会占用少量内存。

sentences.en: GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS weren't thread or interrupt safe outside systems with getaddrinfo().
sentences.zh: GET-HOST-BY-NAME 和 GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS 不是使用 getaddrinfo() 的线程或中断安全外部系统。

blocks.html_en: • GET-PROTOCOL-BY-NAME had a significant memory leak.

blocks.html_en: • GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS small amounts of memory on systems with getaddrinfo().

sentences.en: GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS small amounts of memory on systems with getaddrinfo().
sentences.zh: 使用 getaddrinfo() 的系统上的 GET-HOST-BY-NAME 和 GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS 会占用少量内存。

blocks.html_en: • GET-HOST-BY-NAME and GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS weren't thread or interrupt safe outside systems with getaddrinfo().

sentences.zh: GET-HOST-BY-NAME 和 GET-HOST-BY-ADDRESS 不是使用 getaddrinfo() 的线程或中断安全外部系统。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: ASDF has been updated 2.019.

sentences.en: enhancement: ASDF has been updated 2.019.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：ASDF 已更新 2.019。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: special-case TCO prevention for functions which never return extended to untrusted types, keeping one more frame's worth of debug information around in many cases.

sentences.en: enhancement: special-case TCO prevention for functions which never return extended to untrusted types, keeping one more frame's worth of debug information around in many cases.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：针对永远不会返回扩展为不受信任类型的函数的特殊情况 TCO 预防，在许多情况下保留多一帧的调试信息。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: debug-names of anonymous and local function are more descriptive. Affects backtraces and SB-SPROF results. (#805100)

sentences.en: enhancement: debug-names of anonymous and local function are more descriptive.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：匿名函数和本地函数的调试名称更具描述性。

sentences.en: Affects backtraces and SB-SPROF results.
sentences.zh: 影响回溯和 SB-SPROF 结果。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: on win32, ABS of complex floats guards better against overflows. (#888410)

sentences.en: enhancement: on win32, ABS of complex floats guards better against overflows.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：在 win32 上，复杂浮动的 ABS 可以更好地防止溢出。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: RUN-PROGRAM now distinguishes exec() failing from child process exiting with code 1. (#676987)

sentences.en: enhancement: RUN-PROGRAM now distinguishes exec() failing from child process exiting with code 1.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：RUN-PROGRAM 现在可以区分 exec() 失败与以代码 1 退出的子进程。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: convenience function SET-SBCL-SOURCE-LOCATION for informing the system where on the filesystem the SBCL sources themselves are located. (Thanks to Zach Beane)

sentences.en: enhancement: convenience function SET-SBCL-SOURCE-LOCATION for informing the system where on the filesystem the SBCL sources themselves are located.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：方便的函数 SET-SBCL-SOURCE-LOCATION 用于通知系统 SBCL 源本身在文件系统上的位置。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Zach Beane)
sentences.zh: （感谢扎克·比恩）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: the compiler is now able to derive tighter bounds for floating point numbers in some cases. (Thanks to Lutz Euler, #894498)

sentences.en: enhancement: the compiler is now able to derive tighter bounds for floating point numbers in some cases.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：编译器现在能够在某些情况下为浮点数得出更严格的界限。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Lutz Euler, #894498)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Lutz Euler，#894498）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: on 64-bit targets, atomic-incf/aref does index computation correctly, even on wide-fixnum builds. (#887220)

sentences.en: bug fix: on 64-bit targets, atomic-incf/aref does index computation correctly, even on wide-fixnum builds.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 64 位目标上，atomic-incf/aref 可以正确执行索引计算，即使在 Wide-fixnum 构建上也是如此。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: (DIRECTORY "foo/*/*.*") did not follow symlinks in foo/ that resolved to directories.

sentences.en: bug fix: (DIRECTORY "foo/*/*.*") did not follow symlinks in foo/ that resolved to directories.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：(DIRECTORY "foo/*/*.*") 没有遵循 foo/ 中解析为目录的符号链接。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: type mismatch when assigning to lexical variables no longer result in fasl-dumping internal type objects. (#890750)

sentences.en: bug fix: type mismatch when assigning to lexical variables no longer result in fasl-dumping internal type objects.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：分配给词法变量时的类型不匹配不再导致 fasl 转储内部类型对象。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: type mismatch on (SETF AREF) and function return values no longer result in fasl-dumping internal type objects.

sentences.en: bug fix: type mismatch on (SETF AREF) and function return values no longer result in fasl-dumping internal type objects.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：(SETF AREF) 上的类型不匹配和函数返回值不再导致 fasl 转储内部类型对象。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: With several combinations of argument types, for example (EXPT <integer> <(complex double)>), EXPT now uses double-precision throughout instead of partially calculating only to single-precision. (#741564; thanks to Lutz Euler)

sentences.en: bug fix: With several combinations of argument types, for example (EXPT <integer> <(complex double)>), EXPT now uses double-precision throughout instead of partially calculating only to single-precision.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对于参数类型的多种组合，例如 (EXPT <integer> <(complex double)>)，EXPT 现在始终使用双精度，而不是仅部分计算为单精度。

sentences.en: (#741564; thanks to Lutz Euler)
sentences.zh: （#741564；感谢 Lutz Euler）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SYMBOL-VALUE-IN-THREAD is no longer able to construct bogus objects when interrupted by GC on PPC.

sentences.en: bug fix: SYMBOL-VALUE-IN-THREAD is no longer able to construct bogus objects when interrupted by GC on PPC.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当 PPC 上的 GC 中断时，SYMBOL-VALUE-IN-THREAD 不再能够构造虚假对象。

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-EXT:WAIT-FOR allows waiting for arbitrary events.

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: DESCRIBE now reports a lambda-list and source location for complext setf-expanders.

sentences.en: enhancement: DESCRIBE now reports a lambda-list and source location for complext setf-expanders.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：DESCRIBE 现在报告复杂 setf 扩展器的 lambda 列表和源位置。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: PUSH, PUSHNEW, POP, REMF, INCF, DECF, DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO, GETF, LOGBITP, LDB, and MASK-FIELD now arrange for non-primary values of multiple-valued places to be set to NIL, instead of signalling an error (per a careful reading of CLHS 5.1.2.3).

sentences.en: bug fix: PUSH, PUSHNEW, POP, REMF, INCF, DECF, DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO, GETF, LOGBITP, LDB, and MASK-FIELD now arrange for non-primary values of multiple-valued places to be set to NIL, instead of signalling an error (per a careful reading of CLHS 5.1.2.3).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：PUSH、PUSHNEW、POP、REMF、INCF、DECF、DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO、GETF、LOGBITP、LDB 和 MASK-FIELD 现在安排将多值位置的非主值设置为 NIL，而不是发出错误信号（根据仔细阅读 CLHS 5.1.2.3）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: floating-point traps now work on darwin/x86 and /x86-64.

sentences.en: bug fix: floating-point traps now work on darwin/x86 and /x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：浮点陷阱现在可以在 darwin/x86 和 /x86-64 上运行。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: repair crash in x86oid darwin signal handling emulation when built with certain compilers.

sentences.en: bug fix: repair crash in x86oid darwin signal handling emulation when built with certain compilers.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复使用某些编译器构建时 x86oid darwin 信号处理仿真中的崩溃问题。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-ROTATE-BYTE misrotated to the right when using constant rotation arguments on x86-64. (#882151)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-ROTATE-BYTE misrotated to the right when using constant rotation arguments on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 x86-64 上使用常量旋转参数时，SB-ROTATE-BYTE 错误旋转到右侧。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: low-level control flow optimisations could result in bogus code in functions with tail and non-tail calls to local functions on x86oids. (#883500)

sentences.en: bug fix: low-level control flow optimisations could result in bogus code in functions with tail and non-tail calls to local functions on x86oids.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：低级控制流优化可能会导致在 x86oid 上对本地函数进行尾部和非尾部调用的函数中出现虚假代码。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: on SPARC/:sb-unicode, avoid crashing the assembler by trying to emit literal characters > (code-char 4095), for comparisons with constant characters.

sentences.en: bug fix: on SPARC/:sb-unicode, avoid crashing the assembler by trying to emit literal characters > (code-char 4095), for comparisons with constant characters.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 SPARC/:sb-unicode 上，通过尝试发出文字字符 > (code-char 4095) 来与常量字符进行比较，以避免汇编器崩溃。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ROOM reported only the low 32 bits of dynamic space usage on 64 bit platforms. (#881445)

sentences.en: bug fix: ROOM reported only the low 32 bits of dynamic space usage on 64 bit platforms.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ROOM 仅报告 64 位平台上动态空间使用情况的低 32 位。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DELETE-FILE did not MERGE-PATHNAMES, making it possible to delete the wrong file when using relative pathnames. (#882877)

sentences.en: bug fix: DELETE-FILE did not MERGE-PATHNAMES, making it possible to delete the wrong file when using relative pathnames.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DELETE-FILE 没有 MERGE-PATHNAMES，使得使用相对路径名时可能删除错误的文件。

sentences.en: bug fix: optimized SEARCH of vectors-on-vectors mishandled zero-length sequences and :KEY NIL.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：向量对向量的优化搜索错误处理了零长度序列和 :KEY NIL。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: (SETF GC-LOGFILE) allows logging garbage collections to a file, making it easier to understand heap dynamics.

sentences.en: enhancement: (SETF GC-LOGFILE) allows logging garbage collections to a file, making it easier to understand heap dynamics.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：(SETF GC-LOGFILE) 允许将垃圾收集记录到文件中，从而更容易理解堆动态。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: using a &REST argument only in APPLY or VALUES-LIST calls allows the compiler to automatically elide rest-list allocation so long as the call sites are in functions that the compiler knows cannot escape. (#504575)

sentences.en: optimization: using a &REST argument only in APPLY or VALUES-LIST calls allows the compiler to automatically elide rest-list allocation so long as the call sites are in functions that the compiler knows cannot escape.
sentences.zh: 优化：仅在 APPLY 或 VALUES-LIST 调用中使用 &REST 参数允许编译器自动忽略剩余列表分配，只要调用站点位于编译器知道无法转义的函数中即可。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: CALL-NEXT-METHOD using explicit arguments is faster, especially in safe code when none of the required arguments have changed their identities.

sentences.en: optimization: CALL-NEXT-METHOD using explicit arguments is faster, especially in safe code when none of the required arguments have changed their identities.
sentences.zh: 优化：使用显式参数的 CALL-NEXT-METHOD 速度更快，特别是在安全代码中，当所需参数都没有更改其标识时。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: blocking reads from FIFOs created by RUN-PROGRAM were uninterruptible, as well as blocking reads from socket streams created with for which :SERVE-EVENTS NIL. (regression from 1.0.42.43)

sentences.en: bug fix: blocking reads from FIFOs created by RUN-PROGRAM were uninterruptible, as well as blocking reads from socket streams created with for which :SERVE-EVENTS NIL.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：阻塞读取 RUN-PROGRAM 创建的 FIFO 是不间断的，阻塞读取使用 :SERVE-EVENTS NIL 创建的套接字流。

sentences.en: (regression from 1.0.42.43)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SET-SYNTAX-FROM-CHAR now removes dispatch-macro character syntax from the to-char if the from-char is not a dispatch-macro character.

sentences.en: bug fix: SET-SYNTAX-FROM-CHAR now removes dispatch-macro character syntax from the to-char if the from-char is not a dispatch-macro character.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果 from-char 不是调度宏字符，SET-SYNTAX-FROM-CHAR 现在会从 to-char 中删除调度宏字符语法。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: references to undefined variables in function calls that are optimized away now signal a runtime error. (#722734)

sentences.en: bug fix: references to undefined variables in function calls that are optimized away now signal a runtime error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对已优化的函数调用中未定义变量的引用现在发出运行时错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: miscompilation of MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL when asserting derived types from a function defined in the same file. (regression from 1.0.43.57)

sentences.en: bug fix: miscompilation of MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL when asserting derived types from a function defined in the same file.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：从同一文件中定义的函数断言派生类型时，MULTIPLE-VALUE-CALL 编译错误。

sentences.en: (regression from 1.0.43.57)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: TRULY-THE forms are now macroexpandable and setf-expandable. (#771673)

sentences.en: bug fix: TRULY-THE forms are now macroexpandable and setf-expandable.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：确实，表单现在可以宏扩展和 setf 扩展。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: spurious errors during QUIT when standard streams were closed.

sentences.en: bug fix: spurious errors during QUIT when standard streams were closed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当标准流关闭时，退出期间出现虚假错误。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.48, 2011-05-09

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: SB!KERNEL:INSTANCE-LAMBDA, deprecated for over five years, is now no longer supported.

sentences.en: incompatible change: SB!KERNEL:INSTANCE-LAMBDA, deprecated for over five years, is now no longer supported.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：SB!KERNEL:INSTANCE-LAMBDA 已弃用五年多，现在不再受支持。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: read() and write() have been added to SB-POSIX.

sentences.en: enhancement: read() and write() have been added to SB-POSIX.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：read() 和 write() 已添加到 SB-POSIX。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: types of DEFSTRUCT constructors are proclaimed more accurately, allowing better typechecking of call-sites.

sentences.en: enhancement: types of DEFSTRUCT constructors are proclaimed more accurately, allowing better typechecking of call-sites.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：DEFSTRUCT 构造函数的类型声明得更准确，从而可以更好地对调用站点进行类型检查。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: errors during compile-time-too processing (i.e. EVAL-WHEN) are no longer caught. (reverted to pre 1.0.34 behaviour)

sentences.en: enhancement: errors during compile-time-too processing (i.e. EVAL-WHEN) are no longer caught.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：不再捕获编译时处理（即 EVAL-WHEN）期间的错误。

sentences.en: (reverted to pre 1.0.34 behaviour)
sentences.zh: （恢复到 1.0.34 之前的行为）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: slightly faster ISQRT. (#713343)

sentences.en: optimization: slightly faster ISQRT.
sentences.zh: 优化：ISQRT 稍快一些。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: better support for Solaris /bin/sh in sh-based tests.

sentences.en: bug fix: better support for Solaris /bin/sh in sh-based tests.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在基于 sh 的测试中更好地支持 Solaris /bin/sh。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: TRACE behaves better when attempting to trace undefined functions. (#740717)

sentences.en: bug fix: TRACE behaves better when attempting to trace undefined functions.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：尝试跟踪未定义的函数时，TRACE 表现更好。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: missed optimizations for (FUNCALL (LAMBDA ...) ...) in comparison to (FUNCALL #'(LAMBDA ...) ...).

sentences.en: bug fix: missed optimizations for (FUNCALL (LAMBDA ...) ...)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：错过了 (FUNCALL (LAMBDA ...) ...) 的优化

sentences.en: in comparison to (FUNCALL #'(LAMBDA ...) ...).
sentences.zh: 与 (FUNCALL #'(LAMBDA ...) ...) 相比。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ((LAMBDA ...) ...) forms with invalid argument counts resulted in a compile-time error. (#720382)

sentences.en: bug fix: ((LAMBDA ...) ...)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：((LAMBDA ...) ...)

sentences.en: forms with invalid argument counts resulted in a compile-time error.
sentences.zh: 具有无效参数计数的表单会导致编译时错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: forms such as (FUNCALL (FUNCTION NAME OOPS) ...) were compiled without complaints.

sentences.en: bug fix: forms such as (FUNCALL (FUNCTION NAME OOPS) ...)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：诸如 (FUNCALL (FUNCTION NAME OOPS) ...) 之类的形式

sentences.en: were compiled without complaints.
sentences.zh: 毫无怨言地进行了编译。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: less verbose source forms for functions from EVAL. (#747485)

sentences.en: bug fix: less verbose source forms for functions from EVAL.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：EVAL 函数的更简洁的源形式。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: sense of SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS was inverted in a MAKE-INSTANCE optimization. (regression from 1.0.45.18/1.0.46.15)

sentences.en: bug fix: sense of SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS was inverted in a MAKE-INSTANCE optimization.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS 的意义在 MAKE-INSTANCE 优化中被反转。

sentences.en: (regression from 1.0.45.18/1.0.46.15)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: package locks did not protects against compile-time side-effects of DEFUN. (#675584)

sentences.en: bug fix: package locks did not protects against compile-time side-effects of DEFUN.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：包锁不能防止 DEFUN 的编译时副作用。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: --dynamic-space-size argument is validated more carefully. (#721457)

sentences.en: bug fix: --dynamic-space-size argument is validated more carefully.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：--dynamic-space-size 参数经过更仔细的验证。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: memory fault from printing a malformed simple-condition. (#705690)

sentences.en: bug fix: memory fault from printing a malformed simple-condition.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：打印格式错误的简单条件导致内存故障。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: redefining classes so that slot-definition classes change now engages the obsolete instance protocol. (#766271)

sentences.en: bug fix: redefining classes so that slot-definition classes change now engages the obsolete instance protocol.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：重新定义类，以便插槽定义类更改现在使用过时的实例协议。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: constant improper lists could break source coverage recording. (#767959)

sentences.en: bug fix: constant improper lists could break source coverage recording.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：持续不正确的列表可能会破坏源覆盖记录。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: compiling calls to eg. MEMBER with massive constant list arguments could exhaust stack.

sentences.en: bug fix: compiling calls to eg.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译对例如的调用。

sentences.en: MEMBER with massive constant list arguments could exhaust stack.
sentences.zh: 具有大量常量列表参数的 MEMBER 可能会耗尽堆栈。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.47, 2011-03-27

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: fix mach port rights leaks in mach exception handling code on darwin/x86 and /x86-64. (thanks to Willem Oudshoorn for motivation and the initial patch)

sentences.en: bug fix: fix mach port rights leaks in mach exception handling code on darwin/x86 and /x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复 darwin/x86 和 /x86-64 上的 mach 异常处理代码中的 mach 端口权限泄漏。

sentences.en: (thanks to Willem Oudshoorn for motivation and the initial patch)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Willem Oudshoorn 的激励和最初的补丁）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: --script muffles style-warnings and compiler notes. (#677779)

sentences.en: enhancement: --script muffles style-warnings and compiler notes.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：--script 消除样式警告和编译器注释。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: redefinition warnings for macros from different files. (#434657)

sentences.en: enhancement: redefinition warnings for macros from different files.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：来自不同文件的宏的重新定义警告。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: better MACHINE-VERSION on Darwin x86 and x86-64. (#668332)

sentences.en: enhancement: better MACHINE-VERSION on Darwin x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：Darwin x86 和 x86-64 上更好的机器版本。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: (FORMAT "foo" ...) and similar signal a compile-time warning. (#327223)

sentences.en: enhancement: (FORMAT "foo" ...)
sentences.zh: 增强：（格式“foo”...）

sentences.en: and similar signal a compile-time warning.
sentences.zh: 和类似的信号编译时警告。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: no more "in: LAMBDA NIL" messages from the compiler for forms processed using EVAL -- now the appropriate toplevel form is reported instead.

sentences.en: enhancement: no more "in: LAMBDA NIL" messages from the compiler for forms processed using EVAL -- now the appropriate toplevel form is reported instead.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：对于使用 EVAL 处理的表单，编译器不再发出“in: LAMBDA NIL”消息——现在改为报告适当的顶级表单。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: more legible style-warnings for inappropriate IGNORE and IGNORABLE declarations. (#726331)

sentences.en: enhancement: more legible style-warnings for inappropriate IGNORE and IGNORABLE declarations.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：针对不适当的 IGNORE 和 IGNORABLE 声明提供更清晰的样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: :NOT-NULL option has been added to alien C-STRING type to indicate that NIL/NULL is excluded from the type.

sentences.en: enhancement: :NOT-NULL option has been added to alien C-STRING type to indicate that NIL/NULL is excluded from the type.
sentences.zh: 增强功能： :NOT-NULL 选项已添加到外来 C-STRING 类型中，以指示从该类型中排除 NIL/NULL。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-INTROSPECT:MAP-ROOT allows mapping over pointers contained in arbitrary objects.

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-INTROSPECT:MAP-ROOT allows mapping over pointers contained in arbitrary objects.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-INTROSPECT:MAP-ROOT 允许映射任意对象中包含的指针。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: SLOT-VALUE &co are faster in the presence of SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS and its compatriots.

sentences.en: optimization: SLOT-VALUE &co are faster in the presence of SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS and its compatriots.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS 及其同胞存在的情况下，SLOT-VALUE &co 速度更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: core startup time is reduced by 30% on x86-64. (#557357)

sentences.en: optimization: core startup time is reduced by 30% on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：x86-64 上核心启动时间减少 30%。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-DEBUG:BACKTRACE-AS-LIST guards against potentially leaking stack-allocated values out of their dynamic-extent. (#310175)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-DEBUG:BACKTRACE-AS-LIST guards against potentially leaking stack-allocated values out of their dynamic-extent.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-DEBUG:BACKTRACE-AS-LIST 可防止堆栈分配值超出其动态范围的潜在泄漏。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: attempts to use SB-SPROF for wallclock profiling on threaded x86-64 builds caused a type-error.

sentences.en: bug fix: attempts to use SB-SPROF for wallclock profiling on threaded x86-64 builds caused a type-error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：尝试在线程 x86-64 构建上使用 SB-SPROF 进行挂钟分析会导致类型错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: calling COMPILE with something else than a lambda-expression as the second argument reports a more sensible error. (#718905)

sentences.en: bug fix: calling COMPILE with something else than a lambda-expression as the second argument reports a more sensible error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 lambda 表达式之外的其他内容调用 COMPILE，因为第二个参数会报告更明智的错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: invalid combinations of :PREDICATE and :TYPE options in DEFSTRUCT are detected. (#520607)

sentences.en: bug fix: invalid combinations of :PREDICATE and :TYPE options in DEFSTRUCT are detected.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：检测到 DEFSTRUCT 中 :PREDICATE 和 :TYPE 选项的无效组合。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: constant keyword argument checking didn't take :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS into account.

sentences.en: bug fix: constant keyword argument checking didn't take :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS into account.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：常量关键字参数检查未考虑 :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS 。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SLOT-BOUNDP information is correct during MAKE-INSTANCE in the presence of (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS) and SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS methods. (regression from 1.0.45.18)

sentences.en: bug fix: SLOT-BOUNDP information is correct during MAKE-INSTANCE in the presence of (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS) and SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS methods.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在存在 (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS) 和 SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS 方法的情况下，SLOT-BOUNDP 信息在 MAKE-INSTANCE 期间是正确的。

sentences.en: (regression from 1.0.45.18)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: INITIALIZE-INSTANCE :AROUND methods supplying initargs via CALL-NEXT-METHOD work correctly. (regression from 1.0.45.19)

sentences.en: bug fix: INITIALIZE-INSTANCE :AROUND methods supplying initargs via CALL-NEXT-METHOD work correctly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：通过 CALL-NEXT-METHOD 提供 initargs 的 INITIALIZE-INSTANCE :AROUND 方法可以正常工作。

sentences.en: (regression from 1.0.45.19)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: several foreign functions accepting string also accepted NIL and consequently caused a memory fault at 0 now signal a type-error instead. (#721087)

sentences.en: bug fix: several foreign functions accepting string also accepted NIL and consequently caused a memory fault at 0 now signal a type-error instead.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：几个接受字符串的外部函数也接受 NIL，因此导致 0 处的内存错误，现在改为发出类型错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: under rare circumstances, constraint propagation could rewrite a variable reference to refer to a variable not in scope, causing an error during physical environment analysis when attempting to close over the variable. (#551227)

sentences.en: bug fix: under rare circumstances, constraint propagation could rewrite a variable reference to refer to a variable not in scope, causing an error during physical environment analysis when attempting to close over the variable.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在极少数情况下，约束传播可能会重写变量引用以引用不在范围内的变量，从而在物理环境分析期间尝试关闭变量时导致错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SIMPLE-CONDITION :FORMAT-CONTROL defaults to NIL.

sentences.en: bug fix: SIMPLE-CONDITION :FORMAT-CONTROL defaults to NIL.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SIMPLE-CONDITION :FORMAT-CONTROL 默认为 NIL。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.46, 2011-02-20

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: largefile support on Solaris.

sentences.en: enhancement: largefile support on Solaris.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：Solaris 上的大文件支持。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-PROFILE:REPORT now supports :LIMIT and :PRINT-NO-CALL-LIST arguments (#710017)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-PROFILE:REPORT now supports :LIMIT and :PRINT-NO-CALL-LIST arguments (#710017)
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-PROFILE:REPORT 现在支持 :LIMIT 和 :PRINT-NO-CALL-LIST 参数 (#710017)

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-PCL:+SLOT-UNBOUND+ is exported, making it possible to distinguish unbound instance slots when using STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS &co. (#718039)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-PCL:+SLOT-UNBOUND+ is exported, making it possible to distinguish unbound instance slots when using STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS &co.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：导出 SB-PCL:+SLOT-UNBOUND+，使得在使用 STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS &co 时可以区分未绑定的实例插槽。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: ERROR and CERROR are approximately 5 times faster.

sentences.en: optimization: ERROR and CERROR are approximately 5 times faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：ERROR 和 CERROR 大约快 5 倍。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: optimized constructors are used for MAKE-INSTANCE of classes with applicable non-standard (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS), SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS, and INITIALIZE-INSTANCE :AROUND methods, speeding up instance creation in those cases.

sentences.en: optimization: optimized constructors are used for MAKE-INSTANCE of classes with applicable non-standard (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS), SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS, and INITIALIZE-INSTANCE :AROUND methods, speeding up instance creation in those cases.
sentences.zh: 优化：优化的构造函数用于具有适用的非标准 (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS)、SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS 和 INITIALIZE-INSTANCE :AROUND 方法的类的 MAKE-INSTANCE，从而加快这些情况下的实例创建速度。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: arithmetic operations with multiple constant arguments in now have them reduced at compile-time. (#676414)

sentences.en: optimization: arithmetic operations with multiple constant arguments in now have them reduced at compile-time.
sentences.zh: 优化：现在具有多个常量参数的算术运算在编译时减少了它们。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: determining current character position on string-streams for pretty-printing was overly slow.

sentences.en: optimization: determining current character position on string-streams for pretty-printing was overly slow.
sentences.zh: 优化：确定字符串流上的当前字符位置以进行漂亮打印的速度太慢。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: local tail calls to DYNAMIC-EXTENT functions can no longer cause lifetime analysis to overwrite closed-over variables (#681092).

sentences.en: bug fix: local tail calls to DYNAMIC-EXTENT functions can no longer cause lifetime analysis to overwrite closed-over variables (#681092).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对 DYNAMIC-EXTENT 函数的本地尾调用不再导致生命周期分析覆盖封闭变量 (#681092)。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: encoding errors from some multibyte external formats such as EUC-JP were not handled correctly (#713063).

sentences.en: bug fix: encoding errors from some multibyte external formats such as EUC-JP were not handled correctly (#713063).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：来自某些多字节外部格式（例如 EUC-JP）的编码错误未正确处理（#713063）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: printing waitqueue objects without setting *PRINT-CIRCLE* to T is now safe (#673630).

sentences.en: bug fix: printing waitqueue objects without setting *PRINT-CIRCLE* to T is now safe (#673630).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在不将 *PRINT-CIRCLE* 设置为 T 的情况下打印 waitqueue 对象现在是安全的 (#673630)。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Solaris/x86-64 wasn't getting built with lutex support by mistake. (#667297).

sentences.en: bug fix: Solaris/x86-64 wasn't getting built with lutex support by mistake.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：Solaris/x86-64 没有错误地使用 lutex 支持进行构建。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: CONSTANTLY generated functions had bogus lambda-lists. (#713626)

sentences.en: bug fix: CONSTANTLY generated functions had bogus lambda-lists.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：不断生成的函数具有虚假的 lambda 列表。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: RUN-PROGRAM :PTY option was racy on OpenBSD. (#669485)

sentences.en: bug fix: RUN-PROGRAM :PTY option was racy on OpenBSD.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：RUN-PROGRAM :PTY 选项在 OpenBSD 上很活跃。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: UNINTERN takes a symbol, not a symbol designator -- could previously unintern the wrong symbol with the same name. (#693796)

sentences.en: bug fix: UNINTERN takes a symbol, not a symbol designator -- could previously unintern the wrong symbol with the same name.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：UNINTERN 采用符号，而不是符号指示符——之前可能会取消同名的错误符号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: COPY-PPRINT-DISPATCH always has access to a pristine table, making it possible to restore the initial table if it has been messed up. (#678409)

sentences.en: bug fix: COPY-PPRINT-DISPATCH always has access to a pristine table, making it possible to restore the initial table if it has been messed up.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：COPY-PPRINT-DISPATCH 始终可以访问原始表，从而可以在初始表被弄乱时恢复初始表。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.45, 2010-12-06

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: ASDF has been updated to version 2.010.

blocks.html_en: • optimization: mutated closed-over variables that are only accessed by DYNAMIC-EXTENT closures (currently only FLET and LABELS functions declared to be DYNAMIC-EXTENT) are stored directly in their containing stack frame, rather than allocating a VALUE-CELL (#586103).

sentences.en: optimization: mutated closed-over variables that are only accessed by DYNAMIC-EXTENT closures (currently only FLET and LABELS functions declared to be DYNAMIC-EXTENT) are stored directly in their containing stack frame, rather than allocating a VALUE-CELL (#586103).
sentences.zh: 优化：仅由 DYNAMIC-EXTENT 闭包访问的变异封闭变量（当前仅声明为 DYNAMIC-EXTENT 的 FLET 和 LABELS 函数）直接存储在其包含的堆栈帧中，而不是分配 VALUE-CELL (#586103)。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: UNWIND-PROTECT cleanup functions are now declared DYNAMIC-EXTENT.

sentences.en: optimization: UNWIND-PROTECT cleanup functions are now declared DYNAMIC-EXTENT.

sentences.en: bug fix: backtracing function with &REST arguments now shows the full argument list.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: return types for functions with complex lambda-lists are now derived properly (#384892)

sentences.en: bug fix: return types for functions with complex lambda-lists are now derived properly (#384892)

sentences.en: bug fix: when SPEED > SPACE compiling CONCATENATE 'STRING with constant long string arguments slowed the compiler down to a crawl.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当 SPEED > SPACE 编译带有常量长字符串参数的 CONCATENATE 'STRING 时，编译器速度会减慢。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: closure VALUE-CELLs are no longer stack-allocated (#308934).

sentences.en: bug fix: closure VALUE-CELLs are no longer stack-allocated (#308934).
sentences.zh: bug 修复：闭包 VALUE-CELL 不再是堆栈分配的 (#308934)。

sentences.zh: 错误修复：不要为算术运算符派生过于复杂的数字类型联合。

sentences.en: enhancement: the system detects known type-erros in calls better, signalling a full warning about violated proclaimed FTYPEs and violations of derived FTYPEs within the same file, including self-calls.

sentences.en: optimization: numeric, character and member types that are inhabited by exactly one value are tested with EQL.
sentences.zh: 优化：使用 EQL 测试仅包含一个值的数字、字符和成员类型。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: more conditional branches are eliminated during IR1. Branches are simplified before performing if/if-conversion, and simple equivalent branches (that only read the same constant or variable) are merged.

sentences.en: bug fix: interrupts arriving during CL:OPEN caused an error.

sentences.en: bug fix: better errors for unknown external-formats in OPEN.

sentences.en: bug fix: DEBUG>SPEED no longer degrades ALIEN-FUNCALL performance quite so badly.

sentences.en: (#613871, thanks to Roman Marynchak)

sentences.en: bug fix: more reliable &REST list type derivation.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK multiply-evaluated :PER-LINE-PREFIX, and issued pointles code-deletion notes for it, :PREFIX, and :SUFFIX.

sentences.en: bug fix: PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK multiply-evaluated :PER-LINE-PREFIX, and issued pointles code-deletion notes for it, :PREFIX, and :SUFFIX.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK 多重计算：PER-LINE-PREFIX，并为其发布了要点代码删除注释：PREFIX 和：SUFFIX。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the compiler didn't utilize the proclaimed ftype for functions also declared NOTINLINE. (#655581)

sentences.en: bug fix: the compiler didn't utilize the proclaimed ftype for functions also declared NOTINLINE.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译器没有将声明的 ftype 用于也声明为 NOTINLINE 的函数。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the compiler could attempt to emit constant left shifts of greater value than n-word-bits. (#309063)

sentences.en: bug fix: the compiler could attempt to emit constant left shifts of greater value than n-word-bits.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译器可能会尝试发出比 n 个字位更大的值的常量左移。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: (SETF SYMBOL-FUNCTION) and (SETF FDEFINITION) clear derived type information for the function being set. (#659220)

sentences.en: bug fix: (SETF SYMBOL-FUNCTION) and (SETF FDEFINITION) clear derived type information for the function being set.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：(SETF SYMBOL-FUNCTION) 和 (SETF FDEFINITION) 清除正在设置的函数的派生类型信息。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the system used to signal bogus STYLE-WARNINGs when functions containing self-calls were recompiled with a new signature, and failed to warn when a self-call using the old signature was left in. (#655126)

sentences.en: bug fix: the system used to signal bogus STYLE-WARNINGs when functions containing self-calls were recompiled with a new signature, and failed to warn when a self-call using the old signature was left in.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当使用新签名重新编译包含自调用的函数时，系统会发出虚假的样式警告，而当保留使用旧签名的自调用时，系统会发出警告。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: incorrect FILE-POSITION on streams opened using :EXTERNAL-FORMAT :DEFAULT when the default external had character size other than 8 bits. (#657183)

sentences.en: bug fix: incorrect FILE-POSITION on streams opened using :EXTERNAL-FORMAT :DEFAULT when the default external had character size other than 8 bits.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当默认外部字符大小不是 8 位时，使用 :EXTERNAL-FORMAT :DEFAULT 打开的流上的文件位置不正确。

sentences.en: bug fix: derived types of functions in the same file were implicitly trusted, leading to potential heap corruption when those function were defined incompatibly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：同一文件中的函数的派生类型是隐式信任的，当这些函数定义不兼容时，会导致潜在的堆损坏。

sentences.en: bug fix: existing ASDF source registries are ignored when building contribs (#659105)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：构建贡献时会忽略现有的 ASDF 源注册表 (#659105)

sentences.en: bug fix: source-locations of DEFGENERIC forms weren't getting recorded properly.

sentences.en: deprecation: SB-THEAD:GET-MUTEX was deprecated in favor of SB-THREAD:GRAB-MUTEX.
sentences.zh: 弃用：SB-THEAD:GET-MUTEX 已弃用，取而代之的是 SB-THREAD:GRAB-MUTEX。

blocks.html_en: • new contributed module: SB-CONCURRENCY is a new contrib; it's supposed to contain additional data structures and tools for concurrent programming; at the moment it contains a lock-free queue, and a lock-free mailbox implementation.

sentences.en: new contributed module: SB-CONCURRENCY is a new contrib; it's supposed to contain additional data structures and tools for concurrent programming; at the moment it contains a lock-free queue, and a lock-free mailbox implementation.
sentences.zh: 新贡献模块：SB-CONCURRENCY 是一个新贡献；它应该包含用于并发编程的附加数据结构和工具；目前它包含一个无锁队列和一个无锁邮箱实现。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: added SB-THREAD:GRAB-MUTEX; it's like the now deprecated GET-MUTEX but takes &key rather than &optional parameters. Also added :TIMEOUT argument to GRAB-MUTEX on non-sb-lutex platforms like Linux and BSD.

sentences.en: new feature: added SB-THREAD:GRAB-MUTEX; it's like the now deprecated GET-MUTEX but takes &key rather than &optional parameters.
sentences.zh: 新功能：添加了SB-THREAD:GRAB-MUTEX；它类似于现在已弃用的 GET-MUTEX，但采用 &key 而不是 &可选参数。

sentences.en: Also added :TIMEOUT argument to GRAB-MUTEX on non-sb-lutex platforms like Linux and BSD.
sentences.zh: 还在 Linux 和 BSD 等非 sb-lutex 平台上向 GRAB-MUTEX 添加了 :TIMEOUT 参数。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: added SB-THREAD:TRY-SEMAPHORE, a non-blocking variant of SB-THREAD:WAIT-ON-SEMAPHORE.

sentences.en: new feature: added SB-THREAD:TRY-SEMAPHORE, a non-blocking variant of SB-THREAD:WAIT-ON-SEMAPHORE.
sentences.zh: 新功能：添加了 SB-THREAD:TRY-SEMAPHORE，这是 SB-THREAD:WAIT-ON-SEMAPHORE 的非阻塞变体。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-EXT:ATOMIC-DECF has been added as a companion to SB-EXT:ATOMIC-INCF.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-EXT:ATOMIC-DECF has been added as a companion to SB-EXT:ATOMIC-INCF.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-EXT:ATOMIC-DECF 已作为 SB-EXT:ATOMIC-INCF 的配套添加。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: a CANCEL-DEADLINE is associated with DEADLINE-TIMEOUT conditions to defer the deadline for forever.

sentences.en: new feature: a CANCEL-DEADLINE is associated with DEADLINE-TIMEOUT conditions to defer the deadline for forever.
sentences.zh: 新功能：取消截止日期与截止日期超时条件相关联，以永远推迟截止日期。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: *STANDARD-OUTPUT*, *STANDARD-INPUT*, and *ERROR-OUTPUT* are now bivalent.

sentences.en: enhancement: *STANDARD-OUTPUT*, *STANDARD-INPUT*, and *ERROR-OUTPUT* are now bivalent.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：*STANDARD-OUTPUT*、*STANDARD-INPUT* 和 *ERROR-OUTPUT* 现在是二价的。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: errors from NO-APPLICABLE-METHOD and NO-PRIMARY-METHOD now have a RETRY restart available to retry the generic function call.

sentences.en: enhancement: errors from NO-APPLICABLE-METHOD and NO-PRIMARY-METHOD now have a RETRY restart available to retry the generic function call.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：来自 NO-APPLICABLE-METHOD 和 NO-PRIMARY-METHOD 的错误现在可以重试重试通用函数调用。

blocks.html_en:
• enhancement: SB-BSD-SOCKET improvements
    • sockets and socket streams now have a more informative printed representation based on the corresponding SOCKET-NAME and SOCKET-PEERNAME.
    • SOCKET-MAKE-STREAM once more supports the :AUTO-CLOSE option. (#540413)
    • SOCKET-CLOSE now accepts :ABORT argument, which is passed on to CL:CLOSE when appropriate, and no longer disassociates the stream from the socket if close failed. (#543951)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-BSD-SOCKET improvements sockets and socket streams now have a more informative printed representation based on the corresponding SOCKET-NAME and SOCKET-PEERNAME.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-BSD-SOCKET 改进套接字和套接字流现在具有基于相应 SOCKET-NAME 和 SOCKET-PEERNAME 的信息更丰富的打印表示形式。

sentences.en: SOCKET-MAKE-STREAM once more supports the :AUTO-CLOSE option.
sentences.zh: SOCKET-MAKE-STREAM 再次支持 :AUTO-CLOSE 选项。

sentences.en: (#540413) SOCKET-CLOSE now accepts :ABORT argument, which is passed on to CL:CLOSE when appropriate, and no longer disassociates the stream from the socket if close failed.
sentences.zh: (#540413) SOCKET-CLOSE 现在接受 :ABORT 参数，该参数在适当时传递给 CL:CLOSE，并且如果关闭失败，则不再取消流与套接字的关联。

blocks.html_en: • sockets and socket streams now have a more informative printed representation based on the corresponding SOCKET-NAME and SOCKET-PEERNAME.

sentences.en: sockets and socket streams now have a more informative printed representation based on the corresponding SOCKET-NAME and SOCKET-PEERNAME.
sentences.zh: 套接字和套接字流现在具有基于相应 SOCKET-NAME 和 SOCKET-PEERNAME 的信息更丰富的打印表示形式。

blocks.html_en: • SOCKET-MAKE-STREAM once more supports the :AUTO-CLOSE option. (#540413)

sentences.en: SOCKET-MAKE-STREAM once more supports the :AUTO-CLOSE option.
sentences.zh: SOCKET-MAKE-STREAM 再次支持 :AUTO-CLOSE 选项。

blocks.html_en: • SOCKET-CLOSE now accepts :ABORT argument, which is passed on to CL:CLOSE when appropriate, and no longer disassociates the stream from the socket if close failed. (#543951)

sentences.en: SOCKET-CLOSE now accepts :ABORT argument, which is passed on to CL:CLOSE when appropriate, and no longer disassociates the stream from the socket if close failed.
sentences.zh: SOCKET-CLOSE 现在接受 :ABORT 参数，该参数在适当时传递给 CL:CLOSE，并且如果关闭失败，则不再取消流与套接字的关联。

blocks.html_en:
• improvements to the instrumenting profiler
    • new feature: report per-function GC overhead. (thanks to John Fremlin)
    • optimization: counters no longer use locks for the overflow mode.
    • bug fix: whenever a profiling counter wrapped into overflow mode, it incurred an off-by-one miscount.

sentences.en: improvements to the instrumenting profiler new feature: report per-function GC overhead.
sentences.zh: 对检测分析器的改进新功能：报告每个函数的 GC 开销。

sentences.en: (thanks to John Fremlin) optimization: counters no longer use locks for the overflow mode.
sentences.zh: （感谢 John Fremlin）优化：计数器不再使用溢出模式的锁。

sentences.en: bug fix: whenever a profiling counter wrapped into overflow mode, it incurred an off-by-one miscount.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：每当分析计数器进入溢出模式时，就会产生相差一的错误计数。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: report per-function GC overhead. (thanks to John Fremlin)

sentences.en: new feature: report per-function GC overhead.
sentences.zh: 新功能：报告每个函数的 GC 开销。

sentences.en: (thanks to John Fremlin)
sentences.zh: （感谢约翰·弗雷姆林）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: counters no longer use locks for the overflow mode.

sentences.en: optimization: counters no longer use locks for the overflow mode.
sentences.zh: 优化：计数器不再使用溢出模式的锁。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: whenever a profiling counter wrapped into overflow mode, it incurred an off-by-one miscount.

sentences.en: bug fix: whenever a profiling counter wrapped into overflow mode, it incurred an off-by-one miscount.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：每当分析计数器进入溢出模式时，就会产生相差一的错误计数。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: improved MAKE-HASH-TABLE documentation (#543473)

sentences.en: enhancement: improved MAKE-HASH-TABLE documentation (#543473)
sentences.zh: 增强功能：改进了 MAKE-HASH-TABLE 文档 (#543473)

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: improved DEFMETHOD pretty-printing.

sentences.en: enhancement: improved DEFMETHOD pretty-printing.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：改进了 DEFMETHOD 漂亮打印。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: perform range reduction when arguments are too large for x87's transcendentals (instead of returning 0). (#327192)

sentences.en: enhancement: perform range reduction when arguments are too large for x87's transcendentals (instead of returning 0).
sentences.zh: 增强功能：当参数对于 x87 的超越数来说太大时，执行范围缩减（而不是返回 0）。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: eliminate some spurious TYPE-WARNINGs. Should help with some of CL-PPCRE's macros. (#570079)

sentences.en: enhancement: eliminate some spurious TYPE-WARNINGs.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：消除一些虚假的类型警告。

sentences.en: Should help with some of CL-PPCRE's macros.
sentences.zh: 应该对 CL-PPCRE 的一些宏有所帮助。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: our machine code is slightly less hostile to valgrind on x86-64.

sentences.en: enhancement: our machine code is slightly less hostile to valgrind on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：我们的机器代码对 x86-64 上的 valgrind 的敌意稍微小一些。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: up-to-date versions of NetBSD-current are supported. (Thanks to Robert Swindells and Aleksej Saushev)

sentences.en: enhancement: up-to-date versions of NetBSD-current are supported.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：支持最新版本的 NetBSD-current。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Robert Swindells and Aleksej Saushev)
sentences.zh: （感谢罗伯特·斯温德尔斯和阿列克谢·索舍夫）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: correct restart text for the continuable error in MAKE-PACKAGE.

sentences.en: bug fix: correct restart text for the continuable error in MAKE-PACKAGE.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：更正 MAKE-PACKAGE 中持续错误的重新启动文本。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a rare case of startup-time page table corruption.

sentences.en: bug fix: a rare case of startup-time page table corruption.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：启动时页表损坏的罕见情况。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a semaphore with multiple waiters and some of them unwinding due to timeouts could be left in an inconsistent state.

sentences.en: bug fix: a semaphore with multiple waiters and some of them unwinding due to timeouts could be left in an inconsistent state.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：具有多个服务员的信号量，其中一些由于超时而展开，可能会处于不一致的状态。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: fix typo in "Reporting Bugs" section of the manual (#520366)

sentences.en: bug fix: fix typo in "Reporting Bugs" section of the manual (#520366)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复手册“报告错误”部分中的拼写错误 (#520366)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: misoptimization of multiplication by one in (SB-C::FLOAT-ACCURACY 0) policies.

sentences.en: bug fix: misoptimization of multiplication by one in (SB-C::FLOAT-ACCURACY 0) policies.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：(SB-C::FLOAT-ACCURACY 0) 策略中乘以一的错误优化。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: miscounts in SB-PROFILE.

sentences.en: bug fix: miscounts in SB-PROFILE.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-PROFILE 中的计数错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Fix lost wakeup bug between SB-THREAD:CONDITION-WAIT and CONDITION-NOTIFY on Linux. See threads "lost wakeup in condition-wait / condition-notify" (Feb 2010) and "Condition-Wait, Deadline handler, waking up itself" (March 2010) for further details.

sentences.en: bug fix: Fix lost wakeup bug between SB-THREAD:CONDITION-WAIT and CONDITION-NOTIFY on Linux.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复 Linux 上 SB-THREAD:CONDITION-WAIT 和 CONDITION-NOTIFY 之间丢失唤醒的错误。

sentences.en: See threads "lost wakeup in condition-wait / condition-notify" (Feb 2010) and "Condition-Wait, Deadline handler, waking up itself" (March 2010) for further details.
sentences.zh: 有关更多详细信息，请参阅线程“在条件等待/条件通知中丢失唤醒”（2010 年 2 月）和“条件等待，截止日期处理程序，唤醒自身”（2010 年 3 月）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: allow forward FIND and POSITION on lists to elide checking :END against length of the list if the element is found before the specified END is reached. (thanks to Alec Berryman, #554385)

sentences.en: bug fix: allow forward FIND and POSITION on lists to elide checking :END against length of the list if the element is found before the specified END is reached.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果在到达指定的 END 之前找到元素，则允许列表上的前向 FIND 和 POSITION 来忽略对列表长度的 :END 检查。

sentences.en: (thanks to Alec Berryman, #554385)
sentences.zh: （感谢亚历克·贝里曼，#554385）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: errors signalled during package graph modification no longer block FIND-SYMBOL and FIND-PACKAGE in other threads. (#511072)

sentences.en: bug fix: errors signalled during package graph modification no longer block FIND-SYMBOL and FIND-PACKAGE in other threads.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：包图修改期间发出的错误信号不再阻止其他线程中的 FIND-SYMBOL 和 FIND-PACKAGE。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-POSIX build was broken when SBCL was compiled without the :SB-DOC feature. (#552564)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-POSIX build was broken when SBCL was compiled without the :SB-DOC feature.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在没有 :SB-DOC 功能的情况下编译 SBCL 时，SB-POSIX 构建被破坏。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-INTROSPECT build issues on GENGC/PPC. (#490490)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-INTROSPECT build issues on GENGC/PPC.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：GENGC/PPC 上的 SB-INTROSPECT 构建问题。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: more robust runtime executable path detection. (#375549)

sentences.en: bug fix: more robust runtime executable path detection.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：更强大的运行时可执行路径检测。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: GCD always returns positive values. (#413680)

sentences.en: bug fix: GCD always returns positive values.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：GCD 始终返回正值。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Converting division to multiplication by reciprocal handles denormals.

sentences.en: bug fix: Converting division to multiplication by reciprocal handles denormals.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：通过倒数将除法转换为乘法可处理非正规数。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: We were too eager in eliding range reduction tests on x87. The maximal magnitude is 2^63, not 2^64.

sentences.en: bug fix: We were too eager in eliding range reduction tests on x87.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：我们太急于取消 x87 上的范围缩减测试。

sentences.en: The maximal magnitude is 2^63, not 2^64.
sentences.zh: 最大幅度是 2^63，而不是 2^64。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Transforms for TRUNCATE don't die when the result is completely ignored anymore.

sentences.en: bug fix: Transforms for TRUNCATE don't die when the result is completely ignored anymore.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当结果完全被忽略时，TRUNCATE 的转换不会消失。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Maybe restore buildability on Alpha.

sentences.en: bug fix: Maybe restore buildability on Alpha.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：也许可以恢复 Alpha 上的可构建性。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: READ-BYTE isn't inline anymore, fixing weird streams failures. (#569404)

sentences.en: bug fix: READ-BYTE isn't inline anymore, fixing weird streams failures.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：READ-BYTE 不再内联，修复了奇怪的流故障。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: RANDOM-STATE can be printed readably again.

sentences.en: bug fix: RANDOM-STATE can be printed readably again.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：随机状态可以再次可读地打印。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Unreadable objects were sometimes printed like #<\nFoo>.

sentences.en: bug fix: Unreadable objects were sometimes printed like #<\nFoo>.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：有时会打印不可读的对象，如 #<\nFoo>。

sentences.en: bug fix: Using EQL with non-constant values of constant type (e.g. EQL types) could result in type mismatches during compilation.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：将 EQL 与常量类型的非常量值（例如 EQL 类型）一起使用可能会导致编译期间类型不匹配。

sentences.en: enhancement: WITH-COMPILATION-UNIT :POLICY allows restricting changes to compiler optimization qualities inside dynamic extent of its body.

sentences.en: enhancement: LOAD-LOGICAL-PATHNAME-TRANSLATIONS can be used to load translations from SYS:SITE;<HOST>.TRANSLATIONS.NEWEST (thanks to Michael Weber)

sentences.en: optimization: SLOT-VALUE and (SETF SLOT-VALUE) take advantage of constraint propgation, allowing better compilation eg.
sentences.zh: 优化：SLOT-VALUE 和 (SETF SLOT-VALUE) 利用约束传播，允许更好的编译，例如

sentences.en: when used to access structures with WITH-SLOTS.
sentences.zh: 当用于访问带有WITH-SLOTS的结构时。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the compiler is now more aware of the type of the underlying storage vector for multidimensional simple arrays resulting in better code for accessing such arrays.

sentences.en: optimization: the compiler is now more aware of the type of the underlying storage vector for multidimensional simple arrays resulting in better code for accessing such arrays.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器现在更加了解多维简单数组的底层存储向量的类型，从而生成更好的代码来访问此类数组。

sentences.en: optimization: passing NIL as the environment argument to TYPEP no longer inhibits optimizing it.
sentences.zh: 优化：将 NIL 作为环境参数传递给 TYPEP 不再抑制优化它。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: more efficient register usage when handling single-float arguments on x86-64. (thanks to Lutz Euler)

sentences.en: optimization: more efficient register usage when handling single-float arguments on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86-64 上处理单浮点参数时更有效地使用寄存器。

sentences.en: (thanks to Lutz Euler)
sentences.zh: （感谢卢茨·欧拉）

sentences.en: optimization: ADJUST-ARRAY and STABLE-SORT on vectors no longer use pre-allocated temporary vectors.

sentences.en: bug fix: Fix compiler error involving MAKE-ARRAY and IF forms in :INITIAL-CONTENTS.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复涉及 :INITIAL-CONTENTS 中的 MAKE-ARRAY 和 IF 形式的编译器错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FUNCTION-LAMBDA-EXPRESSION lost declarations from interpreted functions. (#524707)

sentences.en: bug fix: FUNCTION-LAMBDA-EXPRESSION lost declarations from interpreted functions.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：FUNCTION-LAMBDA-EXPRESSION 丢失了解释函数的声明。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: bogus style warnings from certain (SETF SLOT-VALUE) and WITH-SLOTS usages during compilation.

sentences.en: bug fix: bogus style warnings from certain (SETF SLOT-VALUE) and WITH-SLOTS usages during compilation.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译期间某些（SETF SLOT-VALUE）和WITH-SLOTS用法的虚假样式警告。

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-C::CLASS-INFO now prints correctly.

sentences.en: bug fix: slam.sh now works on win32.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: better differences of numeric types. (#309124)

sentences.en: bug fix: better differences of numeric types.

sentences.en: bug fix: arrays declared intersection and union types can have their upgraded element type derived.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-SPROF allocation profiling for all threads failed to profile threads started during profiling.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：所有线程的 SB-SPROF 分配分析无法分析分析期间启动的线程。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: The function SB-EXT:SEED-RANDOM-STATE has been added to provide for seeding a RANDOM-STATE object with user-provided data or from the operating system's PRNG. Also, (MAKE-RANDOM-STATE T) will attempt to initialize the returned state from the operating system's PRNG where possible. (Thanks to Fare Rideau; launchpad bug #310116)

blocks.html_en:
• fixes and improvements related to Unicode and external formats:
    • the Unicode character database has been upgraded to the Unicode 5.2 standard, giving names and properties to a number of new characters, and providing a few extra characters with case transformations.
    • improvement: restarts for providing replacement input/output on coding errors for fd-stream external formats.
    • improvement: where :<encoding> is a keyword corresponding to an external format the system supports, it is now possible to specify (:<encoding> :replacement <character>) as an external format which will automatically substitute <character> on encoding or decoding errors for streams and for STRING-TO-OCTETS and its inverse. (launchpad bug #317072)
    • improvement: the file streams underlying the standard streams (such as *STANDARD-INPUT*, *TERMINAL-IO*) are opened with an external format which uses the replacement mechanism to handle encoding errors, preventing various infinite error chains and unrecoverable I/O confusion.
    • minor incompatible change: the utf-8 external format now correctly refuses to encode Lisp characters in the surrogate range (char-codes between #xd800 and #xdfff).
    • fix a typo preventing conversion of strings into octet vectors in the latin-2 encoding. (reported by Attila Lendvai; launchpad bug #471689)
    • fix a bug in the octet multibyte handling of decoding errors and the USE-VALUE restart. (launchpad bug #314939)
    • fix the bug underlying the expected failure in the FORCE-END-OF-FILE restart on fd-stream decoding errors.
    • fix a bug in the ATTEMPT-RESYNC fd-stream decoding restart when the error is near the end of file.
    • fix a double-error case in unibyte octet conversions, when the first use of USE-VALUE is ignored.
    • fix bugs in handling of undefined code points in unibyte encodings.
    • fix LISTEN (and consequent hangs in READ-CHAR-NO-HANG) on bivalent streams after an UNREAD-CHAR.

sentences.en: fixes and improvements related to Unicode and external formats: the Unicode character database has been upgraded to the Unicode 5.2 standard, giving names and properties to a number of new characters, and providing a few extra characters with case transformations.
sentences.zh: 与 Unicode 和外部格式相关的修复和改进：Unicode 字符数据库已升级到 Unicode 5.2 标准，为许多新字符提供名称和属性，并提供一些带有大小写转换的额外字符。

sentences.en: improvement: restarts for providing replacement input/output on coding errors for fd-stream external formats.
sentences.zh: 改进：重新启动以针对 fd 流外部格式的编码错误提供替换输入/输出。

sentences.en: improvement: where :<encoding> is a keyword corresponding to an external format the system supports, it is now possible to specify (:<encoding> :replacement <character>) as an external format which will automatically substitute <character> on encoding or decoding errors for streams and for STRING-TO-OCTETS and its inverse.
sentences.zh: 改进：其中 :<encoding> 是与系统支持的外部格式相对应的关键字，现在可以指定 (:<encoding> :replacement <character>) 作为外部格式，该外部格式将在流和 STRING-TO-OCTETS 及其逆的编码或解码错误时自动替换 <character>。

sentences.en: (launchpad bug #317072) improvement: the file streams underlying the standard streams (such as *STANDARD-INPUT*, *TERMINAL-IO*) are opened with an external format which uses the replacement mechanism to handle encoding errors, preventing various infinite error chains and unrecoverable I/O confusion.
sentences.zh: （launchpad bug #317072）改进：标准流（例如 *STANDARD-INPUT*、*TERMINAL-IO*）底层的文件流以外部格式打开，该格式使用替换机制来处理编码错误，防止各种无限错误链和不可恢复的 I/O 混乱。

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the utf-8 external format now correctly refuses to encode Lisp characters in the surrogate range (char-codes between #xd800 and #xdfff).
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：utf-8 外部格式现在正确地拒绝编码代理范围内的 Lisp 字符（#xd800 和 #xdfff 之间的字符代码）。

sentences.en: fix a typo preventing conversion of strings into octet vectors in the latin-2 encoding.
sentences.zh: 修复了阻止将字符串转换为 latin-2 编码中的八位字节向量的拼写错误。

sentences.en: (reported by Attila Lendvai; launchpad bug #471689) fix a bug in the octet multibyte handling of decoding errors and the USE-VALUE restart.
sentences.zh: （由 Attila Lendvai 报告；启动板错误 #471689）修复了解码错误和 USE-VALUE 重新启动的八位组多字节处理中的错误。

sentences.en: (launchpad bug #314939) fix the bug underlying the expected failure in the FORCE-END-OF-FILE restart on fd-stream decoding errors.
sentences.zh: （launchpad bug #314939）修复了 fd 流解码错误时 FORCE-END-OF-FILE 重新启动中预期失败的潜在错误。

sentences.en: fix a bug in the ATTEMPT-RESYNC fd-stream decoding restart when the error is near the end of file.
sentences.zh: 修复了当错误接近文件末尾时 ATTEMPT-RESYNC fd-stream 解码重新启动中的错误。

sentences.en: fix a double-error case in unibyte octet conversions, when the first use of USE-VALUE is ignored.
sentences.zh: 修复当第一次使用 USE-VALUE 被忽略时，单字节八位字节转换中的双错误情况。

sentences.en: fix bugs in handling of undefined code points in unibyte encodings.
sentences.zh: 修复处理单字节编码中未定义代码点的错误。

sentences.en: fix LISTEN (and consequent hangs in READ-CHAR-NO-HANG) on bivalent streams after an UNREAD-CHAR.
sentences.zh: 修复 UNREAD-CHAR 之后二价流上的 LISTEN（以及随后在 READ-CHAR-NO-HANG 中挂起）。
