blocks.html_en: • improvement: stack allocation is should now be possible in all nested inlining cases: failure to stack allocate when equivalent code is manually open coded is now considered a bug.

sentences.en: improvement: stack allocation is should now be possible in all nested inlining cases: failure to stack allocate when equivalent code is manually open coded is now considered a bug.
sentences.zh: 改进：现在应该可以在所有嵌套内联情况下进行堆栈分配：当手动打开编码时，无法进行堆栈分配现在被认为是一个错误。

blocks.html_en:
• improvements related to Unicode:
    • the Unicode character database has been upgraded to the Unicode 5.1 standard, giving names and properties to a number of new characters, and providing a few extra characters with case transformations.
    • the system now recognizes and produces names for Unicode Hangul syllable characters.
    • the EBCDIC-US external-format is now supported for octet operations (as well as for stream operations).

sentences.en: improvements related to Unicode: the Unicode character database has been upgraded to the Unicode 5.1 standard, giving names and properties to a number of new characters, and providing a few extra characters with case transformations.
sentences.zh: 与 Unicode 相关的改进：Unicode 字符数据库已升级到 Unicode 5.1 标准，为许多新字符提供了名称和属性，并提供了一些带有大小写转换的额外字符。

sentences.en: the system now recognizes and produces names for Unicode Hangul syllable characters.
sentences.zh: 系统现在可以识别 Unicode Hangul 音节字符并生成名称。

sentences.en: the EBCDIC-US external-format is now supported for octet operations (as well as for stream operations).
sentences.zh: EBCDIC-US 外部格式现在支持八位位组操作（以及流操作）。

blocks.html_en: • the Unicode character database has been upgraded to the Unicode 5.1 standard, giving names and properties to a number of new characters, and providing a few extra characters with case transformations.

sentences.en: the Unicode character database has been upgraded to the Unicode 5.1 standard, giving names and properties to a number of new characters, and providing a few extra characters with case transformations.
sentences.zh: Unicode 字符数据库已升级到 Unicode 5.1 标准，为许多新字符提供了名称和属性，并提供了一些带有大小写转换的额外字符。

blocks.html_en: • the system now recognizes and produces names for Unicode Hangul syllable characters.

sentences.en: the system now recognizes and produces names for Unicode Hangul syllable characters.
sentences.zh: 系统现在可以识别 Unicode Hangul 音节字符并生成名称。

blocks.html_en: • the EBCDIC-US external-format is now supported for octet operations (as well as for stream operations).

sentences.en: the EBCDIC-US external-format is now supported for octet operations (as well as for stream operations).
sentences.zh: EBCDIC-US 外部格式现在支持八位位组操作（以及流操作）。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: experimental :EMIT-CFASL parameter to COMPILE-FILE can be used to output toplevel compile-time effects into a separate .CFASL file.

sentences.en: new feature: experimental :EMIT-CFASL parameter to COMPILE-FILE can be used to output toplevel compile-time effects into a separate .CFASL file.
sentences.zh: 新功能：实验性：COMPILE-FILE 的 EMIT-CFASL 参数可用于将顶级编译时效果输出到单独的 .CFASL 文件中。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: COERCE to VECTOR, STRING, SIMPLE-STRING and recognizable one-dimenstional subtypes of ARRAY is upto 70% faster when the coercion is actually needed.

sentences.en: optimization: COERCE to VECTOR, STRING, SIMPLE-STRING and recognizable one-dimenstional subtypes of ARRAY is upto 70% faster when the coercion is actually needed.
sentences.zh: 优化：当实际需要强制转换时，强制转换为 VECTOR、STRING、SIMPLE-STRING 和 ARRAY 的可识别一维子类型的速度最多可提高 70%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: TRUNCATE on known single- and double-floats is upto 25% faster.

sentences.en: optimization: TRUNCATE on known single- and double-floats is upto 25% faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：已知单浮点数和双浮点数上的 TRUNCATE 速度提高了 25%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: division of floating point numbers by constants uses multiplication by reciprocal when an exact reciprocal exists.

sentences.en: optimization: division of floating point numbers by constants uses multiplication by reciprocal when an exact reciprocal exists.
sentences.zh: 优化：当存在精确倒数时，浮点数除以常量使用倒数乘法。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: multiplication of single- and double-floats floats by constant two has been optimized.

sentences.en: optimization: multiplication of single- and double-floats floats by constant two has been optimized.
sentences.zh: 优化：单浮点和双浮点乘以常数二的乘法已得到优化。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: ARRAY-IN-BOUNDS-P is resolved at compile-time when sufficient type information is available. (thanks to Leslie Polzer)

sentences.en: optimization: ARRAY-IN-BOUNDS-P is resolved at compile-time when sufficient type information is available.
sentences.zh: 优化：当有足够的类型信息可用时，ARRAY-IN-BOUNDS-P 在编译时解析。

sentences.en: (thanks to Leslie Polzer)
sentences.zh: （感谢莱斯利·波尔泽）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: SLOT-VALUE and (SETF SLOT-VALUE) with constant slot names on known structure objects are as efficient as defstruct generated accessors.

sentences.en: optimization: SLOT-VALUE and (SETF SLOT-VALUE) with constant slot names on known structure objects are as efficient as defstruct generated accessors.
sentences.zh: 优化：已知结构对象上具有常量槽名称的 SLOT-VALUE 和 (SETF SLOT-VALUE) 与 defstruct 生成的访问器一样高效。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: unused vector creation can now be optimized away.

sentences.en: optimization: unused vector creation can now be optimized away.
sentences.zh: 优化：现在可以优化未使用的矢量创建。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: ASDF systems can now depends on SB-INTROSPECT.

sentences.en: improvement: ASDF systems can now depends on SB-INTROSPECT.
sentences.zh: 改进：ASDF 系统现在可以依赖于 SB-INTROSPECT。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: a STYLE-WARNING is signalled when a generic function clobbers an earlier FTYPE proclamation.

sentences.en: improvement: a STYLE-WARNING is signalled when a generic function clobbers an earlier FTYPE proclamation.
sentences.zh: 改进：当通用函数破坏早期的 FTYPE 声明时，会发出样式警告信号。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: the compiler is able to track the effective type of generic function across method addition and removal even in the absence of an explicit DEFGENERIC.

sentences.en: improvement: the compiler is able to track the effective type of generic function across method addition and removal even in the absence of an explicit DEFGENERIC.
sentences.zh: 改进：即使在没有显式 DEFGENERIC 的情况下，编译器也能够跨方法添加和删除跟踪泛型函数的有效类型。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: DESCRIBE now reports on symbols naming undefined but assumed or declared function as well.

sentences.en: improvement: DESCRIBE now reports on symbols naming undefined but assumed or declared function as well.
sentences.zh: 改进：DESCRIBE 现在报告命名未定义但假设或声明的函数的符号。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: recompilation of systems using SB-GROVEL now works (thanks to Leslie Polzer)

sentences.en: improvement: recompilation of systems using SB-GROVEL now works (thanks to Leslie Polzer)
sentences.zh: 改进：现在可以使用 SB-GROVEL 重新编译系统（感谢 Leslie Polzer）

blocks.html_en:
• improvements to SB-CLTL2 (thanks to Larry D'Anna):
    • functions DECLARATION-INFORMATION, PARSE-MACRO, and ENCLOSE have been documented.
    • AUGMENT-ENVIRONMENT and DEFINE-DECLARATION have been implemented.
    • DECLARATION-INFORMATION now supports declaration name DECLARATION as well as user defined declaration names.
    • VARIABLE-INFORMATION is now aware of alien variables.

sentences.en: improvements to SB-CLTL2 (thanks to Larry D'Anna): functions DECLARATION-INFORMATION, PARSE-MACRO, and ENCLOSE have been documented.
sentences.zh: 对 SB-CLTL2 的改进（感谢 Larry D'Anna）：函数 DECLARATION-INFORMATION、PARSE-MACRO 和 ENCLOSE 已被记录。

sentences.en: AUGMENT-ENVIRONMENT and DEFINE-DECLARATION have been implemented.
sentences.zh: 增强环境和定义声明已实施。

sentences.en: DECLARATION-INFORMATION now supports declaration name DECLARATION as well as user defined declaration names.
sentences.zh: DECLARATION-INFORMATION 现在支持声明名称 DECLARATION 以及用户定义的声明名称。

sentences.en: VARIABLE-INFORMATION is now aware of alien variables.
sentences.zh: VARIABLE-INFORMATION 现在可以识别外来变量。

blocks.html_en: • functions DECLARATION-INFORMATION, PARSE-MACRO, and ENCLOSE have been documented.

sentences.en: functions DECLARATION-INFORMATION, PARSE-MACRO, and ENCLOSE have been documented.
sentences.zh: 函数 DECLARATION-INFORMATION、PARSE-MACRO 和 ENCLOSE 已被记录。

blocks.html_en: • AUGMENT-ENVIRONMENT and DEFINE-DECLARATION have been implemented.

sentences.en: AUGMENT-ENVIRONMENT and DEFINE-DECLARATION have been implemented.
sentences.zh: 增强环境和定义声明已实施。

blocks.html_en: • DECLARATION-INFORMATION now supports declaration name DECLARATION as well as user defined declaration names.

sentences.en: DECLARATION-INFORMATION now supports declaration name DECLARATION as well as user defined declaration names.
sentences.zh: DECLARATION-INFORMATION 现在支持声明名称 DECLARATION 以及用户定义的声明名称。

blocks.html_en: • VARIABLE-INFORMATION is now aware of alien variables.

sentences.en: VARIABLE-INFORMATION is now aware of alien variables.
sentences.zh: VARIABLE-INFORMATION 现在可以识别外来变量。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: improved address space layout on OpenBSD (thanks to Josh Elsasser)

sentences.en: improvement: improved address space layout on OpenBSD (thanks to Josh Elsasser)
sentences.zh: 改进：改进了 OpenBSD 上的地址空间布局（感谢 Josh Elsasser）

blocks.html_en: • improvement: pretty-printing of various Lisp forms has been improved (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: improvement: pretty-printing of various Lisp forms has been improved (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: 改进：各种 Lisp 形式的漂亮打印得到了改进（感谢 Tobias Rittweiler）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: calls to DECODE-FLOAT and INTEGER-DECODE-FLOAT whose value was unused were deleted in safe code. (reported by John Fremlin)

sentences.en: bug fix: calls to DECODE-FLOAT and INTEGER-DECODE-FLOAT whose value was unused were deleted in safe code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对 DECODE-FLOAT 和 INTEGER-DECODE-FLOAT 的调用（其值未使用）已在安全代码中删除。

sentences.en: (reported by John Fremlin)
sentences.zh: （约翰·弗雷姆林报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a failing AVER compiling certain MAKE-ARRAY forms. (reported by James Wright)

sentences.en: bug fix: a failing AVER compiling certain MAKE-ARRAY forms.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：AVER 编译某些 MAKE-ARRAY 表单失败。

sentences.en: (reported by James Wright)
sentences.zh: （詹姆斯·赖特报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: some out-of-line array predicates were missing (reported by Stelian Ionescu)

sentences.en: bug fix: some out-of-line array predicates were missing (reported by Stelian Ionescu)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：缺少一些外联数组谓词（由 Stelian Ionescu 报告）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a failing AVER in CONVERT-MV-CALL has been fixed. (thanks to Larry D'Anna)

sentences.en: bug fix: a failing AVER in CONVERT-MV-CALL has been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：CONVERT-MV-CALL 中失败的 AVER 已修复。

sentences.en: (thanks to Larry D'Anna)
sentences.zh: （感谢拉里·德安娜）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a failing AVER in %ALLOCATE-CLOSURES conversion has been fixed (thanks to Larry D'Anna)

sentences.en: bug fix: a failing AVER in %ALLOCATE-CLOSURES conversion has been fixed (thanks to Larry D'Anna)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：%ALLOCATE-CLOSURES 转换中失败的 AVER 已修复（感谢 Larry D'Anna）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SLEEP supports times over 100 million seconds on long on OpenBSD as well. (reported by Josh Elsasser)

sentences.en: bug fix: SLEEP supports times over 100 million seconds on long on OpenBSD as well.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SLEEP 在 OpenBSD 上也支持超过 1 亿秒的时间。

sentences.en: (reported by Josh Elsasser)
sentences.zh: （乔什·埃尔萨瑟报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DELETE-FILE on streams no longer closes the stream with :ABORT T, leading to possible attempts to delete the same file twice. See docstring on DELETE-FILE for details. (reported by John Fremlin)

sentences.en: bug fix: DELETE-FILE on streams no longer closes the stream with :ABORT T, leading to possible attempts to delete the same file twice.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：流上的 DELETE-FILE 不再使用 :ABORT T 关闭流，导致可能会尝试两次删除同一文件。

sentences.en: See docstring on DELETE-FILE for details.
sentences.zh: 有关详细信息，请参阅 DELETE-FILE 上的文档字符串。

sentences.en: (reported by John Fremlin)
sentences.zh: （约翰·弗雷姆林报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DELETE-FILE once again deletes the file named by the pathname designator argument, rather than its truename. (reported by Luis Oliveira)

sentences.en: bug fix: DELETE-FILE once again deletes the file named by the pathname designator argument, rather than its truename.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DELETE-FILE 再次删除由路径名指示符参数命名的文件，而不是其真实名称。

sentences.en: (reported by Luis Oliveira)
sentences.zh: （路易斯·奥利维拉报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the low-level debugger had 32-bit assumptions and was missing information about some array types. (thanks to Luis Oliveira)

sentences.en: bug fix: the low-level debugger had 32-bit assumptions and was missing information about some array types.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：低级调试器假设为 32 位，并且缺少有关某些数组类型的信息。

sentences.en: (thanks to Luis Oliveira)
sentences.zh: （感谢路易斯·奥利维拉）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: moderately complex combinations of inline expansions could be miscompiled if the result was declared to be dynamic extent.

sentences.en: bug fix: moderately complex combinations of inline expansions could be miscompiled if the result was declared to be dynamic extent.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果结果声明为动态范围，则内联扩展的中等复杂组合可能会被错误编译。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: on x86, SAP-REF of sizes greater than 8 bits with offsets of the form (+ <variable> <integer>) were miscompiled under certain circumstances.

sentences.en: bug fix: on x86, SAP-REF of sizes greater than 8 bits with offsets of the form (+ <variable> <integer>) were miscompiled under certain circumstances.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 x86 上，大小大于 8 位且偏移量形式为 (+ <variable> <integer>) 的 SAP-REF 在某些情况下会被错误编译。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: in some cases no compiler note about failure to stack allocate was emitted, even if the objects were in fact heap allocated.

sentences.en: bug fix: in some cases no compiler note about failure to stack allocate was emitted, even if the objects were in fact heap allocated.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在某些情况下，即使对象实际上是堆分配的，也不会发出有关堆栈分配失败的编译器注释。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: minor violation of "otherwise inaccessible" rule for stack allocation could cause objects users might reasonably expect to be heap allocated to be stack allocated.

sentences.en: bug fix: minor violation of "otherwise inaccessible" rule for stack allocation could cause objects users might reasonably expect to be heap allocated to be stack allocated.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：轻微违反堆栈分配的“否则无法访问”规则可能会导致用户可能合理地期望分配堆的对象被分配为堆栈。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DESCRIBE signalled an error for generic functions under certain circumstances. (thanks to Leslie Polzer)

sentences.en: bug fix: DESCRIBE signalled an error for generic functions under certain circumstances.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DESCRIBE 在某些情况下发出通用函数错误信号。

sentences.en: (thanks to Leslie Polzer)
sentences.zh: （感谢莱斯利·波尔泽）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Fixed spelling of an error message.

sentences.en: bug fix: Fixed spelling of an error message.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复了错误消息的拼写。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.30, 2009-07-17

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SB-THREAD:JOIN-THREAD-ERROR-THREAD and SB-THREAD:INTERRUPT-THREAD-ERROR-THREAD have been deprecated in favor of SB-THREAD:THREAD-ERROR-THREAD.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SB-THREAD:JOIN-THREAD-ERROR-THREAD and SB-THREAD:INTERRUPT-THREAD-ERROR-THREAD have been deprecated in favor of SB-THREAD:THREAD-ERROR-THREAD.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：SB-THREAD:JOIN-THREAD-ERROR-THREAD 和 SB-THREAD:INTERRUPT-THREAD-ERROR-THREAD 已被弃用，取而代之的是 SB-THREAD:THREAD-ERROR-THREAD。

blocks.html_en: • new contrib module: SB-QUEUE provides thread-safe lockless FIFO queues.

sentences.en: new contrib module: SB-QUEUE provides thread-safe lockless FIFO queues.
sentences.zh: 新的 contrib 模块：SB-QUEUE 提供线程安全的无锁 FIFO 队列。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: docstrings for local and anonymous functions are no longer discarded. (thanks to Leslie Polzer)

sentences.en: new feature: docstrings for local and anonymous functions are no longer discarded.
sentences.zh: 新功能：本地和匿名函数的文档字符串不再被丢弃。

sentences.en: (thanks to Leslie Polzer)
sentences.zh: （感谢莱斯利·波尔泽）

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-THREAD:SYMBOL-VALUE-IN-THREAD provides access to symbol values in other threads.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-THREAD:SYMBOL-VALUE-IN-THREAD provides access to symbol values in other threads.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-THREAD:SYMBOL-VALUE-IN-THREAD 提供对其他线程中符号值的访问。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-INTROSPECT:ALLOCATION-INFORMATION provides information about object allocation.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-INTROSPECT:ALLOCATION-INFORMATION provides information about object allocation.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-INTROSPECT:ALLOCATION-INFORMATION 提供有关对象分配的信息。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: division of a real float by a complex float is implemented with a specialised code sequence.

sentences.en: optimization: division of a real float by a complex float is implemented with a specialised code sequence.
sentences.zh: 优化：实浮点数除以复浮点数是通过专门的代码序列实现的。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: MAKE-INSTANCE with non-constant class-argument but constant keywords is an order of magnitude faster.

sentences.en: optimization: MAKE-INSTANCE with non-constant class-argument but constant keywords is an order of magnitude faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：使用非恒定类参数但使用恒定关键字的 MAKE-INSTANCE 速度要快一个数量级。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: MAKE-INSTANCE with constant keyword arguments is x2-4 faster in the presence of :AROUND or non-standard primary INITIALIZE-INSTANCE methods, and similarly for non-standard metaclass classes as long as there are no methods additional on MAKE-INSTANCE.

sentences.en: optimization: MAKE-INSTANCE with constant keyword arguments is x2-4 faster in the presence of :AROUND or non-standard primary INITIALIZE-INSTANCE methods, and similarly for non-standard metaclass classes as long as there are no methods additional on MAKE-INSTANCE.
sentences.zh: 优化：在存在 :AROUND 或非标准主要 INITIALIZE-INSTANCE 方法的情况下，带有常量关键字参数的 MAKE-INSTANCE 速度要快 2-4 倍，对于非标准元类类也类似，只要 MAKE-INSTANCE 上没有附加方法即可。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: more efficient type-checks for FIXNUMs when the value is known to be a signed word on x86 and x86-64.

sentences.en: optimization: more efficient type-checks for FIXNUMs when the value is known to be a signed word on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：当已知值是 x86 和 x86-64 上的有符号字时，对 FIXNUM 进行更有效的类型检查。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: compiler now optimizes (EXPT -1 INTEGER), (EXPT -1.0 INTEGER), and (EXPT -1.0d0 INTEGER) into an ODDP test. (thanks to Stas Boukarev and Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: optimization: compiler now optimizes (EXPT -1 INTEGER), (EXPT -1.0 INTEGER), and (EXPT -1.0d0 INTEGER) into an ODDP test.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器现在将 (EXPT -1 INTEGER)、(EXPT -1.0 INTEGER) 和 (EXPT -1.0d0 INTEGER) 优化为 ODDP 测试。

sentences.en: (thanks to Stas Boukarev and Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Stas Boukarev 和 Paul Khuong）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: compiler is smarter about delegating argument type checks to callees.

sentences.en: optimization: compiler is smarter about delegating argument type checks to callees.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器在将参数类型检查委托给被调用者方面更加智能。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: several character functions are now compiled somewhat more efficiently. (reported by Lynn Quam)

sentences.en: optimization: several character functions are now compiled somewhat more efficiently.
sentences.zh: 优化：现在可以更有效地编译几个字符函数。

sentences.en: (reported by Lynn Quam)
sentences.zh: （林恩·夸姆报道）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the compiler now derives simple types for LOAD-VALUE-FORMs.

sentences.en: optimization: the compiler now derives simple types for LOAD-VALUE-FORMs.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器现在为 LOAD-VALUE-FORM 派生简单类型。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: less unsafe constant folding in floating point arithmetic, especially for mixed complex/real -float operations.

sentences.en: improvement: less unsafe constant folding in floating point arithmetic, especially for mixed complex/real -float operations.
sentences.zh: 改进：浮点运算中不安全的常量折叠更少，特别是对于混合复数/实数浮点运算。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: constant double and single floats are stored in native unboxed format on x86[-64].

sentences.en: optimization: constant double and single floats are stored in native unboxed format on x86[-64].
sentences.zh: 优化：常量双精度和单精度浮点在 x86[-64] 上以本机未装箱格式存储。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: smarter code for arithmetic operations with constant floats, complex floats, or integers on x86[-64].

sentences.en: optimization: smarter code for arithmetic operations with constant floats, complex floats, or integers on x86[-64].
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86[-64] 上使用常量浮点数、复数浮点数或整数进行算术运算的更智能代码。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: smarter code for conjugate/multiplication of float complexes and abs/negate of floats on x86-64.

sentences.en: optimization: smarter code for conjugate/multiplication of float complexes and abs/negate of floats on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：x86-64 上浮点复数的共轭/乘法和浮点的绝对值/求反的更智能代码。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: more efficient complex float and real float operations on x86-64.

sentences.en: optimization: more efficient complex float and real float operations on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：x86-64 上更高效的复杂浮点和实浮点运算。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: complex float division is slightly more stable.

sentences.en: improvement: complex float division is slightly more stable.
sentences.zh: 改进：复杂的浮点数除法稍微稳定一些。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: DESCRIBE output has been reworked to be easier to read and contains more pertinent information.

sentences.en: improvement: DESCRIBE output has been reworked to be easier to read and contains more pertinent information.
sentences.zh: 改进：DESCRIBE 输出经过重新设计，更易于阅读并包含更多相关信息。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: failure to provide requested stack allocation compiler notes provided in all cases (requested stack allocation not happening without a note being issued is now considered a bug.)

sentences.en: improvement: failure to provide requested stack allocation compiler notes provided in all cases (requested stack allocation not happening without a note being issued is now considered a bug.)
sentences.zh: 改进：在所有情况下都无法提供请求的堆栈分配编译器注释（如果没有发出注释，则请求的堆栈分配不会发生，现在被视为错误。）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-POSIX exports the documented types and functions FILE-DESCRIPTOR and FILENAME, and also the corresponding -DESCRIPTOR types. (reported by "abhi")

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-POSIX exports the documented types and functions FILE-DESCRIPTOR and FILENAME, and also the corresponding -DESCRIPTOR types.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-POSIX 导出记录的类型和函数 FILE-DESCRIPTOR 和 FILENAME，以及相应的 -DESCRIPTOR 类型。

sentences.en: (reported by "abhi")
sentences.zh: （《阿比》报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: on 64 bit platforms FILL worked incorrectly on arrays with upgraded element type (COMPLEX SINGLE-FLOAT), regression from 1.0.28.55. (thanks to Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: bug fix: on 64 bit platforms FILL worked incorrectly on arrays with upgraded element type (COMPLEX SINGLE-FLOAT), regression from 1.0.28.55.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 64 位平台上，FILL 在具有升级元素类型 (COMPLEX SINGLE-FLOAT) 的数组上无法正常工作，从 1.0.28.55 开始回归。

sentences.en: (thanks to Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Paul Khuong）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: looping around HANDLER-CASE could silently consume stack space on each iteration. (reported by "foobar")

sentences.en: bug fix: looping around HANDLER-CASE could silently consume stack space on each iteration.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：循环 HANDLER-CASE 可能会在每次迭代时默默地消耗堆栈空间。

sentences.en: (reported by "foobar")
sentences.zh: （《foobar》报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: better error signalling when calls to functions seeking elements from lists (eg. ADJOIN) are compiled with both :TEST and :TEST-NOT. (reported by Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: bug fix: better error signalling when calls to functions seeking elements from lists (eg.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当调用从列表中查找元素的函数时，更好的错误信号（例如

sentences.en: ADJOIN) are compiled with both :TEST and :TEST-NOT.
sentences.zh: ADJOIN) 使用 :TEST 和 :TEST-NOT 进行编译。

sentences.en: (reported by Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （托比亚斯·里特韦勒报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: regressions in DIRECTORY from 1.0.28.61: pattern matching of directory components now works as it used to. (various prolems reported by Michael Becker, Gabriel Dos Reis, Cyrus Harmon, and Harald Hanche-Olsen)

sentences.en: bug fix: regressions in DIRECTORY from 1.0.28.61: pattern matching of directory components now works as it used to.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：从 1.0.28.61 开始，目录中的回归：目录组件的模式匹配现在像以前一样工作。

sentences.en: (various prolems reported by Michael Becker, Gabriel Dos Reis, Cyrus Harmon, and Harald Hanche-Olsen)
sentences.zh: （Michael Becker、Gabriel Dos Reis、Cyrus Harmon 和 Harald Hanche-Olsen 报告的各种问题）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: :PTY option in RUN-PROGRAM was broken with stream arguments. (reported by Elliot Slaughter, thanks to Stas Boukarev)

sentences.en: bug fix: :PTY option in RUN-PROGRAM was broken with stream arguments.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：RUN-PROGRAM 中的 :PTY 选项被流参数破坏。

sentences.en: (reported by Elliot Slaughter, thanks to Stas Boukarev)
sentences.zh: （埃利奥特·斯劳特报道，感谢斯塔斯·布卡列夫）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: bogus undefined variable warnings from fopcompiled references to global variables. (thanks to Lars Rune Nøstdal)

sentences.en: bug fix: bogus undefined variable warnings from fopcompiled references to global variables.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：来自 fopcompiled 的全局变量引用的虚假未定义变量警告。

sentences.en: (thanks to Lars Rune Nøstdal)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Lars Rune Nøstdal）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: foreign function names should now appear in backtraces on FC6 as well. (reported by Tomasz Skutnik and Tobias Rautenkranz)

sentences.en: bug fix: foreign function names should now appear in backtraces on FC6 as well.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：外部函数名称现在也应该出现在 FC6 的回溯中。

sentences.en: (reported by Tomasz Skutnik and Tobias Rautenkranz)
sentences.zh: （托马斯·斯库特尼克和托比亚斯·劳滕克兰兹报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SETF compiler macro documentation strings are not discarded anymore.

sentences.en: bug fix: SETF compiler macro documentation strings are not discarded anymore.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SETF 编译器宏文档字符串不再被丢弃。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: GENTEMP is now unaffected by pretty printer dispatch table. (thanks to Alex Plotnick)

sentences.en: bug fix: GENTEMP is now unaffected by pretty printer dispatch table.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：GENTEMP 现在不受漂亮打印机调度表的影响。

sentences.en: (thanks to Alex Plotnick)
sentences.zh: （感谢亚历克斯·普洛特尼克）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SLEEP accepts large integer arguments, truncating them to SIGNED-WORD on the assumption that sleeping for 68 years is sufficient for anyone. (reported by Leslie Polzer, thanks to Stas Boukarev)

sentences.en: bug fix: SLEEP accepts large integer arguments, truncating them to SIGNED-WORD on the assumption that sleeping for 68 years is sufficient for anyone.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SLEEP 接受大整数参数，假设睡眠 68 年对任何人来说都足够，则将它们截断为 SIGNED-WORD。

sentences.en: (reported by Leslie Polzer, thanks to Stas Boukarev)
sentences.zh: （莱斯利·波尔泽 (Leslie Polzer) 报道，感谢斯塔斯·布卡列夫 (Stas Boukarev)）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: compiler notes for expensive slot type checks could be emitted at runtime MAKE-INSTANCE calls. (reported by Samium Gromoff)

sentences.en: bug fix: compiler notes for expensive slot type checks could be emitted at runtime MAKE-INSTANCE calls.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：昂贵的插槽类型检查的编译器注释可能会在运行时 MAKE-INSTANCE 调用时发出。

sentences.en: (reported by Samium Gromoff)
sentences.zh: （萨米姆·格罗莫夫报道）

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.29, 2009-06-04

blocks.html_en: • IMPORTANT: bug database has moved from the BUGS file to Launchpad https://bugs.launchpad.net/sbcl Bugs can be reported directly there, or by sending email to sbcl-bugs@lists.sourceforge.net (no subscription required.)

sentences.en: IMPORTANT: bug database has moved from the BUGS file to Launchpad https://bugs.launchpad.net/sbcl Bugs can be reported directly there, or by sending email to sbcl-bugs@lists.sourceforge.net (no subscription required.)
sentences.zh: 重要提示：错误数据库已从 BUGS 文件移至 Launchpad https://bugs.launchpad.net/sbcl 可以直接在那里报告错误，或通过发送电子邮件至 sbcl-bugs@lists.sourceforge.net（无需订阅。）

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: under weak type checking policy integer types are weakened less aggressively.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: under weak type checking policy integer types are weakened less aggressively.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：在弱类型检查策略下，整数类型的削弱程度较小。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE :TOPLEVEL function is now allowed to return, which causes SBCL to quit with exit status 0. Previously if the function returned with a small integer return value, that value was accidentally reused as the exit status.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE :TOPLEVEL function is now allowed to return, which causes SBCL to quit with exit status 0.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE :TOPLEVEL 函数现在允许返回，这会导致 SBCL 以退出状态 0 退出。

sentences.en: Previously if the function returned with a small integer return value, that value was accidentally reused as the exit status.
sentences.zh: 以前，如果函数返回一个小整数返回值，该值会被意外地重新用作退出状态。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-EXT:DEFINE-HASH-TABLE-TEST allows defining new arguments to MAKE-HASH-TABLE :TEST, and MAKE-HASH-TABLE has been extended with :HASH-FUNCTION argument. Refer to user manual for details.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-EXT:DEFINE-HASH-TABLE-TEST allows defining new arguments to MAKE-HASH-TABLE :TEST, and MAKE-HASH-TABLE has been extended with :HASH-FUNCTION argument.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-EXT:DEFINE-HASH-TABLE-TEST 允许为 MAKE-HASH-TABLE :TEST 定义新参数，并且 MAKE-HASH-TABLE 已使用 :HASH-FUNCTION 参数进行扩展。

sentences.en: Refer to user manual for details.
sentences.zh: 详细信息请参阅用户手册。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-EXT:DEFGLOBAL macro allows defining global non-special variables.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-EXT:DEFGLOBAL macro allows defining global non-special variables.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-EXT:DEFGLOBAL 宏允许定义全局非特殊变量。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-EXT:GET-TIME-OF-DAY provides access to seconds and microseconds since the Unix epoch on all platforms.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-EXT:GET-TIME-OF-DAY provides access to seconds and microseconds since the Unix epoch on all platforms.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-EXT:GET-TIME-OF-DAY 提供对所有平台上自 Unix 纪元以来的秒和微秒的访问。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-EXT:ALWAYS-BOUND proclamation inhibits MAKUNBOUND, and allows the compiler to safely elide boundedness checks for special variables.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-EXT:ALWAYS-BOUND proclamation inhibits MAKUNBOUND, and allows the compiler to safely elide boundedness checks for special variables.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-EXT:ALWAYS-BOUND 声明会抑制 MAKUNBOUND，并允许编译器安全地忽略特殊变量的有界性检查。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-EXT:GLOBAL proclamation inhibits SPECIAL proclamations for the symbol, prohibits both lexical and dynamic binding. This is mainly an efficiency measure for threaded platforms, but also valueable in expressing intent.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-EXT:GLOBAL proclamation inhibits SPECIAL proclamations for the symbol, prohibits both lexical and dynamic binding.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-EXT：GLOBAL 声明禁止符号的特殊声明，禁止词汇和动态绑定。

sentences.en: This is mainly an efficiency measure for threaded platforms, but also valueable in expressing intent.
sentences.zh: 这主要是线程平台的效率衡量标准，但对于表达意图也很有价值。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: UNC pathnames are now understood by the system on Windows.

sentences.en: new feature: UNC pathnames are now understood by the system on Windows.
sentences.zh: 新功能：Windows 系统现在可以理解 UNC 路径名。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the compiler uses a specialized version of FILL when the element type is know in more cases, making eg. (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) case almost 90% faster.

sentences.en: optimization: the compiler uses a specialized version of FILL when the element type is know in more cases, making eg.
sentences.zh: 优化：当在更多情况下知道元素类型时，编译器会使用专门版本的 FILL，例如：

sentences.en: (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) case almost 90% faster.
sentences.zh: (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) 情况几乎快了 90%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: accesses to potentially non-simple arrays where element type is known are 50% faster.

sentences.en: optimization: accesses to potentially non-simple arrays where element type is known are 50% faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：访问元素类型已知的潜在非简单数组的速度提高了 50%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: compiler now generates faster array typechecking code.

sentences.en: optimization: compiler now generates faster array typechecking code.
sentences.zh: 优化：编译器现在生成更快的数组类型检查代码。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: ARRAY-DIMENSION is now faster for multidimensional and non-simple arrays.

sentences.en: optimization: ARRAY-DIMENSION is now faster for multidimensional and non-simple arrays.
sentences.zh: 优化：对于多维和非简单数组，ARRAY-DIMENSION 现在速度更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: multidimensional array accesses in the absence of type information regarding array rank are approximately 10% faster due to open coding of ARRAY-RANK.

sentences.en: optimization: multidimensional array accesses in the absence of type information regarding array rank are approximately 10% faster due to open coding of ARRAY-RANK.
sentences.zh: 优化：由于 ARRAY-RANK 的开放编码，在缺乏有关数组排名的类型信息的情况下，多维数组访问速度大约快 10%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: result of (FILL (MAKE-ARRAY ...) ...) and (REPLACE (MAKE-ARRAY ...) ...) can be stack allocated if the result of MAKE-ARRAY form can be.

sentences.en: optimization: result of (FILL (MAKE-ARRAY ...) ...)
sentences.zh: 优化： (FILL (MAKE-ARRAY ...) ...) 的结果

sentences.en: and (REPLACE (MAKE-ARRAY ...) ...)
sentences.zh: 和（替换（制作数组...）...）

sentences.en: can be stack allocated if the result of MAKE-ARRAY form can be.
sentences.zh: 如果 MAKE-ARRAY 形式的结果可以，则可以分配堆栈。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: result of call to VECTOR can now be stack allocated.

sentences.en: optimization: result of call to VECTOR can now be stack allocated.
sentences.zh: 优化：现在可以对 VECTOR 调用的结果进行堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: MAKE-ARRAY with :INITIAL-CONTENTS is now vastly faster as long as the resulting array is one-dimensional and has a known element type. In particular, :INITIAL-CONTENTS (LIST ...) where the length of the list matches the known length of the vector does not allocate the list as an intermediate step. Ditto for VECTOR and simple backquoted forms.

sentences.en: optimization: MAKE-ARRAY with :INITIAL-CONTENTS is now vastly faster as long as the resulting array is one-dimensional and has a known element type.
sentences.zh: 优化：只要生成的数组是一维的并且具有已知的元素类型，使用 :INITIAL-CONTENTS 的 MAKE-ARRAY 现在就会快得多。

sentences.en: In particular, :INITIAL-CONTENTS (LIST ...)
sentences.zh: 特别是：初始内容（列表...）

sentences.en: where the length of the list matches the known length of the vector does not allocate the list as an intermediate step.
sentences.zh: 如果列表的长度与向量的已知长度匹配，则不会将列表分配为中间步骤。

sentences.en: Ditto for VECTOR and simple backquoted forms.
sentences.zh: VECTOR 和简单反引号形式也是如此。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: MAKE-ARRAY can now stack allocate in the presence of :INITIAL-CONTENTS and :INITIAL-ELEMENT as long as the result has a known element type, and is known to be simple and one dimensional.

sentences.en: optimization: MAKE-ARRAY can now stack allocate in the presence of :INITIAL-CONTENTS and :INITIAL-ELEMENT as long as the result has a known element type, and is known to be simple and one dimensional.
sentences.zh: 优化：MAKE-ARRAY 现在可以在存在 :INITIAL-CONTENTS 和 :INITIAL-ELEMENT 的情况下进行堆栈分配，只要结果具有已知的元素类型，并且已知是简单的和一维的。

blocks.html_en: • improvement: SBCL now emits a compiler note where stack allocation was requested but could not be provided (not in all cases, unfortunately)

sentences.en: improvement: SBCL now emits a compiler note where stack allocation was requested but could not be provided (not in all cases, unfortunately)
sentences.zh: 改进：SBCL 现在会发出编译器注释，其中请求了堆栈分配但无法提供（不幸的是，并非在所有情况下）

blocks.html_en: • improvement: better MACHINE-VERSION responses. (thanks to Josh Elsasser)

sentences.en: improvement: better MACHINE-VERSION responses.
sentences.zh: 改进：更好的机器版本响应。

sentences.en: (thanks to Josh Elsasser)
sentences.zh: （感谢乔什·埃尔萨瑟）

blocks.html_en: • improvement: pretty-printing loop has been implemented properly. (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: improvement: pretty-printing loop has been implemented properly.
sentences.zh: 改进：漂亮的打印循环已正确实现。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯·里特韦勒）

blocks.html_en: • documentation: CLOS slot typechecing policy has been documented.

sentences.en: documentation: CLOS slot typechecing policy has been documented.
sentences.zh: 文档：CLOS 槽类型检查策略已记录。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FILE-AUTHOR no longer signals an error on Windows.

sentences.en: bug fix: FILE-AUTHOR no longer signals an error on Windows.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：FILE-AUTHOR 不再在 Windows 上发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-SPROF could be foiled by foreign code not have a frame pointer, leading to memory faults. (thanks to Bart Botta)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-SPROF could be foiled by foreign code not have a frame pointer, leading to memory faults.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-SPROF 可能会被没有帧指针的外部代码阻止，从而导致内存错误。

sentences.en: (thanks to Bart Botta)
sentences.zh: （感谢巴特·博塔）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: better floating point exception handling on x86/OpenBSD. (thanks to Josh Elsasser)

sentences.en: bug fix: better floating point exception handling on x86/OpenBSD.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：x86/OpenBSD 上更好的浮点异常处理。

sentences.en: (thanks to Josh Elsasser)
sentences.zh: （感谢乔什·埃尔萨瑟）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: exit status from QUIT when called under --script was lost (reported by Hubert Kauker)

sentences.en: bug fix: exit status from QUIT when called under --script was lost (reported by Hubert Kauker)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 --script 下调用时从 QUIT 退出状态丢失（由 Hubert Kauker 报告）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: MAKE-ARRAY for non-zero :INITIAL-ELEMENT always used the same implementation of FILL to initialize the array, even if a more efficient one was available (reported by Stas Boukarev, thanks to Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: bug fix: MAKE-ARRAY for non-zero :INITIAL-ELEMENT always used the same implementation of FILL to initialize the array, even if a more efficient one was available (reported by Stas Boukarev, thanks to Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：非零的 MAKE-ARRAY :INITIAL-ELEMENT 始终使用相同的 FILL 实现来初始化数组，即使有更高效的实现（由 Stas Boukarev 报告，感谢 Paul Khuong）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: potential miscompilation of array stack allocation on x86 and x86-64. (reported by Time Tossavainen)

sentences.en: bug fix: potential miscompilation of array stack allocation on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：x86 和 x86-64 上数组堆栈分配的潜在错误编译。

sentences.en: (reported by Time Tossavainen)
sentences.zh: （时代托萨维宁报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: some forms of AND, OR, and COND resulted in expansions that could result in their subforms being treated as top level forms. (reported by James Knight)

sentences.en: bug fix: some forms of AND, OR, and COND resulted in expansions that could result in their subforms being treated as top level forms.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：某些形式的 AND、OR 和 COND 导致扩展，可能导致其子形式被视为顶级形式。

sentences.en: (reported by James Knight)
sentences.zh: （詹姆斯·奈特报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: On x86/x86-64 alien functions declared to return integers shorter than a machine register could leave garbage in the high bits of the result register (bug 316325).

sentences.en: bug fix: On x86/x86-64 alien functions declared to return integers shorter than a machine register could leave garbage in the high bits of the result register (bug 316325).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 x86/x86-64 上，声明返回比机器寄存器短的整数的外来函数可能会在结果寄存器的高位中留下垃圾（错误 316325）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: disable address space randomization Linux/x86-64 as well, not just x86-64. (reported by Ken Olum)

sentences.en: bug fix: disable address space randomization Linux/x86-64 as well, not just x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：禁用地址空间随机化 Linux/x86-64，而不仅仅是 x86-64。

sentences.en: (reported by Ken Olum)
sentences.zh: （肯·奥勒姆报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Attempting to DEREF an (ALIEN (* T)) would produce a WARNING and generate incorrect code.

sentences.en: bug fix: Attempting to DEREF an (ALIEN (* T)) would produce a WARNING and generate incorrect code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：尝试 DEREF (ALIEN (* T)) 会产生警告并生成不正确的代码。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: #201; type inference for CONS and ARRAY types could derive wrong results in the presence of eg. RPLACA or ADJUST-ARRAY.

sentences.en: bug fix: #201; type inference for CONS and ARRAY types could derive wrong results in the presence of eg.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：#201； CONS 和 ARRAY 类型的类型推断可能会在存在例如的情况下得出错误的结果。

sentences.en: RPLACA or ADJUST-ARRAY.
sentences.zh: RPLACA 或调整阵列。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: special variables with a proclaimed specific subtype of FUNCTION could not be assigned to or bound with PROGV. (reported by Lorenz Mösenlechner)

sentences.en: bug fix: special variables with a proclaimed specific subtype of FUNCTION could not be assigned to or bound with PROGV.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：具有声明的特定 FUNCTION 子类型的特殊变量无法分配给 PROGV 或与 PROGV 绑定。

sentences.en: (reported by Lorenz Mösenlechner)
sentences.zh: （洛伦兹·莫森莱赫纳报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the value of CL:- in the inspector was the previous expression evaluated rather than the expression being evaluated.

sentences.en: bug fix: the value of CL:- in the inspector was the previous expression evaluated rather than the expression being evaluated.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：检查器中 CL:- 的值是之前计算的表达式，而不是正在计算的表达式。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: constants can no longer be locally declared special.

sentences.en: bug fix: constants can no longer be locally declared special.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：常量不能再在本地声明为特殊常量。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: signals delivered to threads started from foreign land (read: directly by pthread_create, not by MAKE-THREAD) are redirected to a Lisp thread by blocking all signals and resignalling.

sentences.en: bug fix: signals delivered to threads started from foreign land (read: directly by pthread_create, not by MAKE-THREAD) are redirected to a Lisp thread by blocking all signals and resignalling.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：传递到从外国启动的线程的信号（阅读：直接通过 pthread_create，而不是通过 MAKE-THREAD）通过阻止所有信号和重新发信号来重定向到 Lisp 线程。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SHARED-INITIALIZE initialized unbound :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots from :INITFORM, if any.

sentences.en: bug fix: SHARED-INITIALIZE initialized unbound :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots from :INITFORM, if any.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SHARED-INITIALIZE 从 :INITFORM 初始化了未绑定的 :ALLOCATION :CLASS 插槽（如果有）。

blocks.html_en: • a number of bugs in cross-compilation have been fixed, with the ultimate result that building under (at least) clisp should be much more reliable.

blocks.html_en: • improvement: the system either recovers from stack exhaustion or dies properly as opposed to leaving the user uncertain of whether the handler trampled on some random memory next to the stack or having to rely on --lose-on-corruption (which is still a good idea to use in production because stack exhaustion can happen in signal handlers which will likely lead to hangs.)

sentences.en: improvement: the system either recovers from stack exhaustion or dies properly as opposed to leaving the user uncertain of whether the handler trampled on some random memory next to the stack or having to rely on --lose-on-corruption (which is still a good idea to use in production because stack exhaustion can happen in signal handlers which will likely lead to hangs.)
sentences.zh: 改进：系统要么从堆栈耗尽中恢复，要么正常死亡，而不是让用户不确定处理程序是否践踏了堆栈旁边的一些随机内存，或者必须依赖 --lose-on-corruption （这在生产中使用仍然是一个好主意，因为堆栈耗尽可能发生在信号处理程序中，这可能会导致挂起。）

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: an interruption (be it a function passed to INTERRUPT-THREAD or a timer function) runs in an environment where interrupts can be enabled. The interruption can use WITH-INTERRUPTS or WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS as it sees fit. Use WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS to avoid nesting of interruptions and potentially running out of stack. Keep in mind that in the absence of WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS some potentially blocking operation such as acquiring a lock can enable interrupts.

sentences.en: incompatible change: an interruption (be it a function passed to INTERRUPT-THREAD or a timer function) runs in an environment where interrupts can be enabled.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：中断（无论是传递给 INTERRUPT-THREAD 的函数还是计时器函数）在可以启用中断的环境中运行。

sentences.en: The interruption can use WITH-INTERRUPTS or WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS as it sees fit.
sentences.zh: 中断可以根据需要使用WITH-INTERRUPTS 或WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS。

sentences.en: Use WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS to avoid nesting of interruptions and potentially running out of stack.
sentences.zh: 使用WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS 可以避免中断嵌套和潜在的堆栈溢出。

sentences.en: Keep in mind that in the absence of WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS some potentially blocking operation such as acquiring a lock can enable interrupts.
sentences.zh: 请记住，在没有无中断的情况下，某些潜在的阻塞操作（例如获取锁）可以启用中断。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: GC-OFF and GC-ON are removed, as they were always unsafe. Use WITHOUT-GCING instead.

sentences.en: incompatible change: GC-OFF and GC-ON are removed, as they were always unsafe.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：GC-OFF 和 GC-ON 被删除，因为它们始终不安全。

sentences.en: Use WITHOUT-GCING instead.
sentences.zh: 请改用 NOT-GCING。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: runtime option --disable-ldb

sentences.en: new feature: runtime option --disable-ldb
sentences.zh: 新功能：运行时选项 --disable-ldb

blocks.html_en: • new feature: runtime option --lose-on-corruption to die at the slightest hint of possibly non-recoverable errors: running out of memory, stack, alien stack, binding stack, encountering a memory fault, etc. In the absence of --lose-on-corruption a warning is printed to stderr.

sentences.en: new feature: runtime option --lose-on-corruption to die at the slightest hint of possibly non-recoverable errors: running out of memory, stack, alien stack, binding stack, encountering a memory fault, etc. In the absence of --lose-on-corruption a warning is printed to stderr.
sentences.zh: 新功能：运行时选项 --lose-on-corruption 会在出现最轻微的可能不可恢复错误的提示时终止：内存不足、堆栈、外来堆栈、绑定堆栈、遇到内存故障等。如果没有 --lose-on-corruption，则会将警告打印到 stderr。

sentences.en: If an expiration time is in the past it will trigger after a short grace period that may give a chance to other things to run.

sentences.zh: （斯蒂芬·韦斯特福尔德报道，感谢鲁迪·施拉特）

blocks.html_en: • SB-BSD-SOCKETS now works from saved cores as well. (reported by Stephen Westfold, thanks to Rudi Schlatte)

sentences.en: SB-BSD-SOCKETS now works from saved cores as well.
sentences.zh: SB-BSD-SOCKETS 现在也可以在保存的内核上运行。

sentences.en: (reported by Stephen Westfold, thanks to Rudi Schlatte)
sentences.zh: （斯蒂芬·韦斯特福尔德报道，感谢鲁迪·施拉特）

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.24, 2008-12-31

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • new feature: ARRAY-STORAGE-VECTOR provides access to the underlying data vector of a multidimensional SIMPLE-ARRAY.

sentences.en: new feature: ARRAY-STORAGE-VECTOR provides access to the underlying data vector of a multidimensional SIMPLE-ARRAY.
sentences.zh: 新功能：ARRAY-STORAGE-VECTOR 提供对多维 SIMPLE-ARRAY 的底层数据向量的访问。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: the system now signals a continuable error if standard readtable modification is attempted. (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: new feature: the system now signals a continuable error if standard readtable modification is attempted.
sentences.zh: 新功能：如果尝试进行标准可读表修改，系统现在会发出持续错误信号。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯·里特韦勒）

blocks.html_en: • new feature: DIRECTORY has been extended with a non-standard keyword argument :RESOLVE-SYMLINKS. (thanks to TC-Rucho)

sentences.en: new feature: DIRECTORY has been extended with a non-standard keyword argument :RESOLVE-SYMLINKS.
sentences.zh: 新功能：DIRECTORY 已使用非标准关键字参数进行了扩展：RESOLVE-SYMLINKS。

sentences.en: (thanks to TC-Rucho)
sentences.zh: （感谢 TC-Rucho）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:MAKE-SOCKET-STREAM keyword argument handling has been robustified and documented better. (thanks to Robert Goldman)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:MAKE-SOCKET-STREAM keyword argument handling has been robustified and documented better.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-BSD-SOCKETS:MAKE-SOCKET-STREAM 关键字参数处理已得到增强并得到更好的记录。

sentences.en: (thanks to Robert Goldman)
sentences.zh: （感谢罗伯特·戈德曼）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: faster generic arithmetic dispatch on x86 and x86-64.

sentences.en: optimization: faster generic arithmetic dispatch on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86 和 x86-64 上更快的通用算术调度。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: FORMAT ~D and ~F are now approximately 5% faster.

sentences.en: optimization: FORMAT ~D and ~F are now approximately 5% faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：FORMAT ~D 和 ~F 现在大约快 5%。

blocks.html_en: • tradeoff: constant FORMAT control strings are now compiled unless SPACE > SPEED (previously only when SPEED > SPACE.)

sentences.en: tradeoff: constant FORMAT control strings are now compiled unless SPACE > SPEED (previously only when SPEED > SPACE.)
sentences.zh: 权衡：现在编译常量 FORMAT 控制字符串，除非 SPACE > SPEED（以前仅当 SPEED > SPACE 时）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Red Hat Enterprise 3 mmap randomization workaround. (thanks to Thomas Burdick)

sentences.en: bug fix: Red Hat Enterprise 3 mmap randomization workaround.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：Red Hat Enterprise 3 mmap 随机化解决方法。

sentences.en: (thanks to Thomas Burdick)
sentences.zh: （感谢托马斯·伯迪克）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DEFCLASS and ENSURE-CLASS-USING-CLASS are now expected to be thread safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: DEFCLASS and ENSURE-CLASS-USING-CLASS are now expected to be thread safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DEFCLASS 和 ENSURE-CLASS-USING-CLASS 现在预计是线程安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: lexical type declarations are now correctly reported by SB-CLTL2. (reported by Larry D'Anna)

sentences.en: bug fix: lexical type declarations are now correctly reported by SB-CLTL2.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-CLTL2 现在可以正确报告词法类型声明。

sentences.en: (reported by Larry D'Anna)
sentences.zh: （拉里·德安娜报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: STRING-TO-OCTETS did not handle :START properly when using UTF-8 as external format. (thanks to Luis Oliveira)

sentences.en: bug fix: STRING-TO-OCTETS did not handle :START properly when using UTF-8 as external format.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 UTF-8 作为外部格式时，STRING-TO-OCTETS 无法正确处理 :START。

sentences.en: (thanks to Luis Oliveira)
sentences.zh: （感谢路易斯·奥利维拉）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: errors from invalid fill-pointer values to (SETF FILL-POINTER) are signalled correctly. (thanks to Stas Boukarev)

sentences.en: bug fix: errors from invalid fill-pointer values to (SETF FILL-POINTER) are signalled correctly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：正确指示从无效填充指针值到 (SETF FILL-POINTER) 的错误。

sentences.en: (thanks to Stas Boukarev)
sentences.zh: （感谢斯塔斯·布卡列夫）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SET-MACRO-CHARACTER accepts NIL as the readtable designator. (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: bug fix: SET-MACRO-CHARACTER accepts NIL as the readtable designator.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SET-MACRO-CHARACTER 接受 NIL 作为可读指示符。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯·里特韦勒）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SET-DISPATCH-MACRO-CHARACTER accepts NIL as the readtable designator, and returns T instead of the function. (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: bug fix: SET-DISPATCH-MACRO-CHARACTER accepts NIL as the readtable designator, and returns T instead of the function.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SET-DISPATCH-MACRO-CHARACTER 接受 NIL 作为可读指示符，并返回 T 而不是函数。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯·里特韦勒）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: direct superclasses of STANDARD-CLASS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS now default to STANDARD-OBJECT and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT as required by AMOP.

sentences.en: bug fix: direct superclasses of STANDARD-CLASS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS now default to STANDARD-OBJECT and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT as required by AMOP.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：STANDARD-CLASS 和 FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS 的直接超类现在默认为 AMOP 要求的 STANDARD-OBJECT 和 FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: compiling a call to SLOT-VALUE with a constant slot-name when no class with the named slot yet exists no longer causes a compile-time style-warning.

sentences.en: bug fix: compiling a call to SLOT-VALUE with a constant slot-name when no class with the named slot yet exists no longer causes a compile-time style-warning.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当不存在具有指定槽的类时，使用常量槽名称编译对 SLOT-VALUE 的调用不再导致编译时样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots are type-checked properly in safe code. (reported by Didier Verna)

sentences.en: bug fix: :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots are type-checked properly in safe code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复： :ALLOCATION :CLASS 插槽在安全代码中进行了正确的类型检查。

sentences.en: (reported by Didier Verna)
sentences.zh: （迪迪埃·维尔纳报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: #430; nested structure constructors can stack allocate.

sentences.en: bug fix: #430; nested structure constructors can stack allocate.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：#430；嵌套结构构造函数可以进行堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: on some 64-bit platforms dynamic space size was truncated to #xffff0000 bytes. (reported by Benjamin Lambert)

sentences.en: bug fix: on some 64-bit platforms dynamic space size was truncated to #xffff0000 bytes.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在某些 64 位平台上，动态空间大小被截断为 #xffff0000 字节。

sentences.en: (reported by Benjamin Lambert)
sentences.zh: （本杰明·兰伯特报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: setting *READ-SUPPRESS* to T no longer renders the default REPL unusable. (reported by Daniel Herring)

sentences.en: bug fix: setting *READ-SUPPRESS* to T no longer renders the default REPL unusable.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：将 *READ-SUPPRESS* 设置为 T 不再导致默认 REPL 不可用。

sentences.en: (reported by Daniel Herring)
sentences.zh: （丹尼尔·赫林报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: return values of READ-SEQUENCE did not take :START into account on file streams, regressions since 1.0.12.22. (reported by Thomas Russ, patch by Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: bug fix: return values of READ-SEQUENCE did not take :START into account on file streams, regressions since 1.0.12.22.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：READ-SEQUENCE 的返回值没有考虑文件流上的 :START，自 1.0.12.22 以来的回归。

sentences.en: (reported by Thomas Russ, patch by Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: （Thomas Russ 报道，Paul Khuong 补丁）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: using SET or (SETF SYMBOL-VALUE) to change the value of a method specializer used to confuse permuation vector optimization.

sentences.en: bug fix: using SET or (SETF SYMBOL-VALUE) to change the value of a method specializer used to confuse permuation vector optimization.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 SET 或 (SETF SYMBOL-VALUE) 更改用于混淆排列向量优化的方法专门化器的值。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: system inserted bogus implicit type declarations for local special variables in DEFMETHOD bodies.

sentences.en: bug fix: system inserted bogus implicit type declarations for local special variables in DEFMETHOD bodies.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：系统在 DEFMETHOD 主体中为局部特殊变量插入了虚假的隐式类型声明。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: #354; duplicated frames in backtraces due to non-tail-call-optimized XEPs to functions with return type NIL have been elimited.

sentences.en: bug fix: #354; duplicated frames in backtraces due to non-tail-call-optimized XEPs to functions with return type NIL have been elimited.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：#354；由于对返回类型 NIL 的函数进行非尾部调用优化的 XEP，回溯中的重复帧已被消除。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: #357; MAKE-INSTANCE/SHARED-INITIALIZE now initializes structure object slots according to DEFSTRUCT initforms, and DEFSTRUCT forms :INCLUDEind structure classes defined using DEFCLASS :METACLASS STRUCTURE-CLASS now inherit their initforms. (reported by Bruno Haible and Stephen Wilson)

sentences.en: bug fix: #357; MAKE-INSTANCE/SHARED-INITIALIZE now initializes structure object slots according to DEFSTRUCT initforms, and DEFSTRUCT forms :INCLUDEind structure classes defined using DEFCLASS :METACLASS STRUCTURE-CLASS now inherit their initforms.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：#357； MAKE-INSTANCE/SHARED-INITIALIZE 现在根据 DEFSTRUCT initforms 初始化结构对象槽，并且 DEFSTRUCT 形式 :INCLUDEind 使用 DEFCLASS :METACLASS STRUCTURE-CLASS 定义的结构类现在继承其 initforms。

sentences.en: (reported by Bruno Haible and Stephen Wilson)
sentences.zh: （布鲁诺·海布尔和斯蒂芬·威尔逊报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: #395; fill-pointer output streams used now support element-type BASE-CHAR as well.

sentences.en: bug fix: #395; fill-pointer output streams used now support element-type BASE-CHAR as well.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：#395；现在使用的填充指针输出流也支持元素类型 BASE-CHAR。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: compiler error when attempting to derive return value of ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE when the array type was a union of intersection types.

sentences.en: bug fix: compiler error when attempting to derive return value of ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE when the array type was a union of intersection types.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当数组类型是交集类型的联合时，尝试派生 ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE 的返回值时出现编译器错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: address-spaces overlapped on OpenBSD. (thanks to Josh Elsasser)

sentences.en: bug fix: address-spaces overlapped on OpenBSD.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：OpenBSD 上的地址空间重叠。

sentences.en: (thanks to Josh Elsasser)
sentences.zh: （感谢乔什·埃尔萨瑟）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Mac OS X binaries should now be portable between Leopard and Tiger.

sentences.en: bug fix: Mac OS X binaries should now be portable between Leopard and Tiger.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：Mac OS X 二进制文件现在应该可以在 Leopard 和 Tiger 之间移植。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.23, 2008-12-01

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: when disassembling method functions, disassembly for the associated fast function is also produced.

sentences.en: enhancement: when disassembling method functions, disassembly for the associated fast function is also produced.
sentences.zh: 增强：反汇编方法函数时，也会产生关联的快速函数的反汇编。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: system stores DEFTYPE lambda-lists, so DESCRIBE can report them.

sentences.en: enhancement: system stores DEFTYPE lambda-lists, so DESCRIBE can report them.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：系统存储 DEFTYPE lambda 列表，因此 DESCRIBE 可以报告它们。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: printing with *PRINT-PRETTY* true is now more efficient as long as the object being printed doesn't require special handling by the pretty printer.

sentences.en: optimization: printing with *PRINT-PRETTY* true is now more efficient as long as the object being printed doesn't require special handling by the pretty printer.
sentences.zh: 优化：只要打印的对象不需要漂亮打印机的特殊处理，使用 *PRINT-PRETTY* true 进行打印现在会更加高效。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: slot symbol-macros from WITH-SLOTS inside DEFMETHOD bodies now interact correctly with type declarations.

sentences.en: bug fix: slot symbol-macros from WITH-SLOTS inside DEFMETHOD bodies now interact correctly with type declarations.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DEFMETHOD 体内WITH-SLOTS 中的槽符号宏现在可以与类型声明正确交互。

blocks.html_en: • partial bug fix: PCL detects infinite recursion during wrapper validation. (thanks to Attila Lendvai)

sentences.en: partial bug fix: PCL detects infinite recursion during wrapper validation.
sentences.zh: 部分错误修复：PCL 在包装器验证期间检测到无限递归。

sentences.en: (thanks to Attila Lendvai)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿提拉·伦德维）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: #426; nested function calls are inlined properly. Previously if FOO was an inline function, in calls of the form (FOO (FOO ...)) the outer call was not inlined.

sentences.en: bug fix: #426; nested function calls are inlined properly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：#426；嵌套函数调用已正确内联。

sentences.en: Previously if FOO was an inline function, in calls of the form (FOO (FOO ...)) the outer call was not inlined.
sentences.zh: 以前，如果 FOO 是内联函数，则在 (FOO (FOO ...)) 形式的调用中，外部调用不会内联。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: long long arguments passed in registers to alien functions on PowerPC Linux and NetBSD are now handled correctly when preceded by SYSTEM-AREA-POINTERs. (reported by Josh Elsasser)

sentences.en: bug fix: long long arguments passed in registers to alien functions on PowerPC Linux and NetBSD are now handled correctly when preceded by SYSTEM-AREA-POINTERs.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 PowerPC Linux 和 NetBSD 上，当前面带有 SYSTEM-AREA-POINTER 时，在寄存器中传递给外来函数的 long long 参数现在可以正确处理。

sentences.en: (reported by Josh Elsasser)
sentences.zh: （乔什·埃尔萨瑟报道）

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.22, 2008-10-30

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT no longer by default looks for the shared object in the current directory, but passes the native namestring of the designated pathname to the operation system's shared object loading function as-it.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT no longer by default looks for the shared object in the current directory, but passes the native namestring of the designated pathname to the operation system's shared object loading function as-it.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：默认情况下，LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT不再查找当前目录中的共享对象，而是将指定路径名的本机名称字符串传递给操作系统的共享对象加载函数。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: --disable-debugger toplevel option now takes effect before processing of initialization files and --eval or --load options.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: --disable-debugger toplevel option now takes effect before processing of initialization files and --eval or --load options.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：--disable-debugger 顶级选项现在在处理初始化文件和 --eval 或 --load 选项之前生效。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: new commandline argument: --script, which supports shebang lines. See documentation for details. (based on work by Kevin Reid)

sentences.en: new feature: new commandline argument: --script, which supports shebang lines.
sentences.zh: 新功能：新的命令行参数：--script，支持 shebang 行。

sentences.en: See documentation for details.
sentences.zh: 有关详细信息，请参阅文档。

sentences.en: (based on work by Kevin Reid)
sentences.zh: （基于凯文·里德的作品）

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE can save current values of --dynamic-space-size and --control-stack-size in the executable core, causing it to skip normal runtime option processing. See documentation for details. (thanks to Zach Beane)

sentences.en: new feature: SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE can save current values of --dynamic-space-size and --control-stack-size in the executable core, causing it to skip normal runtime option processing.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE 可以将 --dynamic-space-size 和 --control-stack-size 的当前值保存在可执行核心中，从而使其跳过正常的运行时选项处理。

sentences.en: See documentation for details.
sentences.zh: 有关详细信息，请参阅文档。

sentences.en: (thanks to Zach Beane)
sentences.zh: （感谢扎克·比恩）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: inoccous calls to EVAL or generic functions dispatching on subclasses of eg. STREAM no longer cause compiler notes to appear.

sentences.en: enhancement: inoccous calls to EVAL or generic functions dispatching on subclasses of eg.
sentences.zh: 增强：对 EVAL 或通用函数的无害调用在例如子类上调度。

sentences.en: STREAM no longer cause compiler notes to appear.
sentences.zh: STREAM 不再导致出现编译器注释。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: the system no longer resignals errors from --load and --eval toplevel arguments as SIMPLE-ERRORS, which caused restarts associated with the original error to be lost. (thanks to Ariel Badichi)

sentences.en: enhancement: the system no longer resignals errors from --load and --eval toplevel arguments as SIMPLE-ERRORS, which caused restarts associated with the original error to be lost.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：系统不再将 --load 和 --eval 顶级参数中的错误重新标记为 SIMPLE-ERRORS，这会导致与原始错误相关的重新启动丢失。

sentences.en: (thanks to Ariel Badichi)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿里尔·巴迪奇）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: :DONT-SAVE keyword argument has been added to LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT for controlling interaction with SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE, and UNLOAD-SHARED-OBJECT can be used to undo the effects of an earlier LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT call.

sentences.en: enhancement: :DONT-SAVE keyword argument has been added to LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT for controlling interaction with SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE, and UNLOAD-SHARED-OBJECT can be used to undo the effects of an earlier LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT call.
sentences.zh: 增强功能： :DONT-SAVE 关键字参数已添加到 LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT 中，用于控制与 SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE 的交互，并且 UNLOAD-SHARED-OBJECT 可用于撤消早期 LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT 调用的影响。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ADJUST-ARRAY on multidimensional arrays used bogusly give them a fill pointer unless :DISPLACED-TO or :INITIAL-CONTENTS were provided. (reported by Cedric St-Jean)

sentences.en: bug fix: ADJUST-ARRAY on multidimensional arrays used bogusly give them a fill pointer unless :DISPLACED-TO or :INITIAL-CONTENTS were provided.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：除非提供了 :DISPLACED-TO 或 :INITIAL-CONTENTS，否则在多维数组上使用的 ADJUST-ARRAY 会错误地给它们一个填充指针。

sentences.en: (reported by Cedric St-Jean)
sentences.zh: （塞德里克·圣让报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: circularity handling in the reader did not treat raw structure slots correctly. (reported by Cedric St-Jean)

sentences.en: bug fix: circularity handling in the reader did not treat raw structure slots correctly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：读取器中的循环处理未正确处理原始结构槽。

sentences.en: (reported by Cedric St-Jean)
sentences.zh: （塞德里克·圣让报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SERVE-EVENT occasionally signaled an error about bogus file descriptors when there were none.

sentences.en: bug fix: SERVE-EVENT occasionally signaled an error about bogus file descriptors when there were none.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SERVE-EVENT 有时会在不存在虚假文件描述符的情况下发出有关虚假文件描述符的错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DEFINE-COMPILER-MACRO support of destructuring lambda-lists was broken. (reporteed by Willem Broekema)

sentences.en: bug fix: DEFINE-COMPILER-MACRO support of destructuring lambda-lists was broken.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DEFINE-COMPILER-MACRO 对解构 lambda 列表的支持已损坏。

sentences.en: (reporteed by Willem Broekema)
sentences.zh: （威廉·布罗克玛报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-EXT:NATIVE-NAMESTRING on Windows did not work on pathnames without a directory.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-EXT:NATIVE-NAMESTRING on Windows did not work on pathnames without a directory.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：Windows 上的 SB-EXT:NATIVE-NAMESTRING 不适用于没有目录的路径名。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: COMPILE-FILE did not warn about undefined variable references at toplevel, and LOAD of the resulting fasl did not signal an error.

sentences.en: bug fix: COMPILE-FILE did not warn about undefined variable references at toplevel, and LOAD of the resulting fasl did not signal an error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：COMPILE-FILE 没有警告顶层未定义的变量引用，并且生成的 fasl 的 LOAD 没有发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: functions with non-required arguments used to end up with (SB-C::&OPTIONAL-DISPATCH ...) as their name.

sentences.en: bug fix: functions with non-required arguments used to end up with (SB-C::&OPTIONAL-DISPATCH ...)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：具有非必需参数的函数通常以 (SB-C::&OPTIONAL-DISPATCH ...) 结尾

sentences.en: as their name.
sentences.zh: 作为他们的名字。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • interval arithmetic during type derivation used inexact integer to single-float coercions.
    • arithmetic operations involving large integers and single floats give the same results in compiled and interpreted code.
    • deriving the result type of COERCE no longer signals an error if the derived type of the second argument is a MEMBER type containing invalid type specifiers.
    • ADJOIN with constant NIL as second argument works correctly.
    • FUNCTION-KEYWORDS was called SB-PCL::FUNCTION-KEYWORD-PARAMETERS.

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-SPROF now has support for wallclock profiling, and is also able to profile specific threads. REPORT output has also additional sorting options.

sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-SPROF 现在支持挂钟分析，并且还能够分析特定线程。

sentences.en: REPORT output has also additional sorting options.
sentences.zh: REPORT 输出还有附加的排序选项。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: better pretty-printing of DEFPACKAGE forms. (Thanks to Michael Weber)

sentences.en: enhancement: better pretty-printing of DEFPACKAGE forms.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：DEFPACKAGE 表单的打印更加美观。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Michael Weber)
sentences.zh: （感谢迈克尔·韦伯）

blocks.html_en:
• optimization: structure allocation has been improved
    • constructors created by non-toplevel DEFSTRUCTs are ~40% faster.
    • out of line constructors are ~10% faster.
    • inline constructors are ~15% faster.
    • inline constructors are capable of dynamic extent allocation (generally on x86 and x86-64, in some cases on other platforms as well.)

sentences.en: optimization: structure allocation has been improved constructors created by non-toplevel DEFSTRUCTs are ~40% faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：结构分配已得到改进，由非顶级 DEFSTRUCT 创建的构造函数速度快了约 40%。

sentences.en: out of line constructors are ~10% faster.
sentences.zh: 异常构造函数的速度大约快 10%。

sentences.en: inline constructors are ~15% faster.
sentences.zh: 内联构造函数的速度大约快 15%。

sentences.en: inline constructors are capable of dynamic extent allocation (generally on x86 and x86-64, in some cases on other platforms as well.)
sentences.zh: 内联构造函数能够进行动态范围分配（通常在 x86 和 x86-64 上，在某些情况下也在其他平台上。）

blocks.html_en: • constructors created by non-toplevel DEFSTRUCTs are ~40% faster.

sentences.en: constructors created by non-toplevel DEFSTRUCTs are ~40% faster.
sentences.zh: 由非顶级 DEFSTRUCT 创建的构造函数速度快约 40%。

blocks.html_en: • out of line constructors are ~10% faster.

sentences.en: out of line constructors are ~10% faster.
sentences.zh: 异常构造函数的速度大约快 10%。

blocks.html_en: • inline constructors are ~15% faster.

sentences.en: inline constructors are ~15% faster.
sentences.zh: 内联构造函数的速度大约快 15%。

blocks.html_en: • inline constructors are capable of dynamic extent allocation (generally on x86 and x86-64, in some cases on other platforms as well.)

sentences.en: inline constructors are capable of dynamic extent allocation (generally on x86 and x86-64, in some cases on other platforms as well.)
sentences.zh: 内联构造函数能够进行动态范围分配（通常在 x86 和 x86-64 上，在某些情况下也在其他平台上。）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: simple uses of HANDLER-CASE and HANDLER-BIND no longer cons.

sentences.en: optimization: simple uses of HANDLER-CASE and HANDLER-BIND no longer cons.
sentences.zh: 优化：简单使用 HANDLER-CASE 和 HANDLER-BIND 不再是缺点。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: file compiler is now able to coalesce non-circular lists, non-base strings, and bit-vectors. Additionally, constants are never referenced through SYMBOL-VALUE at runtime.

sentences.en: optimization: file compiler is now able to coalesce non-circular lists, non-base strings, and bit-vectors.
sentences.zh: 优化：文件编译器现在能够合并非循环列表、非基字符串和位向量。

sentences.en: Additionally, constants are never referenced through SYMBOL-VALUE at runtime.
sentences.zh: 此外，运行时永远不会通过 SYMBOL-VALUE 引用常量。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: code defining methods on PRINT-OBJECT (and other generic functions in the COMMON-LISP package) now loads faster.

sentences.en: optimization: code defining methods on PRINT-OBJECT (and other generic functions in the COMMON-LISP package) now loads faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：PRINT-OBJECT（以及 COMMON-LISP 包中的其他通用函数）上的代码定义方法现在加载速度更快。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: EAI_NODATA is deprecated since RFC 3493. Stop using it in sb-bsd-sockets.

sentences.en: bug fix: EAI_NODATA is deprecated since RFC 3493.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：自 RFC 3493 起，EAI_NODATA 已被弃用。

sentences.en: Stop using it in sb-bsd-sockets.
sentences.zh: 停止在 sb-bsd-sockets 中使用它。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: if COMPILE-FILE aborts due to an unwind, the partial fasl is now deleted. (reported by Attila Lendvai)

sentences.en: bug fix: if COMPILE-FILE aborts due to an unwind, the partial fasl is now deleted.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果 COMPILE-FILE 由于展开而中止，则部分 fasl 现在将被删除。

sentences.en: (reported by Attila Lendvai)
sentences.zh: （阿提拉·伦德瓦伊报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: READ-LINE always returned NIL for the last line in files. (reported by Yoshinori Tahara)

sentences.en: bug fix: READ-LINE always returned NIL for the last line in files.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：READ-LINE 总是为文件的最后一行返回 NIL。

sentences.en: (reported by Yoshinori Tahara)
sentences.zh: （田原嘉德报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: more accurate disassembly annotations of foreign function calls. (thanks to Andy Hefner)

sentences.en: bug fix: more accurate disassembly annotations of foreign function calls.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：外部函数调用的更准确的反汇编注释。

sentences.en: (thanks to Andy Hefner)
sentences.zh: （感谢安迪·海夫纳）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: trimming non-simple strings and non-string string designators when the there is nothing to trim works properly. (thanks to James Knight)

sentences.en: bug fix: trimming non-simple strings and non-string string designators when the there is nothing to trim works properly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当没有任何可修剪的内容时，修剪非简单字符串和非字符串字符串指示符可以正常工作。

sentences.en: (thanks to James Knight)
sentences.zh: （感谢詹姆斯·奈特）

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-POSIX bindings for mlockall, munlockall, and setsid. (thanks to Travis Cross)

sentences.en: new feature: SB-POSIX bindings for mlockall, munlockall, and setsid.
sentences.zh: 新功能：mlockall、munlockall 和 setsid 的 SB-POSIX 绑定。

sentences.en: (thanks to Travis Cross)
sentences.zh: （感谢特拉维斯·克罗斯）

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • NIL is a valid function name (regression at 1.0.13.38)
    • FILL on lists was missing its return value (regression at 1.0.12.27)
    • STRING-TRIM, STRING-LEFT-TRIM, and STRING-RIGHT-TRIM did not respect fill pointers properly (regression at 1.0.12.23)
    • STRING-TRIM, STRING-LEFT-TRIM, and STRING-RIGHT-TRIM did not respect displacement indices properly (regression at 1.0.12.23)

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: NIL is a valid function name (regression at 1.0.13.38) FILL on lists was missing its return value (regression at 1.0.12.27) STRING-TRIM, STRING-LEFT-TRIM, and STRING-RIGHT-TRIM did not respect fill pointers properly (regression at 1.0.12.23) STRING-TRIM, STRING-LEFT-TRIM, and STRING-RIGHT-TRIM did not respect displacement indices properly (regression at 1.0.12.23)
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误： NIL 是一个有效的函数名称（在 1.0.13.38 回归） 列表上的 FILL 缺少其返回值（在 1.0.12.27 回归） STRING-TRIM、STRING-LEFT-TRIM 和 STRING-RIGHT-TRIM 没有正确尊重填充指针（在 1.0.12.23 回归） STRING-TRIM、STRING-LEFT-TRIM 和 STRING-RIGHT-TRIM 未正确考虑位移指数（1.0.12.23 的回归）

blocks.html_en: • NIL is a valid function name (regression at 1.0.13.38)

sentences.zh: NIL 是一个有效的函数名称（在 1.0.13.38 回归）

blocks.html_en: • FILL on lists was missing its return value (regression at 1.0.12.27)

sentences.zh: STRING-TRIM、STRING-LEFT-TRIM 和 STRING-RIGHT-TRIM 未正确遵守填充指针（1.0.12.23 回归）

blocks.html_en: • STRING-TRIM, STRING-LEFT-TRIM, and STRING-RIGHT-TRIM did not respect displacement indices properly (regression at 1.0.12.23)

sentences.zh: STRING-TRIM、STRING-LEFT-TRIM 和 STRING-RIGHT-TRIM 未正确考虑位移指数（1.0.12.23 的回归）
