blocks.html_en: • temporary regression: user code can no longer allocate closure variable storage on stack, due to bug 419 without explicitly requesting it. Please consult sbcl-devel for advice if you need to use this feature in the meanwhile.

sentences.en: temporary regression: user code can no longer allocate closure variable storage on stack, due to bug 419 without explicitly requesting it.
sentences.zh: 临时回归：由于错误 419，用户代码无法再在堆栈上分配闭包变量存储，而无需明确请求。

sentences.en: Please consult sbcl-devel for advice if you need to use this feature in the meanwhile.
sentences.zh: 如果您同时需要使用此功能，请咨询 sbcl-devel 获取建议。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: runtime argument --control-stack-size can be used to adjust thread default control stack size.

sentences.en: new feature: runtime argument --control-stack-size can be used to adjust thread default control stack size.
sentences.zh: 新功能：运行时参数 --control-stack-size 可用于调整线程默认控制堆栈大小。

blocks.html_en:
• enhancement: improved TIME output
    • all times are reported using the measured accuracy (milliseconds for real and GC times, microseconds for everything else.)
    • processor cycle counts on x86 and x86-64.
    • interpreted forms are counted for both evaluator modes.
    • number of lambdas converted by the compiler is reported.
    • CPU percentage report (computed from real and total run time.)
    • more comprehensive run time reporting, using a condenced format
    • interperted form, lambda, and page fault counts are omitted when zero.

sentences.en: enhancement: improved TIME output all times are reported using the measured accuracy (milliseconds for real and GC times, microseconds for everything else.)
sentences.zh: 增强功能：改进的 TIME 输出 所有时间均使用测量的精度进行报告（实际时间和 GC 时间为毫秒，其他时间为微秒。）

sentences.en: processor cycle counts on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: x86 和 x86-64 上的处理器周期计数。

sentences.en: interpreted forms are counted for both evaluator modes.
sentences.zh: 解释形式对于两种评估器模式均计数。

sentences.en: number of lambdas converted by the compiler is reported.
sentences.zh: 报告由编译器转换的 lambda 数量。

sentences.en: CPU percentage report (computed from real and total run time.)
sentences.zh: CPU 百分比报告（根据实际运行时间和总运行时间计算。）

sentences.en: more comprehensive run time reporting, using a condenced format interperted form, lambda, and page fault counts are omitted when zero.
sentences.zh: 更全面的运行时报告，使用压缩格式解释形式，lambda 和页面错误计数在零时被忽略。

blocks.html_en: • all times are reported using the measured accuracy (milliseconds for real and GC times, microseconds for everything else.)

sentences.en: all times are reported using the measured accuracy (milliseconds for real and GC times, microseconds for everything else.)
sentences.zh: 所有时间均使用测量的精度进行报告（实际时间和 GC 时间为毫秒，其他时间为微秒。）

blocks.html_en: • processor cycle counts on x86 and x86-64.

sentences.en: processor cycle counts on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: x86 和 x86-64 上的处理器周期计数。

blocks.html_en: • interpreted forms are counted for both evaluator modes.

sentences.en: interpreted forms are counted for both evaluator modes.
sentences.zh: 解释形式对于两种评估器模式均计数。

blocks.html_en: • number of lambdas converted by the compiler is reported.

sentences.en: number of lambdas converted by the compiler is reported.
sentences.zh: 报告由编译器转换的 lambda 数量。

blocks.html_en: • CPU percentage report (computed from real and total run time.)

sentences.en: CPU percentage report (computed from real and total run time.)
sentences.zh: CPU 百分比报告（根据实际运行时间和总运行时间计算。）

blocks.html_en: • more comprehensive run time reporting, using a condenced format

sentences.en: more comprehensive run time reporting, using a condenced format
sentences.zh: 更全面的运行时报告，使用压缩格式

blocks.html_en: • interperted form, lambda, and page fault counts are omitted when zero.

sentences.en: interperted form, lambda, and page fault counts are omitted when zero.
sentences.zh: 当零时，解释形式、lambda 和页面错误计数将被忽略。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: ADJOIN and PUSHNEW are upto ~70% faster in normal SPEED policies.

sentences.en: optimization: ADJOIN and PUSHNEW are upto ~70% faster in normal SPEED policies.
sentences.zh: 优化：在正常 SPEED 策略中，ADJOIN 和 PUSHNEW 速度提高约 70%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: APPEND is upto ~10% faster in normal SPEED policies.

sentences.en: optimization: APPEND is upto ~10% faster in normal SPEED policies.
sentences.zh: 优化：在正常 SPEED 策略中，APPEND 速度提高约 10%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: two argument forms of LAST are upto ~10% faster in normal SPEED policies.

sentences.en: optimization: two argument forms of LAST are upto ~10% faster in normal SPEED policies.
sentences.zh: 优化：在正常的 SPEED 策略中，LAST 的两种参数形式最多快 10%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: NCONC no longer needs to heap cons its &REST list in normal SPEED policies.

sentences.en: optimization: NCONC no longer needs to heap cons its &REST list in normal SPEED policies.
sentences.zh: 优化：NCONC 不再需要在正常 SPEED 策略中堆放其 &REST 列表。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-FLUID build feature no longer breaks the build. (thanks to Sidney Markowitz)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-FLUID build feature no longer breaks the build.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-FLUID 构建功能不再破坏构建。

sentences.en: (thanks to Sidney Markowitz)
sentences.zh: （感谢西德尼·马科维茨）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: UNION and NUNION work with :TEST-NOT once more, regression since 1.0.9.1. (thanks to Eric Marsden)

sentences.en: bug fix: UNION and NUNION work with :TEST-NOT once more, regression since 1.0.9.1.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：UNION 和 NUNION 再次使用 :TEST-NOT，从 1.0.9.1 开始回归。

sentences.en: (thanks to Eric Marsden)
sentences.zh: （感谢埃里克·马斯登）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: result of MAKE-ARRAY can be stack allocated - regression since 1.0.15.36. (thanks to Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: bug fix: result of MAKE-ARRAY can be stack allocated - regression since 1.0.15.36.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：MAKE-ARRAY 的结果可以进行堆栈分配 - 自 1.0.15.36 以来的回归。

sentences.en: (thanks to Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Paul Khuong）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: LAST when always returned the whole list when given a bignum as the second argument.

sentences.en: bug fix: LAST when always returned the whole list when given a bignum as the second argument.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当给定 bignum 作为第二个参数时，LAST 总是返回整个列表。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: dynamic extent allocation of nested lists and vectors could leak to otherwise accessible parts.

sentences.en: bug fix: dynamic extent allocation of nested lists and vectors could leak to otherwise accessible parts.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：嵌套列表和向量的动态范围分配可能会泄漏到其他可访问的部分。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: invalid optimization of heap-allocated alien variable reference.

sentences.en: bug fix: invalid optimization of heap-allocated alien variable reference.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：堆分配的外来变量引用的优化无效。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: fasl header checking is less vulnerable to different platform word lengths.

sentences.en: bug fix: fasl header checking is less vulnerable to different platform word lengths.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：fasl 标头检查不易受不同平台字长的影响。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: more correct assembler syntax for GNU binutils 2.18.50.0.4 support. (thanks to Marijn Schouten)

sentences.en: bug fix: more correct assembler syntax for GNU binutils 2.18.50.0.4 support.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：GNU binutils 2.18.50.0.4 支持的更正确的汇编器语法。

sentences.en: (thanks to Marijn Schouten)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Marijn Schouten）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: fix ECASE warnings from CMUCL-as-xc-host. (reported by Andreas Franke)

sentences.en: bug fix: fix ECASE warnings from CMUCL-as-xc-host.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：修复来自 CMUCL-as-xc-host 的 ECASE 警告。

sentences.en: (reported by Andreas Franke)
sentences.zh: （安德烈亚斯·弗兰克报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the fopcompiler can handle LOCALLY forms (with no declarations) successfully. (reported by Attila Lendvai)

sentences.en: bug fix: the fopcompiler can handle LOCALLY forms (with no declarations) successfully.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：fopcompiler 可以成功处理本地表单（没有声明）。

sentences.en: (reported by Attila Lendvai)
sentences.zh: （阿提拉·伦德瓦伊报道）

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: revert the changes to sb-posix's error signaling added in 1.0.14.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: revert the changes to sb-posix's error signaling added in 1.0.14.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：恢复对 1.0.14 中添加的 sb-posix 错误信号的更改。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: change PROBE-FILE back to returning NIL whenever we can't get a truename, as was the case before 1.0.14.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: change PROBE-FILE back to returning NIL whenever we can't get a truename, as was the case before 1.0.14.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小改动：每当我们无法获得真实名称时，将 PROBE-FILE 更改回返回 NIL，就像 1.0.14 之前的情况一样。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:NAME-SERVICE-ERROR now inherits from ERROR instead of just CONDITION.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:NAME-SERVICE-ERROR now inherits from ERROR instead of just CONDITION.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小改动：SB-BSD-SOCKETS:NAME-SERVICE-ERROR 现在继承自 ERROR 而不仅仅是 CONDITION。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-INTROSPECT can provide source locations for instances as well. (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: new feature: SB-INTROSPECT can provide source locations for instances as well.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-INTROSPECT 还可以提供实例的源位置。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯·里特韦勒）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: binding special variables now generates smaller code on threaded platforms.

sentences.en: optimization: binding special variables now generates smaller code on threaded platforms.
sentences.zh: 优化：绑定特殊变量现在可以在线程平台上生成更小的代码。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: MEMBER and ASSOC are over 50% faster for :TEST #'EQ and cases where no :TEST is given but the compiler can infer that the element to search is of type (OR FIXNUM (NOT NUMBER)).

sentences.en: optimization: MEMBER and ASSOC are over 50% faster for :TEST #'EQ and cases where no :TEST is given but the compiler can infer that the element to search is of type (OR FIXNUM (NOT NUMBER)).
sentences.zh: 优化：MEMBER 和 ASSOC 对于 :TEST #'EQ 以及未给出 :TEST 但编译器可以推断要搜索的元素的类型（OR FIXNUM (NOT NUMBER)）的情况快了 50% 以上。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: better LOGNOT on fixnums.

sentences.en: optimization: better LOGNOT on fixnums.
sentences.zh: 优化：在fixnums 上更好的LOGNOT。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: modular arithmetic for a particular requested width is implemented using a tagged representation unless a better representation is available.

sentences.en: optimization: modular arithmetic for a particular requested width is implemented using a tagged representation unless a better representation is available.
sentences.zh: 优化：除非有更好的表示可用，否则使用标记表示来实现特定请求宽度的模块化算术。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 423: TRULY-THE and *CHECK-CONSISTENCY* interaction.

sentences.en: fixed bug 423: TRULY-THE and *CHECK-CONSISTENCY* interaction.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 423：TRULY-THE 和 *CHECK-CONSISTENCY* 交互。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:MAKE-INET-ADDRESS checks the input string for wellformedness and returns a specialized vector. (reported by Francois-Rene Rideau)

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-BSD-SOCKETS:MAKE-INET-ADDRESS checks the input string for wellformedness and returns a specialized vector.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-BSD-SOCKETS:MAKE-INET-ADDRESS 检查输入字符串的格式正确性并返回专用向量。

sentences.en: (reported by Francois-Rene Rideau)
sentences.zh: （弗朗索瓦-雷内·里多报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FIND-CLASS was not thread-safe. (reported by Attila Lendvai)

sentences.en: bug fix: FIND-CLASS was not thread-safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：FIND-CLASS 不是线程安全的。

sentences.en: (reported by Attila Lendvai)
sentences.zh: （阿提拉·伦德瓦伊报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ~R was broken for vigtillions. (thanks to Luis Oliveira)

sentences.en: bug fix: ~R was broken for vigtillions.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：~R 因 vigtillions 而被破坏。

sentences.en: (thanks to Luis Oliveira)
sentences.zh: （感谢路易斯·奥利维拉）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: attempt to obtain *SCHEDULER-LOCK* recursively when unscheduling timer at the same time as another timer fires.

sentences.en: bug fix: attempt to obtain *SCHEDULER-LOCK* recursively when unscheduling timer at the same time as another timer fires.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当另一个计时器触发的同时取消调度计时器时，尝试递归获取*SCHEDULER-LOCK*。

blocks.html_en: • SB-DEBUG:PRINT-FRAME-CALL now prints the entry-point kind even when SB-DEBUG:*SHOW-ENTRY-POINT-DETAILS* is NIL.

blocks.html_en: • unreadably printed representation of hash-tables now includes weakness if any.

sentences.en: unreadably printed representation of hash-tables now includes weakness if any.
sentences.zh: 哈希表的难以阅读的打印表示现在包含弱点（如果有的话）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: partially fixed #188: type propagation from assignments is now more efficient.

sentences.zh: bug 修复：部分修复 #188：赋值的类型传播现在更加高效。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: fixed #407: (COERCE X 'SINGLE-FLOAT) and (COERCE X 'DOUBLE-FLOAT) are not flushable.

sentences.en: bug fix: fixed #407: (COERCE X 'SINGLE-FLOAT) and (COERCE X 'DOUBLE-FLOAT) are not flushable.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：已修复 #407：(COERCE X 'SINGLE-FLOAT) 和 (COERCE X 'DOUBLE-FLOAT) 不可刷新。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: on x86 and x86-64 pointer based EQ-hashing now uses the full address of the object, and none of the tag bits.

sentences.en: bug fix: on x86 and x86-64 pointer based EQ-hashing now uses the full address of the object, and none of the tag bits.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 x86 和 x86-64 上，基于指针的 EQ 哈希现在使用对象的完整地址，而不使用任何标记位。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: readably printing hash-tables now respects other printer control variables. (reported by Cedric St-Jean)

sentences.en: bug fix: readably printing hash-tables now respects other printer control variables.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：可读打印哈希表现在尊重其他打印机控制变量。

sentences.en: (reported by Cedric St-Jean)
sentences.zh: （塞德里克·圣让报道）

sentences.en: bug fix: compiler gave a bogus STYLE-WARNING for the :SYNCHRONIZED keyword with MAKE-HASH-TABLE.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译器为带有 MAKE-HASH-TABLE 的 :SYNCHRONIZED 关键字给出了虚假的样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: export SB-POSIX:MKSTEMP.

sentences.en: bug fix: export SB-POSIX:MKSTEMP.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：导出 SB-POSIX:MKSTEMP。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SORT was not interrupt safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: SORT was not interrupt safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SORT 不是中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: XREF accounts for the last node of each basic-block as well.

sentences.en: bug fix: XREF accounts for the last node of each basic-block as well.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：XREF 也考虑了每个基本块的最后一个节点。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: MAKE-INSTANCE optimizations interacted badly with non-keyword :DEFAULT-INITARGS in the presence of :BEFORE/:AFTER methods on SHARED-INITIALIZE. (thanks to Matt Marjanovic)

sentences.en: bug fix: MAKE-INSTANCE optimizations interacted badly with non-keyword :DEFAULT-INITARGS in the presence of :BEFORE/:AFTER methods on SHARED-INITIALIZE.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 SHARED-INITIALIZE 上存在 :BEFORE/:AFTER 方法时，MAKE-INSTANCE 优化与非关键字 :DEFAULT-INITARGS 交互不良。

sentences.en: (thanks to Matt Marjanovic)
sentences.zh: （感谢马特·马扬诺维奇）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the CTOR optimization for MAKE-INSTANCE should no longer create obsolete instances in the case of redefinition or obsoletion of a superclass. (thanks to Andy Hefner)

sentences.en: bug fix: the CTOR optimization for MAKE-INSTANCE should no longer create obsolete instances in the case of redefinition or obsoletion of a superclass.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在重新定义或废弃超类的情况下，MAKE-INSTANCE 的 CTOR 优化不应再创建废弃实例。

sentences.en: (thanks to Andy Hefner)
sentences.zh: （感谢安迪·海夫纳）

sentences.en: bug fix: Support for the Alpha architecture has been revived; it had suffered somewhat from lack of maintenance since sbcl-1.0.
sentences.zh: bug修复：恢复了对Alpha架构的支持；自 sbcl-1.0 以来，它因缺乏维护而受到一定影响。

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-SPROF:REPORT no longer signals an error if there are no samples.

sentences.en: bug fix: RESOLVE-CONFLICT (and the other name conflict machinery) is now actually exported from SB-EXT as documented.

sentences.en: bug fix: CLOSE :ABORT T behaves more correctly on Windows.

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: RUN-PROGRAM now uses execvp(3) to find an executable in the search path, and does so in the child process's PATH. The function FIND-EXECUTABLE-IN-SEARCH-PATH has been removed; it can be found in the CVS history, for somebody who needs that search behavior (see the manual).

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: RUN-PROGRAM now uses execvp(3) to find an executable in the search path, and does so in the child process's PATH.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：RUN-PROGRAM 现在使用 execvp(3) 在搜索路径中查找可执行文件，并在子进程的 PATH 中执行此操作。

sentences.en: The function FIND-EXECUTABLE-IN-SEARCH-PATH has been removed; it can be found in the CVS history, for somebody who needs that search behavior (see the manual).
sentences.zh: 函数 FIND-EXECUTABLE-IN-SEARCH-PATH 已被删除；对于需要搜索行为的人来说，可以在 CVS 历史记录中找到它（请参阅手册）。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: compiler policy re. weakening type checks has changed: now type checks are weakened only if SAFETY < 2 and SAFETY < SPEED.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: compiler policy re.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：编译器策略重新。

sentences.en: weakening type checks has changed: now type checks are weakened only if SAFETY < 2 and SAFETY < SPEED.
sentences.zh: 弱化类型检查已更改：现在仅当 SAFETY < 2 且 SAFETY < SPEED 时才会弱化类型检查。

blocks.html_en: • SB-EXT:NATIVE-NAMESTRING takes a new keyword AS-FILE, forcing unparsing of directory pathnames as files. Analogously, SB-EXT:PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING takes an AS-DIRECTORY, forcing a filename to parse into a directory pathname.

sentences.en: SB-EXT:NATIVE-NAMESTRING takes a new keyword AS-FILE, forcing unparsing of directory pathnames as files.
sentences.zh: SB-EXT:NATIVE-NAMESTRING 采用新关键字 AS-FILE，强制将目录路径名解析为文件。

sentences.en: Analogously, SB-EXT:PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING takes an AS-DIRECTORY, forcing a filename to parse into a directory pathname.
sentences.zh: 类似地，SB-EXT:PARSE-NATIVE-NAMESTRING 采用 AS-DIRECTORY，强制将文件名解析为目录路径名。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: implicit generic function creation now signals a specific style-warning IMPLICIT-GENERIC-FUNCTION-WARNING, which users can bind handlers for and muffle around calls to LOAD.

sentences.en: enhancement: implicit generic function creation now signals a specific style-warning IMPLICIT-GENERIC-FUNCTION-WARNING, which users can bind handlers for and muffle around calls to LOAD.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：隐式通用函数创建现在发出特定样式警告 IMPLICIT-GENERIC-FUNCTION-WARNING，用户可以绑定处理程序并屏蔽对 LOAD 的调用。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: RUN-PROGRAM allows unicode arguments and environments to be used (using the default stream external format), and allows non-simple strings to be used. (thanks to Harald Hanche-Olsen)

sentences.en: enhancement: RUN-PROGRAM allows unicode arguments and environments to be used (using the default stream external format), and allows non-simple strings to be used.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：RUN-PROGRAM 允许使用 unicode 参数和环境（使用默认流外部格式），并允许使用非简单字符串。

sentences.en: (thanks to Harald Hanche-Olsen)
sentences.zh: （感谢哈拉尔德·汉什·奥尔森）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: COPY-SEQ, FILL, and SUBSEQ are 30-80% faster for strings and vectors whose element-type or simplicity is not fully known at compile-time.

sentences.en: optimization: COPY-SEQ, FILL, and SUBSEQ are 30-80% faster for strings and vectors whose element-type or simplicity is not fully known at compile-time.
sentences.zh: 优化：对于在编译时不完全了解元素类型或简单性的字符串和向量，COPY-SEQ、FILL 和 SUBSEQ 速度提高 30-80%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: STRING-TRIM and related functions no longer allocate a new string when no trimming needs to be performed. These functions are also faster than before when the input string has been declared as a simple-string.

sentences.en: optimization: STRING-TRIM and related functions no longer allocate a new string when no trimming needs to be performed.
sentences.zh: 优化：当不需要执行修剪时，STRING-TRIM 和相关函数不再分配新字符串。

sentences.en: These functions are also faster than before when the input string has been declared as a simple-string.
sentences.zh: 当输入字符串被声明为简单字符串时，这些函数也比以前更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: READ-SEQUENCE on simple-strings is up to 80% faster.

sentences.en: optimization: READ-SEQUENCE on simple-strings is up to 80% faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：简单字符串上的 READ-SEQUENCE 速度提高了 80%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: READ-LINE is significantly faster for files containing long lines.

sentences.en: optimization: READ-LINE is significantly faster for files containing long lines.
sentences.zh: 优化：对于包含长行的文件，READ-LINE 的速度明显更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: non-open coded uses of character comparison operators (e.g. char=) no longer cons when called with more than one parameter on platforms supporting dynamic-extent allocation.

sentences.en: optimization: non-open coded uses of character comparison operators (e.g. char=) no longer cons when called with more than one parameter on platforms supporting dynamic-extent allocation.
sentences.zh: 优化：在支持动态范围分配的平台上使用多个参数调用时，字符比较运算符（例如 char=）的非开放编码使用不再是缺点。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: READ-SEQUENCE on composite stream wrapping a Gray stream with STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) signalled an error.

sentences.en: bug fix: READ-SEQUENCE on composite stream wrapping a Gray stream with STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) signalled an error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) 包装灰色流的复合流上的 READ-SEQUENCE 发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: COPY-SEQ on lists did not signal a type-error on improper lists in safe code.

sentences.en: bug fix: COPY-SEQ on lists did not signal a type-error on improper lists in safe code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：列表上的 COPY-SEQ 不会在安全代码中的不正确列表上发出类型错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: some sequence functions elided bounds checking when SPEED > SAFETY.

sentences.en: bug fix: some sequence functions elided bounds checking when SPEED > SAFETY.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当速度 > 安全时，某些序列函数忽略了边界检查。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: too liberal weakening of union-type checks when SPEED > SAFETY.

sentences.en: bug fix: too liberal weakening of union-type checks when SPEED > SAFETY.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当速度 > 安全时，联合类型检查的削弱过于自由。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: more bogus fixnum declarations in ROOM implementation have been fixed.

sentences.en: bug fix: more bogus fixnum declarations in ROOM implementation have been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ROOM 实现中更多虚假的 fixnum 声明已得到修复。

sentences.en: See also: SB-EXT:WITH-LOCKED-HASH-TABLE, and SB-EXT:HASH-TABLE-SYNCHRONIZED-P.
sentences.zh: 另请参见：SB-EXT:WITH-LOCKED-HASH-TABLE 和 SB-EXT:HASH-TABLE-SYNCHRONIZED-P。

sentences.en: bug fix: bug 417 fixed -- source location reporting is now more robust.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：错误 417 已修复——源位置报告现在更加强大。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SUBSEQ on a list will now correctly signal an error if if END is smaller then START.

sentences.en: bug fix: SUBSEQ on a list will now correctly signal an error if if END is smaller then START.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果 END 小于 START，列表上的 SUBSEQ 现在将正确发出错误信号。

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-PROFILE will no longer report extra consing for nested calls to profiled functions.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：SB-PROFILE 将不再报告对分析函数的嵌套调用的额外 consing。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ROOM implementation had bogus fixnum declarations which could cause type-errors when calling ROOM on large images.

sentences.en: bug fix: ROOM implementation had bogus fixnum declarations which could cause type-errors when calling ROOM on large images.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ROOM 实现具有虚假的 fixnum 声明，在大图像上调用 ROOM 时可能会导致类型错误。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: if file compilation is aborted, the partial fasl is now deleted, and COMPILE-FILE returns NIL as the primary value.

sentences.en: bug fix: if file compilation is aborted, the partial fasl is now deleted, and COMPILE-FILE returns NIL as the primary value.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果文件编译被中止，则部分 fasl 现在将被删除，并且 COMPILE-FILE 将返回 NIL 作为主要值。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: number of thread safety issues relating to SBCL's internal hash-table usage have been fixed.

sentences.en: bug fix: number of thread safety issues relating to SBCL's internal hash-table usage have been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：与 SBCL 的内部哈希表使用相关的许多线程安全问题已得到修复。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-SYS:WITH-PINNED-OBJECTS could cause garbage values to be returned from its body when the values were being returned using unknown-values return convection and the W-P-O was wrapped inside an UNWIND-PROTECT.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-SYS:WITH-PINNED-OBJECTS could cause garbage values to be returned from its body when the values were being returned using unknown-values return convection and the W-P-O was wrapped inside an UNWIND-PROTECT.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当使用未知值返回对流返回值并且 W-P-O 被包裹在 UNWIND-PROTECT 内时，SB-SYS:WITH-PINNED-OBJECTS 可能会导致从其主体返回垃圾值。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: sb-posix should now compile again under Windows, enabling slime to work again.

sentences.en: bug fix: sb-posix should now compile again under Windows, enabling slime to work again.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：sb-posix 现在应该在 Windows 下再次编译，使 slime 能够再次工作。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: hash-table accessor functions are no longer automatically protected by locks. Concurrent accesses on the same hash-table from multiple threads can give inconsistent results or even corrupt the hash-table completely. Multi-threaded applications should do their own locking at the correct granularity. In the current implementation it is still safe to have multiple readers access the same table, but it's not guaranteed that this property will be maintained in future releases.

sentences.en: incompatible change: hash-table accessor functions are no longer automatically protected by locks.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：哈希表访问器函数不再自动受锁保护。

sentences.en: Concurrent accesses on the same hash-table from multiple threads can give inconsistent results or even corrupt the hash-table completely.
sentences.zh: 从多个线程并发访问同一个哈希表可能会产生不一致的结果，甚至完全损坏哈希表。

sentences.en: Multi-threaded applications should do their own locking at the correct granularity.
sentences.zh: 多线程应用程序应该以正确的粒度进行自己的锁定。

sentences.en: In the current implementation it is still safe to have multiple readers access the same table, but it's not guaranteed that this property will be maintained in future releases.
sentences.zh: 在当前的实现中，让多个读取器访问同一个表仍然是安全的，但不能保证在未来的版本中保留此属性。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: (SETF MUTEX-VALUE) is not longer supported, and will signal an error at runtime.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: (SETF MUTEX-VALUE) is not longer supported, and will signal an error at runtime.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：不再支持 (SETF MUTEX-VALUE)，并将在运行时发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-THREAD package now exports a semaphore interface.

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-THREAD package now exports a semaphore interface.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-THREAD 包现在导出信号量接口。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: CONS can now stack-allocate on x86 and x86-64. (Earlier LIST and LIST* supported stack-allocation, but CONS did not.)

sentences.en: enhancement: CONS can now stack-allocate on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：CONS 现在可以在 x86 和 x86-64 上进行堆栈分配。

sentences.en: (Earlier LIST and LIST* supported stack-allocation, but CONS did not.)
sentences.zh: （早期的 LIST 和 LIST* 支持堆栈分配，但 CONS 不支持。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: nested lists can now be stack allocated on platforms providing stack allocation support.

sentences.en: enhancement: nested lists can now be stack allocated on platforms providing stack allocation support.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：嵌套列表现在可以在提供堆栈分配支持的平台上进行堆栈分配。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: dynamic-extent support has been extended to support cases where there are multiple possible sources for the stack allocated value.

sentences.en: enhancement: dynamic-extent support has been extended to support cases where there are multiple possible sources for the stack allocated value.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：动态范围支持已扩展为支持堆栈分配值有多个可能来源的情况。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: RELEASE-MUTEX no longer needs to perform a syscall if the mutex is uncontested on Linux.

sentences.en: optimization: RELEASE-MUTEX no longer needs to perform a syscall if the mutex is uncontested on Linux.
sentences.zh: 优化：如果互斥体在 Linux 上没有争议，则 RELEASE-MUTEX 不再需要执行系统调用。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: symbol-macro expansion now uses the *MACROEXPAND-HOOK* as specified by the CLHS. (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)

sentences.en: bug fix: symbol-macro expansion now uses the *MACROEXPAND-HOOK* as specified by the CLHS.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：符号宏扩展现在使用 CLHS 指定的 *MACROEXPAND-HOOK*。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯·里特韦勒）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: NaN comparison now works on x86-64.

sentences.en: bug fix: NaN comparison now works on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：NaN 比较现在适用于 x86-64。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: CLOSE :ABORT T on a stream with pending output now works.

sentences.en: bug fix: CLOSE :ABORT T on a stream with pending output now works.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：带有待处理输出的流上的 CLOSE :ABORT T 现在可以正常工作。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: instances of non-standard metaclasses using standard instance structure protocol sometimes missed the slot type checks in safe code.

sentences.en: bug fix: instances of non-standard metaclasses using standard instance structure protocol sometimes missed the slot type checks in safe code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用标准实例结构协议的非标准元类实例有时会错过安全代码中的槽类型检查。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: known functions can be inlined in high-debug code.

sentences.en: bug fix: known functions can be inlined in high-debug code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：已知函数可以内联在高调试代码中。

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the MSI installer on Windows no longer associates .lisp and .fasl files with the installed SBCL.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: :UNIX is no longer present in *FEATURES* on Windows.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：：UNIX 不再出现在 Windows 上的 *FEATURES* 中。

sentences.en: (thanks to Luis Oliviera)
sentences.zh: （感谢路易斯·奥利维埃拉）

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-CLTL2 contrib module now implements FUNCTION-INFORMATION. (thanks to Larry D'Anna)

sentences.en: new feature: SB-CLTL2 contrib module now implements FUNCTION-INFORMATION.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-CLTL2 contrib 模块现在实现功能信息。

sentences.en: (thanks to Larry D'Anna)
sentences.zh: （感谢拉里·德安娜）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: scavenging weak pointers is now more efficient, requiring O(1) instead of O(N) per weak pointer to identify scanvenged vs. unscavenged pointers. (thanks to Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: optimization: scavenging weak pointers is now more efficient, requiring O(1) instead of O(N) per weak pointer to identify scanvenged vs. unscavenged pointers.
sentences.zh: 优化：清除弱指针现在更加高效，每个弱指针需要 O(1) 而不是 O(N) 来识别扫描指针和未清除指针。

sentences.en: (thanks to Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Paul Khuong）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: typechecking (SETF SLOT-VALUE) is now ~5x faster in method bodies using constant slot-names when the first argument is a specializer parameter for the method.

sentences.en: optimization: typechecking (SETF SLOT-VALUE) is now ~5x faster in method bodies using constant slot-names when the first argument is a specializer parameter for the method.
sentences.zh: 优化：当第一个参数是方法的专用参数时，使用常量槽名称的方法体中的类型检查 (SETF SLOT-VALUE) 现在速度提高了约 5 倍。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: SLOT-VALUE &co are now ~50% faster for variable slot names, when the class of the instance is a direct instance STANDARD-CLASS or FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS (making them only 3x as slow as the constant slot-name case.)

sentences.en: optimization: SLOT-VALUE &co are now ~50% faster for variable slot names, when the class of the instance is a direct instance STANDARD-CLASS or FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS (making them only 3x as slow as the constant slot-name case.)
sentences.zh: 优化：当实例的类是直接实例 STANDARD-CLASS 或 FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS 时，SLOT-VALUE &co 现在对于变量槽名称快约 50%（使它们仅比常量槽名称情况慢 3 倍。）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: member type construction is now O(N) instead of O(N^2).

sentences.en: optimization: member type construction is now O(N) instead of O(N^2).
sentences.zh: 优化：成员类型构造现在是 O(N) 而不是 O(N^2)。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: UNION and NUNION are now O(N+M) for large inputs as long as the :TEST function is one of EQ, EQL, EQUAL, or EQUALP.

sentences.en: optimization: UNION and NUNION are now O(N+M) for large inputs as long as the :TEST function is one of EQ, EQL, EQUAL, or EQUALP.
sentences.zh: 优化：对于大输入，UNION 和 NUNION 现在是 O(N+M)，只要 :TEST 函数是 EQ、EQL、EQUAL 或 EQUALP 之一。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO lambda-list information is now more readable in environments like Slime which display it. (thanks to Tobias C. Rittweiler)

sentences.en: enhancement: DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO lambda-list information is now more readable in environments like Slime which display it.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO lambda 列表信息现在在显示它的 Slime 等环境中更具可读性。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tobias C.
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯 C.

sentences.en: Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: 里威纳犬）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-EXT:COMPARE-AND-SWAP was non-atomic unless the compiler was able to infer the correct argument type for the object on which the CAS operation was being performed.

sentences.en: bug fix: SB-EXT:COMPARE-AND-SWAP was non-atomic unless the compiler was able to infer the correct argument type for the object on which the CAS operation was being performed.
sentences.zh: bug 修复：SB-EXT:COMPARE-AND-SWAP 是非原子的，除非编译器能够推断出正在执行 CAS 操作的对象的正确参数类型。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: copy propagation interfered with parallel assignment semantics in local calls. (reported by Paul Khuong)

sentences.en: bug fix: copy propagation interfered with parallel assignment semantics in local calls.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：复制传播干扰本地调用中的并行分配语义。

sentences.en: (reported by Paul Khuong)
sentences.zh: （姜保罗报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the signed modular fixnum shift compiled to wrong code on x86 and x86-64. (spotted by a slight modification to some of PFD's random tests)

sentences.en: bug fix: the signed modular fixnum shift compiled to wrong code on x86 and x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：已签名的模块化 Fixnum 移位在 x86 和 x86-64 上编译为错误代码。

sentences.en: (spotted by a slight modification to some of PFD's random tests)
sentences.zh: （通过对 PFD 的一些随机测试进行轻微修改发现）

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.9, 2007-08-27

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SB-SYS:OUTPUT-RAW-BYTES is deprecated.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SB-SYS:OUTPUT-RAW-BYTES is deprecated.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：SB-SYS:OUTPUT-RAW-BYTES 已弃用。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-EXT:FINALIZE accepts a :DONT-SAVE keyword argument, indicating the finalizer should be cancelled when SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE is called.

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-EXT:FINALIZE accepts a :DONT-SAVE keyword argument, indicating the finalizer should be cancelled when SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE is called.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-EXT:FINALIZE 接受 :DONT-SAVE 关键字参数，指示调用 SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE 时应取消终结器。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: default PRINT-OBJECT methods for classes, slot-definitions, and generic function now print the object identity for anonymous instances. (thanks to Attila Lendvai)

sentences.en: enhancement: default PRINT-OBJECT methods for classes, slot-definitions, and generic function now print the object identity for anonymous instances.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：类、槽定义和通用函数的默认 PRINT-OBJECT 方法现在打印匿名实例的对象标识。

sentences.en: (thanks to Attila Lendvai)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿提拉·伦德维）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: as an extension to MOP, SBCL now supports SETF of STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS. (thanks to Attila Lendvai)

sentences.en: enhancement: as an extension to MOP, SBCL now supports SETF of STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：作为 MOP 的扩展，SBCL 现在支持 STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS 和 FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-INSTANCE-ACCESS 的 SETF。

sentences.en: (thanks to Attila Lendvai)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿提拉·伦德维）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: sb-cover has an alternate annotation mode which puts the form annotations at the car of the form, instead of annotating it completely. The benefit of this mode is that it shows better which forms were instrumented by the compiler.

sentences.en: enhancement: sb-cover has an alternate annotation mode which puts the form annotations at the car of the form, instead of annotating it completely.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：sb-cover 有一个备用注释模式，它将表单注释放在表单的车上，而不是完全注释它。

sentences.en: The benefit of this mode is that it shows better which forms were instrumented by the compiler.
sentences.zh: 这种模式的好处是它可以更好地显示编译器检测了哪些形式。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: new compiler transforms for MEMBER and ASSOC were affected by printer control variables. (reported by Dan Corkill)

sentences.en: bug fix: new compiler transforms for MEMBER and ASSOC were affected by printer control variables.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：MEMBER 和 ASSOC 的新编译器转换受到打印机控制变量的影响。

sentences.en: (reported by Dan Corkill)
sentences.zh: （丹·科基尔报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: system leaked memory when delayed output was performed by the OS in smaller chunks then expected. (thanks to David Smith)

sentences.en: bug fix: system leaked memory when delayed output was performed by the OS in smaller chunks then expected.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当操作系统以比预期更小的块执行延迟输出时，系统会泄漏内存。

sentences.en: (thanks to David Smith)
sentences.zh: （感谢大卫·史密斯）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: system leaked memory when file streams were not closed properly.

sentences.en: bug fix: system leaked memory when file streams were not closed properly.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：文件流未正确关闭时系统泄漏内存。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: large objects written to slow streams that were modified after the write could end up with the modified state written to the underlying file descriptor.

sentences.en: bug fix: large objects written to slow streams that were modified after the write could end up with the modified state written to the underlying file descriptor.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：写入慢速流的大对象在写入后进行了修改，最终可能会将修改后的状态写入底层文件描述符。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: multiple threads operating in parallel on the same stream could cause buffer-overflows.

sentences.en: bug fix: multiple threads operating in parallel on the same stream could cause buffer-overflows.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在同一流上并行操作的多个线程可能会导致缓冲区溢出。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: source location information is stored correctly (broken since 1.0.6). This bug would generally show up as the Slime debugger highlighting the wrong form when the sldb-show-source command was used.

sentences.en: bug fix: source location information is stored correctly (broken since 1.0.6).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：源位置信息已正确存储（自 1.0.6 起已损坏）。

sentences.en: This bug would generally show up as the Slime debugger highlighting the wrong form when the sldb-show-source command was used.
sentences.zh: 当使用 sldb-show-source 命令时，此错误通常会显示为 Slime 调试器突出显示错误的形式。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Branch forms are again annotated as branches in the sb-cover annotations.

sentences.en: bug fix: Branch forms are again annotated as branches in the sb-cover annotations.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：分支形式再次在 sb-cover 注释中注释为分支。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: GCD on MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM no longer causes an infinite loop on x86-64. (reported by Gregory Vanuxem)

sentences.en: bug fix: GCD on MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM no longer causes an infinite loop on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM 上的 GCD 不再导致 x86-64 上的无限循环。

sentences.en: (reported by Gregory Vanuxem)
sentences.zh: （格雷戈里·瓦努森报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: EQUALP could return wrong results for structures with raw slots (slots with a :TYPE of SINGLE-FLOAT, DOUBLE-FLOAT, or a machine word). (reported by Vjacheslav Fyodorov)

sentences.en: bug fix: EQUALP could return wrong results for structures with raw slots (slots with a :TYPE of SINGLE-FLOAT, DOUBLE-FLOAT, or a machine word).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：EQUALP 可能会为具有原始槽的结构（具有 :TYPE 为 SINGLE-FLOAT、DOUBLE-FLOAT 或机器字的槽）返回错误结果。

sentences.en: (reported by Vjacheslav Fyodorov)
sentences.zh: （维亚切斯拉夫·费奥多罗夫报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: sb-sprof sampling didn't work on non-x86oid platforms. (patch by Pierre Mai)

sentences.en: bug fix: sb-sprof sampling didn't work on non-x86oid platforms.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：sb-sprof 采样在非 x86oid 平台上不起作用。

sentences.en: (patch by Pierre Mai)
sentences.zh: （皮埃尔·麦的补丁）

sentences.en: enhancement: experimental function SB-EXT:RESTRICT-COMPILER-POLICY allows assigning a global minimum value to optimization qualities (overriding proclamations and declarations).
sentences.zh: 增强功能：实验函数 SB-EXT:RESTRICT-COMPILER-POLICY 允许为优化质量分配全局最小值（覆盖声明和声明）。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: closed over variables can be stack-allocated on x86 and x86-64.

sentences.en: enhancement: closed over variables can be stack-allocated on x86 and x86-64.

sentences.zh: 性能错误修复：GETHASH 和 (SETF GETHASH) 再次成为非 consing。

sentences.zh: 优化：槽定义查找现在是 O(1)。

sentences.en: SLOT-VALUE and (SETF SLOT-VALUE) with variable slot names.
sentences.zh: SLOT-VALUE 和 (SETF SLOT-VALUE) 具有可变槽名称。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: STRING-TO-OCTETS is now up to 60% faster for UTF-8.

sentences.en: optimization: STRING-TO-OCTETS is now up to 60% faster for UTF-8.
sentences.zh: 优化：对于 UTF-8，STRING-TO-OCTETS 现在速度提高了 60%。

sentences.en: optimization: ASSOC and MEMBER can now be open-coded for all combinations of keyword arguments when second argument is constant and SPEED >= SPACE.

sentences.en: In other cases a specialized version is selected.
sentences.zh: 在其他情况下，会选择专门的版本。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: using obsoleted structure instances with TYPEP and generic functions now signals a sensible error.

sentences.en: bug fix: using obsoleted structure instances with TYPEP and generic functions now signals a sensible error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用带有 TYPEP 和通用函数的过时的结构实例现在会发出明显的错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: threads waiting on GET-FOREGROUND can be interrupted. (reported by Kristoffer Kvello)

sentences.en: bug fix: threads waiting on GET-FOREGROUND can be interrupted.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：等待 GET-FOREGROUND 的线程可能会被中断。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: backtrace construction is now more careful when making lisp-objects from pointers on the stack, to avoid creating bogus objects that can be seen by the GC.

sentences.en: bug fix: backtrace construction is now more careful when making lisp-objects from pointers on the stack, to avoid creating bogus objects that can be seen by the GC.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：当从堆栈上的指针创建 lisp 对象时，回溯构造现在更加小心，以避免创建 GC 可以看到的虚假对象。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: defaulting of values in contexts expecting more than 7 variables now works on x86-64. (reported by Christopher Laux)

sentences.en: bug fix: defaulting of values in contexts expecting more than 7 variables now works on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在需要超过 7 个变量的上下文中默认值现在可以在 x86-64 上运行。

sentences.en: (reported by Christopher Laux)
sentences.zh: （克里斯托弗·劳克斯报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: modifications to packages (INTERN, EXPORT, etc) are now thread safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: modifications to packages (INTERN, EXPORT, etc) are now thread safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对包（INTERN、EXPORT 等）的修改现在是线程安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: (SETF SYMBOL-PLIST) no longer allows assigning a non-list as the property-list of a symbol.

sentences.en: bug fix: (SETF SYMBOL-PLIST) no longer allows assigning a non-list as the property-list of a symbol.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：（SETF SYMBOL-PLIST）不再允许将非列表指定为符号的属性列表。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DEFMETHOD forms with CALL-NEXT-METHOD in the method body, in EVAL-WHEN forms with both :COMPILE-TOPLEVEL and :LOAD-TOPLEVEL situations requested, are once again file-compileable. (reported by Sascha Wilde)

sentences.en: bug fix: DEFMETHOD forms with CALL-NEXT-METHOD in the method body, in EVAL-WHEN forms with both :COMPILE-TOPLEVEL and :LOAD-TOPLEVEL situations requested, are once again file-compileable.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在方法主体中包含 CALL-NEXT-METHOD 的 DEFMETHOD 表单，以及同时请求 :COMPILE-TOPLEVEL 和 :LOAD-TOPLEVEL 情况的 EVAL-WHEN 表单，都可以再次进行文件编译。

sentences.en: (reported by Sascha Wilde)
sentences.zh: （萨沙·王尔德报道）

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.7, 2007-06-27

blocks.html_en: • MOP improvement: support for user-defined subclasses of SB-MOP:SPECIALIZER has been enhanced. The experimental interface function SB-PCL:MAKE-METHOD-SPECIALIZERS-FORM, called as part of the expansion of DEFMETHOD, is responsible for generating a form which creates a list of specializers when evaluated. Additional functions SB-PCL:[UN]PARSE-SPECIALIZER-USING-CLASS provide debugging and introspective support.

sentences.en: MOP improvement: support for user-defined subclasses of SB-MOP:SPECIALIZER has been enhanced.
sentences.zh: MOP 改进：增强了对 SB-MOP:SPECIALIZER 用户定义子类的支持。

sentences.en: The experimental interface function SB-PCL:MAKE-METHOD-SPECIALIZERS-FORM, called as part of the expansion of DEFMETHOD, is responsible for generating a form which creates a list of specializers when evaluated.
sentences.zh: 实验接口函数 SB-PCL:MAKE-METHOD-SPECIALIZERS-FORM 是 DEFMETHOD 扩展的一部分，负责生成一个表单，该表单在评估时创建一个专门化器列表。

sentences.en: Additional functions SB-PCL:[UN]PARSE-SPECIALIZER-USING-CLASS provide debugging and introspective support.
sentences.zh: 附加功能 SB-PCL:[UN]PARSE-SPECIALIZER-USING-CLASS 提供调试和内省支持。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the (unsupported) spinlock interface has changed: free spinlock now has the value NIL, and a held spinlock has the owning thread as its value.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the (unsupported) spinlock interface has changed: free spinlock now has the value NIL, and a held spinlock has the owning thread as its value.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：（不支持的）自旋锁接口已更改：自由自旋锁现在的值为 NIL，而持有的自旋锁的值为所属线程。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS now binds ALLOW-WITH-INTERRUPTS and WITH-LOCAL-INTERRUPTS as local macros. Refer to documentation string for details.

sentences.en: enhancement: WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS now binds ALLOW-WITH-INTERRUPTS and WITH-LOCAL-INTERRUPTS as local macros.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：WITHOUT-INTERRUPTS 现在将 ALLOW-WITH-INTERRUPTS 和 WITH-LOCAL-INTERRUPTS 绑定为本地宏。

sentences.en: Refer to documentation string for details.
sentences.zh: 有关详细信息，请参阅文档字符串。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: name of a socket-stream is now "a socket" instead of "a constant string".

sentences.en: enhancement: name of a socket-stream is now "a socket" instead of "a constant string".
sentences.zh: 增强功能：套接字流的名称现在是“套接字”而不是“常量字符串”。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-POSIX now supports lockf(). (Thanks to Zach Beane.)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-POSIX now supports lockf().
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-POSIX 现在支持 lockf()。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Zach Beane.)
sentences.zh: （感谢扎克·比恩。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-POSIX now supports getcwd(). (Thanks to Tassilo Horn.)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-POSIX now supports getcwd().
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-POSIX 现在支持 getcwd()。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Tassilo Horn.)
sentences.zh: （感谢塔西洛·霍恩。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SB-INTROSPECT:FUNCTION-ARGLIST shows nicer argument lists for generic functions. (Thanks to Tobias C. Rittweiler)

sentences.en: enhancement: SB-INTROSPECT:FUNCTION-ARGLIST shows nicer argument lists for generic functions.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SB-INTROSPECT:FUNCTION-ARGLIST 显示更好的泛型函数参数列表。

sentences.en: (Thanks to Tobias C.
sentences.zh: （感谢托比亚斯 C.

sentences.en: Rittweiler)
sentences.zh: 里威纳犬）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: bignum printing speed has been improved by 20-40% (depending on the bignum size.)

sentences.en: optimization: bignum printing speed has been improved by 20-40% (depending on the bignum size.)
sentences.zh: 优化：bignum 打印速度提高了 20-40%（取决于 bignum 大小。）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: WITH-MUTEX and WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK are now interrupt safe on Linux.

sentences.en: bug fix: WITH-MUTEX and WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK are now interrupt safe on Linux.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：WITH-MUTEX 和WITH-RECURSIVE-LOCK 现在在 Linux 上是中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the cache used by the CLOS to store precomputed effective methods, slot offsets, and constant return values is now thread and interrupt safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: the cache used by the CLOS to store precomputed effective methods, slot offsets, and constant return values is now thread and interrupt safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：CLOS 用于存储预先计算的有效方法、槽偏移量和常量返回值的缓存现在是线程和中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: generic function dispatch function updating is now thread and interrupt safe (in the sense that the known issues have been fixed.)

sentences.en: bug fix: generic function dispatch function updating is now thread and interrupt safe (in the sense that the known issues have been fixed.)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：通用函数调度函数更新现在是线程和中断安全的（从某种意义上说，已知问题已得到修复。）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ADD/REMOVE-METHOD is now thread and interrupt safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: ADD/REMOVE-METHOD is now thread and interrupt safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ADD/REMOVE-METHOD 现在是线程和中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: interning EQL-specializers is now thread and interrupt safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: interning EQL-specializers is now thread and interrupt safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：实习 EQL 专用程序现在是线程和中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: asdf systems with dependencies to the SB-POSIX or SB-BSD-SOCKETS contribs can be loaded with :FORCE T.

sentences.en: bug fix: asdf systems with dependencies to the SB-POSIX or SB-BSD-SOCKETS contribs can be loaded with :FORCE T.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：可以使用 :FORCE T 加载依赖于 SB-POSIX 或 SB-BSD-SOCKETS 贡献的 asdf 系统。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: interrupt safety of applicable method computation has been improved.

sentences.en: bug fix: interrupt safety of applicable method computation has been improved.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：改进了适用方法计算的中断安全性。

sentences.en: New in version 1.0.6, 2007-05-27

sentences.en: Back to top

blocks.html_en: • new contrib: sb-cover, an experimental code coverage tool, is included as a contrib module.

sentences.en: new contrib: sb-cover, an experimental code coverage tool, is included as a contrib module.
sentences.zh: 新的 contrib：sb-cover，一个实验性代码覆盖工具，作为 contrib 模块包含在内。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: STRING-TO-OCTETS for unibyte encodings and UTF-8 is significantly faster.

sentences.en: optimization: STRING-TO-OCTETS for unibyte encodings and UTF-8 is significantly faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：单字节编码和 UTF-8 的 STRING-TO-OCTETS 明显更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: calls of the form (AREF FOO (+ INDEX <constant>)) now produce more efficient code on x86-64 if the compiler can determine that (+ INDEX <constant>) does not require a bounds check and FOO has an element type at least 8 bits wide.

sentences.en: optimization: calls of the form (AREF FOO (+ INDEX <constant>)) now produce more efficient code on x86-64 if the compiler can determine that (+ INDEX <constant>) does not require a bounds check and FOO has an element type at least 8 bits wide.
sentences.zh: 优化：如果编译器可以确定 (+ INDEX <constant>) 不需要边界检查并且 FOO 具有至少 8 位宽的元素类型，则 (AREF FOO (+ INDEX <constant>)) 形式的调用现在可以在 x86-64 上生成更高效的代码。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: a new, experimental synchronous timeout facility is provided. Refer to SB-SYS:WITH-DEADLINE for details.

sentences.en: enhancement: a new, experimental synchronous timeout facility is provided.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：提供了一个新的实验性同步超时工具。

sentences.en: Refer to SB-SYS:WITH-DEADLINE for details.
sentences.zh: 有关详细信息，请参阅 SB-SYS:WITH-DEADLINE。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: when a symbol name conflict error arises, the conflicting symbols are always printed with a package prefix. (thanks to Kevin Reid)

sentences.en: enhancement: when a symbol name conflict error arises, the conflicting symbols are always printed with a package prefix.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：当出现符号名称冲突错误时，冲突的符号总是用包前缀打印。

sentences.en: (thanks to Kevin Reid)
sentences.zh: （感谢凯文·里德）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: stepping is now once again supported on the SPARC and MIPS platforms. (It is also now more likely to work on CheneyGC builds on the PPC.)

sentences.en: enhancement: stepping is now once again supported on the SPARC and MIPS platforms.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SPARC 和 MIPS 平台现在再次支持步进。

sentences.en: (It is also now more likely to work on CheneyGC builds on the PPC.)
sentences.zh: （现在它也更有可能在 PPC 上的 CheneyGC 构建上工作。）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: sb-sprof can now also track and report accurate call counts.

sentences.en: enhancement: sb-sprof can now also track and report accurate call counts.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：sb-sprof 现在还可以跟踪和报告准确的呼叫计数。

blocks.html_en: • bug fixes: the treatment of non-standard subclasses of SB-MOP:SPECIALIZER is more correct.

sentences.en: bug fixes: the treatment of non-standard subclasses of SB-MOP:SPECIALIZER is more correct.
sentences.zh: bug修复：SB-MOP:SPECIALIZER非标准子类的处理更加正确。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: PURIFY no longer copies the data from the dynamic space into the static and read-only spaces on platforms that use the generational garbage collector

sentences.en: incompatible change: PURIFY no longer copies the data from the dynamic space into the static and read-only spaces on platforms that use the generational garbage collector
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：PURIFY 不再将数据从动态空间复制到使用分代垃圾收集器的平台上的静态和只读空间

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: GETHASH, (SETF GETHASH), CLRHASH and REMHASH are now interrupt safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: GETHASH, (SETF GETHASH), CLRHASH and REMHASH are now interrupt safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：GETHASH、(SETF GETHASH)、CLRHASH 和 REMHASH 现在是中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: GC race condition occasionally resulting in crashes with the error message "SIG_STOP_FOR_GC blocked at a bad place" has been fixed.

sentences.en: bug fix: GC race condition occasionally resulting in crashes with the error message "SIG_STOP_FOR_GC blocked at a bad place" has been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：GC 竞争条件偶尔会导致崩溃，并显示错误消息“SIG_STOP_FOR_GC 阻塞在错误位置”已得到修复。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: &ENVIRONMENT variables in macro lambda lists can now be declared ignored.

sentences.en: bug fix: &ENVIRONMENT variables in macro lambda lists can now be declared ignored.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：现在可以声明忽略宏 lambda 列表中的 &ENVIRONMENT 变量。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DEFSETF lambda lists without &ENVIRONMENT no longer cause a STYLE-WARNING to be signalled (regression from 1.0.4.)

sentences.en: bug fix: DEFSETF lambda lists without &ENVIRONMENT no longer cause a STYLE-WARNING to be signalled (regression from 1.0.4.)
sentences.zh: 错误修复：不带 &ENVIRONMENT 的 DEFSETF lambda 列表不再导致发出样式警告信号（从 1.0.4 回归。）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: an asynchronous interrupt could previously leave the system running with GC inhibited.

sentences.en: bug fix: an asynchronous interrupt could previously leave the system running with GC inhibited.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：异步中断可能会导致系统在 GC 禁止的情况下运行。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: a DECLARE form evaluated at top-level now causes an error rather than silently (or verbosely) returning NIL.

sentences.en: bug fix: a DECLARE form evaluated at top-level now causes an error rather than silently (or verbosely) returning NIL.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在顶层评估的 DECLARE 表单现在会导致错误，而不是默默地（或详细地）返回 NIL。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: trying to dissassemble functions compiled at high DEBUG could result in a error being signalled due to source form lookup errors. (reported by Peter Graves)

sentences.en: bug fix: trying to dissassemble functions compiled at high DEBUG could result in a error being signalled due to source form lookup errors.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：尝试反汇编在高 DEBUG 下编译的函数可能会因源形式查找错误而导致发出错误信号。

sentences.en: (reported by Peter Graves)
sentences.zh: （彼得·格雷夫斯报道）

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: removed writer methods for host-ent-name, host-ent-addresses -- changing the values did not update the DNS information anyway.

sentences.en: incompatible change: removed writer methods for host-ent-name, host-ent-addresses -- changing the values did not update the DNS information anyway.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：删除了 host-ent-name、host-ent-addresses 的编写器方法——更改值无论如何都不会更新 DNS 信息。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: changed experimental JOIN-THREAD interface

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: changed experimental JOIN-THREAD interface
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：更改了实验性 JOIN-THREAD 接口

blocks.html_en: • documentation: the manual now lists reader and writer methods in class slot documentation sections. (thanks to Richard M Kreuter)

sentences.en: documentation: the manual now lists reader and writer methods in class slot documentation sections.
sentences.zh: 文档：手册现在在类槽文档部分列出了读取器和写入器方法。

sentences.en: (thanks to Richard M Kreuter)
sentences.zh: （感谢理查德·M·克鲁特）

blocks.html_en: • documentation: unwinding from asyncronous events has been documented as unsafe.

sentences.en: documentation: unwinding from asyncronous events has been documented as unsafe.
sentences.zh: 文档：从异步事件中展开已被记录为不安全。

blocks.html_en: • documentation: SB-SYS:WITHOUT-GCING has been documented as unsafe in multithreaded application code.

sentences.en: documentation: SB-SYS:WITHOUT-GCING has been documented as unsafe in multithreaded application code.
sentences.zh: 文档：SB-SYS:WITHOUT-GCING 已被记录为在多线程应用程序代码中不安全。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: GET-INTERNAL-REAL-TIME has been optimized on POSIX platforms. (thanks to James Anderson for the optimization hint)

sentences.en: optimization: GET-INTERNAL-REAL-TIME has been optimized on POSIX platforms.
sentences.zh: 优化：GET-INTERNAL-REAL-TIME 已在 POSIX 平台上进行了优化。

sentences.en: (thanks to James Anderson for the optimization hint)
sentences.zh: （感谢 James Anderson 的优化提示）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: REPLACE, SUBSEQ, and COPY-SEQ are now optimized in more cases.

sentences.en: optimization: REPLACE, SUBSEQ, and COPY-SEQ are now optimized in more cases.
sentences.zh: 优化：REPLACE、SUBSEQ 和 COPY-SEQ 现在在更多情况下进行了优化。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: STRING-{EQUAL,LESSP,GREATER-P} and their NOT- variants no longer cons.

sentences.en: optimization: STRING-{EQUAL,LESSP,GREATER-P} and their NOT- variants no longer cons.
sentences.zh: 优化：STRING-{EQUAL,LESSP,GREATER-P} 及其 NOT- 变体不再是缺点。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: Direct calls to CHAR-{EQUAL,LESSP,GREATERP} and their NOT- variants no longer cons.

sentences.en: optimization: Direct calls to CHAR-{EQUAL,LESSP,GREATERP} and their NOT- variants no longer cons.
sentences.zh: 优化：直接调用 CHAR-{EQUAL,LESSP,GREAERP} 及其 NOT- 变体不再是缺点。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: EQUAL hash tables no longer use SXHASH for objects of all data types, but instead use an EQL hash for types for which EQUAL is the same as EQL.

sentences.en: optimization: EQUAL hash tables no longer use SXHASH for objects of all data types, but instead use an EQL hash for types for which EQUAL is the same as EQL.
sentences.zh: 优化：EQUAL 哈希表不再对所有数据类型的对象使用 SXHASH，而是对 EQUAL 与 EQL 相同的类型使用 EQL 哈希。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the non-inlined generic versions of AREF and (SETF AREF) are significantly faster.

sentences.en: optimization: the non-inlined generic versions of AREF and (SETF AREF) are significantly faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：AREF 和 (SETF AREF) 的非内联通用版本明显更快。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: new STRING-OUTPUT-STREAM implementation is much faster for large outputs and conses 30% less on average.

sentences.en: optimization: new STRING-OUTPUT-STREAM implementation is much faster for large outputs and conses 30% less on average.
sentences.zh: 优化：新的 STRING-OUTPUT-STREAM 实现对于大输出来说速度更快，并且平均消耗减少 30%。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: XREF information is now collected for references made to global variables using SYMBOL-VALUE and a constant argument.

sentences.en: enhancement: XREF information is now collected for references made to global variables using SYMBOL-VALUE and a constant argument.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：现在收集 XREF 信息，以使用符号值和常量参数对全局变量进行引用。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: SIGINT now causes a specific condition SB-SYS:INTERACTIVE-INTERRUPT to be signalled.

sentences.en: enhancement: SIGINT now causes a specific condition SB-SYS:INTERACTIVE-INTERRUPT to be signalled.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：SIGINT 现在会导致发出特定条件 SB-SYS:INTERACTIVE-INTERRUPT 信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FILE-POSITION used to signal an error in some cases where ANSI requires it to return NIL.

sentences.en: bug fix: FILE-POSITION used to signal an error in some cases where ANSI requires it to return NIL.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 ANSI 要求返回 NIL 的某些情况下，FILE-POSITION 用于发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ADJUST-ARRAY is now interrupt-safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: ADJUST-ARRAY is now interrupt-safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ADJUST-ARRAY 现在是中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: adding and removing fd-handlers is now interrupt-safe.

sentences.en: bug fix: adding and removing fd-handlers is now interrupt-safe.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：添加和删除 fd 处理程序现在是中断安全的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: inlined calls to C now ensure 16byte stack alignment on x86/Darwin.

sentences.en: bug fix: inlined calls to C now ensure 16byte stack alignment on x86/Darwin.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：对 C 的内联调用现在可确保 x86/Darwin 上的 16 字节堆栈对齐。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: bad type declaration in the CLOS implementation has been fixed. (reported by James Anderson)

sentences.en: bug fix: bad type declaration in the CLOS implementation has been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：CLOS 实现中错误的类型声明已修复。

sentences.en: (reported by James Anderson)
sentences.zh: （詹姆斯·安德森报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: incorrect ROOM reporting on x86-64 has been fixed. (thanks to Lutz Euler)

sentences.en: bug fix: incorrect ROOM reporting on x86-64 has been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：x86-64 上不正确的 ROOM 报告已修复。

sentences.en: (thanks to Lutz Euler)
sentences.zh: （感谢卢茨·欧拉）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DEFSETF now allows &ENVIRONMENT and disallows &AUX as required by the CLHS. (reported by Samium Gromoff)

sentences.en: bug fix: DEFSETF now allows &ENVIRONMENT and disallows &AUX as required by the CLHS.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：DEFSETF 现在允许 &ENVIRONMENT 并根据 CLHS 的要求不允许 &AUX。

sentences.en: (reported by Samium Gromoff)
sentences.zh: （萨米姆·格罗莫夫报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: dead unbound variable references now signal an error. (reported by Marco Monteiro)

sentences.en: bug fix: dead unbound variable references now signal an error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：死的未绑定变量引用现在发出错误信号。

sentences.en: (reported by Marco Monteiro)
sentences.zh: （马可·蒙泰罗报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: / with an unused value was being deleted in safe code. (thanks to Marco Monteiro and Kevin Reid)

sentences.en: bug fix: / with an unused value was being deleted in safe code.
sentences.zh: 错误修复： / 未使用的值已在安全代码中被删除。

sentences.en: (thanks to Marco Monteiro and Kevin Reid)
sentences.zh: （感谢马可·蒙泰罗和凯文·里德）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: number of characters that can be written onto a single line in a file is unlimited.

sentences.en: bug fix: number of characters that can be written onto a single line in a file is unlimited.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：文件中单行可以写入的字符数是无限的。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: some GC deadlocks caused by asynchronous interrupts have been fixed by inhibiting interrupts for when GC is disabled.

sentences.en: bug fix: some GC deadlocks caused by asynchronous interrupts have been fixed by inhibiting interrupts for when GC is disabled.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS declarations no longer trigger a bogus warning in DEFMETHOD bodies. (reported by Kevin Reid)

sentences.en: bug fix: a logic error was causing the hash function for bignums to have excessive amounts of collisions.

sentences.en: bug fix: modifying the contents of an array could change the return value of SXHASH on that array, which is only allowed for strings and bit vectors.

blocks.html_en: • improvement: the x86-64/darwin port now passes all tests (except for the debugger tests) but should still be considered experimental until this is fixed.

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: the thread-safe (on most platforms) getaddrinfo and getnameinfo sockets functions are used instead of gethostbyaddr and gethostbyname, on platforms where the newer functions are available. sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：在提供新函数的平台上，使用线程安全（在大多数平台上）的 getaddrinfo 和 getnameinfo 套接字函数而不是 gethostbyaddr 和 gethostbyname 。

sentences.en: As a result, the ALIASES field of HOST-ENT will always be NIL on these platforms.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这些平台上，HOST-ENT 的 ALIASES 字段将始终为 NIL。

blocks.html_en:
• Improvements to the Windows port:
    • floating point exceptions are now reported correctly.
    • stack exhaustion detection works partially.
    • more accurate GET-INTERNAL-REAL-TIME.
    • better RUN-PROGRAM behaviour in case of errors in the child process.
    • PROBE-FILE now simplifies pathnames correctly.
    • DIRECTORY now works correctly with :WILD-INFERIORS.
    • DECODE-UNIVERSAL-TIME works on times before 00:00:00 January 1st 1970 (although time timezone data will be unreliable).
    • Hyperbolic functions TANH, ASINH, ACOSH, and ATANH work.

sentences.en: Improvements to the Windows port: floating point exceptions are now reported correctly.
sentences.zh: Windows 端口的改进：现在可以正确报告浮点异常。

sentences.en: stack exhaustion detection works partially.
sentences.zh: 堆栈耗尽检测部分起作用。

sentences.en: more accurate GET-INTERNAL-REAL-TIME.
sentences.zh: 更准确的获取内部实时。

sentences.en: better RUN-PROGRAM behaviour in case of errors in the child process.
sentences.zh: 在子进程中出现错误时更好的 RUN-PROGRAM 行为。

sentences.en: PROBE-FILE now simplifies pathnames correctly.
sentences.zh: PROBE-FILE 现在可以正确简化路径名。

sentences.en: DIRECTORY now works correctly with :WILD-INFERIORS.
sentences.zh: DIRECTORY 现在可以与 :WILD-INFERIORS 一起正常工作。

sentences.en: DECODE-UNIVERSAL-TIME works on times before 00:00:00 January 1st 1970 (although time timezone data will be unreliable).
sentences.zh: DECODE-UNIVERSAL-TIME 适用于 1970 年 1 月 1 日 00:00:00 之前的时间（尽管时间时区数据不可靠）。

sentences.en: Hyperbolic functions TANH, ASINH, ACOSH, and ATANH work.
sentences.zh: 双曲函数 TANH、ASINH、ACOSH 和 ATANH 有效。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: External-format support for FFI calls. The SB-ALIEN:C-STRING no longer implies an ASCII external-format. Instead the string is subject to external-format conversion. Additionally return values of type SB-ALIEN:C-STRING are by default of type (SIMPLE-ARRAY CHARACTER), not SIMPLE-BASE-STRING. For an alien type that behaves like the old SB-ALIEN:C-STRING type, use (SB-ALIEN:C-STRING :EXTERNAL-FORMAT :ASCII :ELEMENT-TYPE BASE-CHAR). (thanks to Yaroslav Kavenchuk)

sentences.en: incompatible change: External-format support for FFI calls.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：FFI 调用的外部格式支持。

sentences.en: The SB-ALIEN:C-STRING no longer implies an ASCII external-format.
sentences.zh: SB-ALIEN:C-STRING 不再暗示 ASCII 外部格式。

sentences.en: Instead the string is subject to external-format conversion.
sentences.zh: 相反，该字符串需要进行外部格式转换。

sentences.en: Additionally return values of type SB-ALIEN:C-STRING are by default of type (SIMPLE-ARRAY CHARACTER), not SIMPLE-BASE-STRING.

sentences.en: For an alien type that behaves like the old SB-ALIEN:C-STRING type, use (SB-ALIEN:C-STRING :EXTERNAL-FORMAT :ASCII :ELEMENT-TYPE BASE-CHAR).
sentences.zh: 对于行为类似于旧 SB-ALIEN:C-STRING 类型的外来类型，请使用 (SB-ALIEN:C-STRING :EXTERNAL-FORMAT :ASCII :ELEMENT-TYPE BASE-CHAR)。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the single-stepper REPL has been merged with the normal debugger (see the "Stepping" heading of the debugger help for more details). The debugger command STEP will no longer switch to the single-stepper REPL.

sentences.en: The debugger command STEP will no longer switch to the single-stepper REPL.

sentences.en: bug fix: better detection of circularities in the file-compiler.

sentences.en: (reported by Marco Monteiro)

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the CL pathname functions now work with files that have non-ASCII characters in their names (thanks to Yaroslav Kavenchuk)

sentences.en: bug fix: the CL pathname functions now work with files that have non-ASCII characters in their names (thanks to Yaroslav Kavenchuk)

sentences.en: bug fix: The :PTY argument for RUN-PROGRAM will now work on systems with Unix98 pty semantics.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：RUN-PROGRAM 的 :PTY 参数现在可以在具有 Unix98 pty 语义的系统上工作。

sentences.en: bug fix: ASDF-INSTALL will now work with bsd tar.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ASDF-INSTALL 现在可以与 bsd tar 一起使用。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ASDF-INSTALL uses GNU tar on Solaris (thanks to Josip Gracin).

sentences.en: bug fix: ASDF-INSTALL uses GNU tar on Solaris (thanks to Josip Gracin).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：ASDF-INSTALL 在 Solaris 上使用 GNU tar（感谢 Josip Gracin）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: timers expiring in dead threads no longer cause a type-error (reported by Paul "Nonny Mouse").

sentences.en: bug fix: timers expiring in dead threads no longer cause a type-error (reported by Paul "Nonny Mouse").
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在死线程中到期的计时器不再导致类型错误（由 Paul“Nonny Mouse”报告）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: thanks to more lightweight single-stepper instrumentation, code compiled with (DEBUG 3) will compile and execute significantly faster, and will have more accurate type-inferencing than before

sentences.zh: 错误修复：得益于更轻量级的单步检测，使用（DEBUG 3）编译的代码将编译和执行速度显着加快，并且比以前具有更准确的类型推断

sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：变量 SB-EXT:*USE-IMPLMENTATION-TYPES* 不再存在。

sentences.en: optimization: faster LOGCOUNT implementation on x86 and x86-64 (thanks to Lutz Euler)

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: step-instrumentation no longer wraps known single-value functions with multiple-value context, allowing better type inference.

sentences.en: enhancement: step-instrumentation no longer wraps known single-value functions with multiple-value context, allowing better type inference.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：逐步检测不再将已知的单值函数与多值上下文包装在一起，从而允许更好的类型推断。

sentences.en: fixed bug #337: use of MAKE-METHOD in method combination now works even in the presence of user-defined method classes.

sentences.zh: （布鲁诺·海布尔和帕斯卡·科斯坦萨报道）

sentences.en: (reported by Bruno Haible)
sentences.zh: （布鲁诺·海布尔报道）

sentences.en: fixed bug #361: the :FUNCTION initarg in the protocol for initialization of methods can now be used to override internally-produced optimized functions.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #361：方法初始化协议中的 :FUNCTION initarg 现在可用于覆盖内部生成的优化函数。

sentences.en: (reported by Bruno Haible)
sentences.zh: （布鲁诺·海布尔报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: extensions of MAKE-METHOD-LAMBDA which wrap the system-provided lambda expression no longer cause warnings about unbound #:|pv-table| symbols.

sentences.en: bug fix: extensions of MAKE-METHOD-LAMBDA which wrap the system-provided lambda expression no longer cause warnings about unbound #:|pv-table| symbols.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：包装系统提供的 lambda 表达式的 MAKE-METHOD-LAMBDA 扩展不再导致有关未绑定 #:|pv-table| 的警告符号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: improved the handling of type declarations and the detection of violations for keyword arguments with non-constant defaults.

sentences.en: bug fix: improved the handling of type declarations and the detection of violations for keyword arguments with non-constant defaults.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：改进了类型声明的处理以及对具有非常量默认值的关键字参数的违规检测。

sentences.en: bug fix: potentially erronous calls to PATHNAME and MERGE-PATHNAMES were being flushed in some cases.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在某些情况下可能会刷新对 PATHNAME 和 MERGE-PATHNAMES 的潜在错误调用。

sentences.en: bug fix: compiled calls to TYPEP were mishandling obsolete instances.

sentences.zh: （詹姆斯·贝尔曼和阿蒂拉·伦德瓦伊报道）

sentences.en: bug fix: format strings with ~> without matching ~< no longer trigger an AVER, but signal an understandable error instead.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 ~> 而不匹配 ~< 格式化字符串不再触发 AVER，而是发出可理解的错误信号。

sentences.en: (reported by Robert Dodier)
sentences.zh: （罗伯特·多迪尔报道）

sentences.zh: 错误修复：FUNCALL 形式的编译器宏 lambda 列表解析。

sentences.en: (reported by James Y Knight).
sentences.zh: （詹姆斯·Y·奈特报道）。

sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译器宏函数没有考虑本地函数遮蔽的环境参数。

sentences.en: bug fix: #368: incorrect use of expressed vs. upgraded array element type.

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: prevent the user from specializing the new-value argument to SB-MOP:SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS. blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • REMOVE-METHOD returns its generic function argument even when the method is not one of the generic functions' methods.
    • objects declared as MEMBER types can be admissible arguments to structure accessors.
    • printing characters should simply be printed by the FORMAT ~:C directive.
    • compiler failure when compiling functions with hairy constant defaults for optional parameters.
    • compiler produces wrong code when MAYBE-INLINE-expanding a function, which is already optimized.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: REMOVE-METHOD returns its generic function argument even when the method is not one of the generic functions' methods.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：即使该方法不是泛型函数的方法之一，REMOVE-METHOD 也会返回其泛型函数参数。

sentences.en: objects declared as MEMBER types can be admissible arguments to structure accessors.
sentences.zh: 声明为 MEMBER 类型的对象可以是结构访问器可接受的参数。

sentences.en: printing characters should simply be printed by the FORMAT ~:C directive.
sentences.zh: 打印字符应该简单地由 FORMAT ~:C 指令打印。

sentences.en: compiler failure when compiling functions with hairy constant defaults for optional parameters.
sentences.zh: 编译带有可选参数的常量默认值的函数时编译器失败。

sentences.en: compiler produces wrong code when MAYBE-INLINE-expanding a function, which is already optimized.
sentences.zh: 当可能内联扩展已经优化的函数时，编译器会生成错误的代码。

blocks.html_en: • REMOVE-METHOD returns its generic function argument even when the method is not one of the generic functions' methods.

sentences.en: REMOVE-METHOD returns its generic function argument even when the method is not one of the generic functions' methods.
sentences.zh: 即使该方法不是泛型函数的方法之一，REMOVE-METHOD 也会返回其泛型函数参数。

blocks.html_en: • objects declared as MEMBER types can be admissible arguments to structure accessors.

sentences.en: objects declared as MEMBER types can be admissible arguments to structure accessors.
sentences.zh: 声明为 MEMBER 类型的对象可以是结构访问器可接受的参数。

blocks.html_en: • printing characters should simply be printed by the FORMAT ~:C directive.

sentences.en: printing characters should simply be printed by the FORMAT ~:C directive.
sentences.zh: 打印字符应该简单地由 FORMAT ~:C 指令打印。

sentences.en: compiler failure when compiling functions with hairy constant defaults for optional parameters.

sentences.zh: 当可能内联扩展已经优化的函数时，编译器会生成错误的代码。

blocks.html_en: • new platform: experimental support for SBCL x86/Darwin, including MacOS X 10.4.5 on Intel.

sentences.en: new platform: experimental support for SBCL x86/Darwin, including MacOS X 10.4.5 on Intel.
sentences.zh: 新平台：对 SBCL x86/Darwin 的实验性支持，包括 Intel 上的 MacOS X 10.4.5。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: Unicode character names are now known to the system (through CHAR-NAME and NAME-CHAR).

sentences.en: new feature: Unicode character names are now known to the system (through CHAR-NAME and NAME-CHAR).
sentences.zh: 新功能：系统现在已知 Unicode 字符名称（通过 CHAR-NAME 和 NAME-CHAR）。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: the filesystem location of SBCL's core file is exposed to lisp through the variable SB-EXT:*CORE-PATHNAME*.

sentences.en: new feature: the filesystem location of SBCL's core file is exposed to lisp through the variable SB-EXT:*CORE-PATHNAME*.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SBCL 核心文件的文件系统位置通过变量 SB-EXT:*CORE-PATHNAME* 暴露给 Lisp。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the contrib modules SB-POSIX and SB-BSD-SOCKETS no longer depend on stub C libraries; the intent of this change is to make it easier to distribute location-independent binaries.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the contrib modules SB-POSIX and SB-BSD-SOCKETS no longer depend on stub C libraries; the intent of this change is to make it easier to distribute location-independent binaries.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：contrib 模块 SB-POSIX 和 SB-BSD-SOCKETS 不再依赖存根 C 库；此更改的目的是使分发与位置无关的二进制文件变得更加容易。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: as implied by AMOP, standardized classes no longer have slots named by external symbols of public packages. (reported by Pascal Costanza)

sentences.en: bug fix: as implied by AMOP, standardized classes no longer have slots named by external symbols of public packages.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：正如 AMOP 所暗示的，标准化类不再具有由公共包的外部符号命名的插槽。

sentences.en: (reported by Pascal Costanza)
sentences.zh: （帕斯卡·科斯坦萨报道）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: calling functions via constant symbols -- as in (FUNCALL 'FOO) -- is now roughly as efficient as calling them via the function object as in (FUNCALL #'FOO).

sentences.en: optimization: calling functions via constant symbols -- as in (FUNCALL 'FOO) -- is now roughly as efficient as calling them via the function object as in (FUNCALL #'FOO).
sentences.zh: 优化：通过常量符号调用函数——如 (FUNCALL 'FOO) 中的函数——现在与通过函数对象调用函数（如 (FUNCALL #'FOO) 中的函数）大致相同。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: on x86 and x86-64, the calling convention for the case of dealing with an unknown number of values has been altered to be friendlier to the prediction heuristics implemented, particularly with reference to CALL and RET pairing. (thanks to Alastair Bridgewater)

sentences.en: optimization: on x86 and x86-64, the calling convention for the case of dealing with an unknown number of values has been altered to be friendlier to the prediction heuristics implemented, particularly with reference to CALL and RET pairing.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86 和 x86-64 上，处理未知数量值的情况下的调用约定已更改为对实现的预测启发式更加友好，特别是参考 CALL 和 RET 配对。

sentences.en: (thanks to Alastair Bridgewater)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿拉斯泰尔·布里奇沃特）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: on x86, the code for access to thread-local symbol values and binding/unbinding of thread-local symbols is smaller. (thanks to Alastair Bridgewater)

sentences.en: optimization: on x86, the code for access to thread-local symbol values and binding/unbinding of thread-local symbols is smaller.
sentences.zh: 优化：在 x86 上，访问线程本地符号值和绑定/取消绑定线程本地符号的代码更小。

sentences.en: (thanks to Alastair Bridgewater)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿拉斯泰尔·布里奇沃特）

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: CONSTANTP is now able to determine constantness of more complex forms, including calls to constant-foldable standardized functions and some special forms beyond QUOTE.

sentences.en: enhancement: CONSTANTP is now able to determine constantness of more complex forms, including calls to constant-foldable standardized functions and some special forms beyond QUOTE.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：CONSTNTP 现在能够确定更复杂形式的恒定性，包括对常量可折叠标准化函数的调用以及 QUOTE 之外的一些特殊形式。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: occasional GC crashes on Solaris/x86

sentences.en: fixed bug: occasional GC crashes on Solaris/x86
sentences.zh: 修复 bug：在 Solaris/x86 上偶尔 GC 崩溃

blocks.html_en: • optimization: x86-64 supports stack allocation of results of simple calls of MAKE-ARRAY, bound to variables, declared DYNAMIC-EXTENT

sentences.en: optimization: x86-64 supports stack allocation of results of simple calls of MAKE-ARRAY, bound to variables, declared DYNAMIC-EXTENT
sentences.zh: 优化：x86-64 支持对 MAKE-ARRAY 的简单调用结果进行堆栈分配，绑定到变量，声明为 DYNAMIC-EXTENT

blocks.html_en: • enchancement: the PROCESS-INPUT and -OUTPUT streams created by SB-EXT:RUN-PROGRAM can be used for both character and byte IO (thanks to James Knight)

sentences.en: enchancement: the PROCESS-INPUT and -OUTPUT streams created by SB-EXT:RUN-PROGRAM can be used for both character and byte IO (thanks to James Knight)
sentences.zh: 增强：SB-EXT:RUN-PROGRAM 创建的 PROCESS-INPUT 和 -OUTPUT 流可用于字符和字节 IO（感谢 James Knight）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: CL:LISTEN always returns NIL at end of file, as required by the standard (thanks to Stephen Compall)

sentences.en: fixed bug: CL:LISTEN always returns NIL at end of file, as required by the standard (thanks to Stephen Compall)
sentences.zh: 修复错误：按照标准要求，CL:LISTEN 总是在文件末尾返回 NIL（感谢 Stephen Compall）

sentences.en: New in version 0.9.10, 2006-02-27
