blocks.html_en: • new feature: new SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE keyword argument :EXECUTABLE can be used for bundling the runtime and the core file into one executable binary. This feature is not currently supported on all SBCL platforms. (thanks to James Bielman and NIIMI Satoshi)

sentences.en: new feature: new SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE keyword argument :EXECUTABLE can be used for bundling the runtime and the core file into one executable binary.
sentences.zh: 新功能：新的 SAVE-LISP-AND-DIE 关键字参数 :EXECUTABLE 可用于将运行时和核心文件捆绑到一个可执行二进制文件中。

sentences.en: This feature is not currently supported on all SBCL platforms.
sentences.zh: 目前并非所有 SBCL 平台都支持此功能。

sentences.en: (thanks to James Bielman and NIIMI Satoshi)
sentences.zh: （感谢 James Bielman 和 NIIMI Satoshi）

blocks.html_en: • new feature: a generational or ephemeral garbage collector is now the default on the PowerPC platform (both Linux and Darwin). The old Cheney (stop and copy) collector is a build-time option. (thanks to Cyrus Harmon, after Raymond Toy)

sentences.en: new feature: a generational or ephemeral garbage collector is now the default on the PowerPC platform (both Linux and Darwin).
sentences.zh: 新功能：分代或临时垃圾收集器现在是 PowerPC 平台（Linux 和 Darwin）上的默认设置。

sentences.en: The old Cheney (stop and copy) collector is a build-time option.
sentences.zh: 旧的切尼（停止并复制）收集器是一个构建时选项。

sentences.en: (thanks to Cyrus Harmon, after Raymond Toy)
sentences.zh: （感谢雷蒙德·托伊之后的赛勒斯·哈蒙）

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the method by which SBCL finds its contributed modules has changed; it no longer relies on symbolic links from an $SBCL_HOME/systems directory, but searches directly in the subdirectories of $SBCL_HOME.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the method by which SBCL finds its contributed modules has changed; it no longer relies on symbolic links from an $SBCL_HOME/systems directory, but searches directly in the subdirectories of $SBCL_HOME.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：SBCL 查找其贡献模块的方法已更改；它不再依赖于 $SBCL_HOME/systems 目录中的符号链接，而是直接在 $SBCL_HOME 的子目录中搜索。

blocks.html_en: • enhancement: the dynamic heap size on the Linux/PPC platform is markedly larger, even using the older Cheney garbage collector.

sentences.en: enhancement: the dynamic heap size on the Linux/PPC platform is markedly larger, even using the older Cheney garbage collector.
sentences.zh: 增强功能：Linux/PPC 平台上的动态堆大小明显更大，即使使用较旧的 Cheney 垃圾收集器也是如此。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #399: full call to DATA-VECTOR-REF in accesses to certain complicated string types. (reported by Gary King)

sentences.en: fixed bug #399: full call to DATA-VECTOR-REF in accesses to certain complicated string types.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #399：在访问某些复杂字符串类型时完全调用 DATA-VECTOR-REF。

sentences.en: (reported by Gary King)
sentences.zh: （加里·金报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: STRING-TO-OCTETS and OCTETS-TO-STRING did not convert character codes. (thanks to Yaroslav Kavenchuk and Ivan Boldyrev)

sentences.en: fixed bug: STRING-TO-OCTETS and OCTETS-TO-STRING did not convert character codes.
sentences.zh: 修复错误：STRING-TO-OCTETS 和 OCTETS-TO-STRING 未转换字符代码。

sentences.en: (thanks to Yaroslav Kavenchuk and Ivan Boldyrev)
sentences.zh: （感谢雅罗斯拉夫·卡文丘克和伊万·博尔德列夫）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: DOCUMENTATION on structures no longer signals an error if no structure type of the right name exists. (reported by Glenn Ehrlich)

sentences.en: fixed bug: DOCUMENTATION on structures no longer signals an error if no structure type of the right name exists.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：如果不存在正确名称的结构类型，结构上的文档不再发出错误信号。

sentences.en: (reported by Glenn Ehrlich)
sentences.zh: （格伦·埃利希报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: compiled calls to MAKE-INSTANCE where there is an applicable non-standard primary or :AROUND method on INITIALIZE-INSTANCE or SHARED-INITIALIZE and a non-keyword initarg no longer cause unbound variable errors. (reported by Kevin Reid)

sentences.en: fixed bug: compiled calls to MAKE-INSTANCE where there is an applicable non-standard primary or :AROUND method on INITIALIZE-INSTANCE or SHARED-INITIALIZE and a non-keyword initarg no longer cause unbound variable errors.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：编译对 MAKE-INSTANCE 的调用，其中 INITIALIZE-INSTANCE 或 SHARED-INITIALIZE 上有适用的非标准主方法或 :AROUND 方法以及非关键字 initarg 不再导致未绑定变量错误。

sentences.en: (reported by Kevin Reid)
sentences.zh: （凯文·里德报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: metacircle resolution in cases where methods have slots added before the slots from STANDARD-METHOD. (reported by Jean Bresson)

sentences.en: fixed bug: metacircle resolution in cases where methods have slots added before the slots from STANDARD-METHOD.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：如果方法在标准方法的槽之前添加了槽，则元圆解析。

sentences.en: (reported by Jean Bresson)
sentences.zh: （让·布列松报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: the Power PC assembly code for calling into lisp sometimes computed its return address wrongly (depending on the 15th bit of the address, fixed at link time). This used to manifest itself in a segmentation violation while building PCL. (reported by Kevin Rosenberg, Eric Marsden, Lars Brinkhoff and many others over the years)

sentences.en: fixed bug: the Power PC assembly code for calling into lisp sometimes computed its return address wrongly (depending on the 15th bit of the address, fixed at link time).
sentences.zh: 修复的错误：用于调用 lisp 的 Power PC 汇编代码有时会错误地计算其返回地址（取决于地址的第 15 位，在链接时修复）。

sentences.en: This used to manifest itself in a segmentation violation while building PCL.
sentences.zh: 这通常表现为构建 PCL 时的分段冲突。

sentences.en: (reported by Kevin Rosenberg, Eric Marsden, Lars Brinkhoff and many others over the years)
sentences.zh: （凯文·罗森伯格、埃里克·马斯登、拉尔斯·布林克霍夫和其他许多人多年来的报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: ROOM no longer reports silly numbers for stack usage if the stack pointer (treated as a signed integer) is negative. (thanks to Peter van Eynde)

sentences.en: fixed bug: ROOM no longer reports silly numbers for stack usage if the stack pointer (treated as a signed integer) is negative.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：如果堆栈指针（视为有符号整数）为负数，ROOM 不再报告堆栈使用情况的愚蠢数字。

sentences.en: (thanks to Peter van Eynde)
sentences.zh: （感谢彼得·范·艾因德）

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some incompatibilities between SBCL's MOP and the MOP specified by AMOP:
    • the METAOBJECT class is now implemented;
    • FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT is now a subclass of STANDARD-OBJECT, as required;
    • the classes STANDARD-CLASS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS are now compatible (as required by VALIDATE-SUPERCLASS); there remains a consistency requirement over the presence or absence of the FUNCTION class in the superclass list of finalized classes; see the manual for more details;
    • the :AROUND method for COMPUTE-SLOTS on FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS now honours the primary method's requested slot ordering.

sentences.en: fixed some incompatibilities between SBCL's MOP and the MOP specified by AMOP: the METAOBJECT class is now implemented; FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT is now a subclass of STANDARD-OBJECT, as required; the classes STANDARD-CLASS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS are now compatible (as required by VALIDATE-SUPERCLASS); there remains a consistency requirement over the presence or absence of the FUNCTION class in the superclass list of finalized classes; see the manual for more details; the :AROUND method for COMPUTE-SLOTS on FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS now honours the primary method's requested slot ordering.
sentences.zh: 修复了 SBCL 的 MOP 和 AMOP 指定的 MOP 之间的一些不兼容性：现在实现了 METAOBJECT 类；根据需要，FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT 现在是 STANDARD-OBJECT 的子类； STANDARD-CLASS 和 FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS 类现在兼容（根据 VALIDATE-SUPERCLASS 的要求）；对于最终类的超类列表中是否存在 FUNCTION 类，仍然存在一致性要求；请参阅手册了解更多详细信息； FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS 上的 COMPUTE-SLOTS 的 :AROUND 方法现在遵循主要方法请求的槽排序。

blocks.html_en: • the METAOBJECT class is now implemented;

sentences.en: the METAOBJECT class is now implemented;
sentences.zh: METAOBJECT 类现已实现；

blocks.html_en: • FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT is now a subclass of STANDARD-OBJECT, as required;

sentences.en: FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT is now a subclass of STANDARD-OBJECT, as required;
sentences.zh: 根据需要，FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-OBJECT 现在是 STANDARD-OBJECT 的子类；

blocks.html_en: • the classes STANDARD-CLASS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS are now compatible (as required by VALIDATE-SUPERCLASS); there remains a consistency requirement over the presence or absence of the FUNCTION class in the superclass list of finalized classes; see the manual for more details;

sentences.en: the classes STANDARD-CLASS and FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS are now compatible (as required by VALIDATE-SUPERCLASS); there remains a consistency requirement over the presence or absence of the FUNCTION class in the superclass list of finalized classes; see the manual for more details;
sentences.zh: STANDARD-CLASS 和 FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS 类现在兼容（根据 VALIDATE-SUPERCLASS 的要求）；对于最终类的超类列表中是否存在 FUNCTION 类，仍然存在一致性要求；请参阅手册了解更多详细信息；

blocks.html_en: • the :AROUND method for COMPUTE-SLOTS on FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS now honours the primary method's requested slot ordering.

sentences.en: the :AROUND method for COMPUTE-SLOTS on FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS now honours the primary method's requested slot ordering.
sentences.zh: FUNCALLABLE-STANDARD-CLASS 上的 COMPUTE-SLOTS 的 :AROUND 方法现在遵循主要方法请求的槽排序。

blocks.html_en:
• threads
    • bug fix: parent thread now can be gc'ed even with a live child thread
    • bug fix: binding a special with PROGV to no value is not the same as that symbol not having been bound (thanks to Hannu Koivisto)
    • bug fix: binding specials is thread safe (thanks to Hannu Koivisto)
    • bug fix: interrupt handlers are now per-process, RUN-PROGRAM and SB-SPROF do not die with 'no handler for signal XX in interrupt_handle_now(..)' anymore
    • bug fix: WITH-TIMEOUT works with multiple running threads

sentences.en: threads bug fix: parent thread now can be gc'ed even with a live child thread bug fix: binding a special with PROGV to no value is not the same as that symbol not having been bound (thanks to Hannu Koivisto) bug fix: binding specials is thread safe (thanks to Hannu Koivisto) bug fix: interrupt handlers are now per-process, RUN-PROGRAM and SB-SPROF do not die with 'no handler for signal XX in interrupt_handle_now(..)' anymore bug fix: WITH-TIMEOUT works with multiple running threads
sentences.zh: 线程错误修复：即使在活动子线程的情况下，父线程现在也可以进行 gc 错误修复：将带有 PROGV 的特殊值绑定到无值与未绑定的符号不同（感谢 Hannu Koivisto）错误修复：绑定特殊值是线程安全的（感谢 Hannu Koivisto）错误修复：中断处理程序现在是每个进程的，RUN-PROGRAM 和 SB-SPROF 不会因“没有信号 XX 的处理程序而死亡”错误修复：WITH-TIMEOUT 适用于多个正在运行的线程

sentences.en: bug fix: WITH-TIMEOUT works with multiple running threads

blocks.html_en:
• threads
    • bug fix: RELEASE-FOREGROUND doesn't choke on session lock if there is only one thread in the session
    • bug fix: memory leak for streams created in one thread and written to in another
    • bug fix: lockup when compiled with gcc4
    • bug fix: race that allows the gc to be triggered when gc is inhibited
    • bug fix: one less memory fault in INTERRUPT-THREAD, again
    • bug fix: gc and INTERRUPT-THREAD don't hang when the RT signal queue is full

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • CALL-NEXT-METHOD signals an error (in safe code) when the call has arguments with a different set of applicable methods from the orignal arguments.
    • The type error thrown by MAP now has a correct expected-type cell.
    • DISASSEMBLE now throws a TYPE-ERROR when its argument does not name a compiled function.
    • Three MISC tests where a large bignum was improperly coerced to a float that couldn't represent that bignum during type derivation were fixed.
    • SUBTYPEP can now handle types involving the negation of a list-form FUNCTION type.
    • SUBTYPEP also now handles certain COMPLEX type specifiers such as (COMPLEX (AND RATIO (NOT FIXNUM))).
    • READ-BYTE and WRITE-BYTE no longer take stream designators.

blocks.html_en:
• threads
    • added x86-64 support
    • incompatible change: the threading api now works with thread objects instead of thread ids
    • bug fix: threads are protected from signals and interruption when starting up or going down
    • bug fix: a race where an exiting thread could lose its stack to gc
    • bug fix: don't halt on infinite error in threads if possible
    • fixed numerous gc deadlocks introduced in the pthread merge
    • bug fix: fixed thread safety issues in read and print
    • bug fix: debugger doesn't hang on session lock if interrupted at an inappropriate moment
    • bug fix: run-program is now thread safe(r)
    • bug fix: inner with-recursive-lock no longer releases the mutex

sentences.en: threads added x86-64 support incompatible change: the threading api now works with thread objects instead of thread ids bug fix: threads are protected from signals and interruption when starting up or going down bug fix: a race where an exiting thread could lose its stack to gc bug fix: don't halt on infinite error in threads if possible fixed numerous gc deadlocks introduced in the pthread merge bug fix: fixed thread safety issues in read and print bug fix: debugger doesn't hang on session lock if interrupted at an inappropriate moment bug fix: run-program is now thread safe(r) bug fix: inner with-recursive-lock no longer releases the mutex

sentences.en: optimization: structure instances with raw slots now use less memory, and probably show better memory locality.

sentences.en: optimization: DYNAMIC-EXTENT declarations for lists and closures are treated as requests for stack allocation on the x86-64, Alpha-32, PPC and SPARC platforms.
sentences.zh: 优化：列表和闭包的 DYNAMIC-EXTENT 声明被视为 x86-64、Alpha-32、PPC 和 SPARC 平台上的堆栈分配请求。

blocks.html_en: • contrib improvement: it's harder to cause SOCKET-CLOSE to close() the wrong file descriptor; implementation of SOCKET-OPEN-P. (thanks to Tony Martinez)

sentences.en: contrib improvement: it's harder to cause SOCKET-CLOSE to close() the wrong file descriptor; implementation of SOCKET-OPEN-P.
sentences.zh: contrib 改进：更难导致 SOCKET-CLOSE close() 错误的文件描述符； SOCKET-OPEN-P 的实现。

sentences.en: (thanks to Tony Martinez)
sentences.zh: （感谢托尼·马丁内斯）

blocks.html_en:
• threads
    • gcing a dead thread can no longer lead to lockups
    • threads block signals until they are set up properly
    • errno is no longer shared by threads
    • interrupt-thread restores the eflags register on x86
    • fixed some lockups due to gc/thread interaction

sentences.en: threads gcing a dead thread can no longer lead to lockups threads block signals until they are set up properly errno is no longer shared by threads interrupt-thread restores the eflags register on x86 fixed some lockups due to gc/thread interaction

sentences.zh: 修复了由于 gc/线程交互而导致的一些锁定

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • invalid dotted lists no longer raise a read error when *READ-SUPPRESS* is T
    • signal an error if a symbol that names a declaration is used as the name of a type, or vice versa
    • allow using the (declare (typespec var*)) abbreviation for (declare (type typespec var*)) with all type specifiers
    • circularity detection works properly with PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK
    • always return NIL from PPRINT-POP when OBJECT is NIL
    • don't signal errors when pretty-printing malformed LABELS, FLET or MACROLET forms
    • declarations in a DOLIST body are also in scope for the DOLIST return-form
    • COMPILE-FILE accepts all pathname designators as INPUT-FILE and OUTPUT-FILE
    • the ELEMENT-TYPE keyword argument to WITH-OUTPUT-STREAM is always evaluated

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: invalid dotted lists no longer raise a read error when *READ-SUPPRESS* is T signal an error if a symbol that names a declaration is used as the name of a type, or vice versa allow using the (declare (typespec var*)) abbreviation for (declare (type typespec var*)) with all type specifiers circularity detection works properly with PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK always return NIL from PPRINT-POP when OBJECT is NIL don't signal errors when pretty-printing malformed LABELS, FLET or MACROLET forms declarations in a DOLIST body are also in scope for the DOLIST return-form COMPILE-FILE accepts all pathname designators as INPUT-FILE and OUTPUT-FILE the ELEMENT-TYPE keyword argument to WITH-OUTPUT-STREAM is always evaluated
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：当 *READ-SUPPRESS* 为 T 时，无效的点列表不再引发读取错误 如果命名声明的符号用作类型名称，则发出错误信号，反之亦然 允许使用 (declare (typespec var*)) 缩写（declare (type typespec var*)) 与所有类型说明符 循环性检测与 PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK 一起正常工作 始终返回 NIL当 OBJECT 为 NIL 时，PPRINT-POP 在 DOLIST 主体中的漂亮打印格式错误的 LABELS、FLET 或 MACROLET 形式声明也在 DOLIST 返回形式的范围内时不发出错误信号 COMPILE-FILE 接受所有路径名指示符作为 INPUT-FILE 和 OUTPUT-FILE 始终评估 WITH-OUTPUT-STREAM 的 ELEMENT-TYPE 关键字参数

blocks.html_en: • invalid dotted lists no longer raise a read error when *READ-SUPPRESS* is T

sentences.zh: 当 *READ-SUPPRESS* 为 T 时，无效的点列表不再引发读取错误

sentences.zh: 允许对所有类型说明符使用 (declare (typespec var*)) 缩写 (declare (type typespec var*))

blocks.html_en: • circularity detection works properly with PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK

sentences.en: circularity detection works properly with PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK
sentences.zh: 循环检测与 PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK 一起正常工作

sentences.en: always return NIL from PPRINT-POP when OBJECT is NIL

sentences.zh: 在漂亮打印格式错误的 LABELS、FLET 或 MACROLET 表单时不发出错误信号

sentences.zh: DOLIST 主体中的声明也在 DOLIST 返回形式的范围内

sentences.zh: COMPILE-FILE 接受所有路径名指示符作为 INPUT-FILE 和 OUTPUT-FILE

blocks.html_en: • the ELEMENT-TYPE keyword argument to WITH-OUTPUT-STREAM is always evaluated

sentences.en: the ELEMENT-TYPE keyword argument to WITH-OUTPUT-STREAM is always evaluated

sentences.en: Please use the equivalent --disable-debugger option instead.
sentences.zh: 请改用等效的 --disable-debugger 选项。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: finalizers and *AFTER-GC-HOOKS* are now run with interrupts enabled.

sentences.en: incompatible change: finalizers and *AFTER-GC-HOOKS* are now run with interrupts enabled.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：终结器和 *AFTER-GC-HOOKS* 现在在启用中断的情况下运行。

sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：对 *BEFORE-GC-HOOKS* 的支持（已经有一段时间无法运行）已被完全删除。

blocks.html_en: • null lexical environments are now printed as #<NULL-LEXENV>, significantly reducing the amount of clutter in typical backtraces.

sentences.en: null lexical environments are now printed as #<NULL-LEXENV>, significantly reducing the amount of clutter in typical backtraces.
sentences.zh: 空词法环境现在打印为 #<NULL-LEXENV>，显着减少了典型回溯中的混乱程度。

sentences.en: documentation on weak pointers, finalization, and after GC hooks has been added to the manual.
sentences.zh: 有关弱指针、终结和 GC 挂钩之后的文档已添加到手册中。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: REPLACE on declared (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) vectors, as well as other specialized array types, is much faster. SUBSEQ and COPY-SEQ on such arrays have also been sped up.

sentences.en: optimization: REPLACE on declared (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) vectors, as well as other specialized array types, is much faster.
sentences.zh: 优化：对已声明的 (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) 向量以及其他专用数组类型进行 REPLACE 速度要快得多。

sentences.en: SUBSEQ and COPY-SEQ on such arrays have also been sped up.
sentences.zh: 此类阵列上的 SUBSEQ 和 COPY-SEQ 也得到了加速。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: EQL is now more efficient when at least other argument is known to be of type (OR FIXNUM (NOT NUMBER)).

sentences.en: optimization: EQL is now more efficient when at least other argument is known to be of type (OR FIXNUM (NOT NUMBER)).
sentences.zh: 优化：当至少已知其他参数为类型（OR FIXNUM（NOT NUMBER））时，EQL 现在更加高效。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: the runtime is now less vulnerable to changes in the size of the SBCL object on OS X, and virtual memory is reserved for all spaces that need to be at a fixed address.

sentences.en: fixed bug: the runtime is now less vulnerable to changes in the size of the SBCL object on OS X, and virtual memory is reserved for all spaces that need to be at a fixed address.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：运行时现在不太容易受到 OS X 上 SBCL 对象大小变化的影响，并且虚拟内存是为所有需要位于固定地址的空间保留的。

sentences.en: (thanks to Gabor Mellis)
sentences.zh: （感谢加博尔·梅利斯）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: finalizers and after GC hooks that cause consing are now safe.

sentences.zh: 修复了 bug：导致 consing 的终结器和 GC 后钩子现在是安全的。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: compiler error messages and summaries are now printed to *ERROR-OUTPUT*, not *STANDARD-OUTPUT*.

sentences.en: fixed bug: compiler error messages and summaries are now printed to *ERROR-OUTPUT*, not *STANDARD-OUTPUT*.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：编译器错误消息和摘要现在打印到 *ERROR-OUTPUT*，而不是 *STANDARD-OUTPUT*。

sentences.zh: 修复了错误 305：INLINE/NOTINLINE 声明不再导致本地 ftype 声明被忽略。

sentences.en: (reported by Dave Roberts)
sentences.zh: （戴夫·罗伯茨报道）

sentences.zh: 修复了 bug 373：由于在 ppc/darwin 上运行时错误地编译了对外来变量的引用而导致。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 376: CONJUGATE type deriver.

sentences.en: fixed bug 376: CONJUGATE type deriver.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 376：CONJUGATE 类型派生器。

sentences.en: fixed infinite looping of ALIEN-FUNCALL, compiled with high DEBUG.

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • MISC.549 and similar: late transformation of unsafe type assertions into derived types caused unexpected code transformations.
    • SCALE-FLOAT type deriver is less wrong.
    • type derivers for EXP, LOG and similar functions compute result types for complex arguments better.
    • (MISC.563) CONJUGATE type deriver works for very restricted complex types.
    • out-of-line type testers for character strings are available.
    • EQUAL compiler transform understands specialness of objects of type BIT-VECTOR.
    • accessing double-floats stored on the stack now works on x86-64.
    • debugger internals could sometimes create invalid lispobjs, resulting in GC crashes.
    • MISC.548: type check weakening can convert required type into optional.
    • initialization forms for bindings are not in scope of free special declarations.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: MISC.549 and similar: late transformation of unsafe type assertions into derived types caused unexpected code transformations.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 的测试套件揭示的一些错误：MISC.549 和类似的：不安全类型断言到派生类型的后期转换导致意外的代码转换。

sentences.en: SCALE-FLOAT type deriver is less wrong.
sentences.zh: SCALE-FLOAT 类型的导出器错误较少。

sentences.en: type derivers for EXP, LOG and similar functions compute result types for complex arguments better.
sentences.zh: EXP、LOG 和类似函数的类型导出器可以更好地计算复杂参数的结果类型。

sentences.en: (MISC.563) CONJUGATE type deriver works for very restricted complex types.
sentences.zh: (MISC.563) CONJUGATE 类型派生程序适用于非常受限的复杂类型。

sentences.en: out-of-line type testers for character strings are available.
sentences.zh: 可以使用字符串的离线类型测试仪。

sentences.en: EQUAL compiler transform understands specialness of objects of type BIT-VECTOR.
sentences.zh: EQUAL 编译器转换了解 BIT-VECTOR 类型对象的特殊性。

sentences.en: accessing double-floats stored on the stack now works on x86-64.
sentences.zh: 现在可以在 x86-64 上访问存储在堆栈上的双浮点数。

sentences.en: debugger internals could sometimes create invalid lispobjs, resulting in GC crashes.
sentences.zh: 调试器内部有时可能会创建无效的 lispobj，从而导致 GC 崩溃。

sentences.en: MISC.548: type check weakening can convert required type into optional.
sentences.zh: MISC.548：类型检查弱化可以将所需类型转换为可选类型。

sentences.en: initialization forms for bindings are not in scope of free special declarations.
sentences.zh: 绑定的初始化形式不在自由特殊声明的范围内。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: thread support for non-NPTL systems has been removed - locking is buggy and unreliable. A threaded SBCL build will now warn at startup and refuse to create new threads, unless futex support is detected in the kernel

sentences.en: incompatible change: thread support for non-NPTL systems has been removed - locking is buggy and unreliable.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：已删除对非 NPTL 系统的线程支持 - 锁定有问题且不可靠。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: the top level REPL now has only an ABORT restart associated with it, not TOPLEVEL and ABORT as it used to. TOP and TOPLEVEL are now available as debugger commands for returning to the top level.

sentences.en: incompatible change: the top level REPL now has only an ABORT restart associated with it, not TOPLEVEL and ABORT as it used to.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：顶层 REPL 现在仅具有与其关联的 ABORT 重新启动，而不是像以前那样的 TOPLEVEL 和 ABORT。

sentences.zh: TOP 和 TOPLEVEL 现在可用作返回顶层的调试器命令。

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: user- and system-initialization files are no longer processed with LOAD, but by READ and EVAL; hence the global optimization policy, startup package, readtable, etc, can be set by them.

sentences.en: incompatible change: user- and system-initialization files are no longer processed with LOAD, but by READ and EVAL; hence the global optimization policy, startup package, readtable, etc, can be set by them.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：用户和系统初始化文件不再使用 LOAD 处理，而是通过 READ 和 EVAL 处理；因此全局优化策略、启动包、可读表等都可以由它们设置。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: receiving the signal which results from attempting to write to mprotect()ed memory (SIGSEGV on Linux and some *BSDs, SIGBUS on other *BSDs) on architectures where the C stack is also the Lisp stack (x86 and x86-64) from foreign code no longer leads to debugger confusion or wild instability. (reported by Cheuksan Wang)

sentences.en: fixed bug: receiving the signal which results from attempting to write to mprotect()ed memory (SIGSEGV on Linux and some *BSDs, SIGBUS on other *BSDs) on architectures where the C stack is also the Lisp stack (x86 and x86-64) from foreign code no longer leads to debugger confusion or wild instability.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：在 C 堆栈也是 Lisp 堆栈（x86 和 x86-64）的体系结构上，接收来自尝试从外部代码写入 mprotect()ed 内存（Linux 和某些 *BSD 上的 SIGSEGV，其他 *BSD 上的 SIGBUS）而产生的信号不再导致调试器混乱或严重不稳定。

sentences.en: (reported by Cheuksan Wang)

• fixed some bugs related to Unicode integration:
    • portions of multibyte characters at the end of buffers for character-based file input are correctly transferred to the start of the buffer at the next read.
    • COMPILE-FILE now respects any EXTERNAL-FORMAT argument given, passing it through to OPEN.
    • LOAD on source files likewise passes any EXTERNAL-FORMAT argument given to internal calls to OPEN.
    • the built-in comment readers (introduced by character sequences ";" and "#|") are more forgiving to encoding errors; they will STYLE-WARN and then attempt to resync the stream at a character boundary. (thanks to Teemu Kalvas)

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • Space, Tab, Linefeed, Return and Page have the invalid secondary constituent character trait.
    • SET-SYNTAX-FROM-CHAR correctly copies multiple-escape character syntax.
    • WITH-INPUT-FROM-STRING should only update the index place on normal termination.
    • Pretty-printing backquoted forms when *PRINT-CIRCLE* is true works more reliably.
    • Bit-array operations (BIT-AND and similar) worked incorrectly with one-dimensional arrays with fill pointers.
    • TYPE-OF failed on a complex with an integer realpart and a RATIO imagpart.
    • compiler failure during type inference for the code of form (IF (EQL X (THE ...)) ...) (MISC.535).

blocks.html_en: • new feature: reloading changed shared object files with LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT now causes the new definitions to take effect.

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • INCF, DECF and REMF evaluate their place form as specified in CLtS 5.1.3.
    • FORMATTER expands ~{ ~} iteration directives with V or # parameters correctly.
    • FORMATTER deals with the ~@[ ~] conditional directive where the consequent uses no arguments correctly.
    • the system has a partial understanding of the (COMPLEX RATIO) type specifier.
    • UPGRADED-COMPLEX-PART-TYPE obeys the lattice upgrading rules required.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: INCF, DECF and REMF evaluate their place form as specified in CLtS 5.1.3.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：INCF、DECF 和 REMF 按照 CLtS 5.1.3 中的指定评估其位置形式。

sentences.en: FORMATTER expands ~{ ~} iteration directives with V or # parameters correctly.
sentences.zh: FORMATTER 使用 V 或 # 参数正确扩展 ~{ ~} 迭代指令。

sentences.zh: FORMATTER 处理 ~@[ ~] 条件指令，其中后续指令未正确使用参数。

sentences.en: the system has a partial understanding of the (COMPLEX RATIO) type specifier.
sentences.zh: 系统对 (COMPLEX RATIO) 类型说明符有部分理解。

sentences.en: UPGRADED-COMPLEX-PART-TYPE obeys the lattice upgrading rules required.
sentences.zh: UPGRADED-COMPLEX-PART-TYPE 遵循所需的晶格升级规则。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: a build-time option (controlled by the :SB-UNICODE keyword feature, enabled by default) for building the system with support for the entire 21-bit character space defined by the Unicode consortium.

sentences.en: new feature: a build-time option (controlled by the :SB-UNICODE keyword feature, enabled by default) for building the system with support for the entire 21-bit character space defined by the Unicode consortium.
sentences.zh: 新功能：构建时选项（由 :SB-UNICODE 关键字功能控制，默认启用）用于构建支持 Unicode 联盟定义的整个 21 位字符空间的系统。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: the system now has rudimentary external-format support; the primary user-visible change at this time is that characters with the high bit set (such as lower-case-e-acute) will print correctly to a terminal in a UTF-8 environment.

sentences.en: new feature: the system now has rudimentary external-format support; the primary user-visible change at this time is that characters with the high bit set (such as lower-case-e-acute) will print correctly to a terminal in a UTF-8 environment.
sentences.zh: 新功能：系统现在具有基本的外部格式支持；此时用户可见的主要变化是设置了高位的字符（例如小写-e-acute）将在 UTF-8 环境中正确打印到终端。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: BASE-CHAR no longer names a class; however, CHARACTER continues to do so, as required by ANSI.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: BASE-CHAR no longer names a class; however, CHARACTER continues to do so, as required by ANSI.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：BASE-CHAR 不再命名类；然而，CHARACTER 按照 ANSI 的要求继续这样做。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SB-DEBUG:*DEBUG-PRINT-FOO* variables are no longer supported, and SB-DEBUG:*DEBUG-PRINT-VARIABLE-ALIST* has been moved to the SB-EXT package (temporarily re-exported from SB-DEBUG).

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SB-DEBUG:*DEBUG-PRINT-FOO* variables are no longer supported, and SB-DEBUG:*DEBUG-PRINT-VARIABLE-ALIST* has been moved to the SB-EXT package (temporarily re-exported from SB-DEBUG).
sentences.zh: 细微的不兼容更改：不再支持 SB-DEBUG:*DEBUG-PRINT-FOO* 变量，并且 SB-DEBUG:*DEBUG-PRINT-VARIABLE-ALIST* 已移至 SB-EXT 包（暂时从 SB-DEBUG 重新导出）。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SB-C::*COMPILER-ERROR-PRINT-FOO* variables are no longer supported: use SB-EXT:*COMPILER-PRINT-VARIABLE-ALIST* instead.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SB-C::*COMPILER-ERROR-PRINT-FOO* variables are no longer supported: use SB-EXT:*COMPILER-PRINT-VARIABLE-ALIST* instead.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：不再支持 SB-C::*COMPILER-ERROR-PRINT-FOO* 变量：使用 SB-EXT:*COMPILER-PRINT-VARIABLE-ALIST* 代替。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • RENAME-PACKAGE allows all package designators as new package names.
    • constraint propagation and lambda variable substitution are more cautious in dealing with partially deleted code.
    • compiler sometimes lost reoptimization passes.
    • CERROR, given a condition as condition designator, passes its remaining arguments to the continue format control without complaint.
    • Case-altering FORMAT directives work correctly on non-ASCII characters.
    • The REAL type specifier handles bounds outside the floating point ranges without signalling FLOATING-POINT-OVERFLOW.
    • Functions with IR1-transformations can create intercomponent references to global functions.
    • NIL parameter to the FORMAT directive ~^ means `unsupplied parameter'.
    • FORMAT ~R treats a nil value for its first parameter correctly.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: RENAME-PACKAGE allows all package designators as new package names.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：RENAME-PACKAGE 允许所有包指示符作为新包名称。

sentences.zh: REAL 类型说明符处理浮点范围之外的边界，而不发出 FLOATING-POINT-OVERFLOW 信号。

sentences.en: Functions with IR1-transformations can create intercomponent references to global functions.
sentences.zh: 具有 IR1 转换的函数可以创建对全局函数的组件间引用。

sentences.en: NIL parameter to the FORMAT directive ~^ means `unsupplied parameter'.
sentences.zh: FORMAT 指令的 NIL 参数 ~^ 表示“未提供的参数”。

sentences.en: FORMAT ~R treats a nil value for its first parameter correctly.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: division operators (MOD, TRUNCATE and the like) with constant zero divisors and integer dividends no longer generate left shifts.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: provide default methods for INPUT-STREAM-P and OUTPUT-STREAM-P specialized on SB-GRAY:FUNDAMENTAL-STREAM.

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: improve the detection and resolution of MOP metacycles (where effective method computation depends on the generic function having its effective method computed). (reported by Bruno Haible)

sentences.en: bug fix: improve the detection and resolution of MOP metacycles (where effective method computation depends on the generic function having its effective method computed).
sentences.zh: 错误修复：改进 MOP 元周期的检测和解析（其中有效方法计算取决于计算其有效方法的通用函数）。

sentences.en: (reported by Bruno Haible)
sentences.zh: （布鲁诺·海布尔报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: pass the right initargs to :BEFORE or :AFTER methods on SHARED-INITIALIZE or INITIALIZE-INSTANCE in optimized MAKE-INSTANCE constructors. (reported by Axel Schairer for cmucl)

sentences.en: bug fix: pass the right initargs to :BEFORE or :AFTER methods on SHARED-INITIALIZE or INITIALIZE-INSTANCE in optimized MAKE-INSTANCE constructors.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：将正确的 initargs 传递给优化的 MAKE-INSTANCE 构造函数中 SHARED-INITIALIZE 或 INITIALIZE-INSTANCE 上的 :BEFORE 或 :AFTER 方法。

sentences.en: (reported by Axel Schairer for cmucl)
sentences.zh: （Axel Schairer 为 cmucl 报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: pathnames with relative directory components can be represented relative to default pathnames.

sentences.en: bug fix: pathnames with relative directory components can be represented relative to default pathnames.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：具有相对目录组件的路径名可以相对于默认路径名表示。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: in taking the GCD of bignums, reduce the two bignums to approximately the same size (using Euclid's algorithm) before applying the more sophisticated binary GCD. (thanks to Juho Snellman)

sentences.en: optimization: in taking the GCD of bignums, reduce the two bignums to approximately the same size (using Euclid's algorithm) before applying the more sophisticated binary GCD.
sentences.zh: 优化：在采用 bignum 的 GCD 时，在应用更复杂的二进制 GCD 之前，将两个 bignum 减小到大致相同的大小（使用欧几里得算法）。

sentences.en: (thanks to Juho Snellman)
sentences.zh: （感谢尤霍·斯内尔曼）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: COUNT on bitvectors now operates word-at-a-time.

sentences.en: optimization: COUNT on bitvectors now operates word-at-a-time.
sentences.zh: 优化：位向量上的 COUNT 现在一次运行一个字。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: ASH with a positive, but not necessarily constant, (leftwards) shift, when in a modular context, is compiled to a hardware shift.

sentences.en: optimization: ASH with a positive, but not necessarily constant, (leftwards) shift, when in a modular context, is compiled to a hardware shift.
sentences.zh: 优化：在模块化上下文中，具有正向但不一定恒定（向左）移位的 ASH 被编译为硬件移位。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • FORMAT variable parameters ("~V<char>") are defaulted properly if the corresponding argument is NIL.
    • FORMAT directives accepting a minpad parameter treat negative values as 0.
    • literal commas as character parameters to FORMAT directives are parsed correctly.
    • literal spaces directly after ~<Newline> directives within a format-logical-block (~:< ~@:>) do not induce :FILL-style conditional newlines.
    • PRINT-UNREADABLE-OBJECT inserts spaces as specified (and only as specified: it no longer includes conditional newlines).
    • PRINC-TO-STRING binds *PRINT-READABLY* to NIL (as well as *PRINT-ESCAPE*).
    • PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK signals a TYPE-ERROR if its :PREFIX or :PER-LINE-PREFIX argument does not evaluate to a string.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: FORMAT variable parameters ("~V<char>") are defaulted properly if the corresponding argument is NIL.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 的测试套件揭示的一些错误：如果相应的参数为 NIL，则 FORMAT 变量参数（“~V<char>”）将被正确默认。

sentences.en: FORMAT directives accepting a minpad parameter treat negative values as 0.
sentences.zh: 接受 minpad 参数的 FORMAT 指令将负值视为 0。

sentences.en: literal commas as character parameters to FORMAT directives are parsed correctly.
sentences.zh: 作为 FORMAT 指令的字符参数的文字逗号可以正确解析。

sentences.en: literal spaces directly after ~<Newline> directives within a format-logical-block (~:< ~@:>) do not induce :FILL-style conditional newlines.
sentences.zh: 格式逻辑块中 ~<Newline> 指令后面的文字空格 (~:< ~@:>) 不会引发 :FILL 样式的条件换行符。

sentences.en: PRINT-UNREADABLE-OBJECT inserts spaces as specified (and only as specified: it no longer includes conditional newlines).
sentences.zh: PRINT-UNREADABLE-OBJECT 按指定插入空格（并且仅按指定插入：它不再包含条件换行符）。

sentences.en: PRINC-TO-STRING binds *PRINT-READABLY* to NIL (as well as *PRINT-ESCAPE*).
sentences.zh: PRINC-TO-STRING 将 *PRINT-READABLY* 绑定到 NIL（以及 *PRINT-ESCAPE*）。

sentences.en: PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK signals a TYPE-ERROR if its :PREFIX or :PER-LINE-PREFIX argument does not evaluate to a string.
sentences.zh: 如果 PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK 的 :PREFIX 或 :PER-LINE-PREFIX 参数计算结果不是字符串，则会发出 TYPE-ERROR 信号。

blocks.html_en: • FORMAT variable parameters ("~V<char>") are defaulted properly if the corresponding argument is NIL.

sentences.en: FORMAT variable parameters ("~V<char>") are defaulted properly if the corresponding argument is NIL.
sentences.zh: 如果相应的参数为 NIL，则 FORMAT 变量参数（“~V<char>”）将被正确默认。

blocks.html_en: • FORMAT directives accepting a minpad parameter treat negative values as 0.

sentences.en: FORMAT directives accepting a minpad parameter treat negative values as 0.
sentences.zh: 接受 minpad 参数的 FORMAT 指令将负值视为 0。

sentences.en: literal commas as character parameters to FORMAT directives are parsed correctly.
sentences.zh: 作为 FORMAT 指令的字符参数的文字逗号可以正确解析。

blocks.html_en: • literal spaces directly after ~<Newline> directives within a format-logical-block (~:< ~@:>) do not induce :FILL-style conditional newlines.

sentences.en: literal spaces directly after ~<Newline> directives within a format-logical-block (~:< ~@:>) do not induce :FILL-style conditional newlines.
sentences.zh: 格式逻辑块中 ~<Newline> 指令后面的文字空格 (~:< ~@:>) 不会引发 :FILL 样式的条件换行符。

blocks.html_en: • PRINT-UNREADABLE-OBJECT inserts spaces as specified (and only as specified: it no longer includes conditional newlines).

sentences.en: PRINT-UNREADABLE-OBJECT inserts spaces as specified (and only as specified: it no longer includes conditional newlines).
sentences.zh: PRINT-UNREADABLE-OBJECT 按指定插入空格（并且仅按指定插入：它不再包含条件换行符）。

blocks.html_en: • PRINC-TO-STRING binds *PRINT-READABLY* to NIL (as well as *PRINT-ESCAPE*).

sentences.en: PRINC-TO-STRING binds *PRINT-READABLY* to NIL (as well as *PRINT-ESCAPE*).
sentences.zh: PRINC-TO-STRING 将 *PRINT-READABLY* 绑定到 NIL（以及 *PRINT-ESCAPE*）。

blocks.html_en: • PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK signals a TYPE-ERROR if its :PREFIX or :PER-LINE-PREFIX argument does not evaluate to a string.

sentences.en: PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK signals a TYPE-ERROR if its :PREFIX or :PER-LINE-PREFIX argument does not evaluate to a string.

blocks.html_en: • new feature: SB-PACKAGE-LOCKS. See the "Package Locks" section of the manual for details; for now, package locks can be disabled by removing :SB-PACKAGE-LOCKS in customize-target-features.lisp, but if no major problems are found then it is likely that they will be compiled in unconditionally.

sentences.en: new feature: SB-PACKAGE-LOCKS.
sentences.zh: 新功能：SB-PACKAGE-LOCKS。

sentences.en: See the "Package Locks" section of the manual for details; for now, package locks can be disabled by removing :SB-PACKAGE-LOCKS in customize-target-features.lisp, but if no major problems are found then it is likely that they will be compiled in unconditionally.
sentences.zh: 详细信息请参见手册的“包锁”部分；目前，可以通过删除customize-target-features.lisp中的:SB-PACKAGE-LOCKS来禁用包锁，但如果没有发现重大问题，那么它们很可能会被无条件编译。

blocks.html_en: • major incompatible change: LOAD-FOREIGN and LOAD-1-FOREIGN are now unsupported operators on all platforms. To load a shared library into SBCL, use SB-ALIEN:LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT. To load a non-shared object file, link it into a shared library outside of SBCL and load it using SB-ALIEN:LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT. (incidentally fixes bug #79)

sentences.en: major incompatible change: LOAD-FOREIGN and LOAD-1-FOREIGN are now unsupported operators on all platforms.
sentences.zh: 主要不兼容更改：LOAD-FOREIGN 和 LOAD-1-FOREIGN 现在在所有平台上均不受支持。

sentences.en: To load a shared library into SBCL, use SB-ALIEN:LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT.
sentences.zh: 要将共享库加载到 SBCL 中，请使用 SB-ALIEN:LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT。

sentences.en: To load a non-shared object file, link it into a shared library outside of SBCL and load it using SB-ALIEN:LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT.
sentences.zh: 要加载非共享对象文件，请将其链接到 SBCL 外部的共享库并使用 SB-ALIEN:LOAD-SHARED-OBJECT 加载它。

sentences.en: (incidentally fixes bug #79)
sentences.zh: （顺便修复了错误#79）

blocks.html_en: • bug workaround: ROOM T and the GC were not working together reliably, because invariants expected by the SB!VM:INSTANCE-USAGE reporting facility aren't preserved. That reporting has been disabled, so now until and unless someone figures out how to make it work reliably with the current GC, (ROOM T) is equivalent to (ROOM).

sentences.en: bug workaround: ROOM T and the GC were not working together reliably, because invariants expected by the SB!VM:INSTANCE-USAGE reporting facility aren't preserved.
sentences.zh: bug 解决方法：ROOM T 和 GC 无法可靠地协同工作，因为未保留 SB!VM:INSTANCE-USAGE 报告工具预期的不变量。

sentences.en: That reporting has been disabled, so now until and unless someone figures out how to make it work reliably with the current GC, (ROOM T) is equivalent to (ROOM).
sentences.zh: 该报告已被禁用，所以现在直到并且除非有人弄清楚如何使其与当前 GC 可靠地工作，（ROOM T）相当于（ROOM）。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: as threatened around sbcl-0.8.0, the home package of MOP-related symbols is now SB-MOP, not SB-PCL. The symbols are also exported from SB-PCL for backwards compatibility, but more so than before SB-PCL should be treated as an implementation-internal package.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: as threatened around sbcl-0.8.0, the home package of MOP-related symbols is now SB-MOP, not SB-PCL.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：由于 sbcl-0.8.0 周围的威胁，MOP 相关符号的主包现在是 SB-MOP，而不是 SB-PCL。

sentences.en: The symbols are also exported from SB-PCL for backwards compatibility, but more so than before SB-PCL should be treated as an implementation-internal package.
sentences.zh: 这些符号也从 SB-PCL 导出以实现向后兼容性，但比以前更应该将 SB-PCL 视为实现内部包。

blocks.html_en: • fasl format changed: SBCL 0.8.13 fasls are incompatible with those of earlier versions

sentences.en: fasl format changed: SBCL 0.8.13 fasls are incompatible with those of earlier versions
sentences.zh: fasl 格式已更改：SBCL 0.8.13 fasls 与早期版本不兼容

blocks.html_en: • the SB-SPROF contrib now works on (most) non-x86 architectures. It is known as of this release not to work on the Alpha, however.

sentences.en: the SB-SPROF contrib now works on (most) non-x86 architectures.
sentences.zh: SB-SPROF contrib 现在适用于（大多数）非 x86 架构。

sentences.en: It is known as of this release not to work on the Alpha, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，众所周知，此版本不适用于 Alpha。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #167: errors signalled due to illegal syntax in method bodies are now more legible.

sentences.en: fixed bug #167: errors signalled due to illegal syntax in method bodies are now more legible.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #167：由于方法体中的非法语法而发出的错误现在更加清晰。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #338: instances of EQL-SPECIFIER are now valid type designators and can hence be used with TYPEP.

sentences.en: fixed bug #338: instances of EQL-SPECIFIER are now valid type designators and can hence be used with TYPEP.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #338：EQL-SPECIFIER 的实例现在是有效的类型指示符，因此可以与 TYPEP 一起使用。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #333: CHECK-TYPE now ensures that the type error signalled, if any, has the right object to be accessed by TYPE-ERROR-DATUM. (reported by Tony Martinez)

sentences.en: fixed bug #333: CHECK-TYPE now ensures that the type error signalled, if any, has the right object to be accessed by TYPE-ERROR-DATUM.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #333：CHECK-TYPE 现在可确保发出信号的类型错误（如果有）具有可供 TYPE-ERROR-DATUM 访问的正确对象。

sentences.en: (reported by Tony Martinez)
sentences.zh: （托尼·马丁内斯报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #340: SETF of VALUES obeys the specification in ANSI 5.1.2.3 for multiple-value place subforms. (reported by Kalle Olavi Niemetalo)

sentences.en: fixed bug #340: SETF of VALUES obeys the specification in ANSI 5.1.2.3 for multiple-value place subforms.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #340：VALUES 的 SETF 遵循 ANSI 5.1.2.3 中多值位置子形​​式的规范。

sentences.en: (reported by Kalle Olavi Niemetalo)
sentences.zh: （卡勒·奥拉维·涅梅塔洛报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #334: programmatic addition of slots using specialized methods on SB-MOP:COMPUTE-SLOTS works for :ALLOCATION :INSTANCE and :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots.

sentences.en: fixed bug #334: programmatic addition of slots using specialized methods on SB-MOP:COMPUTE-SLOTS works for :ALLOCATION :INSTANCE and :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #334：在 SB-MOP:COMPUTE-SLOTS 上使用专门方法以编程方式添加插槽适用于 :ALLOCATION :INSTANCE 和 :ALLOCATION :CLASS 插槽。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug #269: SCALE-FLOAT scales floats by any integer, not just float exponents. (rereported by Peter Seibel)

sentences.en: fixed bug #269: SCALE-FLOAT scales floats by any integer, not just float exponents.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 #269：SCALE-FLOAT 按任意整数缩放浮点，而不仅仅是浮点指数。

sentences.en: (rereported by Peter Seibel)
sentences.zh: （彼得·塞贝尔报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed a bug: #\Space (and other whitespace characters) are no longer considered to be macro characters in standard syntax by GET-MACRO-CHARACTER.

sentences.en: fixed a bug: #\Space (and other whitespace characters) are no longer considered to be macro characters in standard syntax by GET-MACRO-CHARACTER.
sentences.zh: 修复了一个错误：#\Space（和其他空白字符）不再被 GET-MACRO-CHARACTER 视为标准语法中的宏字符。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: initialization of condition class metaobjects no longer causes an instance of the condition to be created. (reported by Marco Baringer)

sentences.en: fixed bug: initialization of condition class metaobjects no longer causes an instance of the condition to be created.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：条件类元对象的初始化不再导致创建条件实例。

sentences.en: (reported by Marco Baringer)
sentences.zh: （马可·巴林格报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: it is now possible to have slots such that SB-MOP:SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION of the effective slot description is neither :INSTANCE nor :CLASS.

sentences.en: fixed bug: it is now possible to have slots such that SB-MOP:SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION of the effective slot description is neither :INSTANCE nor :CLASS.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：现在可以有这样的插槽，即有效插槽描述的 SB-MOP:SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION 既不是 :INSTANCE 也不是 :CLASS。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: the ctor optimization of MAKE-INSTANCE now respects user-defined methods on SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS and (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS), and no longer causes errors with non-standard SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION values.

sentences.en: fixed bug: the ctor optimization of MAKE-INSTANCE now respects user-defined methods on SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS and (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS), and no longer causes errors with non-standard SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION values.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：MAKE-INSTANCE 的构造器优化现在尊重 SLOT-BOUNDP-USING-CLASS 和 (SETF SLOT-VALUE-USING-CLASS) 上的用户定义方法，并且不再导致非标准 SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION 值的错误。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bugs: various race conditions handling exiting threads. CL-PPCRE's thread torture test now passes.

sentences.en: fixed bugs: various race conditions handling exiting threads.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：处理退出线程的各种竞争条件。

sentences.en: CL-PPCRE's thread torture test now passes.
sentences.zh: CL-PPCRE 的线程折磨测试现已通过。

blocks.html_en: • fixed arguably-a-bug: GC time proportional to number of threads in system even when most of them are idle

sentences.en: fixed arguably-a-bug: GC time proportional to number of threads in system even when most of them are idle
sentences.zh: 修复了一个可能存在的错误：GC 时间与系统中的线程数量成正比，即使大多数线程处于空闲状态

blocks.html_en: • optimization: improved performance of BIT and SBIT on bit-vectors.

sentences.en: optimization: improved performance of BIT and SBIT on bit-vectors.
sentences.zh: 优化：改进了 BIT 和 SBIT 在位向量上的性能。

blocks.html_en: • .fasl file incompatibility: The fasl file version number has been incremented because of changes associated with package locks.

sentences.en: .fasl file incompatibility: The fasl file version number has been incremented because of changes associated with package locks.
sentences.zh: .fasl 文件不兼容：由于与程序包锁定相关的更改，fasl 文件版本号已增加。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the system no longer provides optimization hints (conditions which are TYPEP SB-EXT:COMPILER-NOTE) for conforming code in default compilation mode; these hints are still emitted when higher SPEED optimization is requested.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the system no longer provides optimization hints (conditions which are TYPEP SB-EXT:COMPILER-NOTE) for conforming code in default compilation mode; these hints are still emitted when higher SPEED optimization is requested.

sentences.en: new contrib module: a sampling profiler (profiling by statistical sampling, rather than by instrumenting functions) is available as the SB-SPROF contrib.

sentences.en: fixed bug 276: mutating a binding of a specialized parameter to a method to something that is not TYPEP the specializer is now possible.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 276：现在可以将专用参数与方法的绑定更改为非 TYPEP 专用器。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bugs 45d and 118: DOUBLE-FLOAT[-NEGATIVE]-EPSILON now exhibit the required behaviour on the x86 platform. (thanks to Peter van Eynde, Eric Marsden and Bruno Haible)

sentences.en: fixed bugs 45d and 118: DOUBLE-FLOAT[-NEGATIVE]-EPSILON now exhibit the required behaviour on the x86 platform.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 45d 和 118：DOUBLE-FLOAT[-NEGATIVE]-EPSILON 现在在 x86 平台上表现出所需的行为。

sentences.en: (thanks to Peter van Eynde, Eric Marsden and Bruno Haible)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Peter van Eynde、Eric Marsden 和 Bruno Haible）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 335: ATANH now computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent even for difficult arguments. (reported by Peter Graves)

sentences.en: fixed bug 335: ATANH now computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent even for difficult arguments.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 335：ATANH 现在即使对于困难的参数也可以计算反双曲正切。

sentences.en: (reported by Peter Graves)
sentences.zh: （彼得·格雷夫斯报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 141a: the backquote printer now descends quoted structure.

sentences.en: fixed bug 141a: the backquote printer now descends quoted structure.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 141a：反引号打印机现在降序引用结构。

blocks.html_en: • fixed another bug in backquote printing: no more destructive modification of the form's list structure. (reported by Brian Downing)

sentences.en: fixed another bug in backquote printing: no more destructive modification of the form's list structure.

sentences.en: (reported by Brian Downing)
sentences.zh: （布莱恩·唐宁报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug in INTERRUPT-THREAD: pin the function, so that it cannot move between its address being taken and the call to interrupt_thread, fixing a crashing race condition.

sentences.en: fixed bug in INTERRUPT-THREAD: pin the function, so that it cannot move between its address being taken and the call to interrupt_thread, fixing a crashing race condition.
sentences.zh: 修复了 INTERRUPT-THREAD 中的错误：固定该函数，以便它无法在所获取的地址和对 Interrupt_thread 的调用之间移动，从而修复了崩溃的竞争条件。

blocks.html_en: • the SB-POSIX contrib implementation has been adjusted so that it no longer exhibits ridiculously poor performance when constructing instances corresponding to C structs.

sentences.en: the SB-POSIX contrib implementation has been adjusted so that it no longer exhibits ridiculously poor performance when constructing instances corresponding to C structs.
sentences.zh: SB-POSIX contrib 实现已经过调整，因此在构造与 C 结构相对应的实例时，它不再表现出极其糟糕的性能。

sentences.en: New in version 0.8.11, 2004-06-07

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the sb-grovel contrib now treats C structures as alien (in the sense of SB-ALIEN) objects rather than as undistinguished (simple-array (unsigned-byte 8) (*))s. This has implications for memory management of client code (sb-grovel-returned objects must now be manually managed) and for type safety (alien objects now have full types).

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the sb-grovel contrib now treats C structures as alien (in the sense of SB-ALIEN) objects rather than as undistinguished (simple-array (unsigned-byte 8) (*))s.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：sb-grovel contrib 现在将 C 结构视为外来对象（在 SB-ALIEN 的意义上），而不是无区别的（简单数组（无符号字节 8）(*)）。

sentences.en: This has implications for memory management of client code (sb-grovel-returned objects must now be manually managed) and for type safety (alien objects now have full types).
sentences.zh: 这对客户端代码的内存管理（sb-grovel 返回的对象现在必须手动管理）和类型安全（外​​来对象现在具有完整类型）有影响。

blocks.html_en: • new feature: the SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS declaration should be used to control emission of compiler diagnostics, rather than the SB-EXT:INHIBIT-WARNINGS OPTIMIZE quality. See the manual for documentation on this feature. The SB-EXT:INHIBIT-WARNINGS quality should be considered deprecated.

sentences.en: new feature: the SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS declaration should be used to control emission of compiler diagnostics, rather than the SB-EXT:INHIBIT-WARNINGS OPTIMIZE quality.
sentences.zh: 新功能：应使用 SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS 声明来控制编译器诊断的发出，而不是 SB-EXT:INHIBIT-WARNINGS OPTIMIZE 质量。

sentences.en: See the manual for documentation on this feature.
sentences.zh: 有关此功能的文档，请参阅手册。

sentences.en: The SB-EXT:INHIBIT-WARNINGS quality should be considered deprecated.
sentences.zh: SB-EXT:INHIBIT-WARNINGS 质量应被视为已弃用。

blocks.html_en: • install.sh now installs the user manual as well

sentences.en: install.sh now installs the user manual as well
sentences.zh: install.sh 现在也安装用户手册

blocks.html_en: • (not quite a new documentable feature, but worth considering in the light of the new SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS declaration): the beginnings of a semantically meaningful condition hierarchy is under development, for use in SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS and by IDEs.

sentences.en: (not quite a new documentable feature, but worth considering in the light of the new SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS declaration): the beginnings of a semantically meaningful condition hierarchy is under development, for use in SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS and by IDEs.
sentences.zh: （不是一个新的可记录功能，但根据新的 SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS 声明值得考虑）：语义上有意义的条件层次结构的开始正在开发中，供 SB-EXT:MUFFLE-CONDITIONS 和 IDE 使用。

sentences.en: fixed bug: CLOSE :ABORT T on appending stream no longer causes file deletion.

sentences.en: fixed bug: Invalid slot specification errors now print correctly.

sentences.en: (thanks to Zach Beane)

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 320: Shared to local slot value transfers in class redefinitions now happen corrently from superclasses as well. (reported by Bruno Haible)

sentences.en: fixed bug 320: Shared to local slot value transfers in class redefinitions now happen corrently from superclasses as well.

sentences.en: fixed bug 307: The obsolete instance protocol ensures that subclasses are properly obsoleted.

sentences.en: fixed bug: as reported by Kalle Olavi Niemitalo on #lisp IRC, don't warn on legal loop code involving more than one aggregate boolean.

sentences.en: (thanks to Nikodemus Siivola)

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: as reported by Peter Graves on #lisp IRC, passing a NIL in keyword position to MAKE-PACKAGE was not being reported as invalid.

sentences.en: fixed bug: as reported by Peter Graves on #lisp IRC, passing a NIL in keyword position to MAKE-PACKAGE was not being reported as invalid.

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: as reported by Juan Ripoll on cmucl-imp, MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND should be able to lexically bind lambda list keywords.

sentences.en: fixed bug: as reported by Juan Ripoll on cmucl-imp, MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND should be able to lexically bind lambda list keywords.

sentences.en: fixed bugs 280 and 312: the checking for multiple definitions in a file is less likely to become confused by uses of inline functions.

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: the #S reader macro performs the keyword coercion specified for slot names. (reported by Kalle Niemitalo)

sentences.en: fixed bug: the #S reader macro performs the keyword coercion specified for slot names.

sentences.en: fixed bug: lambda lists may contain symbols whose names start with & but are not lambda-list-keywords; their occurrence triggers a STYLE-WARNING.
sentences.zh: 修复错误：lambda 列表可能包含名称以 & 开头但不是 lambda-list-keywords 的符号；它们的出现会触发样式警告。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 321: define-method-combination argument lambda lists do not cause invalid code to be generated when &optional or &aux variables have default values. (reported by Bruno Haible)

sentences.en: fixed bug 321: define-method-combination argument lambda lists do not cause invalid code to be generated when &optional or &aux variables have default values.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 321：当 &Optional 或 &aux 变量具有默认值时，定义方法组合参数 lambda 列表不会导致生成无效代码。

sentences.en: (reported by Bruno Haible)
sentences.zh: （布鲁诺·海布尔报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 327: system subclasses of STRUCTURE-OBJECT or CONDITION have CLOS classes; this appears also to have fixed reported instability in stack exhaustion detection.

sentences.en: fixed bug 327: system subclasses of STRUCTURE-OBJECT or CONDITION have CLOS classes; this appears also to have fixed reported instability in stack exhaustion detection.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 327：STRUCTURE-OBJECT 或 CONDITION 的系统子类具有 CLOS 类；这似乎还修复了堆栈耗尽检测中报告的不稳定问题。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: the CONTROL-ERROR from ABORT, CONTINUE and MUFFLE-WARNING when no associated restart is present is now printable.

sentences.en: fixed bug: the CONTROL-ERROR from ABORT, CONTINUE and MUFFLE-WARNING when no associated restart is present is now printable.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：当不存在关联的重新启动时，来自 ABORT、CONTINUE 和 MUFFLE-WARNING 的 CONTROL-ERROR 现在可以打印。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: rearranged the expansion of various defining macros so that each expands into only one top-level form in a :LOAD-TOPLEVEL context; this appears to decrease fasl sizes by approximately 10%.

sentences.en: optimization: rearranged the expansion of various defining macros so that each expands into only one top-level form in a :LOAD-TOPLEVEL context; this appears to decrease fasl sizes by approximately 10%.
sentences.zh: 优化：重新安排了各种定义宏的扩展，以便每个宏在 :LOAD-TOPLEVEL 上下文中仅扩展为一种顶级形式；这似乎使 fasl 大小减少了大约 10%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: used a previously little-used slot in symbols to cache SXHASH values, yielding a 5-10% compiler speedup. (thanks to Juho Snellman)

sentences.en: optimization: used a previously little-used slot in symbols to cache SXHASH values, yielding a 5-10% compiler speedup.
sentences.zh: 优化：使用符号中以前很少使用的槽来缓存 SXHASH 值，从而使编译器加速 5-10%。

sentences.en: (thanks to Juho Snellman)
sentences.zh: （感谢尤霍·斯内尔曼）

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • MAKE-INSTANCES-OBSOLETE returns the class name when called with a symbol.
    • Fixed an optimization bug related to inheritance of initforms from local to shared slots.
    • FILE-POSITION works as specified on BROADCAST-STREAMs.
    • CAST optimizer forgot to flush argument derived type.
    • print/read consistency on floats is now orders of magnitude more likely. (thanks also to Bruno Haible for a similar report and discussions)
    • removed stack cleaning in the cleanup part of UNWIND-PROTECT.
    • IMAGPART is specified (infelicitously) to return (* 0 <thing>) for objects of type REAL. Make it so.
    • SXHASH is specified (infelicitously) to respect similarity, which means that (SXHASH 0.0) must equal (SXHASH -0.0). Make it so. (thanks to Markus Ziegler)
    • on the Alpha, the compiler succeeds in compiling functions returning a known number of arguments greater than 63.
    • fixed handling of invalid NIL arguments in keyword position in local calls.
    • fixed non-pretty printing of arrays with *PRINT-RADIX* being true.
    • provided a readably-printable representation for RANDOM-STATE objects.
    • ensured that pathnames, where they have a namestring, always print using #P"..." syntax.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: MAKE-INSTANCES-OBSOLETE returns the class name when called with a symbol.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 的测试套件揭示的一些错误：MAKE-INSTANCES-OBSOLETE 在使用符号调用时返回类名。

sentences.en: Fixed an optimization bug related to inheritance of initforms from local to shared slots.
sentences.zh: 修复了与 initform 从本地继承到共享插槽相关的优化错误。

sentences.en: FILE-POSITION works as specified on BROADCAST-STREAMs.
sentences.zh: 文件位置按照广播流上指定的方式工作。

sentences.en: CAST optimizer forgot to flush argument derived type.
sentences.zh: CAST 优化器忘记刷新参数派生类型。

sentences.en: print/read consistency on floats is now orders of magnitude more likely.
sentences.zh: 浮点上的打印/读取一致性现在更有可能提高几个数量级。

sentences.en: (thanks also to Bruno Haible for a similar report and discussions) removed stack cleaning in the cleanup part of UNWIND-PROTECT.
sentences.zh: （也感谢 Bruno Haible 的类似报告和讨论）在 UNWIND-PROTECT 的清理部分中删除了堆栈清理。

sentences.en: IMAGPART is specified (infelicitously) to return (* 0 <thing>) for objects of type REAL.
sentences.zh: IMAGPART 被指定（不恰当地）为 REAL 类型的对象返回 (* 0 <thing>)。

sentences.en: Make it so.
sentences.zh: 就这样吧。

sentences.en: SXHASH is specified (infelicitously) to respect similarity, which means that (SXHASH 0.0) must equal (SXHASH -0.0).
sentences.zh: SXHASH 被指定（不恰当地）以尊重相似性，这意味着 (SXHASH 0.0) 必须等于 (SXHASH -0.0)。

sentences.en: Make it so.
sentences.zh: 就这样吧。

sentences.en: (thanks to Markus Ziegler) on the Alpha, the compiler succeeds in compiling functions returning a known number of arguments greater than 63.
sentences.zh: （感谢 Markus Ziegler）在 Alpha 上，编译器成功编译了返回已知数量大于 63 的参数的函数。

sentences.en: fixed handling of invalid NIL arguments in keyword position in local calls.
sentences.zh: 修复了本地调用中关键字位置中无效 NIL 参数的处理。

sentences.en: fixed non-pretty printing of arrays with *PRINT-RADIX* being true.
sentences.zh: 修复了 *PRINT-RADIX* 为 true 时数组打印不美观的问题。

sentences.en: provided a readably-printable representation for RANDOM-STATE objects.
sentences.zh: 为随机状态对象提供了可读可打印的表示。

sentences.en: ensured that pathnames, where they have a namestring, always print using #P"..."
sentences.zh: 确保路径名（其中有名称字符串）始终使用 #P"..." 打印

sentences.en: syntax.
sentences.zh: 句法。

sentences.en: (thanks also to Bruno Haible for a similar report and discussions)

sentences.en: IMAGPART is specified (infelicitously) to return (* 0 <thing>) for objects of type REAL.
sentences.zh: IMAGPART 被指定（不恰当地）为 REAL 类型的对象返回 (* 0 <thing>)。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • ADJUST-ARRAY now copies the datum in a zero rank array if required.
    • ADJUST-ARRAY no longer adjusts non-adjustable arrays.
    • MAKE-STRING-INPUT-STREAM accepts NIL as a value for :END.
    • MAKE-STRING-INPUT-STREAM functions correctly for strings with element-type NIL.
    • CLEAR-INPUT accepts NIL and T for its (optional) stream argument.
    • Ratios can now be printed correctly with *PRINT-BASE* bound to 2, 8 or 16.
    • ECHO-STREAMs no longer attempt to echo the end of file value to their output stream on EOF from read.
    • CONCATENATED-STREAM-STREAMS discards constituent streams which have been read to end-of-file.
    • CLOSE works as expected on the null CONCATENATED-STREAM, and on STRING-STREAMS.
    • Printing symbols with *PRINT-CASE* :CAPITALIZE respects the description of determination of which consecutive characters constitute a word.
    • Printing the "Space" character with escaping on now yields "#\\ ", rather than "#\\Space", as mandated by ANSI 22.1.3.2.
    • Reading floating-point numbers with *READ-BASE* set to a number less than 10 works correctly.
    • Reading floating-point numbers with *READ-BASE* set to a number more than 10 works correctly.
    • Printing with *PRINT-READABLY* targets the standard readtable, not the readtable currently in effect.

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: parsing of namestrings on a physical (Unix) host has changed; numbers after the final #\. in a namestring are no longer interpreted as a version field. This is intented to be largely invisible to the user, except that the meaning of the namestring "*.*.*" has changed: it now refers to a pathname with :TYPE :WILD :NAME #<pattern "*.*">. This namestring should usually be replaced by (make-pathname :name :wild :type :wild :version :wild) with the added benefit that this is more likely to be portable. As a consequence of this change, the :IF-EXISTS :NEW-VERSION option to OPEN now signals an error if the file being opened exists; this may have an impact on existing code.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: parsing of namestrings on a physical (Unix) host has changed; numbers after the final #\.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：物理（Unix）主机上名称字符串的解析已更改；最后#\ 后面的数字。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • in stack analysis liveness information is propagated from non-local entry points.
    • pathwise CAST removing failed when the CAST node did not start a block.
    • INPUT-STREAM-P, OUTPUT-STREAM-P, STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE and OPEN-STREAM-P signal a TYPE-ERROR if their argument is not a stream.
    • LOAD-LOGICAL-PATHNAME-TRANSLATIONS returns NIL if the logical host is already defined.
    • RENAME-FILE works on streams instead of signalling an internal type error.
    • PEEK-CHAR uses the current readtable when determining whether or not a character is whitespace.
    • MERGE-PATHNAMES handles the case when the pathname does not specify a name while the default-pathname specifies a version.
    • Pathnames now stand a better chance of respecting print/read consistency.
    • Attempting to use standardized file system operators with a pathname with invalid :DIRECTORY components signals a FILE-ERROR.
    • OPEN :DIRECTION :IO no longer fails to work on non-existent files.
    • DIRECTORY on logical pathnames is more correct.
    • CLEAR-INPUT, CLEAR-OUTPUT, FINISH-OUTPUT and FORCE-OUTPUT signal a TYPE-ERROR if their argument is not a stream.
    • READ-BYTE and WRITE-BYTE signal a TYPE-ERROR if their stream designator argument does not designate a stream.
    • OPEN-STREAM-P and INPUT-STREAM-P on synonym streams work by examining the synonym.
    • STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE and FRESH-LINE on broadcast-streams now work as specified.
    • OPEN and WITH-OPEN-STREAM allow opening streams with element-type larger than ([UN]SIGNED-BYTE 32).

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: in stack analysis liveness information is propagated from non-local entry points.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：在堆栈分析中，活动信息是从非本地入口点传播的。

sentences.en: pathwise CAST removing failed when the CAST node did not start a block.
sentences.zh: 当 CAST 节点未启动块时，路径 CAST 删除失败。

sentences.en: INPUT-STREAM-P, OUTPUT-STREAM-P, STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE and OPEN-STREAM-P signal a TYPE-ERROR if their argument is not a stream.
sentences.zh: 如果 INPUT-STREAM-P、OUTPUT-STREAM-P、STREAM-ELEMENT-TYPE 和 OPEN-STREAM-P 的参数不是流，则它们会发出 TYPE-ERROR 信号。

sentences.en: LOAD-LOGICAL-PATHNAME-TRANSLATIONS returns NIL if the logical host is already defined.
sentences.zh: 如果逻辑主机已定义，则 LOAD-LOGICAL-PATHNAME-TRANSLATIONS 返回 NIL。

sentences.en: RENAME-FILE works on streams instead of signalling an internal type error.
sentences.zh: RENAME-FILE 适用于流，而不是发出内部类型错误信号。

sentences.en: PEEK-CHAR uses the current readtable when determining whether or not a character is whitespace.
sentences.zh: PEEK-CHAR 在确定字符是否为空格时使用当前的可读表。

sentences.en: MERGE-PATHNAMES handles the case when the pathname does not specify a name while the default-pathname specifies a version.
sentences.zh: MERGE-PATHNAMES 处理路径名未指定名称而默认路径名指定版本的情况。

sentences.en: Pathnames now stand a better chance of respecting print/read consistency.
sentences.zh: 路径名现在更有可能尊重打印/读取的一致性。

sentences.en: Attempting to use standardized file system operators with a pathname with invalid :DIRECTORY components signals a FILE-ERROR.
sentences.zh: 尝试使用带有无效 :DIRECTORY 组件的路径名的标准化文件系统运算符会发出文件错误信号。

sentences.zh: OPEN :DIRECTION :IO 不再无法处理不存在的文件。

sentences.zh: 逻辑路径名上的 DIRECTORY 更正确。

sentences.zh: 如果 READ-BYTE 和 WRITE-BYTE 的流指示符参数未指定流，则会发出类型错误信号。

sentences.en: OPEN-STREAM-P and INPUT-STREAM-P on synonym streams work by examining the synonym.
sentences.zh: 同义词流上的 OPEN-STREAM-P 和 INPUT-STREAM-P 通过检查同义词来工作。

sentences.zh: OPEN 和WITH-OPEN-STREAM 允许打开元素类型大于([UN]SIGNED-BYTE 32) 的流。

sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，HANDLER-CASE 无法接受处理程序子句中的声明。

blocks.html_en: • New code in contrib/sb-introspect (still probably not entirely stable yet) provides some support for smart Lisp development environments like SLIME.

blocks.html_en: • The conditions signalled for errors occurring when loading .fasl files have been systematized (inheriting from SB-EXT:INVALID-FASL) in a way which should help ASDF recover gracefully.

blocks.html_en: • The REQUIRE/PROVIDE behavior of *MODULE-PROVIDER-FUNCTIONS* stuff has been cleaned up. If you code contrib/ stuff, this might affect you, and you can look at contrib/README, contrib/STANDARDS, and/or the 0.8.4.27 diff to check.

blocks.html_en: • In full calls the compiler now does not generate checks for declared argument types for all arguments.

sentences.en: In full calls the compiler now does not generate checks for declared argument types for all arguments.
sentences.zh: 在完整调用中，编译器现在不会对所有参数的声明参数类型生成检查。

blocks.html_en:
• various threading fixes
    • and some experimental patches which didn't make it into the main tree for this release, but which are shipped in contrib/experimental-thread.patch as a possible fix for some failures (deadlock, spinning...) in GC-intensive multithreaded applications.

sentences.en: various threading fixes and some experimental patches which didn't make it into the main tree for this release, but which are shipped in contrib/experimental-thread.patch as a possible fix for some failures (deadlock, spinning...)

blocks.html_en: • fixed PPC build problem (source code incompatibility of different library versions): added offsetof() hackery which attempts to divine where glibc maintainers put uc_mcontext today

sentences.en: fixed PPC build problem (source code incompatibility of different library versions): added offsetof() hackery which attempts to divine where glibc maintainers put uc_mcontext today
sentences.zh: 修复了 PPC 构建问题（不同库版本的源代码不兼容）：添加了 offsetof() 黑客行为，试图推测 glibc 维护者今天将 uc_mcontext 放在哪里

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 282: compiler does not trust type assertions while passing arguments to a full call.

sentences.en: fixed bug 282: compiler does not trust type assertions while passing arguments to a full call.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 282：编译器在将参数传递给完整调用时不信任类型断言。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 261: compiler allows NIL or "no value" to be accepted for &OPTIONAL VALUES type parameter.

sentences.en: fixed bug 261: compiler allows NIL or "no value" to be accepted for &OPTIONAL VALUES type parameter.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 261：编译器允许 &OPTIONAL VALUES 类型参数接受 NIL 或“无值”。

blocks.html_en: • fix bug 214: algorithm for noting rejected templates is now more similar to that of template seletion. (also reported by rydis on #lisp)

sentences.en: fix bug 214: algorithm for noting rejected templates is now more similar to that of template seletion.
sentences.zh: 修复错误 214：用于标记被拒绝模板的算法现在与模板选择的算法更加相似。

sentences.en: (also reported by rydis on #lisp)

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 141b: printing backquoted information readably and prettily inserts a space where necessary.

sentences.zh: 修复了错误 141b：以可读方式打印反引号信息，并在必要时漂亮地插入空格。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: obviously wrong type specifiers such as (FIXNUM 1) or (CHARACTER 10) are now reported as errors, rather than propagated as unknown types. (reported by piso on #lisp)

sentences.en: bug fix: obviously wrong type specifiers such as (FIXNUM 1) or (CHARACTER 10) are now reported as errors, rather than propagated as unknown types.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：明显错误的类型说明符（例如 (FIXNUM 1) 或 (CHARACTER 10)）现在被报告为错误，而不是作为未知类型传播。

sentences.en: (reported by piso on #lisp)
sentences.zh: （piso 在 #lisp 上报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the :IF-EXISTS argument to OPEN now behaves correctly with values NIL and :ERROR. (thanks to Milan Zamazal)

sentences.en: bug fix: the :IF-EXISTS argument to OPEN now behaves correctly with values NIL and :ERROR.

sentences.en: (thanks to Milan Zamazal)
sentences.zh: （感谢米兰扎马扎尔）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 191c: CLOS now does proper keyword argument checking as described in CLHS 7.6.5 and 7.6.5.1.

sentences.en: fixed bug 191c: CLOS now does proper keyword argument checking as described in CLHS 7.6.5 and 7.6.5.1.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 191c：CLOS 现在执行正确的关键字参数检查，如 CLHS 7.6.5 和 7.6.5.1 中所述。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: LOOP forms using NIL as a for-as-arithmetic counter no longer raise an error; further, using a list as a for-as-arithmetic counter now raises a meaningful error.

sentences.en: bug fix: LOOP forms using NIL as a for-as-arithmetic counter no longer raise an error; further, using a list as a for-as-arithmetic counter now raises a meaningful error.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 NIL 作为 for-as-arithmetic 计数器的 LOOP 表单不再引发错误；此外，使用列表作为算术计数器现在会引发有意义的错误。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 213a: even fairly unreasonable CONS type specifiers are now understood by sequence creation functions such as MAKE-SEQUENCE and COERCE.

sentences.en: fixed bug 213a: even fairly unreasonable CONS type specifiers are now understood by sequence creation functions such as MAKE-SEQUENCE and COERCE.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 213a：即使是相当不合理的 CONS 类型说明符现在也可以被序列创建函数（例如 MAKE-SEQUENCE 和 COERCE）理解。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 46k: READ-BYTE now signals an error when asked to read from a STRING-INPUT-STREAM.

sentences.en: fixed bug 46k: READ-BYTE now signals an error when asked to read from a STRING-INPUT-STREAM.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 46k：当要求从 STRING-INPUT-STREAM 读取时，READ-BYTE 现在发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • compiler enhancement: SIGNUM is now better able to derive the type of its result.

sentences.en: compiler enhancement: SIGNUM is now better able to derive the type of its result.
sentences.zh: 编译器增强：SIGNUM 现在能够更好地导出其结果的类型。

blocks.html_en: • type declarations inside WITH-SLOTS are checked. (reported by salex on #lisp)

sentences.en: type declarations inside WITH-SLOTS are checked.

sentences.en: (reported by salex on #lisp)
sentences.zh: （由 salex 在 #lisp 上报道）

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • incorrect optimization of TRUNCATE for a positive first argument and negative second.
    • compiler failure in let-convertion during flushing dead code.
    • compiler failure while deriving type of TRUNCATE on an interval, containing 0.
    • ASH of a negative bignum by a negative bignum count now returns -1, not 0.
    • intersection of CONS types now canonicalizes properly, fixing inconsistencies in SUBTYPEP.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: incorrect optimization of TRUNCATE for a positive first argument and negative second.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：对于正的第一个参数和负的第二个参数，TRUNCATE 的优化不正确。

sentences.en: compiler failure in let-convertion during flushing dead code.
sentences.zh: 刷新死代码期间编译器在 let 转换中失败。

sentences.en: compiler failure while deriving type of TRUNCATE on an interval, containing 0.
sentences.zh: 在包含 0 的区间上派生 TRUNCATE 类型时编译器失败。

sentences.en: ASH of a negative bignum by a negative bignum count now returns -1, not 0.
sentences.zh: 负 bignum 乘以负 bignum 计数的 ASH 现在返回 -1，而不是 0。

sentences.en: intersection of CONS types now canonicalizes properly, fixing inconsistencies in SUBTYPEP.
sentences.zh: CONS 类型的交集现在可以正确规范化，修复 SUBTYPEP 中的不一致问题。

sentences.zh: 负 bignum 乘以负 bignum 计数的 ASH 现在返回 -1，而不是 0。

sentences.en: intersection of CONS types now canonicalizes properly, fixing inconsistencies in SUBTYPEP.
sentences.zh: CONS 类型的交集现在可以正确规范化，修复 SUBTYPEP 中的不一致问题。
