blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: The --disable-debugger command line option now clobbers the debugger at a more fundamental level, by redefining #'INVOKE-DEBUGGER instead of by rebinding *DEBUGGER-HOOK*. The main difference is that BREAK is specified by ANSI to ignore *DEBUGGER-HOOK* and INVOKE-DEBUGGER regardless. Under the old system, BREAK would enter the debugger REPL and then suffer recursive errors because *DEBUG-IO* is also messed up in --disable-debugger mode; while under the new system, BREAK in --disable-debugger mode terminates the system just as an unhandled error would.

sentences.en: incompatible change: The --disable-debugger command line option now clobbers the debugger at a more fundamental level, by redefining #'INVOKE-DEBUGGER instead of by rebinding *DEBUGGER-HOOK*.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：--disable-debugger 命令行选项现在通过重新定义 #'INVOKE-DEBUGGER 而不是重新绑定 *DEBUGGER-HOOK* 在更基础的级别上破坏调试器。

sentences.en: The main difference is that BREAK is specified by ANSI to ignore *DEBUGGER-HOOK* and INVOKE-DEBUGGER regardless.
sentences.zh: 主要区别在于 ANSI 指定 BREAK 忽略 *DEBUGGER-HOOK* 和 INVOKE-DEBUGGER。

sentences.en: Under the old system, BREAK would enter the debugger REPL and then suffer recursive errors because *DEBUG-IO* is also messed up in --disable-debugger mode; while under the new system, BREAK in --disable-debugger mode terminates the system just as an unhandled error would.
sentences.zh: 在旧系统下，BREAK会进入调试器REPL，然后遭受递归错误，因为*DEBUG-IO*在--disable-debugger模式下也被搞乱了；而在新系统下，--disable-debugger 模式下的 BREAK 会像未处理的错误一样终止系统。

blocks.html_en: • fixed compiler performance when processing loops with a step >1;

sentences.en: fixed compiler performance when processing loops with a step >1;
sentences.zh: 修复了处理步长 >1 的循环时的编译器性能；

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: DOCUMENTATION now retrieves generic function documentation. Also, DOCUMENTATION and (SETF DOCUMENTATION) support has been systematized, and now supports the methods specified by ANSI, along with a default method and a method for slot documentation. (reported by Nathan Froyd)

sentences.en: bug fix: DOCUMENTATION now retrieves generic function documentation.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：文档现在检索通用函数文档。

sentences.en: Also, DOCUMENTATION and (SETF DOCUMENTATION) support has been systematized, and now supports the methods specified by ANSI, along with a default method and a method for slot documentation.
sentences.zh: 此外，文档和（SETF文档）支持已经系统化，现在支持ANSI指定的方法，以及默认方法和槽文档方法。

sentences.en: (reported by Nathan Froyd)
sentences.zh: （内森·弗洛伊德报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: effective methods associated with a generic function are no longer cached over a change of that generic function's method combination. (reported by Andreas Fuchs)

sentences.en: bug fix: effective methods associated with a generic function are no longer cached over a change of that generic function's method combination.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：与通用函数关联的有效方法不再因该通用函数的方法组合的更改而被缓存。

sentences.en: (reported by Andreas Fuchs)
sentences.zh: （安德烈亚斯·福克斯报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: RUN-PROGRAM now does not fail if some element in $PATH names a non-existent directory. (thanks to Andreas Fuchs)

sentences.en: bug fix: RUN-PROGRAM now does not fail if some element in $PATH names a non-existent directory.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：如果 $PATH 中的某些元素命名了不存在的目录，RUN-PROGRAM 现在不会失败。

sentences.en: (thanks to Andreas Fuchs)
sentences.zh: （感谢安德烈亚斯·福克斯）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ROUND and TRUNCATE could, under certain circumstances on the PPC platform, lead to stack corruption; this has been fixed. (reported by Rainer Joswig)

sentences.en: bug fix: ROUND and TRUNCATE could, under certain circumstances on the PPC platform, lead to stack corruption; this has been fixed.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在 PPC 平台上的某些情况下，ROUND 和 TRUNCATE 可能会导致堆栈损坏；这已被修复。

sentences.en: (reported by Rainer Joswig)
sentences.zh: （雷纳·乔斯维格报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: ASH on an (UNSIGNED-BYTE 32) with a shift of -32 or lower no longer ever returns 1 instead of 0. (thanks to Lars Brinkhoff)

sentences.en: bug fix: ASH on an (UNSIGNED-BYTE 32) with a shift of -32 or lower no longer ever returns 1 instead of 0.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：移位为 -32 或更低的 (UNSIGNED-BYTE 32) 上的 ASH 不再返回 1 而不是 0。

sentences.en: (thanks to Lars Brinkhoff)
sentences.zh: （感谢拉尔斯·布林克霍夫）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 285: TRUNCATE on bignum arguments, and indeed bignum arithmetic in general, is now much more reliable on the PPC platform.

sentences.en: fixed bug 285: TRUNCATE on bignum arguments, and indeed bignum arithmetic in general, is now much more reliable on the PPC platform.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 285：bignum 参数上的 TRUNCATE，以及一般的 bignum 算术，现在在 PPC 平台上更加可靠。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: LOGCOUNT on (UNSIGNED-BYTE 64) objects on the Alpha platform now returns the right answer.

sentences.en: bug fix: LOGCOUNT on (UNSIGNED-BYTE 64) objects on the Alpha platform now returns the right answer.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：Alpha 平台上 (UNSIGNED-BYTE 64) 对象的 LOGCOUNT 现在返回正确的答案。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: restored some effective method precomputation in CLOS (turned off by an ANSI fix in sbcl-0.8.3); the amount of precomputation is now tunable.

sentences.en: optimization: restored some effective method precomputation in CLOS (turned off by an ANSI fix in sbcl-0.8.3); the amount of precomputation is now tunable.
sentences.zh: 优化：恢复了 CLOS 中的一些有效方法预计算（通过 sbcl-0.8.3 中的 ANSI 修复关闭）；预计算量现在是可调的。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: compiler-internal data structure use has been reviewed, and changes have been made that should improve the performance of the compiler by about 20%.

sentences.en: optimization: compiler-internal data structure use has been reviewed, and changes have been made that should improve the performance of the compiler by about 20%.
sentences.zh: 优化：已审查编译器内部数据结构的使用，并进行了更改，应将编译器的性能提高约 20%。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: performance of FILL (and :INITIAL-ELEMENT) on simple-base-strings and simple-bit-vectors is improved.

sentences.en: optimization: performance of FILL (and :INITIAL-ELEMENT) on simple-base-strings and simple-bit-vectors is improved.
sentences.zh: 优化：简单基字符串和简单位向量上的 FILL（和：INITIAL-ELEMENT）的性能得到改进。

blocks.html_en: • optimization: the optimization of 32-bit logical and arithmetic functions introduced in version 0.8.3 on the x86 has been implemented on the mips, ppc and sparc platforms; an implementation of the same facility, but for 64-bit arithmetic, has been added for the alpha.

sentences.en: optimization: the optimization of 32-bit logical and arithmetic functions introduced in version 0.8.3 on the x86 has been implemented on the mips, ppc and sparc platforms; an implementation of the same facility, but for 64-bit arithmetic, has been added for the alpha.
sentences.zh: 优化：0.8.3版本中引入的x86上的32位逻辑和算术函数的优化已在mips、ppc和sparc平台上实现；已为 alpha 添加了相同功能的实现，但针对 64 位算术。

blocks.html_en: • microoptimization: the compiler is better able to make use of the x86 LEA instruction for multiplication by constants.

sentences.en: microoptimization: the compiler is better able to make use of the x86 LEA instruction for multiplication by constants.
sentences.zh: 微优化：编译器能够更好地利用 x86 LEA 指令进行常量乘法。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: in some situations compiler did not report usage of generic arithmetic in (SPEED 3) policy.

sentences.en: bug fix: in some situations compiler did not report usage of generic arithmetic in (SPEED 3) policy.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在某些情况下，编译器不会报告 (SPEED 3) 策略中通用算术的使用情况。

blocks.html_en: • bug 145b fix: compiler used wrong type specifier while converting MEMBER-types to numeric.

sentences.en: bug 145b fix: compiler used wrong type specifier while converting MEMBER-types to numeric.
sentences.zh: bug 145b 修复：编译器在将 MEMBER 类型转换为数字时使用了错误的类型说明符。

sentences.en: bug fix: COMPILE-FILE must bind *READTABLE*.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：COMPILE-FILE 必须绑定 *READTABLE*。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • the RETURN clause in LOOP is now equivalent to DO (RETURN ...).
    • ROUND and FROUND now give the right answer when given very small float arguments.
    • (FLOAT X) for X of type DOUBLE-FLOAT now returns X in all circumstances.
    • optimizer for (EXPT X 0) did not work for X not of type FLOAT.
    • (GCD 0 <negative-integer>) returned <negative-integer>.
    • LCM should return a non-negative integer.
    • PARSE-INTEGER returned the index of a terminator instead of the upper bounding index of a substring in case :JUNK-ALLOWED NIL.
    • PARSE-INTEGER returned an incorrect index being applied to a displaced string.
    • LCM with two arguments of 0 returns 0 rather than signalling DIVISION-BY-ZERO.
    • unsigned addition of a 32-bit constant with the high bit set no longer causes an internal compiler error on the x86.
    • LOGBITP accepts a non-negative bignum as its INDEX argument.
    • compiler incorrectly derived types of DPB and DEPOSIT-FIELD with negative last argument.
    • byte specifiers with zero size and position no longer cause an error during type derivation.
    • bignum multiplication on the Alpha platform now returns the right answer.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: the RETURN clause in LOOP is now equivalent to DO (RETURN ...).
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：LOOP 中的 RETURN 子句现在相当于 DO (RETURN ...)。

sentences.en: ROUND and FROUND now give the right answer when given very small float arguments.
sentences.zh: 当给定非常小的浮点参数时，ROUND 和 FROUND 现在可以给出正确的答案。

sentences.en: (FLOAT X) for X of type DOUBLE-FLOAT now returns X in all circumstances.
sentences.zh: 现在，对于 DOUBLE-FLOAT 类型的 X，(FLOAT X) 在所有情况下都会返回 X。

sentences.en: optimizer for (EXPT X 0) did not work for X not of type FLOAT.
sentences.zh: (EXPT X 0) 的优化器不适用于非 FLOAT 类型的 X。

sentences.en: (GCD 0 <negative-integer>) returned <negative-integer>.
sentences.zh: (GCD 0 <负整数>) 返回<负整数>。

sentences.en: LCM should return a non-negative integer.
sentences.zh: LCM 应返回一个非负整数。

sentences.en: PARSE-INTEGER returned the index of a terminator instead of the upper bounding index of a substring in case :JUNK-ALLOWED NIL.
sentences.zh: 在 :JUNK-ALLOWED NIL 情况下，PARSE-INTEGER 返回终止符的索引，而不是子字符串的上限索引。

sentences.en: PARSE-INTEGER returned an incorrect index being applied to a displaced string.
sentences.zh: PARSE-INTEGER 返回了应用于移位字符串的不正确索引。

sentences.en: LCM with two arguments of 0 returns 0 rather than signalling DIVISION-BY-ZERO.
sentences.zh: 两个参数为 0 的 LCM 返回 0，而不是发出“除零”信号。

sentences.en: unsigned addition of a 32-bit constant with the high bit set no longer causes an internal compiler error on the x86.
sentences.zh: 具有高位设置的 32 位常量的无符号加法不再导致 x86 上的内部编译器错误。

sentences.en: LOGBITP accepts a non-negative bignum as its INDEX argument.
sentences.zh: LOGBITP 接受非负 bignum 作为其 INDEX 参数。

sentences.en: compiler incorrectly derived types of DPB and DEPOSIT-FIELD with negative last argument.
sentences.zh: 编译器错误地导出了最后一个参数为负的 DPB 和 DEPOSIT-FIELD 类型。

sentences.en: byte specifiers with zero size and position no longer cause an error during type derivation.
sentences.zh: 大小和位置为零的字节说明符在类型推导过程中不再导致错误。

sentences.en: bignum multiplication on the Alpha platform now returns the right answer.
sentences.zh: Alpha 平台上的 bignum 乘法现在可以返回正确的答案。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • The system now obeys the constraint imposed by UPGRADED-ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE that the upgraded array element types form a lattice under type intersection.
    • FFLOOR, FTRUNCATE, FCEILING and FROUND work with integers.
    • ASSOC now ignores NIL elements in an alist.
    • CEILING now gives the right answer with MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM and (1+ MOST-POSITIVE-FIXNUM) answers.
    • The addition of a method with invalid qualifiers to a generic function does not cause an error to be signalled immediately; a warning is signalled, and the error is generated only on calling the generic function.

blocks.html_en: • CEILING now gives the right answer with MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM and (1+ MOST-POSITIVE-FIXNUM) answers.

sentences.en: CEILING now gives the right answer with MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM and (1+ MOST-POSITIVE-FIXNUM) answers.
sentences.zh: CEILING 现在给出了正确的答案，包括 MOST-NEGATIVE-FIXNUM 和 (1+ MOST-POSITIVE-FIXNUM) 答案。

blocks.html_en: • The addition of a method with invalid qualifiers to a generic function does not cause an error to be signalled immediately; a warning is signalled, and the error is generated only on calling the generic function.

sentences.en: The addition of a method with invalid qualifiers to a generic function does not cause an error to be signalled immediately; a warning is signalled, and the error is generated only on calling the generic function.
sentences.zh: 将具有无效限定符的方法添加到通用函数不会导致立即发出错误信号；发出警告信号，并且仅在调用通用函数时才会生成错误。

blocks.html_en: • changed .fasl file version number, in part to add type codes for new array subtypes UNSIGNED-BYTE 7, 15, 29, and 31 mandated by obscure ANSI requirements

sentences.en: changed .fasl file version number, in part to add type codes for new array subtypes UNSIGNED-BYTE 7, 15, 29, and 31 mandated by obscure ANSI requirements
sentences.zh: 更改了 .fasl 文件版本号，部分是为了根据模糊的 ANSI 要求强制添加新数组子类型 UNSIGNED-BYTE 7、15、29 和 31 的类型代码

sentences.en: New in version 0.8.2, 2003-07-25

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 148: failure to inline-expand a local function left garbage, confusing the compiler.

sentences.en: fixed bug 148: failure to inline-expand a local function left garbage, confusing the compiler.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 148：未能内联扩展本地函数留下垃圾，使编译器感到困惑。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bugs 3cd: structure slot readers perform type check if the slot can have an invalid value (i.e. it is either not initialized or can be written with a less specific slot writer).

sentences.en: fixed bugs 3cd: structure slot readers perform type check if the slot can have an invalid value (i.e. it is either not initialized or can be written with a less specific slot writer).
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 3cd：结构槽读取器执行类型检查，如果槽可以具有无效值（即，它要么未初始化，要么可以用不太具体的槽写入器写入）。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: the compiler now traps array references to elements off the end of an array; previously, the bounds checking in some circumstances could go off-by-one.

sentences.en: bug fix: the compiler now traps array references to elements off the end of an array; previously, the bounds checking in some circumstances could go off-by-one.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：编译器现在捕获对数组末尾元素的数组引用；以前，某些情况下的边界检查可能会减少一倍。

blocks.html_en: • improved MACHINE-VERSION, especially on Linux (thanks to Lars Brinkhoff)

sentences.en: improved MACHINE-VERSION, especially on Linux (thanks to Lars Brinkhoff)
sentences.zh: 改进了机器版本，特别是在 Linux 上（感谢 Lars Brinkhoff）

blocks.html_en: • type declarations for array element types now obey the description on the CLHS page "Declaration TYPE", as per discussions on sbcl-help around 2003-05-08. This means that a declaration (TYPE (ARRAY FOO) BAR) means that, within the scope of the declaration, all references to BAR will be asserted or assumed (with THE, so dependent on compiler policy) to involve objects of type FOO. Note that no such declaration is implied in (MAKE-ARRAY .. :ELEMENT-TYPE 'FOO).

sentences.en: type declarations for array element types now obey the description on the CLHS page "Declaration TYPE", as per discussions on sbcl-help around 2003-05-08.
sentences.zh: 数组元素类型的类型声明现在遵循 CLHS 页面“声明类型”上的描述，根据 2003 年 5 月 8 日左右 sbcl-help 上的讨论。

sentences.en: This means that a declaration (TYPE (ARRAY FOO) BAR) means that, within the scope of the declaration, all references to BAR will be asserted or assumed (with THE, so dependent on compiler policy) to involve objects of type FOO.
sentences.zh: 这意味着声明 (TYPE (ARRAY FOO) BAR) 意味着在声明范围内，所有对 BAR 的引用都将被断言或假定（使用 THE，因此取决于编译器策略）以涉及 FOO 类型的对象。

sentences.en: Note that no such declaration is implied in (MAKE-ARRAY .. :ELEMENT-TYPE 'FOO).
sentences.zh: 请注意，(MAKE-ARRAY .. :ELEMENT-TYPE 'FOO) 中并未隐含此类声明。

blocks.html_en: • declared types of functions from the "Conditions" chapter. (reported by Paul Dietz)

sentences.en: declared types of functions from the "Conditions" chapter.
sentences.zh: “条件”一章中声明的函数类型。

sentences.en: (reported by Paul Dietz)
sentences.zh: （保罗·迪茨报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: CERROR accepts a function as its first argument.

sentences.en: bug fix: CERROR accepts a function as its first argument.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：CERROR 接受函数作为其第一个参数。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: NTH an NTHCDR accept a bignum as index arguments. (reported by Adam Warner)

sentences.en: bug fix: NTH an NTHCDR accept a bignum as index arguments.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：NTH 和 NTHCDR 接受 bignum 作为索引参数。

sentences.en: (reported by Adam Warner)
sentences.zh: （亚当·华纳报道）

blocks.html_en: • optimization: character compare routines now optimize comparing against a constant character. (reported by Gilbert Baumann)

sentences.en: optimization: character compare routines now optimize comparing against a constant character.
sentences.zh: 优化：字符比较例程现在优化与常量字符的比较。

sentences.en: (reported by Gilbert Baumann)
sentences.zh: （吉尔伯特·鲍曼报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: (SETF AREF) on byte-sized-element arrays with constant index argument now works properly on the MIPS platform.

sentences.en: bug fix: (SETF AREF) on byte-sized-element arrays with constant index argument now works properly on the MIPS platform.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：具有常量索引参数的字节大小元素数组上的 (SETF AREF) 现在可以在 MIPS 平台上正常工作。

blocks.html_en: • fixed compiler failure on (TYPEP x '(NOT (MEMBER 0d0))).

sentences.en: fixed compiler failure on (TYPEP x '(NOT (MEMBER 0d0))).
sentences.zh: 修复了 (TYPEP x '(NOT (MEMBER 0d0))) 上的编译器故障。

blocks.html_en: • repeated evaluation of the same DEFSTRUCT, a slot of which is declared to have a functional type, does not cause an error anymore.

sentences.en: repeated evaluation of the same DEFSTRUCT, a slot of which is declared to have a functional type, does not cause an error anymore.
sentences.zh: 重复评估相同的 DEFSTRUCT（其中一个槽被声明为具有函数类型）不会再导致错误。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: sometimes MAKE-INSTANCE did not work with classes with many :DEFAULT-INITARGS. (reported by Istvan Marko)

sentences.en: fixed bug: sometimes MAKE-INSTANCE did not work with classes with many :DEFAULT-INITARGS.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：有时 MAKE-INSTANCE 不适用于具有许多 :DEFAULT-INITARGS 的类。

sentences.en: (reported by Istvan Marko)
sentences.zh: （伊斯特万·马尔科报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: if last continuation of a deleted block has a destination, this destination should be deleted too. (reported by ohler on #lisp)

sentences.en: fixed bug: if last continuation of a deleted block has a destination, this destination should be deleted too.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误：如果已删除块的最后一个延续有目的地，则该目的地也应该被删除。

sentences.en: (reported by ohler on #lisp)
sentences.zh: （由 ohler 在 #lisp 上报道）

blocks.html_en: • fixed a bug in the bootstrap process: the host compiler's values of ARRAY-DIMENSION-LIMIT and ARRAY-TOTAL-SIZE-LIMIT no longer leak into the newly-built SBCL. (reported by Eric Marsden on #lisp, test case from Patrik Nordebo)

sentences.en: fixed a bug in the bootstrap process: the host compiler's values of ARRAY-DIMENSION-LIMIT and ARRAY-TOTAL-SIZE-LIMIT no longer leak into the newly-built SBCL.
sentences.zh: 修复了引导过程中的一个错误：主机编译器的 ARRAY-DIMENSION-LIMIT 和 ARRAY-TOTAL-SIZE-LIMIT 值不再泄漏到新建的 SBCL 中。

sentences.en: (reported by Eric Marsden on #lisp, test case from Patrik Nordebo)
sentences.zh: （Eric Marsden 在 #lisp 上报道，来自 Patrik Nordebo 的测试用例）

blocks.html_en: • improved the ability of the disassembler on the PPC platform to provide helpful disassembly notes.

sentences.en: improved the ability of the disassembler on the PPC platform to provide helpful disassembly notes.
sentences.zh: 改进了 PPC 平台上反汇编器的能力，以提供有用的反汇编注释。

blocks.html_en: • SB-MOP:CLASS-PROTOTYPE on built-in-classes returns an instance of the class in more cases than previously.

sentences.en: SB-MOP:CLASS-PROTOTYPE on built-in-classes returns an instance of the class in more cases than previously.
sentences.zh: 内置类上的 SB-MOP:CLASS-PROTOTYPE 在比以前更多的情况下返回类的实例。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: FILE-POSITION now understands :START and :END for STRING-INPUT-STREAMs. (thanks to Nikodemus Siivola)

sentences.en: bug fix: FILE-POSITION now understands :START and :END for STRING-INPUT-STREAMs.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：FILE-POSITION 现在可以理解 STRING-INPUT-STREAM 的 :START 和 :END。

sentences.en: (thanks to Nikodemus Siivola)
sentences.zh: （感谢尼科德穆斯·西沃拉）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: (SIGNED-BYTE 8) streams no longer return (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) data. (thanks to David Lichteblau)

sentences.en: bug fix: (SIGNED-BYTE 8) streams no longer return (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) data.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：(SIGNED-BYTE 8) 流不再返回 (UNSIGNED-BYTE 8) 数据。

sentences.en: (thanks to David Lichteblau)
sentences.zh: （感谢大卫·利希特布劳）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: it is possible to add a method to a generic function without lambda list.

sentences.en: bug fix: it is possible to add a method to a generic function without lambda list.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：可以在没有 lambda 列表的情况下向通用函数添加方法。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: reader failed to signal END-OF-FILE inside an object representation. (reported by Nikodemus Siivola)

sentences.en: bug fix: reader failed to signal END-OF-FILE inside an object representation.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：读取器无法在对象表示内发出文件结束信号。

sentences.en: (reported by Nikodemus Siivola)
sentences.zh: （尼科德穆斯·西沃拉报道）

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • LAST and [N]BUTLAST should accept a bignum.
    • condition slot accessors are methods.
    • (VECTOR NIL) is a subtype of STRING.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: LAST and [N]BUTLAST should accept a bignum.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：LAST 和 [N]BUTLAST 应该接受 bignum。

sentences.en: condition slot accessors are methods.
sentences.zh: 条件槽访问器是方法。

sentences.en: (VECTOR NIL) is a subtype of STRING.
sentences.zh: (VECTOR NIL) 是 STRING 的子类型。

blocks.html_en: • LAST and [N]BUTLAST should accept a bignum.

sentences.en: LAST and [N]BUTLAST should accept a bignum.
sentences.zh: LAST 和 [N]BUTLAST 应该接受 bignum。

blocks.html_en: • condition slot accessors are methods.

sentences.en: condition slot accessors are methods.
sentences.zh: 条件槽访问器是方法。

blocks.html_en: • (VECTOR NIL) is a subtype of STRING.

sentences.en: (VECTOR NIL) is a subtype of STRING.
sentences.zh: (VECTOR NIL) 是 STRING 的子类型。

sentences.en: New in version 0.8.1, 2003-06-22

sentences.en: Back to top

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: some nonsensical specialized lambda lists (used in DEFMETHOD) which were previously ignored now signal errors.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: some nonsensical specialized lambda lists (used in DEFMETHOD) which were previously ignored now signal errors.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：一些以前被忽略的无意义的专用 lambda 列表（在 DEFMETHOD 中使用）现在发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: the system is now aware of the types of variables in the COMMON-LISP package, and will signal errors for most violations of these type constraints (where previously they were silently accepted).

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: the system is now aware of the types of variables in the COMMON-LISP package, and will signal errors for most violations of these type constraints (where previously they were silently accepted).
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：系统现在可以识别 COMMON-LISP 包中变量的类型，并且对于大多数违反这些类型约束的情况将发出错误信号（以前它们是默默接受的）。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: COMPILE-FILE now uses the freedom afforded (ANSI 3.2.2.3) to use derived function types for functions defined in the same file. This also permits the system to warn on static type mismatches and function redefinition. (Currently it does not work with high DEBUG level.)

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: COMPILE-FILE now uses the freedom afforded (ANSI 3.2.2.3) to use derived function types for functions defined in the same file.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：COMPILE-FILE 现在使用提供的自由 (ANSI 3.2.2.3) 对同一文件中定义的函数使用派生函数类型。

sentences.en: This also permits the system to warn on static type mismatches and function redefinition.
sentences.zh: 这还允许系统对静态类型不匹配和函数重新定义发出警告。

sentences.en: (Currently it does not work with high DEBUG level.)
sentences.zh: （目前它不适用于高 DEBUG 级别。）

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: VALUES declaration is disabled.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: VALUES declaration is disabled.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：VALUES 声明被禁用。

blocks.html_en: • When issuing notes, the compiler now signals a condition of type SB-EXT:COMPILER-NOTE, and provides an associated MUFFLE-WARNING restart for use in user handlers. It is expected that the COMPILER-NOTE condition will eventually become a condition supertype to a hierarchy of note types, which will then be handleable in a similar fashion. However, at the moment, no such note subtypes yet exist. (SB-INT:SIMPLE-COMPILER-NOTE exists, but it's an implementation detail, not a classification for the purpose above.)

sentences.en: When issuing notes, the compiler now signals a condition of type SB-EXT:COMPILER-NOTE, and provides an associated MUFFLE-WARNING restart for use in user handlers.
sentences.zh: 发出注释时，编译器现在会发出 SB-EXT:COMPILER-NOTE 类型的条件信号，并提供关联的 MUFFLE-WARNING 重新启动以在用户处理程序中使用。

sentences.en: It is expected that the COMPILER-NOTE condition will eventually become a condition supertype to a hierarchy of note types, which will then be handleable in a similar fashion.
sentences.zh: 预计 COMPILER-NOTE 条件最终将成为注释类型层次结构的条件超类型，然后可以以类似的方式进行处理。

sentences.en: However, at the moment, no such note subtypes yet exist.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前尚不存在这样的音符子类型。

sentences.en: (SB-INT:SIMPLE-COMPILER-NOTE exists, but it's an implementation detail, not a classification for the purpose above.)
sentences.zh: （SB-INT:SIMPLE-COMPILER-NOTE 存在，但它是一个实现细节，而不是用于上述目的的分类。）

blocks.html_en:
• Changes in type checking closed the following bugs:
    • type checking of unused values (192b, 194d, 203);
    • template selection based on unsafe type assertions (192c, 236);
    • type checking in branches (194bc).

sentences.en: Changes in type checking closed the following bugs: type checking of unused values (192b, 194d, 203); template selection based on unsafe type assertions (192c, 236); type checking in branches (194bc).
sentences.zh: 类型检查的更改消除了以下错误：未使用值的类型检查（192b、194d、203）；基于不安全类型断言的模板选择（192c，236）；分支中的类型检查（194bc）。

blocks.html_en: • type checking of unused values (192b, 194d, 203);

sentences.en: type checking of unused values (192b, 194d, 203);
sentences.zh: 未使用值的类型检查（192b、194d、203）；

blocks.html_en: • template selection based on unsafe type assertions (192c, 236);

sentences.en: template selection based on unsafe type assertions (192c, 236);
sentences.zh: 基于不安全类型断言的模板选择（192c，236）；

blocks.html_en: • type checking in branches (194bc).

sentences.en: type checking in branches (194bc).
sentences.zh: 分支中的类型检查（194bc）。

blocks.html_en: • A short form of VALUES type specifier has ANSI meaning (it has increased the number of situations when SBCL cannot perform type checking).

sentences.en: A short form of VALUES type specifier has ANSI meaning (it has increased the number of situations when SBCL cannot perform type checking).
sentences.zh: VALUES 类型说明符的缩写形式具有 ANSI 含义（它增加了 SBCL 无法执行类型检查的情况数量）。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug in DEFSTRUCT: once again, naming structure slots with keywords or constants is permissible.

sentences.en: fixed bug in DEFSTRUCT: once again, naming structure slots with keywords or constants is permissible.
sentences.zh: 修复了 DEFSTRUCT 中的错误：再次，允许使用关键字或常量命名结构槽。

blocks.html_en: • STREAM-READ-SEQUENCE and STREAM-WRITE-SEQUENCE now have methods defined on the relevant FUNDAMENTAL-BINARY-{INPUT,OUTPUT}-STREAM classes. (thanks to Antonio Martinez)

sentences.en: STREAM-READ-SEQUENCE and STREAM-WRITE-SEQUENCE now have methods defined on the relevant FUNDAMENTAL-BINARY-{INPUT,OUTPUT}-STREAM classes.
sentences.zh: STREAM-READ-SEQUENCE 和 STREAM-WRITE-SEQUENCE 现在具有在相关 FUNDAMENTAL-BINARY-{INPUT,OUTPUT}-STREAM 类上定义的方法。

sentences.en: (thanks to Antonio Martinez)
sentences.zh: （感谢安东尼奥·马丁内斯）

blocks.html_en: • improved ANSIness in DESCRIBE: The DESCRIBE function no longer outputs FRESH-LINE or TERPRI, and no longer converts its stream argument to a pretty-print stream. Instead, it leaves any such operations to DESCRIBE-OBJECT methods.

sentences.en: improved ANSIness in DESCRIBE: The DESCRIBE function no longer outputs FRESH-LINE or TERPRI, and no longer converts its stream argument to a pretty-print stream.
sentences.zh: 改进了 DESCRIBE 中的 ANSIness：DESCRIBE 函数不再输出 FRESH-LINE 或 TERPRI，并且不再将其流参数转换为漂亮打印流。

sentences.en: Instead, it leaves any such operations to DESCRIBE-OBJECT methods.
sentences.zh: 相反，它将任何此类操作留给 DESCRIBE-OBJECT 方法。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: APROPOS now respects the EXTERNAL-ONLY flag. (reported by Teemu Kalvas)

sentences.en: bug fix: APROPOS now respects the EXTERNAL-ONLY flag.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：APROPOS 现在尊重 EXTERNAL-ONLY 标志。

sentences.en: (reported by Teemu Kalvas)
sentences.zh: （提穆·卡尔瓦斯报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: NIL is now a valid destructuring argument in DEFMACRO lambda lists. (thanks to David Lichteblau)

sentences.en: bug fix: NIL is now a valid destructuring argument in DEFMACRO lambda lists.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：NIL 现在是 DEFMACRO lambda 列表中的有效解构参数。

sentences.en: (thanks to David Lichteblau)
sentences.zh: （感谢大卫·利希特布劳）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: Defining a generic function with a :METHOD-CLASS being a subclass of STANDARD-METHOD no longer causes stack exhaustion. (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)

sentences.en: bug fix: Defining a generic function with a :METHOD-CLASS being a subclass of STANDARD-METHOD no longer causes stack exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：使用 :METHOD-CLASS 作为 STANDARD-METHOD 的子类定义通用函数不再导致堆栈耗尽。

sentences.en: (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)
sentences.zh: （感谢格德·莫尔曼）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 246: increased compilation speed of long MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND (and likewise of NTH-VALUE with a constant integer argument)

sentences.en: fixed bug 246: increased compilation speed of long MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND (and likewise of NTH-VALUE with a constant integer argument)
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 246：提高了长 MULTIPLE-VALUE-BIND 的编译速度（同样具有常量整数参数的 NTH-VALUE）

blocks.html_en: • a contributed module implementing COMPILER-LET and MACROEXPAND-ALL has been included.

sentences.en: a contributed module implementing COMPILER-LET and MACROEXPAND-ALL has been included.
sentences.zh: 已包含实现 COMPILER-LET 和 MACROEXPAND-ALL 的贡献模块。

blocks.html_en: • DEFCONSTANT now throws a condition of type SB-EXT:DEFCONSTANT-UNEQL if it is being asked to redefine a constant to a non-EQL value; CONTINUE and ABORT restarts respectively change and preserve the value.

sentences.en: DEFCONSTANT now throws a condition of type SB-EXT:DEFCONSTANT-UNEQL if it is being asked to redefine a constant to a non-EQL value; CONTINUE and ABORT restarts respectively change and preserve the value.
sentences.zh: 如果要求将常量重新定义为非 EQL 值，DEFCONSTANT 现在会抛出 SB-EXT:DEFCONSTANT-UNEQL 类型的条件； CONTINUE和ABORT分别在重新启动时更改和保存该值。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 63: The code walker, part of the implementation of CLOS, is now better at handling symbol macros.

sentences.en: fixed bug 63: The code walker, part of the implementation of CLOS, is now better at handling symbol macros.
sentences.zh: 已修复错误 63：代码步行器是 CLOS 实现的一部分，现在可以更好地处理符号宏。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: There is no longer an internal implementation type named CL:LENGTH. (reported by Raymond Toy)

sentences.en: bug fix: There is no longer an internal implementation type named CL:LENGTH.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：不再有名为 CL:LENGTH 的内部实现类型。

sentences.en: (reported by Raymond Toy)
sentences.zh: （雷蒙德·托伊报道）

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: In macro-like defining macros/special operators the implicit block does not enclose the lambda list.

sentences.en: bug fix: In macro-like defining macros/special operators the implicit block does not enclose the lambda list.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：在类似宏的定义宏/特殊运算符中，隐式块不包含 lambda 列表。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bugs 10 and 43: Bare VALUES, AND, OR and MEMBER symbols (not enclosed in parentheses) are not suitable as type specifiers, and their use properly signals an error now.

sentences.en: fixed bugs 10 and 43: Bare VALUES, AND, OR and MEMBER symbols (not enclosed in parentheses) are not suitable as type specifiers, and their use properly signals an error now.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 10 和 43：裸值、AND、OR 和 MEMBER 符号（未括在括号中）不适合作为类型说明符，并且它们现在正确使用会发出错误信号。

blocks.html_en: • bug fix: An argument count mismatch for a type specifier in code being compiled no longer causes an unhandled error at compile time, but signals a compile-time warning.

sentences.en: bug fix: An argument count mismatch for a type specifier in code being compiled no longer causes an unhandled error at compile time, but signals a compile-time warning.
sentences.zh: 错误修复：正在编译的代码中类型说明符的参数计数不匹配不再导致编译时出现未处理的错误，而是发出编译时警告。

blocks.html_en: • fixed simple vector readable printing

sentences.en: fixed simple vector readable printing

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • NIL is now allowed as a structure slot name.
    • Arbitrary numbers, not just REALs, are allowed in certain circumstances in LOOP for-as-arithmetic clauses.
    • Multiple class redefinitions before slot access no longer causes a type error.
    • (SETF FIND-CLASS) now accepts NIL as an argument to remove the association between the name and a class.
    • Generic functions with non-standard method-combination and over five methods all of which return constants no longer return NIL after the first few invocations. (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)
    • CALL-NEXT-METHOD with no arguments now passes the original values of the arguments, even in the presence of assignment.
    • Functions [N]SUBST*, LAST, NRECONC, [N]SUBLIS may return any object.
    • DISASSEMBLE works with closures and funcallable instances.
    • ADD-METHOD now returns the generic function, not the new method.
    • FIND-METHOD signals an error if the lengths of the specializers is incompatible with the generic function, even if the ERRORP argument is true.
    • TYPE-OF returns recognizeable subtypes of all built-in-types of which its argument is a member.
    • DEFCLASS only redefines the class named by its class-name argument if that name is the proper name of the class; otherwise, it creates a new class.
    • SLOT-UNBOUND now correctly initalizes the CELL-ERROR-NAME slot of the UNBOUND-SLOT condition to the name of the slot.
    • (SETF (AREF bv 0) ...) did not work for bit vectors.
    • SLOT-UNBOUND and SLOT-MISSING now have their return values treated by SLOT-BOUNDP, SLOT-VALUE, (SETF SLOT-VALUE) and SLOT-MAKUNBOUND in the specified fashion.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: NIL is now allowed as a structure slot name.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：现在允许 NIL 作为结构槽名称。

sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，LOOP for-as-arithmetic 子句中允许使用任意数字，而不仅仅是 REAL。

sentences.en: Multiple class redefinitions before slot access no longer causes a type error.
sentences.zh: 槽访问之前的多个类重新定义不再导致类型错误。

sentences.en: (SETF FIND-CLASS) now accepts NIL as an argument to remove the association between the name and a class.
sentences.zh: (SETF FIND-CLASS) 现在接受 NIL 作为参数来删除名称和类之间的关联。

sentences.en: Generic functions with non-standard method-combination and over five methods all of which return constants no longer return NIL after the first few invocations.
sentences.zh: 具有非标准方法组合和超过五个方法的泛型函数，所有这些方法都返回常量，在前几次调用后不再返回 NIL。

sentences.en: (thanks to Gerd Moellmann) CALL-NEXT-METHOD with no arguments now passes the original values of the arguments, even in the presence of assignment.
sentences.zh: （感谢 Gerd Moellmann）不带参数的 CALL-NEXT-METHOD 现在会传递参数的原始值，即使存在赋值也是如此。

sentences.en: Functions [N]SUBST*, LAST, NRECONC, [N]SUBLIS may return any object.
sentences.zh: 函数 [N]SUBST*、LAST、NRECONC、[N]SUBLIS 可以返回任何对象。

sentences.en: DISASSEMBLE works with closures and funcallable instances.
sentences.zh: DISASSEMBLE 适用于闭包和 funcallable 实例。

sentences.en: ADD-METHOD now returns the generic function, not the new method.
sentences.zh: ADD-METHOD 现在返回通用函数，而不是新方法。

sentences.en: FIND-METHOD signals an error if the lengths of the specializers is incompatible with the generic function, even if the ERRORP argument is true.
sentences.zh: 如果专门化器的长度与通用函数不兼容，即使 ERRORP 参数为 true，FIND-METHOD 也会发出错误信号。

sentences.en: TYPE-OF returns recognizeable subtypes of all built-in-types of which its argument is a member.
sentences.zh: TYPE-OF 返回其参数所属的所有内置类型的可识别子类型。

sentences.en: DEFCLASS only redefines the class named by its class-name argument if that name is the proper name of the class; otherwise, it creates a new class.
sentences.zh: DEFCLASS 仅重新定义由其类名参数命名的类（如果该名称是该类的正确名称）；否则，它会创建一个新类。

sentences.en: SLOT-UNBOUND now correctly initalizes the CELL-ERROR-NAME slot of the UNBOUND-SLOT condition to the name of the slot.
sentences.zh: SLOT-UNBOUND 现在可以正确地将 UNBOUND-SLOT 条件的 CELL-ERROR-NAME 槽初始化为槽的名称。

sentences.en: (SETF (AREF bv 0) ...)
did not work for bit vectors.
sentences.zh: 不适用于位向量。

sentences.en: SLOT-UNBOUND and SLOT-MISSING now have their return values treated by SLOT-BOUNDP, SLOT-VALUE, (SETF SLOT-VALUE) and SLOT-MAKUNBOUND in the specified fashion.
sentences.zh: SLOT-UNBOUND 和 SLOT-MISSING 现在的返回值由 SLOT-BOUNDP、SLOT-VALUE、(SETF SLOT-VALUE) 和 SLOT-MAKUNBOUND 以指定的方式处理。

blocks.html_en: • SBCL now builds using CLISP (version of late April 2003 from CVS) as cross-compilation host. As a consequence, we can now bootstrap our way up to SBCL starting with a bare gcc toolchain and human-readable source code (first the source to CLISP, then the source to SBCL).

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • the GENERIC-FUNCTION type is no longer disjoint from FUNCTION types.
    • &ENVIRONMENT parameter in macro lambda list is bound first.
    • SXHASH on condition objects no longer returns NIL.
    • :ALLOCATION :CLASS slots are better treated; their values are updated on class redefinition, and initforms inherited from superclasses are applied.
    • REMOVE-METHOD returns its generic function argument even when no method was removed.
    • SHARED-INITIALIZE now initializes the values of the requested slots, including those with :ALLOCATION :CLASS.
    • ALLOCATE-INSTANCE now works on structure classes defined via DEFSTRUCT (and not just by those from DEFCLASS :METACLASS STRUCTURE-CLASS).
    • SLOT-EXISTS-P now works on conditions, as well as structures and CLOS instances.
    • MAKE-LOAD-FORM now has the required methods on STRUCTURE-OBJECT, CONDITION and STANDARD-OBJECT.
    • MAKE-LOAD-FORM-SAVING-SLOTS no longer returns a special keyword, and now implements the SLOT-NAMES argument.
    • methods with &OPTIONAL arguments no longer allow too many arguments to be passed in the call without error.
    • DEFGENERIC now checks that the :ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER option is consistent with the required arguments of the generic function lambda list.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: the GENERIC-FUNCTION type is no longer disjoint from FUNCTION types. &ENVIRONMENT parameter in macro lambda list is bound first.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：GENERIC-FUNCTION 类型不再与 FUNCTION 类型分离。宏 lambda 列表中的 &ENVIRONMENT 参数首先绑定。

sentences.zh: 条件对象上的 SXHASH 不再返回 NIL。 :ALLOCATION :CLASS 槽位得到更好的处理；它们的值在类重新定义时更新，并应用从超类继承的 initforms。

sentences.en: REMOVE-METHOD returns its generic function argument even when no method was removed.
sentences.zh: 即使没有删除任何方法，REMOVE-METHOD 也会返回其通用函数参数。

sentences.en: SHARED-INITIALIZE now initializes the values of the requested slots, including those with :ALLOCATION :CLASS.
sentences.zh: SHARED-INITIALIZE 现在初始化请求的槽的值，包括带有 :ALLOCATION :CLASS 的槽。

sentences.en: ALLOCATE-INSTANCE now works on structure classes defined via DEFSTRUCT (and not just by those from DEFCLASS :METACLASS STRUCTURE-CLASS).
sentences.zh: ALLOCATE-INSTANCE 现在适用于通过 DEFSTRUCT 定义的结构类（而不仅仅是来自 DEFCLASS :METACLASS STRUCTURE-CLASS 的结构类）。

sentences.en: SLOT-EXISTS-P now works on conditions, as well as structures and CLOS instances.
sentences.zh: SLOT-E​​XISTS-P 现在适用于条件、结构和 CLOS 实例。

sentences.en: MAKE-LOAD-FORM now has the required methods on STRUCTURE-OBJECT, CONDITION and STANDARD-OBJECT.
sentences.zh: MAKE-LOAD-FORM 现在具有 STRUCTURE-OBJECT、CONDITION 和 STANDARD-OBJECT 所需的方法。

sentences.en: MAKE-LOAD-FORM-SAVING-SLOTS no longer returns a special keyword, and now implements the SLOT-NAMES argument.
sentences.zh: MAKE-LOAD-FORM-SAVING-SLOTS 不再返回特殊关键字，现在实现 SLOT-NAMES 参数。

sentences.en: methods with &OPTIONAL arguments no longer allow too many arguments to be passed in the call without error.
sentences.zh: 带有 &OPTIONAL 参数的方法不再允许在调用中传递太多参数而不会出现错误。

sentences.en: DEFGENERIC now checks that the :ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER option is consistent with the required arguments of the generic function lambda list.
sentences.zh: DEFGENERIC 现在检查 :ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER 选项是否与泛型函数 lambda 列表所需的参数一致。

blocks.html_en: • fix for longstanding nonANSIism: The old distinction between CL:CLASS objects and SB-PCL:CLASS objects has been eliminated. The return value from CL:FIND-CLASS is now a CLOS class, and likewise that of CL:CLASS-OF; CL:BUILT-IN-CLASS, CL:STRUCTURE-CLASS and CL:STANDARD-CLASS name CLOS classes.

sentences.en: fix for longstanding nonANSIism: The old distinction between CL:CLASS objects and SB-PCL:CLASS objects has been eliminated.
sentences.zh: 修复了长期存在的非 ANSIism：CL:CLASS 对象和 SB-PCL:CLASS 对象之间的旧区别已被消除。

sentences.en: The return value from CL:FIND-CLASS is now a CLOS class, and likewise that of CL:CLASS-OF; CL:BUILT-IN-CLASS, CL:STRUCTURE-CLASS and CL:STANDARD-CLASS name CLOS classes.
sentences.zh: CL:FIND-CLASS 的返回值现在是一个 CLOS 类，CL:CLASS-OF 的返回值也是如此； CL:BUILT-IN-CLASS、CL:STRUCTURE-CLASS 和 CL:STANDARD-CLASS 命名 CLOS 类。

blocks.html_en: • An interface to the MetaObject Protocol, as described in Kiczales, des Rivieres and Bobrow's "The Art of the Metaobject Protocol", MIT Press, 1991, is available from the SB-MOP package.

sentences.en: An interface to the MetaObject Protocol, as described in Kiczales, des Rivieres and Bobrow's "The Art of the Metaobject Protocol", MIT Press, 1991, is available from the SB-MOP package.

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: the SB-PCL package should now be considered a private implementation detail, and no longer a semi-private MOP interface.

sentences.en: incompatible change: the SB-PCL package should now be considered a private implementation detail, and no longer a semi-private MOP interface.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：SB-PCL 包现在应被视为私有实现细节，而不再是半私有 MOP 接口。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: due to rearrangement for threads, the control stack and binding stack are now allocated at arbitrary addresses instead of being hardcoded per-port. Users affected by this probably have to be doing advanced things with shared libraries, and will know who they are.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: due to rearrangement for threads, the control stack and binding stack are now allocated at arbitrary addresses instead of being hardcoded per-port.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：由于线程的重新排列，控制堆栈和绑定堆栈现在分配在任意地址，而不是按端口进行硬编码。

sentences.en: Users affected by this probably have to be doing advanced things with shared libraries, and will know who they are.
sentences.zh: 受此影响的用户可能必须使用共享库执行高级操作，并且知道他们是谁。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: Previously, all --eval forms used were processed with READ before any of them were processed with EVAL. Now each --eval form is processed with both READ and EVAL before the next --eval form is processed. (Thus package operations like sbcl --eval "(defpackage :foo)" --eval "(print 'foo::bar)" now work as the user might reasonably expect.)

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: Previously, all --eval forms used were processed with READ before any of them were processed with EVAL.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：以前，使用的所有 --eval 表单都先使用 READ 进行处理，然后再使用 EVAL 进行处理。

sentences.en: Now each --eval form is processed with both READ and EVAL before the next --eval form is processed.
sentences.zh: 现在，在处理下一个 --eval 表单之前，每个 --eval 表单都会使用 READ 和 EVAL 进行处理。

sentences.en: (Thus package operations like sbcl --eval "(defpackage :foo)" --eval "(print 'foo::bar)" now work as the user might reasonably expect.)
sentences.zh: （因此像 sbcl --eval "(defpackage :foo)" --eval "(print 'foo::bar)" 这样的包操作现在可以按照用户合理的预期工作。）

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • COPY-ALIST now signals an error if its argument is a dotted list.
    • Condition slots are now accessed more correctly in the presence of multiple initargs for a given slot.
    • The USE-VALUE, CONTINUE and STORE-VALUE functions now correctly exclude restarts of the same name associated with a different condition.
    • DEFCLASS of forward-referenced classes with another forward-referenced class in the superclasses list no longer causes an error.
    • Condition slots are now initialized once each, not multiple times. (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)
    • CONVERT-MORE-CALL failed on a lambda list (&KEY). (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)
    • &WHOLE and &REST arguments in macro lambda lists are patterns.
    • NSET-EXCLUSIVE-OR does not return extra elements when its arguments contain duplicated elements.
    • RESTART-CASE understands local macros.
    • RESTART-CASE associates exactly its own restarts with a condition.
    • ENDP in safe mode checks its argument to be of type LIST.
    • COPY-SYMBOL in a threaded build no longer fails when the symbol in question is unbound.
    • Optimized MAKE-INSTANCE functions no longer cause internal assertion failures in the presence of duplicate initargs.
    • SLOT-MAKUNBOUND returns the instance acted upon, not NIL.
    • Side-effectful :DEFAULT-INITARGS have their side-effects propagated even in the ctor optimized implementation of MAKE-INSTANCE.
    • :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS NIL is now accepted in an initarg list.

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: COPY-ALIST now signals an error if its argument is a dotted list.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：如果 COPY-ALIST 的参数是点列表，则现在会发出错误信号。

sentences.en: Condition slots are now accessed more correctly in the presence of multiple initargs for a given slot.
sentences.zh: 现在，在给定槽存在多个 initarg 的情况下，可以更正确地访问条件槽。

sentences.en: The USE-VALUE, CONTINUE and STORE-VALUE functions now correctly exclude restarts of the same name associated with a different condition.
sentences.zh: USE-VALUE、CONTINUE 和 STORE-VALUE 函数现在可以正确排除与不同条件关联的相同名称的重新启动。

sentences.en: DEFCLASS of forward-referenced classes with another forward-referenced class in the superclasses list no longer causes an error.
sentences.zh: 前向引用类与超类列表中的另一个前向引用类的 DEFCLASS 不再导致错误。

sentences.en: Condition slots are now initialized once each, not multiple times.
sentences.zh: 条件槽现在每次初始化一次，而不是多次。

sentences.en: (thanks to Gerd Moellmann) CONVERT-MORE-CALL failed on a lambda list (&KEY).
sentences.zh: （感谢 Gerd Moellmann）CONVERT-MORE-CALL 在 lambda 列表 (&KEY) 上失败。

sentences.en: (thanks to Gerd Moellmann) &WHOLE and &REST arguments in macro lambda lists are patterns.
sentences.zh: （感谢 Gerd Moellmann）宏 lambda 列表中的 &WHOLE 和 &REST 参数是模式。

sentences.en: NSET-EXCLUSIVE-OR does not return extra elements when its arguments contain duplicated elements.
sentences.zh: 当 NSET-EXCLUSIVE-OR 的参数包含重复元素时，不会返回额外的元素。

sentences.en: RESTART-CASE understands local macros.
sentences.zh: RESTART-CASE 理解本地宏。

sentences.en: RESTART-CASE associates exactly its own restarts with a condition.
sentences.zh: RESTART-CASE 将其自身的重新启动与条件精确关联。

sentences.en: ENDP in safe mode checks its argument to be of type LIST.
sentences.zh: 安全模式下的 ENDP 检查其参数是否为 LIST 类型。

sentences.en: COPY-SYMBOL in a threaded build no longer fails when the symbol in question is unbound.
sentences.zh: 当相关符号未绑定时，线程构建中的 COPY-SYMBOL 不再失败。

sentences.en: Optimized MAKE-INSTANCE functions no longer cause internal assertion failures in the presence of duplicate initargs.
sentences.zh: 优化的 MAKE-INSTANCE 函数在存在重复 initargs 的情况下不再导致内部断言失败。

sentences.en: SLOT-MAKUNBOUND returns the instance acted upon, not NIL.
sentences.zh: SLOT-MAKUNBOUND 返回所操作的实例，而不是 NIL。

sentences.en: Side-effectful :DEFAULT-INITARGS have their side-effects propagated even in the ctor optimized implementation of MAKE-INSTANCE. :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS NIL is now accepted in an initarg list.
sentences.zh: 副作用：即使在 MAKE-INSTANCE 的 ctor 优化实现中，DEFAULT-INITARGS 也会产生副作用。 :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS NIL 现在在 initarg 列表中被接受。

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • a bug in the CONS type specifier, whereby the CAR and CDR types got intertwined, has been fixed;
    • the type system is now able to reason about the interaction between INTEGER and RATIO types more completely;
    • APPEND, [N]REVERSE and NRECONC check that those their arguments, which must be proper lists, are really so;
    • An array specialized to be unable to hold elements has been implemented, as required -- yes, really -- by ANSI;
    • GETF and GET-PROPERTIES throw a TYPE-ERROR, not a SIMPLE-ERROR, on malformed property lists;

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: a bug in the CONS type specifier, whereby the CAR and CDR types got intertwined, has been fixed; the type system is now able to reason about the interaction between INTEGER and RATIO types more completely; APPEND, [N]REVERSE and NRECONC check that those their arguments, which must be proper lists, are really so; An array specialized to be unable to hold elements has been implemented, as required -- yes, really -- by ANSI; GETF and GET-PROPERTIES throw a TYPE-ERROR, not a SIMPLE-ERROR, on malformed property lists;

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • ARRAY-IN-BOUNDS-P now allows arbitrary integers as arguments, not just nonnegative fixnums;
    • the logical bit-array operators such as BIT-AND now accept an explicit NIL for their "opt-arg" argument (to indicate a freshly-consed result bit-array);
    • ELT now signals an error on an invalid sequence index in safe code;
    • the type system is now cleverer about negations of numeric types, and consequently understands the BIGNUM and RATIO types better;
    • the type system is now cleverer about the interaction between INTEGER and RATIO types: while bugs still remain, many more cases are accurately computed;
    • in TYPECASE, OTHERWISE now only introduces an otherwise-clause if it is in the last clause;
    • CONSTANTLY now correctly returns a side-effect-free function in all cases;
    • DECLARE is no longer treated as a special-operator; in particular, SPECIAL-OPERATOR-P no longer returns T for DECLARE;

sentences.en: fixed some bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: ARRAY-IN-BOUNDS-P now allows arbitrary integers as arguments, not just nonnegative fixnums; the logical bit-array operators such as BIT-AND now accept an explicit NIL for their "opt-arg" argument (to indicate a freshly-consed result bit-array); ELT now signals an error on an invalid sequence index in safe code; the type system is now cleverer about negations of numeric types, and consequently understands the BIGNUM and RATIO types better; the type system is now cleverer about the interaction between INTEGER and RATIO types: while bugs still remain, many more cases are accurately computed; in TYPECASE, OTHERWISE now only introduces an otherwise-clause if it is in the last clause; CONSTANTLY now correctly returns a side-effect-free function in all cases; DECLARE is no longer treated as a special-operator; in particular, SPECIAL-OPERATOR-P no longer returns T for DECLARE;
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些错误：ARRAY-IN-BOUNDS-P 现在允许任意整数作为参数，而不仅仅是非负固定数；逻辑位数组运算符（例如 BIT-AND）现在接受显式 NIL 作为其“opt-arg”参数（以指示新的结果位数组）； ELT 现在会在安全代码中的无效序列索引上发出错误信号；类型系统现在对于数字类型的否定更加聪明，因此可以更好地理解 BIGNUM 和 RATIO 类型；类型系统现在对于 INTEGER 和 RATIO 类型之间的交互更加聪明：虽然错误仍然存​​在，但可以准确计算更多情况；在 TYPECASE 中，OTHERWISE 现在仅在最后一个子句中引入 else-子句；现在在所有情况下都能正确返回无副作用的函数； DECLARE 不再被视为特殊操作符；特别是，SPECIAL-OPERATOR-P 不再为 DECLARE 返回 T；

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some LOOP bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • As required by ANSI, LOOP now disallows anonymous collection clauses such as COLLECT I in conjunction with aggregate boolean clauses such as THEREIS (= I 1);
    • LOOP now signals an error when any variable is reused in the same loop (including the potentially useful construct analogous to WITH A = 1 WITH A = (1+ A);
    • IT is only a special loop symbol within the first clause of a conditional loop clause;
    • LOOP with a typed iteration variable over a hashtable now signals a type error iff it should.

sentences.en: fixed some LOOP bugs revealed by Paul Dietz' test suite: As required by ANSI, LOOP now disallows anonymous collection clauses such as COLLECT I in conjunction with aggregate boolean clauses such as THEREIS (= I 1); LOOP now signals an error when any variable is reused in the same loop (including the potentially useful construct analogous to WITH A = 1 WITH A = (1+ A); IT is only a special loop symbol within the first clause of a conditional loop clause; LOOP with a typed iteration variable over a hashtable now signals a type error iff it should.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件揭示的一些 LOOP 错误：根据 ANSI 的要求，LOOP 现在不允许将匿名收集子句（例如 COLLECT I）与聚合布尔子句（例如 THEREIS (= I 1)）结合使用；现在，当在同一循环中重用任何变量时，LOOP 会发出错误信号（包括类似于WITH A = 1 的潜在有用结构，WITH A = (1+ A)；它只是条件循环子句的第一个子句中的特殊循环符号；在哈希表上带有类型化迭代变量的 LOOP 现在会发出类型错误信号（如果它应该发出信号）。

blocks.html_en:
• more systematization and improvement of CLOS and MOP conformance in PCL (thanks to Gerd Moellman and Pierre Mai):
    • the standard ANSI CL generic function NO-NEXT-METHOD is now implemented;
    • DEFINE-METHOD-COMBINATION no longer signals an error for primary methods with no specializers;
    • the MOP generic function GENERIC-FUNCTION-DECLARATIONS is now implemented;
    • the Readers for Class Metaobjects methods CLASS-DIRECT-SLOTS and CLASS-DIRECT-DEFAULT-INITARGS have been implemented for FORWARD-REFERENCED-CLASSes; error reporting on CLASS-DEFAULT-INITARGS, CLASS-PRECEDENCE-LIST and CLASS-SLOTS has been improved;
    • SXHASH on CLOS instances now uses a slot internal to the instance to return different numbers on distinct instances, while preserving the same return value through invocations of CHANGE-CLASS;
    • DEFMETHOD signals errors when methods with longer incongruent lambda lists are added to generic functions;
    • COMPUTE-CLASS-PRECEDENCE-LIST now has a method specialized on CLASS, as specified in AMOP;
    • COMPUTE-SLOTS :AROUND now assigns locations sequentially based on the order returned by the primary method for classes of class STANDARD-CLASS;
    • DEFINE-METHOD-COMBINATION now works with the :ARGUMENTS option.

sentences.en: more systematization and improvement of CLOS and MOP conformance in PCL (thanks to Gerd Moellman and Pierre Mai): the standard ANSI CL generic function NO-NEXT-METHOD is now implemented; DEFINE-METHOD-COMBINATION no longer signals an error for primary methods with no specializers; the MOP generic function GENERIC-FUNCTION-DECLARATIONS is now implemented; the Readers for Class Metaobjects methods CLASS-DIRECT-SLOTS and CLASS-DIRECT-DEFAULT-INITARGS have been implemented for FORWARD-REFERENCED-CLASSes; error reporting on CLASS-DEFAULT-INITARGS, CLASS-PRECEDENCE-LIST and CLASS-SLOTS has been improved; SXHASH on CLOS instances now uses a slot internal to the instance to return different numbers on distinct instances, while preserving the same return value through invocations of CHANGE-CLASS; DEFMETHOD signals errors when methods with longer incongruent lambda lists are added to generic functions; COMPUTE-CLASS-PRECEDENCE-LIST now has a method specialized on CLASS, as specified in AMOP; COMPUTE-SLOTS :AROUND now assigns locations sequentially based on the order returned by the primary method for classes of class STANDARD-CLASS; DEFINE-METHOD-COMBINATION now works with the :ARGUMENTS option.

blocks.html_en:
• fixed some bugs shown by Paul Dietz' test suite:
    • DOLIST puts its body in TAGBODY;
    • SET-EXCLUSIVE-OR sends arguments to :TEST function in the correct order;
    • MULTIPLE-VALUE-SETQ evaluates side-effectful places before value producing form;
    • if more variables are given to PROGV than values, extra variables are bound and made to have no value;
    • NSUBSTITUTE on list arguments gets the right answer with :FROM-END;
    • ELT signals an error of type TYPE-ERROR when the index argument is not a valid sequence index;
    • LOOP signals (at macroexpansion time) an error of type PROGRAM-ERROR when duplicate variable names are found;
    • LOOP supports DOWNTO and ABOVE properly; (thanks to Matthew Danish)
    • FUNCALL of special-operators now cause an error of type UNDEFINED-FUNCTION;
    • PSETQ now works as required in the presence of side-effecting symbol-macro places;
    • NCONC accepts any object as its last argument;
    • :COUNT argument to sequence functions may be BIGNUM; (thanks to Gerd Moellman)
    • loop-for-as-package does not require a package to be explicitely specified;
    • LOOP WITH now treats NIL in the d-var-spec correctly as an ignored binding.

sentences.zh: 修复了 Paul Dietz 测试套件中显示的一些错误：DOLIST 将其主体放入 TAGBODY 中； SET-EXCLUSIVE-OR 以正确的顺序将参数发送到 :TEST 函数； MULTIPLE-VALUE-SETQ 在产生价值的形式之前评估副作用的地方；如果给予 PROGV 的变量多于值，则多余的变量将被绑定并使其没有值；列表参数上的 NSUBSTITUTE 通过 :FROM-END; 得到正确的答案；当索引参数不是有效的序列索引时，ELT 发出 TYPE-ERROR 类型的错误信号；当发现重复的变量名时，LOOP 发出 PROGRAM-ERROR 类型的错误信号（在宏展开时）； LOOP 正确支持 DOWNTO 和 ABOVE； （感谢 Matthew Danish）特殊运算符的 FUNCALL 现在会导致 UNDEFINED-FUNCTION 类型的错误； PSETQ 现在可以在存在副作用符号宏位置的情况下按要求工作； NCONC 接受任何对象作为其最后一个参数； ：序列函数的 COUNT 参数可以是 BIGNUM； （感谢 Gerd Moellman）loop-for-as-package 不需要明确指定包； LOOPWITH 现在正确地将 d-var-spec 中的 NIL 视为忽略的绑定。

sentences.en: MULTIPLE-VALUE-SETQ evaluates side-effectful places before value producing form;

blocks.html_en: • NSUBSTITUTE on list arguments gets the right answer with :FROM-END;

sentences.en: NSUBSTITUTE on list arguments gets the right answer with :FROM-END;

blocks.html_en: • FUNCALL of special-operators now cause an error of type UNDEFINED-FUNCTION;

sentences.en: loop-for-as-package does not require a package to be explicitely specified;
sentences.zh: Loop-for-as-package 不需要显式指定包；

sentences.zh: LOOPWITH 现在正确地将 d-var-spec 中的 NIL 视为忽略的绑定。

sentences.en: fixed Entomotomy PEEK-CHAR-WRONGLY-ECHOS-TO-ECHO-STREAM bug.
sentences.zh: 修复了 Entomotomy PEEK-CHAR-WRONGLY-ECHOS-TO-ECHO-STREAM 错误。

sentences.en: fixed bug 136: CALL-NEXT-METHOD no longer gets confused when arguments are lexically rebound.

sentences.en: fixed bug in COUNT-IF, making it handle :FROM-END correctly (thanks to Matthew Danish)
sentences.zh: 修复了 COUNT-IF 中的错误，使其正确处理 :FROM-END （感谢 MatthewDanish）

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: The runtime (the Unix executable named "sbcl") is now much pickier about the .core files it will load. Essentially it now requires .core files to descend from the same build (not just the same sources or LISP-IMPLEMENTATION-VERSION) as the runtime does. (The intent is to prevent the crashes which can occur, and which can even be reported as mysterious failures, when people patch the sources or change the build parameters without changing LISP-IMPLEMENTATION-VERSION, then mix and match sbcl and .core files.)

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: The runtime (the Unix executable named "sbcl") is now much pickier about the .core files it will load.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的小变化：运行时（名为“sbcl”的 Unix 可执行文件）现在对其将加载的 .core 文件更加挑剔。

sentences.en: Essentially it now requires .core files to descend from the same build (not just the same sources or LISP-IMPLEMENTATION-VERSION) as the runtime does.
sentences.zh: 本质上，它现在要求 .core 文件来自与运行时相同的构建（不仅仅是相同的源或 LISP-IMPLMENTATION-VERSION）。

sentences.en: (The intent is to prevent the crashes which can occur, and which can even be reported as mysterious failures, when people patch the sources or change the build parameters without changing LISP-IMPLEMENTATION-VERSION, then mix and match sbcl and .core files.)
sentences.zh: （目的是防止当人们在不更改 LISP-IMPLMENTATION-VERSION 的情况下修补源代码或更改构建参数，然后混合并匹配 sbcl 和 .core 文件时可能发生的崩溃，甚至可能被报告为神秘故障。）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: VALUES-LIST is no longer optimized away.

sentences.en: fixed bug: VALUES-LIST is no longer optimized away.
sentences.zh: 修复错误：VALUES-LIST 不再优化。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 142: The FFI conversion of C string values to Lisp string values no longer conses excessively. (thanks to Nathan Froyd porting Raymond Toy's fix to CMU CL)

sentences.en: fixed bug 142: The FFI conversion of C string values to Lisp string values no longer conses excessively.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 142：C 字符串值到 Lisp 字符串值的 FFI 转换不再过于简洁。

sentences.en: (thanks to Nathan Froyd porting Raymond Toy's fix to CMU CL)
sentences.zh: （感谢 Nathan Floyd 将 Raymond Toy 的修复程序移植到 CMU CL）

blocks.html_en:
• began to systematize and improve MOP conformance in PCL (thanks to Nathan Froyd, Gerd Moellman and Pierre Mai):
    • SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION now returns :CLASS, not the class itself;
    • GENERIC-FUNCTION-ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER is now implemented;
    • FINALIZE-INHERITANCE is now called on class finalization;
    • DOCUMENTATION and (SETF DOCUMENTATION) now have the correct argument precedence order.

sentences.en: began to systematize and improve MOP conformance in PCL (thanks to Nathan Froyd, Gerd Moellman and Pierre Mai): SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION now returns :CLASS, not the class itself; GENERIC-FUNCTION-ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER is now implemented; FINALIZE-INHERITANCE is now called on class finalization; DOCUMENTATION and (SETF DOCUMENTATION) now have the correct argument precedence order.
sentences.zh: 开始系统化并改进 PCL 中的 MOP 一致性（感谢 Nathan Froyd、Gerd Moellman 和 Pierre Mai）：SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION 现在返回 :CLASS，而不是类本身；通用函数参数优先顺序现已实现；现在在类终结时调用 FINALIZE-INHERITANCE； DOCUMENTATION 和 (SETF DOCUMENTATION) 现在具有正确的参数优先顺序。

blocks.html_en: • SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION now returns :CLASS, not the class itself;

sentences.en: SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION now returns :CLASS, not the class itself;
sentences.zh: SLOT-DEFINITION-ALLOCATION 现在返回 :CLASS，而不是类本身；

blocks.html_en: • GENERIC-FUNCTION-ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER is now implemented;

sentences.en: GENERIC-FUNCTION-ARGUMENT-PRECEDENCE-ORDER is now implemented;
sentences.zh: 通用函数参数优先顺序现已实现；

blocks.html_en: • FINALIZE-INHERITANCE is now called on class finalization;

sentences.en: FINALIZE-INHERITANCE is now called on class finalization;
sentences.zh: 现在在类终结时调用 FINALIZE-INHERITANCE；

blocks.html_en: • DOCUMENTATION and (SETF DOCUMENTATION) now have the correct argument precedence order.

sentences.en: DOCUMENTATION and (SETF DOCUMENTATION) now have the correct argument precedence order.
sentences.zh: DOCUMENTATION 和 (SETF DOCUMENTATION) 现在具有正确的参数优先顺序。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 202: The compiler no longer fails on functions whose derived types contradict their declared type.

sentences.en: fixed bug 202: The compiler no longer fails on functions whose derived types contradict their declared type.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 202：对于派生类型与声明类型相矛盾的函数，编译器不再失败。

sentences.en: fixed bug 48c: SYMBOL-MACROLET signals PROGRAM-ERROR when an introduced symbol is DECLAREd to be SPECIAL.

sentences.en: fixed bug: :ALLOW-OTHER-KEYS is an allowed keyword name

blocks.html_en: • A beta-quality port to the mips architecture running Linux, based on the old CMUCL backend, has been made. It has been tested on a big-endian kernel, and works sufficiently well to be able to rebuild itself; it has not been tested in little-endian mode.

sentences.en: A beta-quality port to the mips architecture running Linux, based on the old CMUCL backend, has been made.
sentences.zh: 基于旧的 CMUCL 后端，针对运行 Linux 的 mips 架构的 beta 质量移植已经完成。

sentences.en: It has been tested on a big-endian kernel, and works sufficiently well to be able to rebuild itself; it has not been tested in little-endian mode.
sentences.zh: 它已经在大端内核上进行了测试，并且工作得足够好，能够自我重建；它尚未在小端模式下进行测试。

blocks.html_en: • fixed an inconsistency between gencgc.c and purify.c which made dumping/loading .core files unreliable

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 120a: The compiler now deals correctly with IFs where the consequent is the same as the alternative, instead of misderiving the return type. (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)

sentences.en: fixed bug 120a: The compiler now deals correctly with IFs where the consequent is the same as the alternative, instead of misderiving the return type.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 120a：编译器现在可以正确处理 IF，其中结果与替代项相同，而不是错误地推导返回类型。

sentences.en: (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿列克谢·德伊内卡）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 113: Logical pathnames are now dumpable (the logical host is resolved at load-time, throwing an error if it is not found).

sentences.en: fixed bug 113: Logical pathnames are now dumpable (the logical host is resolved at load-time, throwing an error if it is not found).
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 113：逻辑路径名现在是可转储的（逻辑主机在加载时解析，如果未找到则抛​​出错误）。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 174: FORMAT's error message is slightly clearer when a non-printing character is used in a format directive.

sentences.en: fixed bug 174: FORMAT's error message is slightly clearer when a non-printing character is used in a format directive.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 174：当格式指令中使用非打印字符时，FORMAT 的错误消息稍微清晰一些。

sentences.en: fixed several bugs in compiler checking of type declarations, i.e. violations of the Python "declarations are assertions" principle (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)

blocks.html_en: • fixed several bugs in PCL's error checking (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)

sentences.en: fixed several bugs in PCL's error checking (thanks to Gerd Moellmann)

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug: printing of FILE-ERROR (thanks to Antonio Martinez-Shotton)

sentences.en: fixed bug: printing of FILE-ERROR (thanks to Antonio Martinez-Shotton)

blocks.html_en: • The compiler's handling TYPE-ERRORs which it can prove will inevitably happen at runtime has been cleaned up and corrected in several ways. (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)

sentences.en: The compiler's handling TYPE-ERRORs which it can prove will inevitably happen at runtime has been cleaned up and corrected in several ways.
sentences.zh: 编译器对类型错误（它可以证明在运行时不可避免地发生）的处理已通过多种方式进行清理和纠正。

sentences.en: (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)
sentences.zh: （感谢阿列克谢·德伊内卡）

blocks.html_en: • improved argument type checking for various basic arithmetic operations (MAX, +, LOGXOR, etc.) which have had so much TLC lavished on them in the past that they can be compiled in many ways in different special cases

sentences.en: improved argument type checking for various basic arithmetic operations (MAX, +, LOGXOR, etc.) which have had so much TLC lavished on them in the past that they can be compiled in many ways in different special cases
sentences.zh: 改进了对各种基本算术运算（MAX、+、LOGXOR 等）的参数类型检查，过去在这些算术运算上投入了大量的 TLC，因此可以在不同的特殊情况下以多种方式编译它们

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 181: compiler checks validity of user supplied type specifiers

sentences.en: fixed bug 181: compiler checks validity of user supplied type specifiers
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 181：编译器检查用户提供的类型说明符的有效性

blocks.html_en: • cleaned up code flushing in optimization: Function calls which should signal errors for safety purposes (e.g. which ANSI says should signal errors when their arguments are of incorrect type) are no longer optimized away.

sentences.en: cleaned up code flushing in optimization: Function calls which should signal errors for safety purposes (e.g. which ANSI says should signal errors when their arguments are of incorrect type) are no longer optimized away.
sentences.zh: 清理优化中的代码刷新：出于安全目的应发出错误信号的函数调用（例如 ANSI 规定，当其参数类型不正确时应发出错误信号）的函数调用不再被优化掉。

blocks.html_en: • added new extension: SB-DEBUG:BACKTRACE-AS-LIST

sentences.en: added new extension: SB-DEBUG:BACKTRACE-AS-LIST
sentences.zh: 添加了新扩展：SB-DEBUG:BACKTRACE-AS-LIST

blocks.html_en: • incremented fasl file version number, because changes in the implementation of sequence functions like COERCE caused internal utility functions like COERCE-TO-SIMPLE-VECTOR (used in old inline expansions) to become undefined. (Actually these changes were later undone, so we might very well be binary compatible with 0.7.7 after all, but leaving the version number incremented seemed like the simplest and most conservative thing to do.)

sentences.en: incremented fasl file version number, because changes in the implementation of sequence functions like COERCE caused internal utility functions like COERCE-TO-SIMPLE-VECTOR (used in old inline expansions) to become undefined.
sentences.zh: 增加了 fasl 文件版本号，因为 COERCE 等序列函数的实现发生变化导致 COERCE-TO-SIMPLE-VECTOR（用于旧的内联扩展）等内部实用函数变得未定义。

sentences.en: (Actually these changes were later undone, so we might very well be binary compatible with 0.7.7 after all, but leaving the version number incremented seemed like the simplest and most conservative thing to do.)
sentences.zh: （实际上这些更改后来被撤消了，所以我们很可能最终与 0.7.7 进行二进制兼容，但让版本号递增似乎是最简单和最保守的事情。）

blocks.html_en: • An alpha-quality port to the parisc architecture running Linux, based on the old CMUCL backend, has been made. This, even more so than the other backends, should be considered still a work in progress; known problems include that the Linux kernel in 64-bit mode does not propagate the correct sigcontext structure to userspace, and consequently SBCL on a parisc64 kernel will not work yet.

sentences.en: An alpha-quality port to the parisc architecture running Linux, based on the old CMUCL backend, has been made.
sentences.zh: 基于旧的 CMUCL 后端，针对运行 Linux 的 parisc 架构的 alpha 质量移植已经完成。

sentences.en: This, even more so than the other backends, should be considered still a work in progress; known problems include that the Linux kernel in 64-bit mode does not propagate the correct sigcontext structure to userspace, and consequently SBCL on a parisc64 kernel will not work yet.
sentences.zh: 与其他后端相比，这更应该被视为仍在进行中；已知问题包括 64 位模式下的 Linux 内核不会将正确的 sigcontext 结构传播到用户空间，因此 parisc64 内核上的 SBCL 尚无法工作。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 189: The compiler now respects NOTINLINE declarations for functions declared in FLET and LABELS. (I.e. "LET conversion" is suppressed.) Also now that the compiler is looking at declarations in the environment, it checks optimization declarations as well, and suppresses inlining when (> DEBUG SPEED).

sentences.en: fixed bug 189: The compiler now respects NOTINLINE declarations for functions declared in FLET and LABELS.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 189：编译器现在支持在 FLET 和 LABELS 中声明的函数的 NOTINLINE 声明。

sentences.en: (I.e.
sentences.zh: （IE。

sentences.en: "LET conversion" is suppressed.)
sentences.zh: “LET 转换”被抑制。）

sentences.en: Also now that the compiler is looking at declarations in the environment, it checks optimization declarations as well, and suppresses inlining when (> DEBUG SPEED).
sentences.zh: 此外，现在编译器正在查看环境中的声明，它也会检查优化声明，并在 (> DEBUG SPEED) 时抑制内联。

blocks.html_en: • More fixes have been made to treatment of floating point exception treatment and other Unix signals. In particular, floating point exceptions no longer cause Bus errors on the SPARC/Linux platform.

sentences.en: More fixes have been made to treatment of floating point exception treatment and other Unix signals.
sentences.zh: 对浮点异常处理和其他 Unix 信号的处理进行了更多修复。

sentences.en: In particular, floating point exceptions no longer cause Bus errors on the SPARC/Linux platform.
sentences.zh: 特别是，浮点异常不再导致 SPARC/Linux 平台上的总线错误。

blocks.html_en: • The detection and handling of control stack exhaustion (infinite or very deeply nested recursion) has changed. Stack exhaustion detection is now done by write-protecting pages at the OS level and applies at all optimization settings; when found, a SB-KERNEL:CONTROL-STACK-EXHAUSTED condition (subclass of STORAGE-CONDITION) is signalled, so stack exhaustion can no longer be caught using IGNORE-ERRORS.

sentences.en: The detection and handling of control stack exhaustion (infinite or very deeply nested recursion) has changed.
sentences.zh: 控制堆栈耗尽（无限或非常深的嵌套递归）的检测和处理已发生变化。

sentences.en: Stack exhaustion detection is now done by write-protecting pages at the OS level and applies at all optimization settings; when found, a SB-KERNEL:CONTROL-STACK-EXHAUSTED condition (subclass of STORAGE-CONDITION) is signalled, so stack exhaustion can no longer be caught using IGNORE-ERRORS.
sentences.zh: 堆栈耗尽检测现在通过操作系统级别的写保护页面来完成，并适用于所有优化设置；当找到时，会发出 SB-KERNEL:CONTROL-STACK-EXHAUSTED 条件（STORAGE-CONDITION 的子类）信号，因此无法再使用 IGNORE-ERRORS 捕获堆栈耗尽。

blocks.html_en: • Bugs 65, 70, and 109 fixed: The compiler now preserves invariants correctly when transforming recursive LABELS functions to LETs. (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)

sentences.en: (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)

blocks.html_en: • Minor incompatible change: COMPILE-FILE-PATHNAME now merges its OUTPUT-FILE argument with its INPUT-FILE argument, resulting in behaviour analogous to RENAME-FILE. This puts its behaviour more in line with ANSI's wording on COMPILE-FILE-PATHNAME. (thanks to Marco Antinotti)

blocks.html_en: • A very ugly but hopefully complete draft of the missing FFI chapter of the manual has been created by reformatting the corresponding CMU CL manual chapter into (currently very ugly and incoherent) DocBook and bringing it up to date for SBCL behavior. Thus, the manual is now essentially complete, at least by my extreme once-and-only-once standards, whereby it's acceptable to refer to the doc strings of SB-EXT functions as the primary documentation.

sentences.en: A very ugly but hopefully complete draft of the missing FFI chapter of the manual has been created by reformatting the corresponding CMU CL manual chapter into (currently very ugly and incoherent) DocBook and bringing it up to date for SBCL behavior.
sentences.zh: 通过将相应的 CMU CL 手册章节重新格式化为（目前非常丑陋且不连贯）DocBook 并使其针对 SBCL 行为进行更新，已创建了手册中缺失的 FFI 章节的非常丑陋但希望完整的草案。

sentences.en: Thus, the manual is now essentially complete, at least by my extreme once-and-only-once standards, whereby it's acceptable to refer to the doc strings of SB-EXT functions as the primary documentation.
sentences.zh: 因此，至少按照我极端的一次且仅一次的标准，该手册现在基本上已经完成，因此可以将 SB-EXT 函数的文档字符串引用为主要文档。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: The --noprogrammer option is deprecated in favor of the new --disable-debugger option, which is very similar. (The major difference is that it takes effect at a slightly different time at startup, causing handling of errors in --sysinit and --userinit files will be affected differently.) The SB-EXT:DISABLE-DEBUGGER and SB-EXT:ENABLE-DEBUGGER functions have been added to allow this functionality to be controlled from ordinary Lisp code. (ENABLE-DEBUGGER should help people like the Debian maintainers, who might want to run non-interactive scripts to build SBCL cores which will later be used interactively.)

sentences.zh: 添加了 SB-EXT:DISABLE-DEBUGGER 和 SB-EXT:ENABLE-DEBUGGER 函数，以允许从普通 Lisp 代码控制此功能。

sentences.en: (ENABLE-DEBUGGER should help people like the Debian maintainers, who might want to run non-interactive scripts to build SBCL cores which will later be used interactively.)
sentences.zh: （ENABLE-DEBUGGER 应该可以帮助像 Debian 维护者这样的人，他们可能想要运行非交互式脚本来构建 SBCL 核心，这些核心稍后将交互使用。）

blocks.html_en:
• bug fixes:
    • The system now detects stack overflow and handles it gracefully, at least for (OR (> SAFETY (MAX SPEED SPACE)) (= SAFETY 3)) optimization settings. (This is a good thing in general, and its introduction in this version should be particularly timely for anyone whose code fails because of suppression of tail recursion!)
    • The system now hunts for the C variable "environ" in a more devious way, to avoid segfaults when the C library version differs between compile time and run time. (thanks to Christophe Rhodes)
    • INTEGER-valued CATCH tags now work. (thanks to Alexey Dejneka, and also to Christophe Rhodes for porting the fix to non-X86 CPUs)
    • The compiler no longer issues bogus style warnings for undefined classes in the same source file as the DEFCLASSes which defined them. (thanks to Stig E Sandoe for reporting and Martin Atzmueller for fixing this)
    • fixes in CONDITION class precedence list for undefined function errors (thanks to Alexei Dejneka)
    • *DEFAULT-PATHNAME-DEFAULTS* is used more consistently and correctly. (thanks to Dan Barlow)
    • portability fixes aiming at bootstrapping under CLISP (thanks to Dave McDonald and Christophe Rhodes)
    • FORMAT fixes (thanks to Robert Strandh and Dan Barlow)
    • fixes in type translation and and type inference (thanks to Christophe Rhodes)
    • fixes to optimizer internal errors (thanks to Alexei Dejneka)
    • various fixes in the new ports (thanks to Dan Barlow)

blocks.html_en:
• mostly bug fixes:
    • SB-ALIEN:LOAD-FOREIGN and SB-ALIEN:LOAD-1-FOREIGN are set up properly again. (There was a packaging bug in 0.7.0 which left their definitions in SB-SYS::LOAD-FOREIGN and SB-SYS::LOAD-1-FOREIGN. LOAD-FOREIGN and LOAD-1-FOREIGN are vital for most things which interface to C-level interfaces, like extensions working with sockets or databases or Perl-compatible regexes or whatever, and the need to fix this bug is the main reason that 0.7.1 was released so soon after 0.7.0.)
    • DEFGENERIC is now choosier about the methods it redefines, so that reLOADing a previously-LOADed file containing DEFGENERICs does the right thing now. Thus, the Lispy edit/reLOAD-a-little/test cycle now works as it should. (thanks to Alexey Dejneka)

blocks.html_en:
• compiler changes:
    • There are many changes in the implementation of the compiler. SBCL is now essentially a compiler-only implementation of ANSI Common Lisp. EVAL still "interprets" a few special cases, but almost all the interesting cases are handled by creating a LAMBDA expression, calling COMPILE on it, then calling FUNCALL on the result.
    • The EVAL-WHEN code has been rewritten to be ANSI-compliant, and various related bugs (IR1-1, IR1-2, IR1-3, IR1-3a) have gone away. Since the code is newer, there might still be some new bugs (though not as many as before Martin Atzmueller's fixes:-). But the new code is substantially simpler and clearer, and hopefully any remaining bugs will be simpler, less fundamental, and more fixable then the bugs in the old code.
    • The revised compiler is still a little unsteady on its feet. In particular,
      • The debugging information it produces (particularly the names of FUNCTION objects) is sometimes much less useful than what the old compiler produced.
      • The support for inlining FOO when you (DECLAIM (INLINE FOO)) then do (DEFUN FOO ..) in a non-null lexical environment (e.g. within a MACROLET) has been temporarily weakened.
    • There are new compiler optimizations for various functions:
      • the sequence functions FIND, POSITION, FIND-IF, POSITION-IF, FIND-IF-NOT, POSITION-IF-NOT, and FILL
      • the math functions TRUNCATE, FLOOR, and CEILING
      • the function-of-all-trades COERCE Mostly these should be transparent, but there's one potentially-annoying problem (bug 117): when the compiler inline-expands a function and does type analysis on the result, it can create control paths which have type mismatches, and when it can't prove that those control paths aren't taken, it will issue WARNINGs about the type mismatches. This is a particular problem in practice for the new sequence functions. It's not clear how this should be fixed, and for now, a workaround is given in the entry for 117 in the BUGS file.
    • (Because of the interaction between the two previous items -- occasional inlining problems and new inline expansions -- some of the new sequence function optimizations won't really kick in completely until debugging information, and then inlining, are straightened out in some future version.)
