blocks.html_en:
• minor incompatible changes:
    • As part of a bug fix by Christophe Rhodes to DIRECTORY behavior, DIRECTORY no longer implicitly promotes NIL slots of its pathname argument to :WILD. In particular, when you ask for the contents of a directory (which you used to be able to do without explicit wildcards, e.g. (DIRECTORY "/tmp/")) you now need to use explicit wildcards, e.g. (DIRECTORY "/tmp/*.*").
    • changes in behavior that ANSI explicitly defines to be implementation dependent:
      • The new compiler-only implementation still conforms with ANSI, but acts a little different than before. Besides the obvious changes in performance tradeoffs (that the cost per form passed to EVAL has gone up, and the cost per form executed by EVAL has gone down), the behavior of the system changes a little because there are no longer any interpreted function objects. COMPILED-FUNCTION-P is now synonymous with FUNCTIONP, and e.g. doing COMPILE on the output of interactive DEFUN is now a no-op.
      • The value of INTERNAL-TIME-UNITS-PER-SECOND has been increased from 100 to 1000.
      • The default for the USE list in MAKE-PACKAGE and DEFPACKAGE has changed from (:CL) to NIL.
      • The CHAR-NAME of unprintable ASCII characters which, unlike e.g. #\Newline and #\Tab, don't have names specified in the ANSI Common Lisp standard, is now based on their ASCII symbolic names (#\Nul, #\Soh, #\Stx, etc.) The old CMU-CL-style names (#\Null, #\^a, #\^b, etc.) are still accepted by NAME-CHAR, but are no longer used for output.
    • changes in internal implementation constants:
      • The default value of *BYTES-CONSED-BETWEEN-GCS* has doubled, to 4 million. (If your application spends a lot of time GCing and you have a lot of RAM, you might want to experiment with increasing it even more.)
    • The SB-C-CALL package has been merged into the SB-ALIEN package. However, almost all old code should still continue to work without immediate update, as SB-C-CALL is now a (deprecated) nickname for SB-ALIEN.
    • Old operator names in the style DEF-FOO are now deprecated in favor of new corresponding names DEFINE-FOO, for consistency with the naming convention used in the ANSI standard (DEFSTRUCT, DEFVAR, DEFINE-CONDITION, DEFINE-MODIFY-MACRO..). This mostly affects internal symbols, but a few supported extensions like SB-ALIEN:DEF-ALIEN-FUNCTION are also affected. (So e.g. DEF-ALIEN-FUNCTION becomes DEFINE-ALIEN-FUNCTION.)
    • The debugger prompt sequence now goes "5]", "5[2]", "5[3]", etc. as you get deeper into recursive calls to the debugger command loop, instead of the old "5]", "5]]", "5]]]" sequence. (I was motivated to do this when squabbles between ILISP and SBCL left me very deeply nested in the debugger. In the short term, this change will probably provoke more ILISP/SBCL squabbles, but hopefully it will be an improvement in the long run.)

blocks.html_en:
• many other bug fixes
    • DEFSTRUCT and DEFCLASS have been substantially updated to take advantage of the new EVAL-WHEN stuff and to clean them up in general, and they are now more ANSI-compliant in a number of ways. Martin Atzmueller is responsible for a lot of this.
    • Besides the cleanups discussed above, Martin Atzmueller fixed several other bugs:
      • fixes in READ-SEQUENCE and WRITE-SEQUENCE
      • correct ERROR type for various file operations
      • some fixes for Lisp streams
      • DEFMETHOD syntax checking
      • changing old weird representation of debug information as strings (which, among their other deficiencies, don't transform correctly when you rename packages, and don't change their print representation when you change things like *PACKAGE* and *PRINT-LENGTH*) to symbols and lists of symbols He also made several improvements and fixed several bugs in DESCRIBE.
    • Alexey Dejneka fixed many bugs, including classic bugs and bugs he discovered himself:
      • misbehavior of WRITE-STRING/WRITE-LINE
      • LOOP over keys of a hash table, LOOP bugs 49b and 81 and 103, and several other LOOP problems as well
      • DIRECTORY when similar filenames are present
      • DEFGENERIC with :METHOD options
      • bug 126, in (MAKE-STRING N :INITIAL-ELEMENT #\SPACE))
      • bug in the optimization of ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE
      • argument ordering in FIND with :TEST option
      • mishandled package designator argument in APROPOS-LIST
      • various problems in the backquote readmacro
      • a bug in APROPOS
      • probably some others that I'm not describing very well here, since the CVS log documents them by reference to sbcl-devel messages, and the SourceForge archives aren't working well.:-(
    • Dan Barlow improved the Alpha port (and is making progress on the PPC port, for those of you who think different).
    • Besides the DIRECTORY fixes and changes mentioned elsewhere, Christophe Rhodes cleaned up the system self-test scripts (in tests/*), contributed the optimization of FIND-IF-NOT and POSITION-IF-NOT, and continues to work on the SPARC port (for those of you in a position to look down upon our little PC-compatible boxes from a great height).
    • PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK now copies the *PRINT-LINES* value on entry and uses that copy, rather than the current dynamic value, when it's trying to decide whether to truncate output. Thus e.g. (let ((*print-lines* 50)) (pprint-logical-block (stream nil) (dotimes (i 10) (let ((*print-lines* 8)) (print (aref possiblybigthings i) stream))))) should now truncate the logical block only at 50 lines, instead of often truncating it at 8 lines, as it did before.

sentences.zh: 马丁·阿茨穆勒对此负有很大责任。

blocks.html_en: • Pathnames and *DEFAULT-DIRECTORY-DEFAULTS* are much more ANSI-compliant, thanks to various fixes and tests from Dan Barlow. Also, at Dan Barlow's suggestion, TRUENAME on a dangling symbolic link now returns the dangling link itself, and for similar reasons, TRUENAME on a cyclic symbolic link returns the cyclic link itself. (In these cases the old code signalled an error and looped endlessly, respectively.) Thus, DIRECTORY now works even in the presence of dangling and cyclic symbolic links.

sentences.en: Pathnames and *DEFAULT-DIRECTORY-DEFAULTS* are much more ANSI-compliant, thanks to various fixes and tests from Dan Barlow.
sentences.zh: 由于 Dan Barlow 的各种修复和测试，路径名和 *DEFAULT-DIRECTORY-DEFAULTS* 更加符合 ANSI 标准。

sentences.en: Also, at Dan Barlow's suggestion, TRUENAME on a dangling symbolic link now returns the dangling link itself, and for similar reasons, TRUENAME on a cyclic symbolic link returns the cyclic link itself.
sentences.zh: 另外，根据 Dan Barlow 的建议，悬空符号链接上的 TRUENAME 现在返回悬空链接本身，并且出于类似的原因，循环符号链接上的 TRUENAME 返回循环链接本身。

sentences.en: (In these cases the old code signalled an error and looped endlessly, respectively.)
sentences.zh: （在这些情况下，旧代码分别发出错误信号并无限循环。）

sentences.zh: 因此，DIRECTORY 现在即使存在悬空和循环符号链接也可以工作。

blocks.html_en: • Compiler trace output (the :TRACE-FILE option to COMPILE-FILE) is now a supported extension again, since the consensus on sbcl-devel was that it can be useful for ordinary development work, not just for debugging SBCL itself.

sentences.zh: 编译器跟踪输出（COMPILE-FILE 的 :TRACE-FILE 选项）现在再次成为受支持的扩展，因为 sbcl-devel 的共识是它可用于普通开发工作，而不仅仅是调试 SBCL 本身。

blocks.html_en: • The default for SB-EXT:*DERIVE-FUNCTION-TYPES* has changed to NIL, i.e. ANSI behavior, i.e. the compiler now recognizes that currently-defined functions might be redefined later with different return types.

sentences.en: The default for SB-EXT:*DERIVE-FUNCTION-TYPES* has changed to NIL, i.e. ANSI behavior, i.e. the compiler now recognizes that currently-defined functions might be redefined later with different return types.
sentences.zh: SB-EXT:*DERIVE-FUNCTION-TYPES* 的默认值已更改为 NIL，即 ANSI 行为，即编译器现在认识到当前定义的函数可能会在以后使用不同的返回类型重新定义。

blocks.html_en: • Hash tables can be printed readably, as inspired by CMU CL code of Eric Marsden and SBCL code of Martin Atzmueller.

sentences.en: Hash tables can be printed readably, as inspired by CMU CL code of Eric Marsden and SBCL code of Martin Atzmueller.
sentences.zh: 受 Eric Marsden 的 CMU CL 代码和 Martin Atzmueller 的 SBCL 代码的启发，哈希表可以可读地打印。

blocks.html_en: • better error handling in CLOS method combination, thanks to Martin Atzmueller porting Pierre Mai's CMU CL patches

sentences.en: better error handling in CLOS method combination, thanks to Martin Atzmueller porting Pierre Mai's CMU CL patches
sentences.zh: 由于 Martin Atzmueller 移植了 Pierre Mai 的 CMU CL 补丁，CLOS 方法组合中的错误处理得到了更好的处理

blocks.html_en: • more overflow fixes for >16Mbyte I/O buffers

sentences.en: more overflow fixes for >16Mbyte I/O buffers
sentences.zh: 针对 >16Mbyte I/O 缓冲区的更多溢出修复

blocks.html_en: • A bug in READ has been fixed, so that now a single Ctrl-D character suffices to cause end-of-file on character streams. In particular, now you only need one Ctrl-D at the command line (not two) to exit SBCL.

sentences.en: A bug in READ has been fixed, so that now a single Ctrl-D character suffices to cause end-of-file on character streams.
sentences.zh: READ 中的一个错误已得到修复，因此现在单个 Ctrl-D 字符足以导致字符流上的文件结束。

sentences.en: In particular, now you only need one Ctrl-D at the command line (not two) to exit SBCL.
sentences.zh: 特别是，现在您只需在命令行中按一次 Ctrl-D（而不是两次）即可退出 SBCL。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 26: ARRAY-DISPLACEMENT now returns (VALUES NIL 0) for undisplaced arrays.

sentences.en: fixed bug 26: ARRAY-DISPLACEMENT now returns (VALUES NIL 0) for undisplaced arrays.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 26：对于未移位的数组，ARRAY-DISPLACMENT 现在返回 (VALUES NIL 0)。

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 107 (reported as a CMU CL bug by Erik Naggum on comp.lang.lisp 2001-06-11): (WRITE #*101 :RADIX T :BASE 36) now does the right thing.

sentences.en: fixed bug 107 (reported as a CMU CL bug by Erik Naggum on comp.lang.lisp 2001-06-11): (WRITE #*101 :RADIX T :BASE 36) now does the right thing.
sentences.zh: 修复了 bug 107（Erik Naggum 在 comp.lang.lisp 2001-06-11 上报告为 CMU CL bug）：(WRITE #*101 :RADIX T :BASE 36) 现在做了正确的事情。

blocks.html_en: • The implementation of some type tests, especially for CONDITION types, is now tidier and maybe faster, due to CMU CL code originally by Douglas Crosher, ported by Martin Atzmueller.

sentences.en: The implementation of some type tests, especially for CONDITION types, is now tidier and maybe faster, due to CMU CL code originally by Douglas Crosher, ported by Martin Atzmueller.
sentences.zh: 由于最初由 Douglas Crosher 编写、由 Martin Atzmueller 移植的 CMU CL 代码，某些类型测试（尤其是 CONDITION 类型）的实现现在更加整洁，甚至可能更快。

blocks.html_en: • Some math functions have been fixed, and there are new optimizers for deriving the types of COERCE and ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE, thanks to Raymond Toy's work on CMU CL, ported by Martin Atzmueller.

sentences.en: Some math functions have been fixed, and there are new optimizers for deriving the types of COERCE and ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE, thanks to Raymond Toy's work on CMU CL, ported by Martin Atzmueller.
sentences.zh: 一些数学函数已得到修复，并且有新的优化器用于派生 COERCE 和 ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE 类型，这要归功于 Raymond Toy 在 CMU CL 上的工作（由 Martin Atzmueller 移植）。

blocks.html_en: • (There are also some new optimizers in contrib/*-extras.lisp. Those aren't built into sbcl-0.6.13, but are a sneak preview of what's likely to be built into sbcl-0.7.0.)

sentences.en: (There are also some new optimizers in contrib/*-extras.lisp.
sentences.zh: （contrib/*-extras.lisp 中还有一些新的优化器。

sentences.en: Those aren't built into sbcl-0.6.13, but are a sneak preview of what's likely to be built into sbcl-0.7.0.)
sentences.zh: 这些未内置于 sbcl-0.6.13 中，但可以预览 sbcl-0.7.0 中可能内置的内容。）

blocks.html_en: • A bug in COPY-READTABLE was fixed. (Joao Cachopo's patch to CMU CL, ported to SBCL by Martin Atzmueller)

sentences.en: A bug in COPY-READTABLE was fixed.
sentences.zh: 修复了 COPY-READTABLE 中的错误。

sentences.en: (Joao Cachopo's patch to CMU CL, ported to SBCL by Martin Atzmueller)
sentences.zh: （Joao Cachopo 的 CMU CL 补丁，由 Martin Atzmueller 移植到 SBCL）

blocks.html_en: • DESCRIBE now gives more information in some cases. (Pierre Mai's patch to CMU CL, ported to SBCL by Martin Atzmueller)

sentences.en: DESCRIBE now gives more information in some cases.
sentences.zh: DESCRIBE 现在在某些情况下提供更多信息。

sentences.en: (Pierre Mai's patch to CMU CL, ported to SBCL by Martin Atzmueller)
sentences.zh: （Pierre Mai 的 CMU CL 补丁，由 Martin Atzmueller 移植到 SBCL）

blocks.html_en: • Martin Atzmueller and Bill Newman fixed some bugs in INSPECT.

sentences.en: Martin Atzmueller and Bill Newman fixed some bugs in INSPECT.
sentences.zh: Martin Atzmueller 和 Bill Newman 修复了 INSPECT 中的一些错误。

blocks.html_en: • There's a new slam.sh hack to shorten the edit/compile/debug cycle for low-level changes to SBCL itself, and a new :SB-AFTER-XC-CORE target feature to control the generation of the after-xc.core file needed by slam.sh.

sentences.en: There's a new slam.sh hack to shorten the edit/compile/debug cycle for low-level changes to SBCL itself, and a new :SB-AFTER-XC-CORE target feature to control the generation of the after-xc.core file needed by slam.sh.
sentences.zh: 有一个新的 slam.sh hack 可以缩短对 SBCL 本身进行低级更改的编辑/编译/调试周期，还有一个新的 :SB-AFTER-XC-CORE 目标功能可以控制 slam.sh 所需的 after-xc.core 文件的生成。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: The ENTRY-POINTS &KEY argument to COMPILE-FILE is no longer supported, so that now every function gets an entry point, so that block compilation looks a little more like the plain vanilla ANSI section 3.2.2.3 scheme.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: The ENTRY-POINTS &KEY argument to COMPILE-FILE is no longer supported, so that now every function gets an entry point, so that block compilation looks a little more like the plain vanilla ANSI section 3.2.2.3 scheme.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：不再支持 COMPILE-FILE 的 ENTRY-POINTS &KEY 参数，因此现在每个函数都有一个入口点，因此块编译看起来更像普通的 ANSI 第 3.2.2.3 节方案。

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: SB-EXT:GET-BYTES-CONSED now returns the number of bytes consed since the system started, rather than the number consed since the first time the function was called. (The new definition parallels ANSI functions like CL:GET-INTERNAL-RUN-TIME.)

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: SB-EXT:GET-BYTES-CONSED now returns the number of bytes consed since the system started, rather than the number consed since the first time the function was called.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：SB-EXT:GET-BYTES-CONSED 现在返回自系统启动以来所消耗的字节数，而不是自第一次调用该函数以来所消耗的字节数。

sentences.en: (The new definition parallels ANSI functions like CL:GET-INTERNAL-RUN-TIME.)
sentences.zh: （新定义与 CL:GET-INTERNAL-RUN-TIME 等 ANSI 函数类似。）

blocks.html_en: • minor incompatible change: The old CMU-CL-style DIRECTORY options, i.e. :ALL, :FOLLOW-LINKS, and :CHECK-FOR-SUBDIRS, are no longer supported. Now DIRECTORY always does the abstract Common-Lisp-y thing, i.e. :ALL T :FOLLOW-LINKS T :CHECK-FOR-SUBDIRS T.

sentences.en: minor incompatible change: The old CMU-CL-style DIRECTORY options, i.e. :ALL, :FOLLOW-LINKS, and :CHECK-FOR-SUBDIRS, are no longer supported.
sentences.zh: 较小的不兼容更改：不再支持旧的 CMU-CL 样式 DIRECTORY 选项，即 :ALL、:FOLLOW-LINKS 和 :CHECK-FOR-SUBDIRS。

sentences.en: Now DIRECTORY always does the abstract Common-Lisp-y thing, i.e. :ALL T :FOLLOW-LINKS T :CHECK-FOR-SUBDIRS T.
sentences.zh: 现在 DIRECTORY 总是做抽象的 Common-Lisp-y 事情，即 :ALL T :FOLLOW-LINKS T :CHECK-FOR-SUBDIRS T。

blocks.html_en: • Fasl file version numbers are now independent of the target CPU, since historically most system changes which required version number changes have affected all CPUs equally. Similarly, the byte fasl file version is now equal to the ordinary fasl file version.

sentences.en: Fasl file version numbers are now independent of the target CPU, since historically most system changes which required version number changes have affected all CPUs equally.
sentences.zh: Fasl 文件版本号现在独立于目标 CPU，因为历史上大多数需要版本号更改的系统更改都会同等地影响所有 CPU。

sentences.en: Similarly, the byte fasl file version is now equal to the ordinary fasl file version.
sentences.zh: 同样，字节 fasl 文件版本现在等于普通 fasl 文件版本。

sentences.en: New in version 0.6.12, 2001-05-05

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • incompatible change: The old SB-EXT:OPTIMIZE-INTERFACE declaration is no longer recognized. I apologize for this, because it was listed in SB-EXT as a supported extension, but I found that its existing behavior was poorly specified, as well as incorrectly specified, and it looked like too much of a mess to straighten it out. I have enough on my hands trying to get ANSI stuff to work..

sentences.en: incompatible change: The old SB-EXT:OPTIMIZE-INTERFACE declaration is no longer recognized.
sentences.zh: 不兼容的更改：旧的 SB-EXT:OPTIMIZE-INTERFACE 声明不再被识别。

sentences.en: I apologize for this, because it was listed in SB-EXT as a supported extension, but I found that its existing behavior was poorly specified, as well as incorrectly specified, and it looked like too much of a mess to straighten it out.
sentences.zh: 我对此表示歉意，因为它在 SB-EXT 中被列为受支持的扩展，但我发现它现有的行为指定得很差，而且指定不正确，而且看起来太乱了，无法理顺它。

sentences.en: I have enough on my hands trying to get ANSI stuff to work..
sentences.zh: 我已经有足够多的精力来尝试让 ANSI 的东西工作了..

blocks.html_en: • many patches ported from CMU CL by Martin Atzmueller, with half a dozen bug fixes in pretty-printing and the debugger, and half a dozen others elsewhere

sentences.en: many patches ported from CMU CL by Martin Atzmueller, with half a dozen bug fixes in pretty-printing and the debugger, and half a dozen others elsewhere
sentences.zh: Martin Atzmueller 从 CMU CL 移植的许多补丁，在漂亮打印和调试器中修复了六处错误，在其他地方还有六处其他错误修复

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 13: Floating point infinities are now supported again. They might still be a little bit flaky, but thanks to bug reports from Nathan Froyd and CMU CL patches from Raymond Toy they're not as flaky as they were.

sentences.en: fixed bug 13: Floating point infinities are now supported again.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 13：现在再次支持浮点无穷大。

sentences.en: They might still be a little bit flaky, but thanks to bug reports from Nathan Froyd and CMU CL patches from Raymond Toy they're not as flaky as they were.
sentences.zh: 它们可能仍然有点不稳定，但由于 Nathan Froyd 的错误报告和 Raymond Toy 的 CMU CL 补丁，它们不再像以前那样不稳定。

blocks.html_en: • The --noprogrammer command line option is now supported. (Its behavior is slightly different in detail from what the old man page claimed it would do, but it's still appropriate under the same circumstances that the man page talks about.)

sentences.en: The --noprogrammer command line option is now supported.
sentences.zh: 现在支持 --noprogrammer 命令行选项。

sentences.en: (Its behavior is slightly different in detail from what the old man page claimed it would do, but it's still appropriate under the same circumstances that the man page talks about.)
sentences.zh: （它的行为在细节上与旧手册页声称的略有不同，但在手册页讨论的相同情况下它仍然是合适的。）

blocks.html_en: • The :SB-PROPAGATE-FLOAT-TYPE and :SB-PROPAGATE-FUN-TYPE features are now supported, and enabled by default. Thus, the compiler can handle many floating point and complex operations much less inefficiently. (Thus e.g. you can implement a complex FFT without consing!)

sentences.en: The :SB-PROPAGATE-FLOAT-TYPE and :SB-PROPAGATE-FUN-TYPE features are now supported, and enabled by default.
sentences.zh: 现在支持 :SB-PROPAGATE-FLOAT-TYPE 和 :SB-PROPAGATE-FUN-TYPE 功能，并且默认启用。

sentences.en: Thus, the compiler can handle many floating point and complex operations much less inefficiently.
sentences.zh: 因此，编译器可以以更低的效率处理许多浮点和复杂的运算。

sentences.en: (Thus e.g. you can implement a complex FFT without consing!)
sentences.zh: （因此，例如，您可以实现复杂的 FFT，无需 consing！）

blocks.html_en: • The compiler now detects type mismatches between DECLAIM FTYPE and DEFUN better, and implements CHECK-TYPE more correctly, and SBCL builds under CMU CL again despite its non-ANSI EVAL-WHEN, thanks to patches from Martin Atzmueller.

sentences.en: The compiler now detects type mismatches between DECLAIM FTYPE and DEFUN better, and implements CHECK-TYPE more correctly, and SBCL builds under CMU CL again despite its non-ANSI EVAL-WHEN, thanks to patches from Martin Atzmueller.
sentences.zh: 编译器现在可以更好地检测 DECLAIM FTYPE 和 DEFUN 之间的类型不匹配，并更正确地实现 CHECK-TYPE，并且 SBCL 再次在 CMU CL 下构建，尽管它是非 ANSI EVAL-WHEN，这要归功于 Martin Atzmueller 的补丁。

blocks.html_en: • various fixes to make the cross-compiler more portable to ANSI-conforming-but-different cross-compilation hosts (notably Lispworks for Windows, following bug reports from Arthur Lemmens)

sentences.en: various fixes to make the cross-compiler more portable to ANSI-conforming-but-different cross-compilation hosts (notably Lispworks for Windows, following bug reports from Arthur Lemmens)
sentences.zh: 各种修复，使交叉编译器更容易移植到符合 ANSI 但不同的交叉编译主机（特别是 Lispworks for Windows，遵循 Arthur Lemmens 的错误报告）

blocks.html_en: • A bug in READ-SEQUENCE for CONCATENATED-STREAM, and a gross ANSI noncompliance in DEFMACRO &KEY argument parsing, have been fixed thanks to Pierre Mai's CMU CL patches.

sentences.en: A bug in READ-SEQUENCE for CONCATENATED-STREAM, and a gross ANSI noncompliance in DEFMACRO &KEY argument parsing, have been fixed thanks to Pierre Mai's CMU CL patches.
sentences.zh: 由于 Pierre Mai 的 CMU CL 补丁，CONCATENATED-STREAM 的 READ-SEQUENCE 中的错误以及 DEFMACRO &KEY 参数解析中的严重 ANSI 不合规性已得到修复。

blocks.html_en: • fixes to keep the system from overflowing internal counters when it tries to use i/o buffers larger than 16M bytes

sentences.en: fixes to keep the system from overflowing internal counters when it tries to use i/o buffers larger than 16M bytes
sentences.zh: 进行修复以防止系统在尝试使用大于 16M 字节的 I/O 缓冲区时溢出内部计数器

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 45a: Various internal functions required to support complex special functions have been merged from CMU CL sources. (When I was first setting up SBCL, I misunderstood a compile-time conditional #-OLD-SPECFUN, and so accidentally deleted them.)

sentences.en: fixed bug 45a: Various internal functions required to support complex special functions have been merged from CMU CL sources.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 45a：支持复杂特殊功能所需的各种内部功能已从 CMU CL 源合并。

sentences.en: (When I was first setting up SBCL, I misunderstood a compile-time conditional #-OLD-SPECFUN, and so accidentally deleted them.)
sentences.zh: （当我第一次设置 SBCL 时，我误解了编译时条件#-OLD-SPECFUN，因此不小心删除了它们。）

blocks.html_en: • improved support for type intersection and union, fixing bug 12 (e.g., now (SUBTYPEP 'KEYWORD 'SYMBOL)=>T,T) and some other more obscure bugs as well

sentences.en: improved support for type intersection and union, fixing bug 12 (e.g., now (SUBTYPEP 'KEYWORD 'SYMBOL)=>T,T) and some other more obscure bugs as well
sentences.zh: 改进了对类型交集和并集的支持，修复了错误 12（例如，现在 (SUBTYPEP 'KEYWORD 'SYMBOL)=>T,T）以及其他一些更模糊的错误

blocks.html_en: • some steps toward byte-compiling non-performance-critical parts of the system, courtesy of patches from Martin Atzmueller

sentences.en: some steps toward byte-compiling non-performance-critical parts of the system, courtesy of patches from Martin Atzmueller
sentences.zh: 对系统的非性能关键部分进行字节编译的一些步骤，由 Martin Atzmueller 提供的补丁提供

blocks.html_en: • Christophe Rhodes has made some debian packages of sbcl at <http://www-jcsu.jesus.cam.ac.uk/ftp/pub/debian/lisp>. From his sbcl-devel e-mail of 2001-04-08 they're not completely stable, but are nonetheless usable. When he's ready, I'd be happy to add them to the SourceForge "File Releases" section. (And if anyone wants to do RPMs or *BSD packages, they'd be welcome too.)

sentences.en: Christophe Rhodes has made some debian packages of sbcl at <http://www-jcsu.jesus.cam.ac.uk/ftp/pub/debian/lisp>. From his sbcl-devel e-mail of 2001-04-08 they're not completely stable, but are nonetheless usable.
sentences.zh: Christophe Rhodes 在 <http://www-jcsu.jesus.cam.ac.uk/ftp/pub/debian/lisp> 制作了一些 sbcl 的 debian 软件包。从他 2001-04-08 的 sbcl-devel 电子邮件来看，它们并不完全稳定，但仍然可用。

sentences.en: When he's ready, I'd be happy to add them to the SourceForge "File Releases" section.
sentences.zh: 当他准备好时，我很乐意将它们添加到 SourceForge 的“文件发布”部分。

sentences.en: (And if anyone wants to do RPMs or *BSD packages, they'd be welcome too.)
sentences.zh: （如果有人想做 RPM 或 *BSD 软件包，我们也欢迎他们。）

blocks.html_en: • new fasl file format version number (because of changes in internal representation of (OR ..) types to accommodate the new support for (AND ..) types, among other things)

sentences.en: new fasl file format version number (because of changes in internal representation of (OR ..)
sentences.zh: 新的 fasl 文件格式版本号（因为 (OR ..) 的内部表示发生变化

sentences.en: types to accommodate the new support for (AND ..)
sentences.zh: 类型以适应 (AND ..) 的新支持

sentences.en: types, among other things)
sentences.zh: 类型等）

sentences.en: New in version 0.6.11, 2001-02-25

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • Martin Atzmueller pointed out that bugs #9 and #25 are gone in current SBCL.

sentences.en: Martin Atzmueller pointed out that bugs #9 and #25 are gone in current SBCL.
sentences.zh: Martin Atzmueller 指出 bug #9 和 #25 在当前的 SBCL 中已经消失。

blocks.html_en: • bug 34 fixed by Martin Atzmueller: dumping/loading instances works better

sentences.en: bug 34 fixed by Martin Atzmueller: dumping/loading instances works better
sentences.zh: 由 Martin Atzmueller 修复的错误 34：转储/加载实例效果更好

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 40: TYPEP, SUBTYPEP, UPGRADED-ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE, and UPGRADED-COMPLEX-PART-TYPE now work better with of compound types built from undefined types, e.g. '(VECTOR SOME-UNDEF-TYPE).

sentences.en: fixed bug 40: TYPEP, SUBTYPEP, UPGRADED-ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE, and UPGRADED-COMPLEX-PART-TYPE now work better with of compound types built from undefined types, e.g. '(VECTOR SOME-UNDEF-TYPE).
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 40：TYPEP、SUBTYPEP、UPGRADED-ARRAY-ELEMENT-TYPE 和 UPGRADED-COMPLEX-PART-TYPE 现在可以更好地处理从未定义类型构建的复合类型，例如'（矢量某些未定义类型）。

blocks.html_en: • DESCRIBE now works on structure objects again.

sentences.en: DESCRIBE now works on structure objects again.
sentences.zh: DESCRIBE 现在再次适用于结构对象。

blocks.html_en: • Most function call argument type mismatches are now handled as STYLE-WARNINGs instead of full WARNINGs, since the compiler doesn't know whether the function will be redefined before the call is executed. (The compiler could flag local calls with full WARNINGs, as per the ANSI spec "3.2.2.3 Semantic Constraints", but right now it doesn't keep track of enough information to know whether calls are local in this sense.)

sentences.en: Most function call argument type mismatches are now handled as STYLE-WARNINGs instead of full WARNINGs, since the compiler doesn't know whether the function will be redefined before the call is executed.
sentences.zh: 大多数函数调用参数类型不匹配现在都作为样式警告而不是完整的警告处理，因为编译器不知道在执行调用之前是否会重新定义函数。

sentences.en: (The compiler could flag local calls with full WARNINGs, as per the ANSI spec "3.2.2.3 Semantic Constraints", but right now it doesn't keep track of enough information to know whether calls are local in this sense.)
sentences.zh: （编译器可以根据 ANSI 规范“3.2.2.3 语义约束”，用完整的警告来标记本地调用，但现在它没有跟踪足够的信息来了解这个意义上的调用是否是本地的。）

blocks.html_en: • Compiler output is now more verbose, with messages truncated later than before. (There should be some supported way for users to override the default verbosity, but I haven't decided how to provide it yet, so this behavior is still controlled by the internal SB-C::*COMPILER-ERROR-PRINT-FOO* variables in src/compiler/ir1util.lisp.)

sentences.en: Compiler output is now more verbose, with messages truncated later than before.
sentences.zh: 编译器输出现在更加详细，消息被截断的时间比以前更晚。

sentences.en: (There should be some supported way for users to override the default verbosity, but I haven't decided how to provide it yet, so this behavior is still controlled by the internal SB-C::*COMPILER-ERROR-PRINT-FOO* variables in src/compiler/ir1util.lisp.)
sentences.zh: （应该有一些支持的方式让用户覆盖默认的详细程度，但我还没有决定如何提供它，所以这种行为仍然由 src/compiler/ir1util.lisp 中的内部 SB-C::*COMPILER-ERROR-PRINT-FOO* 变量控制。）

blocks.html_en: • Fasl file format version numbers have increased again, because support for the Gray streams extension changes the layout of the system's STREAM objects.

sentences.en: Fasl file format version numbers have increased again, because support for the Gray streams extension changes the layout of the system's STREAM objects.
sentences.zh: Fasl 文件格式版本号再次增加，因为对 Gray 流扩展的支持改变了系统 STREAM 对象的布局。

blocks.html_en: • The Gray subclassable streams extension now works, thanks to a patch from Martin Atzmueller.

sentences.en: The Gray subclassable streams extension now works, thanks to a patch from Martin Atzmueller.
sentences.zh: 感谢 Martin Atzmueller 的补丁，Gray 可子分类流扩展现在可以工作了。

blocks.html_en: • The full LOAD-FOREIGN extension (not just the primitive LOAD-FOREIGN-1) now works, thanks to a patch from Martin Atzmueller.

blocks.html_en: • The default behavior of RUN-PROGRAM has changed. Now, unlike CMU CL but like most other programs, it defaults to copying the Unix environment from the original process instead of starting the new process in an empty environment.

blocks.html_en: • The compiler no longer uses special default file extensions for byte-compiled code. (The ANSI definition of COMPILE-FILE-PATHNAME seems to expect a single default extension for all compiled code, and there's no compelling reason to try to stretch the standard to allow two different extensions.) Instead, byte-compiled files default to the same extension as native-compiled files.

blocks.html_en:
• fixed bugs in DEFCONSTANT ANSI-compatibility:
    • DEFCONSTANT now tests reassignments using EQL, not EQUAL, in order to warn about behavior which is undefined under the ANSI spec. Note: This is specified by ANSI, but it's not very popular with programmers. If it causes you problems, take a look at the new SB-INT:DEFCONSTANT-EQX macro in the SBCL sources for an example of a workaround which you might use to make portable ANSI-standard code which does what you want.
    • DEFCONSTANT's implementation is now based on EVAL-WHEN instead of on pre-ANSI IR1 translation magic, so it does the ANSI-specified thing when it's used as a non-toplevel form. (This is required in order to implement the DEFCONSTANT-EQX macro.)
    • (DEFCONSTANT X 1) (DEFVAR X) (SETF X 2) no longer "works".
    • Unfortunately, non-toplevel DEFCONSTANT forms can still do some funny things, due to bugs in the implementation of EVAL-WHEN (bug #IR1-3). This probably won't be fixed until 0.7.x. (Fortunately, non-toplevel DEFCONSTANTs are uncommon.)

• fixed bug 1 (error handling before read-eval-print loop starts), and redid debugger restarts and related debugger commands somewhat while doing so:
    • The QUIT debugger command is gone, since it did something rather different than the SB-EXT:QUIT command, and since it never worked properly outside the main toplevel read/eval/print loop. Invoking the new TOPLEVEL restart provides the same functionality.
    • The GO debugger command is also gone, since you can just invoke the CONTINUE restart directly instead.
    • The TOP debugger command is also gone, since it's redundant with the FRAME 0 command, and since it interfered with abbreviations for the TOPLEVEL restart.

blocks.html_en:
• Martin Atzmueller reviewed the CMU CL mailing lists and came back with a boatload of patches which he ported to SBCL. Now that those have been applied,
    • The system tries to make sure that its low-priority messages are prefixed by semicolons, to help people who like to use syntax highlighting in their ILISP buffer. (This patch was originally due to Raymond Toy.)
    • The system now optimizes INTEGER-LENGTH better, thanks to more patches originally written by Raymond Toy.
    • The compiler understands coercion between single-value and multiple-VALUES type expressions better, getting rid of some very weird behavior, thanks to patches originally by Robert MacLachlan and Douglas Crosher.
    • The system understands ANSI-style non-KEYWORD &KEY arguments in lambda lists, thanks to a patch originally by Pierre Mai.
    • The system no longer bogusly warns about "abbreviated type declarations".
    • The compiler gets less confused by inlining and RETURN-FROM, thanks to some patches originally by Tim Moore.
    • The system no longer hangs when dumping circular lists to fasl files, thanks to a patch originally from Douglas Crosher.

blocks.html_en: • The system tries to make sure that its low-priority messages are prefixed by semicolons, to help people who like to use syntax highlighting in their ILISP buffer. (This patch was originally due to Raymond Toy.)

sentences.en: The system tries to make sure that its low-priority messages are prefixed by semicolons, to help people who like to use syntax highlighting in their ILISP buffer.
sentences.zh: 系统试图确保其低优先级消息以分号为前缀，以帮助那些喜欢在 ILISP 缓冲区中使用语法突出显示的人。

sentences.en: (This patch was originally due to Raymond Toy.)
sentences.zh: （这个补丁最初是由 Raymond Toy 提供的。）

blocks.html_en: • The system now optimizes INTEGER-LENGTH better, thanks to more patches originally written by Raymond Toy.

sentences.en: The system now optimizes INTEGER-LENGTH better, thanks to more patches originally written by Raymond Toy.
sentences.zh: 由于 Raymond Toy 最初编写了更多补丁，系统现在可以更好地优化 INTEGER-LENGTH。

blocks.html_en: • The compiler understands coercion between single-value and multiple-VALUES type expressions better, getting rid of some very weird behavior, thanks to patches originally by Robert MacLachlan and Douglas Crosher.

sentences.en: The compiler understands coercion between single-value and multiple-VALUES type expressions better, getting rid of some very weird behavior, thanks to patches originally by Robert MacLachlan and Douglas Crosher.
sentences.zh: 得益于 Robert MacLachlan 和 Douglas Crosher 最初的补丁，编译器可以更好地理解单值和多值类型表达式之间的强制转换，消除了一些非常奇怪的行为。

blocks.html_en: • The system understands ANSI-style non-KEYWORD &KEY arguments in lambda lists, thanks to a patch originally by Pierre Mai.

sentences.en: The system understands ANSI-style non-KEYWORD &KEY arguments in lambda lists, thanks to a patch originally by Pierre Mai.
sentences.zh: 得益于 Pierre Mai 最初的补丁，系统能够理解 lambda 列表中的 ANSI 风格的非 KEYWORD &KEY 参数。

blocks.html_en: • The system no longer bogusly warns about "abbreviated type declarations".

sentences.en: The system no longer bogusly warns about "abbreviated type declarations".
sentences.zh: 系统不再虚假地警告“缩写类型声明”。

blocks.html_en: • The compiler gets less confused by inlining and RETURN-FROM, thanks to some patches originally by Tim Moore.

sentences.en: The compiler gets less confused by inlining and RETURN-FROM, thanks to some patches originally by Tim Moore.
sentences.zh: 得益于 Tim Moore 最初的一些补丁，编译器不再因内联和 RETURN-FROM 而感到困惑。

blocks.html_en: • The system no longer hangs when dumping circular lists to fasl files, thanks to a patch originally from Douglas Crosher.

sentences.en: The system no longer hangs when dumping circular lists to fasl files, thanks to a patch originally from Douglas Crosher.
sentences.zh: 由于 Douglas Crosher 最初提供的补丁，将循环列表转储到 fasl 文件时系统不再挂起。

blocks.html_en: • Martin Atzmueller also fixed ROOM, so that it no longer fails with an undefined function error.

sentences.en: Martin Atzmueller also fixed ROOM, so that it no longer fails with an undefined function error.
sentences.zh: Martin Atzmueller 还修复了 ROOM，使其不再因未定义函数错误而失败。

blocks.html_en: • gave up on fixing bug 3 (forbidden-by-ANSI warning for type mismatch in structure slot initforms) for now, documented workaround instead:-|

sentences.en: gave up on fixing bug 3 (forbidden-by-ANSI warning for type mismatch in structure slot initforms) for now, documented workaround instead:-|
sentences.zh: 现在放弃修复 bug 3（结构槽 initforms 中类型不匹配的 ANSI 禁止警告），改为记录解决方法：-|

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 4 (no WARNING for DECLAIM FTYPE of slot accessor function)

sentences.en: fixed bug 4 (no WARNING for DECLAIM FTYPE of slot accessor function)
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 4（插槽访问器函数的 DECLAIM FTYPE 没有警告）

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 5: added stubs for various Gray stream functions called in the not-a-CL:STREAM case, so that even when Gray streams aren't installed, at least appropriate type errors are generated

sentences.en: fixed bug 5: added stubs for various Gray stream functions called in the not-a-CL:STREAM case, so that even when Gray streams aren't installed, at least appropriate type errors are generated
sentences.zh: 修复错误 5：为 not-a-CL:STREAM 情况下调用的各种 Gray 流函数添加了存根，这样即使未安装 Gray 流，至少也会生成适当的类型错误

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 8: better reporting of various PROGRAM-ERRORs

sentences.en: fixed bug 8: better reporting of various PROGRAM-ERRORs
sentences.zh: 修复错误 8：更好地报告各种程序错误

blocks.html_en: • fixed bug 9: IGNORE and IGNORABLE now work reasonably and more consistently in DEFMETHOD forms.

sentences.en: fixed bug 9: IGNORE and IGNORABLE now work reasonably and more consistently in DEFMETHOD forms.
sentences.zh: 修复了错误 9：IGNORE 和 IGNORABLE 现在可以在 DEFMETHOD 表单中合理且更加一致地工作。

blocks.html_en: • removed bug 21 from BUGS, since Martin Atzmueller points out that it doesn't seem to affect SBCL after all

sentences.en: removed bug 21 from BUGS, since Martin Atzmueller points out that it doesn't seem to affect SBCL after all
sentences.zh: 从 BUGS 中删除了 bug 21，因为 Martin Atzmueller 指出它似乎并不影响 SBCL

blocks.html_en: • The C runtime system now builds with better optimization and many fewer warnings, thanks to lots of cleanups by Martin Atzmueller.

sentences.en: The C runtime system now builds with better optimization and many fewer warnings, thanks to lots of cleanups by Martin Atzmueller.
sentences.zh: 由于 Martin Atzmueller 的大量清理工作，C 运行时系统现在构建时具有更好的优化和更少的警告。

sentences.en: New in version 0.6.8, 2000-10-26

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • The system is now under CVS at SourceForge (instead of the CVS repository on my home machine).

sentences.en: The system is now under CVS at SourceForge (instead of the CVS repository on my home machine).
sentences.zh: 该系统现在位于 SourceForge 的 CVS 下（而不是我家用计算机上的 CVS 存储库）。

blocks.html_en: • The new signal handling code has been tweaked to treat register contents as (UNSIGNED-BYTE 32), as the old CMU CL code did, instead of (SIGNED-BYTE 32), as the C header files have it. (Code downstream, e.g. in debug-int.lisp, has implicit dependencies on the unsignedness of integer representation of machine words, and that caused the system to bomb out with infinite regress when trying to recover from type errors involving signed values, e.g. (BUTLAST '(1 2 3) -1).)

sentences.en: The new signal handling code has been tweaked to treat register contents as (UNSIGNED-BYTE 32), as the old CMU CL code did, instead of (SIGNED-BYTE 32), as the C header files have it.
sentences.zh: 新的信号处理代码已经过调整，将寄存器内容视为 (UNSIGNED-BYTE 32)，如旧的 CMU CL 代码，而不是 (SIGNED-BYTE 32)，如 C 头文件所示。

sentences.en: (Code downstream, e.g. in debug-int.lisp, has implicit dependencies on the unsignedness of integer representation of machine words, and that caused the system to bomb out with infinite regress when trying to recover from type errors involving signed values, e.g. (BUTLAST '(1 2 3) -1).)
sentences.zh: （下游代码，例如在 debug-int.lisp 中，隐含地依赖于机器字的整数表示的无符号性，这导致系统在尝试从涉及有符号值的类型错误中恢复时以无限回归爆炸，例如 (BUTLAST '(1 2 3) -1)。）

blocks.html_en: • (BUTLAST NIL) and (NBUTLAST NIL) now return NIL as they should. (This was one of the bugs Peter Van Eynde reported back in July.)

sentences.en: (BUTLAST NIL) and (NBUTLAST NIL) now return NIL as they should.
sentences.zh: (BUTLAST NIL) 和 (NBUTLAST NIL) 现在按其应有的方式返回 NIL。

sentences.en: (This was one of the bugs Peter Van Eynde reported back in July.)
sentences.zh: （这是 Peter Van Eynde 在 7 月份报告的错误之一。）

blocks.html_en: • The system now uses code inspired by Colin Walters' O(N) implementation of MAP (from the cmucl-imp@cons.org mailing list, 2 September 2000) when it can't use a DEFTRANSFORM to inline the MAP operation, and there is more than one sequence argument to the MAP call (so that it can't just do ETYPECASE once and for all based on the type of the single sequence argument). (The old non-inline implementation of the general M-argument sequence-of-length-N case required O(M*N*N) time when any of the sequence arguments were LISTs.)

sentences.en: The system now uses code inspired by Colin Walters' O(N) implementation of MAP (from the cmucl-imp@cons.org mailing list, 2 September 2000) when it can't use a DEFTRANSFORM to inline the MAP operation, and there is more than one sequence argument to the MAP call (so that it can't just do ETYPECASE once and for all based on the type of the single sequence argument).
sentences.zh: 系统现在使用受 Colin Walters O(N) MAP 实现（来自 cmucl-imp@cons.org 邮件列表，2000 年 9 月 2 日）启发的代码，此时系统无法使用 DEFTRANSFORM 内联 MAP 操作，并且 MAP 调用有多个序列参数（因此它不能根据单个序列参数的类型一劳永逸地执行 ETYPECASE）。

sentences.en: (The old non-inline implementation of the general M-argument sequence-of-length-N case required O(M*N*N) time when any of the sequence arguments were LISTs.)
sentences.zh: （当任何序列参数是 LIST 时，一般 M 参数长度 N 序列情况的旧非内联实现需要 O(M*N*N) 时间。）

blocks.html_en: • The QUIT :UNIX-CODE keyword argument has been renamed to QUIT :UNIX-STATUS. (The old name still works, but is deprecated.)

sentences.en: The QUIT :UNIX-CODE keyword argument has been renamed to QUIT :UNIX-STATUS.
sentences.zh: QUIT :UNIX-CODE 关键字参数已重命名为 QUIT :UNIX-STATUS。

sentences.en: (The old name still works, but is deprecated.)
sentences.zh: （旧名称仍然有效，但已被弃用。）

blocks.html_en: • Raymond Wiker's patches to port RUN-PROGRAM from CMU CL to SBCL have been added.

sentences.en: Raymond Wiker's patches to port RUN-PROGRAM from CMU CL to SBCL have been added.
sentences.zh: 添加了 Raymond Wiker 将 RUN-PROGRAM 从 CMU CL 移植到 SBCL 的补丁。

blocks.html_en: • Raymond Wiker's patches to port dynamic loading from Linux to FreeBSD have been added.

sentences.en: Raymond Wiker's patches to port dynamic loading from Linux to FreeBSD have been added.
sentences.zh: 添加了 Raymond Wiker 的补丁，用于将动态加载从 Linux 移植到 FreeBSD。

blocks.html_en: • The BUGS file is now more nearly up to date, thanks in large part to Martin Atzmueller's review of it.

sentences.en: The BUGS file is now more nearly up to date, thanks in large part to Martin Atzmueller's review of it.
sentences.zh: BUGS 文件现在几乎是最新的，这在很大程度上要归功于 Martin Atzmueller 对其的审查。

blocks.html_en: • The debugger now flushes standard output streams before it begins its output ("debugger invoked" and so forth).

sentences.en: The debugger now flushes standard output streams before it begins its output ("debugger invoked" and so forth).
sentences.zh: 调试器现在在开始输出之前刷新标准输出流（“调试器调用”等等）。

blocks.html_en: • The core version number and fasl file version number have both been incremented, because of incompatible changes in the layout of static symbols.

sentences.en: The core version number and fasl file version number have both been incremented, because of incompatible changes in the layout of static symbols.
sentences.zh: 由于静态符号布局的不兼容更改，核心版本号和 fasl 文件版本号均已增加。

blocks.html_en: • FINISH-OUTPUT is now called more consistently on QUIT. (It used to not be called for a saved Lisp image.)

sentences.en: FINISH-OUTPUT is now called more consistently on QUIT.
sentences.zh: 现在，在 QUIT 时更一致地调用 FINISH-OUTPUT。

sentences.en: (It used to not be called for a saved Lisp image.)
sentences.zh: （过去保存 Lisp 图像时不会调用它。）

blocks.html_en: • Martin Atzmueller's version of a patch to fix a compiler crash, as posted on sbcl-devel 13 September 2000, has been installed.

sentences.en: Martin Atzmueller's version of a patch to fix a compiler crash, as posted on sbcl-devel 13 September 2000, has been installed.
sentences.zh: Martin Atzmueller 的修复编译器崩溃的补丁版本（2000 年 9 月 13 日发布在 sbcl-devel 上）已经安装。

blocks.html_en: • Instead of installing Martin Atzmueller's patch for the compiler transform for SUBSEQ, I deleted the compiler transform, and transforms for some similar consing operations.

sentences.en: Instead of installing Martin Atzmueller's patch for the compiler transform for SUBSEQ, I deleted the compiler transform, and transforms for some similar consing operations.
sentences.zh: 我没有安装 Martin Atzmueller 的 SUBSEQ 编译器转换补丁，而是删除了编译器转换以及一些类似 consing 操作的转换。

blocks.html_en: • A bug in signal handling which kept TRACE from working on OpenBSD has been fixed.

sentences.en: A bug in signal handling which kept TRACE from working on OpenBSD has been fixed.
sentences.zh: 信号处理中导致 TRACE 无法在 OpenBSD 上运行的错误已得到修复。

blocks.html_en: • added enough DEFTRANSFORMs to allow (SXHASH 'FOO) to be optimized away by constant folding

sentences.en: added enough DEFTRANSFORMs to allow (SXHASH 'FOO) to be optimized away by constant folding
sentences.zh: 添加了足够的 DEFTRANSFORM 以允许 (SXHASH 'FOO) 通过不断折叠进行优化

blocks.html_en: • The system now defines its address space constants in one place (in the Lisp sources), and propagates them automatically elsewhere (through GENESIS and the sbcl.h file). Therefore, patching the address map is less unnecessarily tedious and error-prone. The Lisp names of address space constants have also been systematized.

sentences.en: The system now defines its address space constants in one place (in the Lisp sources), and propagates them automatically elsewhere (through GENESIS and the sbcl.h file).
sentences.zh: 系统现在在一处（在 Lisp 源代码中）定义其地址空间常量，并自动将它们传播到其他地方（通过 GENESIS 和 sbcl.h 文件）。

sentences.en: Therefore, patching the address map is less unnecessarily tedious and error-prone.
sentences.zh: 因此，修补地址映射可以减少不必要的繁琐和容易出错的工作。

sentences.en: The Lisp names of address space constants have also been systematized.
sentences.zh: 地址空间常量的 Lisp 名称也已系统化。

blocks.html_en: • CVS tags like dollar-Header-dollar have been removed from the sources, because they have never saved me trouble and they've been source of trouble working with patches and other diff-related operations.

sentences.en: CVS tags like dollar-Header-dollar have been removed from the sources, because they have never saved me trouble and they've been source of trouble working with patches and other diff-related operations.
sentences.zh: 像 Dollar-Header-dollar 这样的 CVS 标签已从源中删除，因为它们从来没有给我省去麻烦，而且它们一直是处理补丁和其他差异相关操作时遇到麻烦的根源。

blocks.html_en: • fixed the PROG1-vs.-PROGN bug in HANDLER-BIND (reported by ole.rohne@cern.ch on cmucl-help@cons.org 2000-10-25)

sentences.en: fixed the PROG1-vs.-PROGN bug in HANDLER-BIND (reported by ole.rohne@cern.ch on cmucl-help@cons.org 2000-10-25)
sentences.zh: 修复了 HANDLER-BIND 中的 PROG1-vs.-PROGN 错误（由 ole.rohne@cern.ch 在 cmucl-help@cons.org 上报告，2000-10-25）

blocks.html_en: New in version 0.6.7

sentences.en: New in version 0.6.7
sentences.zh: 0.6.7版本新增

blocks.html_en: Back to top

sentences.en: Back to top
sentences.zh: 返回顶部

blocks.html_en: • The system has been ported to OpenBSD.

sentences.en: The system has been ported to OpenBSD.
sentences.zh: 该系统已移植到OpenBSD。

blocks.html_en: • The system now compiles with a simple "sh make.sh" on the systems that it's supported on. I.e., now you no longer need to tweak text in the target-features.lisp-expr and symlinks in src/runtime/ by hand, the make.sh takes care of it for you.

sentences.en: The system now compiles with a simple "sh make.sh" on the systems that it's supported on.
sentences.zh: 现在，系统在支持它的系统上使用简单的“sh make.sh”进行编译。

sentences.en: I.e., now you no longer need to tweak text in the target-features.lisp-expr and symlinks in src/runtime/ by hand, the make.sh takes care of it for you.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，现在您不再需要手动调整 target-features.lisp-expr 中的文本和 src/runtime/ 中的符号链接，make.sh 会为您处理好。

blocks.html_en: • The system is no longer so grossly inefficient when compiling code involving vectors implemented as general (not simple) vectors (VECTOR T), so code which dares to use VECTOR-PUSH-EXTEND and FILL-POINTER, or which dares to use the various sequence functions on non-simple vectors, takes less of a performance hit.

sentences.en: The system is no longer so grossly inefficient when compiling code involving vectors implemented as general (not simple) vectors (VECTOR T), so code which dares to use VECTOR-PUSH-EXTEND and FILL-POINTER, or which dares to use the various sequence functions on non-simple vectors, takes less of a performance hit.
sentences.zh: 当编译涉及作为通用（非简单）向量（VECTOR T）实现的向量的代码时，系统不再那么低效，因此敢于使用VECTOR-PUSH-EXTEND和FILL-POINTER的代码，或者敢于在非简单向量上使用各种序列函数的代码，对性能的影响较小。

blocks.html_en: • There is now a primitive type predicate VECTOR-T-P to test for the (VECTOR T) type, so that e.g. (DEFUN FOO (V) (DECLARE (TYPE (VECTOR T) V)) (AREF V 3)) can now be compiled with some semblance of efficiency. (The old code turned the type declaration into a full call to %TYPEP at runtime!)

sentences.en: There is now a primitive type predicate VECTOR-T-P to test for the (VECTOR T) type, so that e.g. (DEFUN FOO (V) (DECLARE (TYPE (VECTOR T) V)) (AREF V 3)) can now be compiled with some semblance of efficiency.
sentences.zh: 现在有一个原始类型谓词 VECTOR-T-P 来测试 (VECTOR T) 类型，因此例如(DEFUN FOO (V) (DECLARE (TYPE (VECTOR T) V)) (AREF V 3)) 现在可以以一定的效率进行编译。

sentences.en: (The old code turned the type declaration into a full call to %TYPEP at runtime!)
sentences.zh: （旧代码在运行时将类型声明转换为对 %TYPEP 的完整调用！）

blocks.html_en: • AREF on (VECTOR T) is still not fast, since it's still compiled as a full call to SB-KERNEL:DATA-VECTOR-REF, but at least the ETYPECASE used in DATA-VECTOR-REF is now compiled reasonably efficiently. (The old version made full calls to SUBTYPEP at runtime!)

sentences.en: AREF on (VECTOR T) is still not fast, since it's still compiled as a full call to SB-KERNEL:DATA-VECTOR-REF, but at least the ETYPECASE used in DATA-VECTOR-REF is now compiled reasonably efficiently.
sentences.zh: (VECTOR T) 上的 AREF 仍然不快，因为它仍然编译为对 SB-KERNEL:DATA-VECTOR-REF 的完整调用，但至少 DATA-VECTOR-REF 中使用的 ETYPECASE 现在编译得相当有效。

sentences.en: (The old version made full calls to SUBTYPEP at runtime!)
sentences.zh: （旧版本在运行时完全调用了 SUBTYPEP！）

blocks.html_en: • (MAKE-ARRAY 12 :FILL-POINTER T) is now executed less inefficiently, without making full calls to SUBTYPEP at runtime. (Some analogous efficiency issues for non-simple vectors specialized to element types other than T, or for non-simple multidimensional arrays, have not been addressed. They could almost certainly be handled the same way if anyone is motivated to do so.)

sentences.en: (MAKE-ARRAY 12 :FILL-POINTER T) is now executed less inefficiently, without making full calls to SUBTYPEP at runtime.
sentences.zh: (MAKE-ARRAY 12 :FILL-POINTER T) 现在执行效率较低，无需在运行时完全调用 SUBTYPEP。

sentences.en: (Some analogous efficiency issues for non-simple vectors specialized to element types other than T, or for non-simple multidimensional arrays, have not been addressed.
sentences.zh: （专门用于除 T 之外的元素类型的非简单向量或非简单多维数组的一些类似效率问题尚未得到解决。

sentences.en: They could almost certainly be handled the same way if anyone is motivated to do so.)
sentences.zh: 如果有人有动力这样做，几乎肯定可以以同样的方式处理它们。）

blocks.html_en: • The changes in array handling break binary compatibility, so *BACKEND-FASL-FILE-VERSION* has been bumped to 4.

sentences.en: The changes in array handling break binary compatibility, so *BACKEND-FASL-FILE-VERSION* has been bumped to 4.
sentences.zh: 数组处理的变化破坏了二进制兼容性，因此 *BACKEND-FASL-FILE-VERSION* 已增加到 4。

blocks.html_en: • (TYPEP (MAKE-ARRAY 12 :FILL-POINTER 4) 'VECTOR) now returns (VALUES T) instead of (VALUES T T).

sentences.en: (TYPEP (MAKE-ARRAY 12 :FILL-POINTER 4) 'VECTOR) now returns (VALUES T) instead of (VALUES T T).
sentences.zh: (TYPEP (MAKE-ARRAY 12 :FILL-POINTER 4) 'VECTOR) 现在返回 (VALUES T) 而不是 (VALUES T T)。

blocks.html_en: • By following the instructions that Dan Barlow posted to sbcl-devel on 2 July 2000, I was able to enable primitive dynamic object file loading code for Linux. The full-blown CMU CL LOAD-FOREIGN functionality is not implemented (since it calls ld to resolve library references automatically, requiring RUN-PROGRAM for its implementation), but a simpler SB-EXT:LOAD-1-FOREIGN (which doesn't try to resolve library references) is now supported.

sentences.en: By following the instructions that Dan Barlow posted to sbcl-devel on 2 July 2000, I was able to enable primitive dynamic object file loading code for Linux.
sentences.zh: 按照 Dan Barlow 于 2000 年 7 月 2 日发布到 sbcl-devel 的说明，我能够为 Linux 启用原始动态目标文件加载代码。

sentences.en: The full-blown CMU CL LOAD-FOREIGN functionality is not implemented (since it calls ld to resolve library references automatically, requiring RUN-PROGRAM for its implementation), but a simpler SB-EXT:LOAD-1-FOREIGN (which doesn't try to resolve library references) is now supported.
sentences.zh: 尚未实现成熟的 CMU CL LOAD-FOREIGN 功能（因为它调用 ld 自动解析库引用，需要 RUN-PROGRAM 来实现），但现在支持更简单的 SB-EXT:LOAD-1-FOREIGN （不尝试解析库引用）。

blocks.html_en: • The system now flushes the standard output streams when it terminates, unless QUIT is used with the RECKLESSLY-P option set. It also flushes them at several other probably-convenient times, e.g. in each pass of the toplevel read-eval-print loop, and after evaluating a form given as an "--eval" command-line option. (These changes were motivated by a discussion of stream flushing issues on cmucl-imp in August 2000.)

sentences.en: The system now flushes the standard output streams when it terminates, unless QUIT is used with the RECKLESSLY-P option set.
sentences.zh: 现在，系统在终止时会刷新标准输出流，除非 QUIT 与 RECKLESSLY-P 选项集一起使用。

sentences.en: It also flushes them at several other probably-convenient times, e.g. in each pass of the toplevel read-eval-print loop, and after evaluating a form given as an "--eval" command-line option.
sentences.zh: 它还会在其他几个可能方便的时间冲洗它们，例如在顶层 read-eval-print 循环的每次传递中，以及在评估作为“--eval”命令行选项给出的表单之后。

sentences.en: (These changes were motivated by a discussion of stream flushing issues on cmucl-imp in August 2000.)
sentences.zh: （这些更改是由 2000 年 8 月 cmucl-imp 上对流刷新问题的讨论引发的。）

blocks.html_en: • The source transform for TYPEP of array types no longer assumes that an array whose element type is a not-yet-defined type is implemented as an array of T, but instead punts, so that the type will be interpreted at runtime.

sentences.en: The source transform for TYPEP of array types no longer assumes that an array whose element type is a not-yet-defined type is implemented as an array of T, but instead punts, so that the type will be interpreted at runtime.
sentences.zh: 数组类型的 TYPEP 的源转换不再假设元素类型为尚未定义类型的数组被实现为 T 数组，而是转而采用平底符号，以便在运行时解释该类型。

blocks.html_en: • There is now some support for cross-compiling in make.sh: each of the phases of make.sh has its own script. (This should be transparent to people doing ordinary, non-cross-compile builds.)

sentences.en: There is now some support for cross-compiling in make.sh: each of the phases of make.sh has its own script.
sentences.zh: 现在 make.sh 中对交叉编译提供了一些支持：make.sh 的每个阶段都有自己的脚本。

sentences.en: (This should be transparent to people doing ordinary, non-cross-compile builds.)
sentences.zh: （这对于进行普通非交叉编译构建的人来说应该是透明的。）

blocks.html_en:
• Since my laptop doesn't have hundreds of megabytes of memory like my desktop machine, I became more motivated to do some items on my to-do list in order to reduce the size of the system a little:
    • Arrange for various needed-only-at-cold-init things to be uninterned after cold init. To support this, those things have been renamed from FOO and *FOO* to !FOO and *!FOO* (i.e., all symbols with such names are now uninterned after cold init).
    • Bind SB!C::*TOP-LEVEL-LAMBDA-MAX* to a nonzero value when building fasl files for cold load.
    • Remove the old compiler structure pooling code (which used to be conditional on the target feature :SB-ALLOC) completely.
    • Redo the representation of some data in cold init to be more compact. (I also looked into supporting byte compiled code at bootstrap time, which would probably reduce the size of the system a lot, but that looked too complicated, so I punted for now.)

sentences.en: Since my laptop doesn't have hundreds of megabytes of memory like my desktop machine, I became more motivated to do some items on my to-do list in order to reduce the size of the system a little: Arrange for various needed-only-at-cold-init things to be uninterned after cold init.
sentences.zh: 由于我的笔记本电脑不像台式机那样有数百兆字节的内存，因此我更有动力去做我的待办事项列表上的一些项目，以便稍微减少系统的大小：安排各种仅在冷初始化时需要的东西在冷初始化后取消保留。

sentences.en: To support this, those things have been renamed from FOO and *FOO* to !FOO and *!FOO* (i.e., all symbols with such names are now uninterned after cold init).
sentences.zh: 为了支持这一点，这些东西已从 FOO 和 *FOO* 重命名为 !FOO 和 *!FOO* （即，所有具有此类名称的符号现在在冷初始化后都不再保留）。

sentences.en: Bind SB!C::*TOP-LEVEL-LAMBDA-MAX* to a nonzero value when building fasl files for cold load.
sentences.zh: 构建用于冷加载的 fasl 文件时，将 SB!C::*TOP-LEVEL-LAMBDA-MAX* 绑定到非零值。

sentences.en: Remove the old compiler structure pooling code (which used to be conditional on the target feature :SB-ALLOC) completely.
sentences.zh: 完全删除旧的编译器结构池代码（过去以目标功能：SB-ALLOC 为条件）。

sentences.en: Redo the representation of some data in cold init to be more compact.
sentences.zh: 重做冷初始化中一些数据的表示，使其更加紧凑。

sentences.en: (I also looked into supporting byte compiled code at bootstrap time, which would probably reduce the size of the system a lot, but that looked too complicated, so I punted for now.)
sentences.zh: （我还研究了在引导时支持字节编译代码，这可能会大大减少系统的大小，但这看起来太复杂了，所以我现在就放弃了。）

blocks.html_en: • Arrange for various needed-only-at-cold-init things to be uninterned after cold init. To support this, those things have been renamed from FOO and *FOO* to !FOO and *!FOO* (i.e., all symbols with such names are now uninterned after cold init).

sentences.en: Arrange for various needed-only-at-cold-init things to be uninterned after cold init.
sentences.zh: 安排各种仅在冷初始化时需要的东西在冷初始化后取消保留。

sentences.en: To support this, those things have been renamed from FOO and *FOO* to !FOO and *!FOO* (i.e., all symbols with such names are now uninterned after cold init).
sentences.zh: 为了支持这一点，这些东西已从 FOO 和 *FOO* 重命名为 !FOO 和 *!FOO* （即，所有具有此类名称的符号现在在冷初始化后都不再保留）。

blocks.html_en: • Bind SB!C::*TOP-LEVEL-LAMBDA-MAX* to a nonzero value when building fasl files for cold load.

sentences.en: Bind SB!C::*TOP-LEVEL-LAMBDA-MAX* to a nonzero value when building fasl files for cold load.
sentences.zh: 构建用于冷加载的 fasl 文件时，将 SB!C::*TOP-LEVEL-LAMBDA-MAX* 绑定到非零值。

blocks.html_en: • Remove the old compiler structure pooling code (which used to be conditional on the target feature :SB-ALLOC) completely.

sentences.en: Remove the old compiler structure pooling code (which used to be conditional on the target feature :SB-ALLOC) completely.
sentences.zh: 完全删除旧的编译器结构池代码（过去以目标功能：SB-ALLOC 为条件）。

blocks.html_en: • Redo the representation of some data in cold init to be more compact. (I also looked into supporting byte compiled code at bootstrap time, which would probably reduce the size of the system a lot, but that looked too complicated, so I punted for now.)

sentences.en: Redo the representation of some data in cold init to be more compact.
sentences.zh: 重做冷初始化中一些数据的表示，使其更加紧凑。

sentences.en: (I also looked into supporting byte compiled code at bootstrap time, which would probably reduce the size of the system a lot, but that looked too complicated, so I punted for now.)
sentences.zh: （我还研究了在引导时支持字节编译代码，这可能会大大减少系统的大小，但这看起来太复杂了，所以我现在就放弃了。）

blocks.html_en: • The maximum signal nesting depth in the src/runtime/ support code has been reduced from 4096 to 256. (I don't know any reason for the very large old value. If the new smaller value turns out to break something, I'll probably just bump it back up.)

sentences.en: The maximum signal nesting depth in the src/runtime/ support code has been reduced from 4096 to 256.
sentences.zh: src/runtime/ 支持代码中的最大信号嵌套深度已从 4096 减少到 256。

sentences.en: (I don't know any reason for the very large old value.
sentences.zh: （我不知道旧值很大的任何原因。

sentences.en: If the new smaller value turns out to break something, I'll probably just bump it back up.)
sentences.zh: 如果新的较小值被证明会破坏某些东西，我可能会将其恢复原样。）

blocks.html_en: • PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK is now pickier about the types of its arguments, as per ANSI.

sentences.en: PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK is now pickier about the types of its arguments, as per ANSI.
sentences.zh: 根据 ANSI，PPRINT-LOGICAL-BLOCK 现在对其参数类型更加挑剔。

blocks.html_en: • Many, many bugs reported by Peter Van Eynde have been added to the BUGS list; some have even been fixed.

sentences.en: Many, many bugs reported by Peter Van Eynde have been added to the BUGS list; some have even been fixed.
sentences.zh: Peter Van Eynde 报告的许多错误已添加到错误列表中；有些甚至已经得到修复。

blocks.html_en: • While enabling dynamic object file loading, I tried to make the code easier to understand, renaming various functions and variables with less ambiguous names, and changing some function calling conventions to be Lispier (e.g. returning NIL instead of 0 for failure).

sentences.en: While enabling dynamic object file loading, I tried to make the code easier to understand, renaming various functions and variables with less ambiguous names, and changing some function calling conventions to be Lispier (e.g. returning NIL instead of 0 for failure).
sentences.zh: 在启用动态目标文件加载的同时，我尝试让代码更容易理解，用更明确的名称重命名各种函数和变量，并将一些函数调用约定更改为 Lispier（例如，失败时返回 NIL 而不是 0）。

blocks.html_en: • While trying to figure out how to do the OpenBSD port, I tried to clean up some of the code in src/runtime/. In particular, I dropped support for non-POSIX signal handling, added various comments, tweaked the code to reduce the number of compilation warnings, and renamed some files to increase consistency.

sentences.en: While trying to figure out how to do the OpenBSD port, I tried to clean up some of the code in src/runtime/.
sentences.zh: 在尝试弄清楚如何进行 OpenBSD 移植时，我尝试清理 src/runtime/ 中的一些代码。

sentences.en: In particular, I dropped support for non-POSIX signal handling, added various comments, tweaked the code to reduce the number of compilation warnings, and renamed some files to increase consistency.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我放弃了对非 POSIX 信号处理的支持，添加了各种注释，调整了代码以减少编译警告的数量，并重命名了一些文件以提高一致性。

blocks.html_en: • To support the new automatic configuration functionality in make.sh, the source file target-features.lisp-expr has been replaced with the source file base-target-features.lisp-expr and the machine-generated file local-target-features.lisp-expr.

sentences.en: To support the new automatic configuration functionality in make.sh, the source file target-features.lisp-expr has been replaced with the source file base-target-features.lisp-expr and the machine-generated file local-target-features.lisp-expr.
sentences.zh: 为了支持 make.sh 中新的自动配置功能，源文件 target-features.lisp-expr 已替换为源文件 base-target-features.lisp-expr 和机器生成的文件 local-target-features.lisp-expr。

blocks.html_en: • fixed a stupid quoting error in make.sh so that using CMU CL "lisp -batch" as cross-compilation host works again

sentences.en: fixed a stupid quoting error in make.sh so that using CMU CL "lisp -batch" as cross-compilation host works again
sentences.zh: 修复了 make.sh 中的一个愚蠢的引用错误，以便使用 CMU CL“lisp -batch”作为交叉编译主机再次工作

sentences.zh: 0.6.6版本新增

blocks.html_en: • DESCRIBE no longer tries to call itself recursively to describe bound/fbound values, so that it no longer fails on symbols which are bound to themselves (like keywords, T, and NIL).

sentences.en: DESCRIBE no longer tries to call itself recursively to describe bound/fbound values, so that it no longer fails on symbols which are bound to themselves (like keywords, T, and NIL).
sentences.zh: DESCRIBE 不再尝试递归地调用自身来描述绑定/fbound 值，因此它不再在绑定到自身的符号（如关键字、T 和 NIL）上失败。

blocks.html_en: • DESCRIBE now works on generic functions.

sentences.en: DESCRIBE now works on generic functions.
sentences.zh: DESCRIBE 现在适用于通用函数。

blocks.html_en: • The printer now prints less-screwed-up representations of closures (not naively trying to bogusly use the %FUNCTION-NAME accessor on them).

sentences.en: The printer now prints less-screwed-up representations of closures (not naively trying to bogusly use the %FUNCTION-NAME accessor on them).
sentences.zh: 打印机现在打印闭包的不太混乱的表示（不是天真地试图在它们上伪造使用 %FUNCTION-NAME 访问器）。

blocks.html_en: • A private symbol is used instead of the :EMPTY keyword previously used to mark empty slots in hash tables. Thus (DEFVAR *HT* (MAKE-HASH-TABLE)) (SETF (GETHASH :EMPTY *HT*) :EMPTY) (MAPHASH (LAMBDA (K V) (FORMAT T "~&~S ~S~%" K V))) now does what ANSI says that it should. (You can still get similar noncompliant behavior if bang on the hash table implementation with all the symbols you get back from DO-ALL-SYMBOLS, but at least that's a little harder to do.) This breaks binary compatibility, since tests for equality to :EMPTY are wired into things like the macroexpansion of WITH-HASH-TABLE-ITERATOR in FASL files produced by earlier implementations.

sentences.en: A private symbol is used instead of the :EMPTY keyword previously used to mark empty slots in hash tables.
sentences.zh: 使用私有符号代替之前用于标记哈希表中空槽的 :EMPTY 关键字。

sentences.en: Thus (DEFVAR *HT* (MAKE-HASH-TABLE)) (SETF (GETHASH :EMPTY *HT*) :EMPTY) (MAPHASH (LAMBDA (K V) (FORMAT T "~&~S ~S~%" K V))) now does what ANSI says that it should.
sentences.zh: 因此 (DEFVAR *HT* (MAKE-HASH-TABLE)) (SETF (GETHASH :EMPTY *HT*) :EMPTY) (MAPHASH (LAMBDA (K V) (FORMAT T "~&~S ~S~%" K V))) 现在执行 ANSI 所说的操作。

sentences.en: (You can still get similar noncompliant behavior if bang on the hash table implementation with all the symbols you get back from DO-ALL-SYMBOLS, but at least that's a little harder to do.)
sentences.zh: （如果使用从 DO-ALL-SYMBOLS 返回的所有符号来执行哈希表实现，您仍然可能会得到类似的不合规行为，但至少这有点难做到。）

sentences.en: This breaks binary compatibility, since tests for equality to :EMPTY are wired into things like the macroexpansion of WITH-HASH-TABLE-ITERATOR in FASL files produced by earlier implementations.
sentences.zh: 这破坏了二进制兼容性，因为与 :EMPTY 相等的测试被连接到早期实现生成的 FASL 文件中的WITH-HASH-TABLE-ITERATOR 宏扩展之类的内容中。

blocks.html_en: • There's now a minimal placeholder implementation for CL:STEP, as required by ANSI.

sentences.en: There's now a minimal placeholder implementation for CL:STEP, as required by ANSI.
sentences.zh: 现在，按照 ANSI 的要求，CL:STEP 有一个最小的占位符实现。

blocks.html_en: • An obscure bug in the interaction of the normal compiler, the byte compiler, inlining, and structure predicates has been patched by setting the flags for the DEFTRANSFORM of %INSTANCE-TYPEP as :WHEN :BOTH (as per Raymond Toy's suggestion on the cmucl-imp@cons.org mailing list).

sentences.en: An obscure bug in the interaction of the normal compiler, the byte compiler, inlining, and structure predicates has been patched by setting the flags for the DEFTRANSFORM of %INSTANCE-TYPEP as :WHEN :BOTH (as per Raymond Toy's suggestion on the cmucl-imp@cons.org mailing list).
sentences.zh: 普通编译器、字节编译器、内联和结构谓词交互中的一个不起眼的错误已通过将 %INSTANCE-TYPEP 的 DEFTRANSFORM 标志设置为 :WHEN :BOTH 进行了修补（根据 Raymond Toy 在 cmucl-imp@cons.org 邮件列表上的建议）。

blocks.html_en: • Missing ordinary arguments in a macro call are now detected even when the macro lambda list contains &KEY or &REST.

sentences.en: Missing ordinary arguments in a macro call are now detected even when the macro lambda list contains &KEY or &REST.
sentences.zh: 现在，即使宏 lambda 列表包含 &KEY 或 &REST，也会检测到宏调用中缺少的普通参数。

blocks.html_en: • The debugger no longer complains about encountering the top of the stack when you type "FRAME 0" to explicitly instruct it to go to the top of the stack. And it now prints the frame you request even if it's the current frame (instead of saying "You are here.").

sentences.en: The debugger no longer complains about encountering the top of the stack when you type "FRAME 0" to explicitly instruct it to go to the top of the stack.
sentences.zh: 当您键入“FRAME 0”显式指示调试器转到堆栈顶部时，调试器不再抱怨遇到堆栈顶部。

sentences.en: And it now prints the frame you request even if it's the current frame (instead of saying "You are here.").
sentences.zh: 现在，即使它是当前帧，它也会打印您请求的帧（而不是说“您在这里。”）。

blocks.html_en: • As specified by ANSI, the system now always prints keywords as #\: followed by SYMBOL-NAME, even when *PACKAGE* is the KEYWORD package.

sentences.en: As specified by ANSI, the system now always prints keywords as #\: followed by SYMBOL-NAME, even when *PACKAGE* is the KEYWORD package.
sentences.zh: 根据 ANSI 的规定，系统现在始终将关键字打印为 #\: 后跟 SYMBOL-NAME，即使 *PACKAGE* 是 KEYWORD 包也是如此。

blocks.html_en: • The default initial SIZE of HASH-TABLEs is now smaller.

sentences.en: The default initial SIZE of HASH-TABLEs is now smaller.
sentences.zh: 哈希表的默认初始大小现在更小了。

blocks.html_en: • Type information from CLOS class dispatch is now propagated into DEFMETHOD bodies, so that e.g. (DEFMETHOD FOO ((X SINGLE-FLOAT)) (+ X 123.0)) is now basically equivalent to (DEFMETHOD FOO ((X SINGLE-FLOAT)) (DECLARE (TYPE SINGLE-FLOAT X)) (+ X 123.0)) and the compiler can compile (+ X 123.0) as a SINGLE-FLOAT-only operation, without having to do run-time type dispatch.

sentences.en: Type information from CLOS class dispatch is now propagated into DEFMETHOD bodies, so that e.g. (DEFMETHOD FOO ((X SINGLE-FLOAT)) (+ X 123.0)) is now basically equivalent to (DEFMETHOD FOO ((X SINGLE-FLOAT)) (DECLARE (TYPE SINGLE-FLOAT X)) (+ X 123.0)) and the compiler can compile (+ X 123.0) as a SINGLE-FLOAT-only operation, without having to do run-time type dispatch.
sentences.zh: 来自 CLOS 类调度的类型信息现在传播到 DEFMETHOD 主体中，以便例如(DEFMETHOD FOO ((X SINGLE-FLOAT)) (+ X 123.0)) 现在基本上相当于 (DEFMETHOD FOO ((X SINGLE-FLOAT)) (DECLARE (TYPE SINGLE-FLOAT X)) (+ X 123.0)) 并且编译器可以将 (+ X 123.0) 编译为仅 SINGLE-FLOAT 操作，而不必执行运行时类型派遣。

blocks.html_en: • The macroexpansion of DEFMETHOD has been tweaked so that it has reasonable behavior when arguments are declared IGNORE or IGNORABLE.

sentences.en: The macroexpansion of DEFMETHOD has been tweaked so that it has reasonable behavior when arguments are declared IGNORE or IGNORABLE.
sentences.zh: DEFMETHOD 的宏展开已经过调整，因此当参数被声明为 IGNORE 或 IGNORABLE 时，它具有合理的行为。

blocks.html_en: • Since I don't seem to be making big file reorganizations very often any more (and since my archive of sbcl-x.y.zv.tar.bz2 snapshots is overflowing my ability to conveniently back them up), I've finally checked the system into CVS. (The CVS repository is on my home system, not at SourceForge -- putting it on SourceForge might come later.)

sentences.en: Since I don't seem to be making big file reorganizations very often any more (and since my archive of sbcl-x.y.zv.tar.bz2 snapshots is overflowing my ability to conveniently back them up), I've finally checked the system into CVS.
sentences.zh: 由于我似乎不再经常进行大文件重组（而且由于我的 sbcl-x.y.zv.tar.bz2 快照存档已经超出了我方便备份它们的能力），我最终将系统签入 CVS。

sentences.en: (The CVS repository is on my home system, not at SourceForge -- putting it on SourceForge might come later.)
sentences.zh: （CVS 存储库位于我的家庭系统上，而不是在 SourceForge 上——稍后可能会将其放在 SourceForge 上。）

blocks.html_en: • SB-EXT:*GC-NOTIFY-STREAM* has been added, to control where the high-level GC-NOTIFY-FOO functions send their output. (There's still very little control of where low-level verbose GC functions send their output.) The SB-EXT:*GC-VERBOSE* variable now controls less than it used to -- the GC-NOTIFY-FOO functions are now under the control of *GC-NOTIFY-STREAM*, not *GC-VERBOSE*.

sentences.en: SB-EXT:*GC-NOTIFY-STREAM* has been added, to control where the high-level GC-NOTIFY-FOO functions send their output.
sentences.zh: 添加了 SB-EXT:*GC-NOTIFY-STREAM*，以控制高级 GC-NOTIFY-FOO 函数将其输出发送到的位置。

sentences.en: (There's still very little control of where low-level verbose GC functions send their output.)
sentences.zh: （对于低级详细 GC 函数发送输出的位置仍然几乎没有控制。）

sentences.en: The SB-EXT:*GC-VERBOSE* variable now controls less than it used to -- the GC-NOTIFY-FOO functions are now under the control of *GC-NOTIFY-STREAM*, not *GC-VERBOSE*.
sentences.zh: SB-EXT:*GC-VERBOSE* 变量现在的控制量比以前少 — GC-NOTIFY-FOO 函数现在由 *GC-NOTIFY-STREAM* 控制，而不是 *GC-VERBOSE*。

blocks.html_en: • The system now stores the version string (LISP-IMPLEMENTATION-VERSION) in only one place in the source code, and propagates it automatically everywhere that it's needed. Thus e.g. when I bump the version from 0.6.6 to 0.6.7, I'll only need to modify the sources in one place.

sentences.en: The system now stores the version string (LISP-IMPLEMENTATION-VERSION) in only one place in the source code, and propagates it automatically everywhere that it's needed.
sentences.zh: 系统现在仅将版本字符串 (LISP-IMPLMENTATION-VERSION) 存储在源代码中的一处，并自动将其传播到需要的任何地方。

sentences.en: Thus e.g. when I bump the version from 0.6.6 to 0.6.7, I'll only need to modify the sources in one place.
sentences.zh: 因此例如当我将版本从 0.6.6 升级到 0.6.7 时，我只需要修改一处源代码。

blocks.html_en: • The C source files now include boilerplate legalese and documentation at the head of each file (just as the Lisp source files already did).

sentences.en: The C source files now include boilerplate legalese and documentation at the head of each file (just as the Lisp source files already did).
sentences.zh: C 源文件现在在每个文件的头部包含样板法律术语和文档（就像 Lisp 源文件已经做的那样）。

blocks.html_en: • At Dan Barlow's suggestion, the hyperlink from the SBCL website to his page will be replaced with a link to his new CLiki service.

sentences.en: At Dan Barlow's suggestion, the hyperlink from the SBCL website to his page will be replaced with a link to his new CLiki service.
sentences.zh: 根据 Dan Barlow 的建议，从 SBCL 网站到他的页面的超链接将替换为他的新 CLiki 服务的链接。

blocks.html_en: • The build process now looks for GNU make under the default name "gmake", instead of "make" as it used to. If GNU make is not available as "gmake" on your system, you can change this default behavior by setting the GNUMAKE environment variable.

sentences.en: The build process now looks for GNU make under the default name "gmake", instead of "make" as it used to.
sentences.zh: 构建过程现在在默认名称“gmake”下查找 GNU make，而不是像以前那样使用“make”。

sentences.en: If GNU make is not available as "gmake" on your system, you can change this default behavior by setting the GNUMAKE environment variable.
sentences.zh: 如果 GNU make 在您的系统上不能作为“gmake”使用，您可以通过设置 GNUMAKE 环境变量来更改此默认行为。

sentences.en: Replace #+SB-DOC with #!+SB-DOC in seq.lisp so that the system can build without error under CMU CL.
sentences.zh: 将 seq.lisp 中的 #+SB-DOC 替换为 #!+SB-DOC，这样系统就可以在 CMU CL 下正确编译。

blocks.html_en: • There is now a partial SBCL user manual (with some new text and some text cribbed from the CMU CL manual).

sentences.en: There is now a partial SBCL user manual (with some new text and some text cribbed from the CMU CL manual).
sentences.zh: 现在有部分 SBCL 用户手册（其中有一些新文本和一些抄自 CMU CL 手册的文本）。

blocks.html_en: • The beginnings of a profiler have been added (starting with the CMU CL profiler and simplifying and cleaning up). Eventually the main interface should be through the TRACE macro, but for now, it's still accessed through vaguely CMU-CL-style functions and macros exported from the package SB-PROFILE.

sentences.en: The beginnings of a profiler have been added (starting with the CMU CL profiler and simplifying and cleaning up).
sentences.zh: 添加了分析器的开头部分（从 CMU CL 分析器开始并进行简化和清理）。

sentences.en: Eventually the main interface should be through the TRACE macro, but for now, it's still accessed through vaguely CMU-CL-style functions and macros exported from the package SB-PROFILE.

blocks.html_en:
• Some problems left over from porting CMU CL to the new cross-compilation bootstrap process have been cleaned up:
    • DISASSEMBLE now works. (There was a problem in using DEFMACRO instead of SB!XC:DEFMACRO, compounded by an oversight on my part when getting rid of the compiler *BACKEND* stuff.)
    • The value of *NULL-TYPE* was screwed up, because it was being initialized before the type system knew the final definition of the 'NULL type. This screwed up several key optimizations in the compiler, causing inefficiency in all sorts of places. (I found it because I wanted to understand why GET-INTERNAL-RUN-TIME was consing.)

sentences.en: Some problems left over from porting CMU CL to the new cross-compilation bootstrap process have been cleaned up: DISASSEMBLE now works.
sentences.zh: 将 CMU CL 移植到新的交叉编译引导程序过程中遗留的一些问题已得到解决： DISASSSEMBLE 现在可以工作。

sentences.en: (There was a problem in using DEFMACRO instead of SB!XC:DEFMACRO, compounded by an oversight on my part when getting rid of the compiler *BACKEND* stuff.)
sentences.zh: （使用 DEFMACRO 而不是 SB!XC:DEFMACRO 时存在问题，由于我在删除编译器 *BACKEND* 内容时的疏忽而变得更加复杂。）

sentences.en: The value of *NULL-TYPE* was screwed up, because it was being initialized before the type system knew the final definition of the 'NULL type.
sentences.zh: *NULL-TYPE*​​ 的值被搞砸了，因为它是在类型系统知道“NULL 类型”的最终定义之前就被初始化的。

sentences.en: This screwed up several key optimizations in the compiler, causing inefficiency in all sorts of places.
sentences.zh: 这搞砸了编译器中的几个关键优化，导致各个地方效率低下。

sentences.en: (I found it because I wanted to understand why GET-INTERNAL-RUN-TIME was consing.)
sentences.zh: （我发现它是因为我想了解为什么 GET-INTERNAL-RUN-TIME 是 consing。）

blocks.html_en: • The system still can't cross-compile itself with *TYPE-SYSTEM-INITIALIZED* (and all the consistency checks that entails), but at least it can compile more of itself that way than it used to be able to, and various buglets which were uncovered by trying to cross-compile itself that way have now been fixed.

sentences.en: The system still can't cross-compile itself with *TYPE-SYSTEM-INITIALIZED* (and all the consistency checks that entails), but at least it can compile more of itself that way than it used to be able to, and various buglets which were uncovered by trying to cross-compile itself that way have now been fixed.
sentences.zh: 系统仍然无法使用*TYPE-SYSTEM-INITIALIZED*（以及所有需要的一致性检查）进行自身交叉编译，但至少它可以比以前能够以这种方式编译更多的自身，并且通过尝试以这种方式交叉编译自身而发现的各种 buglet 现在已经得到修复。

blocks.html_en: • *RANDOM-STATE* is no longer automatically initialized from (GET-UNIVERSAL-TIME), but instead from a constant seed. Thus, the default behavior of the system is to repeat its behavior every time it's run. If you'd like to change this behavior, you can always explicitly set the seed from (GET-UNIVERSAL-TIME); whereas under the old convention there was no comparably easy way to get the system to repeat its behavior every time it was run.

blocks.html_en: • The quantifiers SOME, EVERY, NOTANY, and NOTEVERY no longer cons when the types of their sequence arguments can be determined at compile time. This is done through a new open code expansion for MAP which eliminates consing for (MAP NIL ..), and reduces consing otherwise, when sequence argument types can be determined at compile time.

sentences.zh: 这是通过 MAP 的新开放代码扩展来完成的，它消除了 (MAP NIL ..) 的 consing，并在编译时确定序列参数类型时减少了 consing。

blocks.html_en: • The optimizer now transforms COERCE into an identity operation when it can prove that the coerced object is already of the correct type. (This can be a win for machine generated code, including the output of other optimization transforms, such as the MAP transform above.)
